jobs.title: Backend Engineer — High-Volume Data Processing
jobs.description: **Location:** Dumbo, Brooklyn, NY **Work Arrangement:** Onsite, 5 days per week (required) **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Base Salary:** $220,000–$300,000 **Equity:** Competitive equity package **Visa:** Open to OPT and H\-1B transfers; additional sponsorship may be considered **Relocation:** Up to $10,000 in relocation assistance **About the Opportunity** A rapidly growing AI and data company is building the data infrastructure that powers next\-generation AI models. The company works with proprietary enterprise data, transforming information generated through real\-world business operations into de\-identified datasets for leading AI research organizations. Having grown from $0 to a multi\-eight\-figure annualized run rate within months, the business is scaling rapidly with a lean engineering team of approximately five people. This is an opportunity to join at an early stage, take meaningful ownership of mission\-critical systems, and directly influence the architecture and reliability of a high\-impact data\-processing platform. The team is seeking a **Backend Engineer** to build and evolve the systems that transform sensitive enterprise information into high\-quality, AI\-training\-ready datasets. **The core focus is on the processing logic applied to the data itself**, rather than traditional data engineering, ETL, or infrastructure work centered primarily on moving data between systems. **What You\#39;ll Do** * Design, build, and scale multi\-stage, high\-volume data\-processing pipelines that de\-identify sensitive enterprise data from collaboration tools, email, cloud storage, code repositories, and project\-management systems. * Own backend systems end\-to\-end, from architecture and implementation through debugging, correctness validation, production monitoring, and recovery. * Develop safeguards to detect silent failures, duplicate outputs, stale data, and other data\-quality issues before customer delivery. * Build reliable mechanisms for retries, checkpoints, partial failures, replay, backfills, and rollbacks across asynchronous workflows, batch workers, queues, and object storage. * Develop internal tools and dashboards to monitor pipeline performance, investigate data quality, and inform release decisions. * Partner with ML, full\-stack, platform, and security engineers to support new data modalities and expand processing capabilities. * Improve the reliability, observability, and scalability of systems handling complex and sensitive datasets. **What We\#39;re Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * **3–10 years of software engineering experience**, with direct ownership of production backend systems. * Demonstrated experience shipping and operating production software, ideally involving multi\-stage, high\-volume data\-processing pipelines. * **Relevant undergraduate STEM degree from a top\-30 U.S. institution.** * Strong understanding of distributed and asynchronous backend systems, including: * + Queues, workers, and concurrency + Idempotency and retry strategies + Partial failures and fault tolerance + Recovery, replay, and data consistency * Meaningful full\-time experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup, with demonstrated ownership, adaptability, and comfort operating in ambiguous environments. * Strong proficiency in a general\-purpose backend programming language. * Ability and willingness to work onsite five days per week in Dumbo, Brooklyn, NY. **Important:** The undergraduate education requirement and five\-day onsite requirement are firm. Candidates who do not meet both criteria will not be considered. **Technical Environment** The current technology stack includes: **Python, AWS, Airflow, AWS Batch, SQS, S3, DynamoDB, and PostgreSQL** Python experience is not mandatory. Strong backend engineers with experience in **Go, Rust, Java, or other general\-purpose languages** are encouraged to apply. Particularly relevant technical experience includes: * AWS and cloud\-based backend systems * Batch processing and workflow orchestration * Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Named Entity Recognition (NER) * Distributed systems and asynchronous processing * Data quality, correctness, and production reliability * Internal tooling, monitoring, and observability The team values engineers who think beyond implementation. Ideal candidates enjoy understanding how data\-processing systems behave, building tools to investigate performance and quality, diagnosing complex failures, and solving problems across the entire workflow. A backend\-focused engineer with some full\-stack experience can also be a strong fit. **Experience That Stands Out** Candidates may be particularly well suited to this role if they bring: * Experience at a highly regarded engineering organization combined with meaningful startup experience. * A clear record of career progression and increasing technical ownership. * Hands\-on AWS experience. * Experience building or operating batch\-processing pipelines and workflow orchestration systems. * Experience developing internal tools, dashboards, or observability systems for data\-processing workflows. * A strong understanding of production failure modes, data correctness, recovery strategies, and system reliability. * The ability to take a broad, ambiguous problem and deliver a reliable end\-to\-end solution. **Who May Not Be a Fit** This position is less suited to candidates whose experience is primarily focused on: * Traditional data engineering, data platforms, or infrastructure work centered on moving data between systems. * ETL development using tools such as Databricks, without substantial ownership of the underlying processing logic. * Frontend\-heavy full\-stack development without significant backend engineering depth. * Large\-company engineering environments without meaningful early\-stage or high\-growth startup experience, unless the candidate\#39;s technical background is directly relevant. * Startup exposure limited mainly to internships or short\-term engagements. **Team amp; Culture** You\#39;ll join a small, high\-performing engineering team operating in a fast\-moving environment with significant customer demand and substantial room to influence the product and technical direction. The team emphasizes: * **First\-principles problem\-solving:** Understand the underlying challenge and build the right solution. * **Ownership and accountability:** Take responsibility for systems and outcomes from start to finish. * **Bias toward action:** Move quickly, experiment, and learn through execution. * **Engineering excellence:** Deliver reliable, high\-quality work that meets a high technical bar. * **Humility and collaboration:** Support teammates, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals. * **Outcome\-driven execution:** Prioritize meaningful results over activity or output alone. With a very small engineering team, this role offers significant responsibility, close collaboration, and the opportunity to help shape critical systems as the business scales. **Compensation amp; Benefits** * **Base Salary:** $220,000–$300,000 * **Equity:** Competitive equity package * **Medical, Dental amp; Vision:** 100% covered * **Paid Time Off:** Unlimited PTO * **Relocation Assistance:** Up to $10,000 **Visa amp; Relocation Support** The company is open to visa transfers, including **OPT and H\-1B transfers**. Additional visa sponsorship may be considered for exceptional candidates, depending on individual circumstances. Sponsorship is not guaranteed and will be evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis. Candidates relocating to New York may be eligible for up to $10,000 in relocation assistance. **Interview Process** The following stages begin after a candidate has been submitted to the hiring team. Agency screening and the initial resume review are not counted as interview stages. **Stage 1 — Introductory Call (30 minutes)** A conversation with the hiring manager covering your background, motivations, experience, and alignment with the role. **Stage 2 — System Design (1 hour)** A distributed\-systems and data\-processing exercise focused on architecture, technical tradeoffs, scalability, and correctness in high\-volume backend pipelines. **Stage 3 — Take\-Home Technical Assessment (A few hours)** An independent, practical backend coding exercise evaluating engineering fundamentals and hands\-on problem\-solving. The engineering team will review the completed submission. **Stage 4 — Final Onsite Interviews (2 hours)** An onsite session at the Dumbo, Brooklyn office with engineering and leadership. The final round evaluates technical depth, problem\-solving, and team fit while giving candidates an opportunity to meet the team and learn more about the business. **Travel Support:** Candidates who are not currently based in New York will be flown in and provided with accommodation for the final onsite interview.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Developer Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Valon is building the AI\-native operating system for regulated finance, starting with mortgage servicing. We're a Series C company backed by a16z, transforming industries that others have written off as too complex to innovate. Rather than build on top of broken legacy systems, we took a different approach: we built and operate our own mortgage servicing business managing $110\+ billion in loans. This wasn't the end goal, it was how we deeply understood the complexity needed to build software that actually works in regulated industries. The results speak for themselves. We've transformed mortgage servicing from a 0% margin business into 60%\+ margins while dramatically improving customer experience. Major enterprise contracts are now deploying across the industry. ValonOS is our unified platform that makes every process structured and programmable and it is perfectly positioned for the AI era. When everything flows through one system with rich data, AI agents don't just automate tasks, they continuously improve entire operations. Mortgage servicing is just the beginning of our vision to transform regulated industries and beyond. ### **Engineering at Valon** Our engineering team powers a modern software ecosystem designed to disrupt one of the most outdated and heavily regulated industries in finance: mortgage servicing. We have built the foundation of a scalable platform capable of managing billions in assets with precision and reliability. Now we are focused on scaling infrastructure, improving developer experience, and building high\-leverage systems that support rapid product iteration and long\-term business growth. We are a tight\-knit, high\-agency group of engineers from Stripe, Jane Street, Meta, and Google, and we aim to do the best work of our lives—together. Our headquarters are in New York City, with a satellite San Francisco office that opened last year. We also fully support remote work. ### **About the Role** We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Developer Infrastructure team on the Platform organization. You will manage and grow a high\-impact team responsible for the systems that shape how every Valon engineer builds, tests, ships, and operates software. You will treat developer infrastructure as a product: understand the needs of engineering teams, define a clear roadmap, and make the common path fast, safe, observable, and pleasant. Your scope will span internal developer tooling such as local development, test infrastructure, CI/CD, release workflows, monitoring and observability, engineering standards, and AI\-enabled tools. You will partner closely with application, data, security, and operations teams to make the entire software lifecycle more reliable and productive. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will guide architecture decisions, write code or debug systems when needed, and stay close to the developer experience you are improving. You will also be a people\-first leader focused on recruiting, coaching, giving feedback, and helping engineers thrive through 360\-degree feedback and continuous development. Examples of work on the roadmap include: * Making integration tests easy to create, discover, and run in CI. * Enabling safe online database schema migrations via Vitess. * Ensuring web clients are compatible with the GraphQL schema before deployment, and vice versa. * Reducing local setup time and improving the reliability of development environments. * Building actionable observability and release feedback loops that help engineers diagnose and fix issues quickly. * Adopting AI tooling that improves engineering throughput while preserving quality, security, and appropriate controls. ### **Responsibilities** * Lead and grow a team of engineers focused on developer infrastructure, platform tooling, and internal developer experience. * Own technical strategy, planning, and execution for the developer platform, with an emphasis on reliability, security, usability, and measurable productivity gains. * Act as a strong technical mentor and hands\-on contributor when needed—guiding architecture, writing code, and debugging systems. * Partner with engineering leaders and teams across the company to understand friction points and deliver high\-leverage improvements. * Build effective mechanisms for prioritization, platform adoption, service ownership, and continuous feedback from internal customers. * Establish and evolve engineering processes that improve velocity, quality, and operational readiness. * Invest in recruiting and developing talent through coaching, mentorship, and ongoing feedback. * Promote a high\-agency, high\-accountability culture with clear communication and pragmatic decision\-making. ### **Ideal Background** * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years leading and developing engineering teams. * Experience building or operating developer platforms, internal tools, CI/CD systems, test infrastructure, release automation, or observability systems. * Strong systems thinking and an understanding of how developer workflows, application architecture, and production infrastructure fit together. * Hands\-on experience with cloud providers such as AWS or GCP, containerization such as Docker or Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and modern observability stacks. * A product mindset and the ability to translate internal customer needs into simple, scalable technical solutions. * Track record of leading teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments and aligning partners around a shared roadmap. * Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow engineers while fostering a high\-performance, feedback\-driven team culture. * Excellent communication skills and a bias toward action, learning, and continuous improvement. ### **Benefits** * Competitive salary with meaningful equity and a 401(k) plan. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Pre\-tax commuter benefits for transportation, rideshare, and parking. * Company\-wide onboarding, career development, and regular review cycles with 360\-degree feedback. * Quarterly budgets for team activities, swag, dinners, and more. * Flexible PTO, sick days, and 11 company holidays. * 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents. *Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from* *valon.com* *email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.* *Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. jobs.title: Flight Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Flight Systems Engineering and Test** SiFly Aviation · Santa Clara, CA · Onsite · Full\-time At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical\-takeoff, long\-endurance drones that deliver helicopter\-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA\-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast. **The role** We fly a lot – and are building methodical ways of turning data from flights into evolved control system decisions. You’ll design test flight campaigns for the questions we need to answer and develop instrumentation that produces trustworthy data. You’ll drive and develop dashboards that tell us whether weight, performance, and reliability are moving the right way. You'll also be a large part of how we tune and validate changes to PX4 — configuration and code — and how the resulting data gets back to the engineers who need it. **What you'll do** * Plan and execute test campaigns end to end — objectives, success criteria, test cards, instrumentation, and safety and site coordination. * Choose the right validation modality for each question: simulation, log replay, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, ground test, or flight. Spend flight time on the highest\-value learning. * Tune and test changes to PX4 — parameters, control and estimation tuning, and configuration — and validate them in the air. * Analyze flight logs and telemetry to diagnose issues across firmware, hardware, and companion computers. * Build and maintain test infrastructure: benches, HIL setups, instrumentation, and the data pipelines and dashboards behind them. * Own the progression from bench test, through integrated ground runs, to flight — and the anomaly reports and configuration records that make a campaign reconstructable. * Generate the flight test evidence used in SiFly’s FAA submissions. * Find, build, and share AI\-assisted approaches to this work — log analysis, test data reduction, reporting — and bring the team along with what works. **What we're looking for** * Hands\-on flight test or systems test on real aircraft, manned or unmanned. You build test setups, not just operate them. * You've closed the loop from controls systems or flight data back into autopilot parameters or code, repeatedly, on real equipment. * Estimation and control fundamentals: coordinate frames, Kalman filtering and sensor fusion, PID analysis. * Data analysis and scripting — Python or equivalent — for reducing test data into something people act on. * Comfortable at the aircraft: instrumentation, harnessing, and debugging on the flight line. * Ability to obtain and use FAA Part 107 certification if not already certified. * First\-principles thinking and a drive to understand the “why” behind traditional approaches to propulsion, power systems, and even radio technologies. * This is a hands\-on job at a company that is still small. You'll be at the bench, in the shop, on the flight line, and sometimes at a customer site working out why a deployed system is misbehaving — alongside new product development. * You use AI as a real tool, not a talking point. We want to hear one specific example of something you did with AI that surprised you — a workflow you rebuilt, a problem you came at sideways, an analysis that wouldn't have been worth doing by hand. We care less about which tools you use than about what you've changed about how you work. We're enthusiastic about the leverage and unforgiving about errors. **Nice to have** * Existing FAA Part 107 certification and real drone piloting or field\-testing experience. * Flight test instrumentation design — sensors, DAQ, wiring and installation for test. * ROS 2, MAVSDK, Linux companion computers; safety risk management process for flight testing. **Details** * Onsite in Santa Clara, CA. * Small team, high ownership, and real hardware in the building.

jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to turn ideas into physical parts, and to turn the making of those parts into a repeatable process. Almost nothing we build can be bought, so we need to build our own as one\-off or low\-volume production. You will own that work: design it, build it, test it, scale it. This is a hands\-on lab role with significant breadth: CAD in the morning, soldering in the afternoon, and Python scripting in between. We expect you to use AI coding tools to develop automations and bespoke tools to improve efficiency. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design and iterate mechanical part design in CAD, for example probe housings, mounts, fixtures, enclosures, and lab hardware. * Own our 3D printing: run and maintain the printers, dial in materials and profiles, manage the queue, and keep turnaround measured in hours. * Build the workflow and automation around 3D printing and CNC, for example scripted slicing and job submission, print farm monitoring, CAM setup, revision control, and part tracking. * Develop processes for low\-volume part production, for example mold design and fabrication, casting, potting, bonding, finishing, and the jigs and fixtures those processes need. * Do the work that makes hardware real: fine\-pitch and through\-hole soldering, cable and harness assembly, routing, and careful assembly of delicate parts. * Build and maintain test fixtures and benchtop setups, and keep lab equipment calibrated, organized, and working. * Write Python to glue the shop together: automation, instrument control, data logging, and part and inventory tracking. * Support the team’s everyday hardware needs, for example specifying and ordering equipment, setting up workstations and lab machines, and keeping the shop stocked. * Work directly with our imaging scientists and research team to understand how each part will actually be used. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Working proficiency in CAD: parametric modeling, assemblies, drawings, and design for manufacturing. * Hands\-on 3D printing experience, for example tuning, troubleshooting, and repair, plus the judgment to know when a part should be printed, machined, or molded. * Strong technician skills: comfortable soldering both boards and wire, building clean harnesses, and assembling precision hardware without breaking it. * Demonstrated experience with Python. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to write a real script, for example file handling, an API call, a serial interface, some data wrangling, without it being a project. * Fluent with AI coding tools and comfortable vibe coding your way to working tooling. * A bias toward building, testing, and improving over designing to completion first. * Self\-directed and self\-motivated, with the ability to execute on a goal rather than a step\-by\-step guide. **Nice to have** * PCB layout experience, particularly in Altium. * CNC machining experience, for example CAM programming, fixturing, workholding. * IT and lab infrastructure work, for example specifying and ordering computers, installing software, and managing network and lab equipment. * Personal projects, a shop of your own, robotics or FSAE, or other evidence that you build things unprompted. * Prior work in a startup or small team, or other evidence of thriving without much scaffolding. **What we offer** ----------------- * Real ownership of the hardware this company runs on, with a direct path to growing into a senior or lead role as the team scales. * A shop you get to build. We buy the equipment and tooling; you decide what we need and how it runs. * Direct collaboration with our imaging scientists and research team, and with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Work on a modality early enough that the tooling does not exist yet. Much of what you build will be the first of its kind. * Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k). Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: ML/AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an ML/AI Engineer to own and scale key parts of the models and infrastructure behind our neural decoding pipeline, from raw functional ultrasound acquisition through image reconstruction, preprocessing, and decoding. This role sits at the frontier of two rapidly converging fields: neural decoding and foundation models. Recent work has shown that brain activity can be mapped into the latent spaces of pretrained deep learning models to reconstruct visual perception and continuous language with remarkable fidelity. This has been demonstrated with fMRI, in research settings. Your job is to bring these techniques to functional ultrasound: a modality with superior spatial and temporal resolution, portability, and a path to consumer deployment. This is a hands\-on role with an unusual amount of surface area. You will scope and lead projects from open question to result with a high degree of independence, and help set the technical direction of our decoding work. You will report to our ML/AI Engineering Lead. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design, implement, train, and evaluate models across the pipeline: fUSI reconstruction, signal preprocessing, and downstream decoding, and own the results for the components you lead. * Drive the experimental agenda for your area: form and test hypotheses about why a model is not learning, design ablations, and tune architectures, losses, and training schedules, then turn what you find into decisions the team can act on. * Extend models to new data regimes, for example new dimensionalities (2D to 3D volumetric), new probes, and new subjects, and build the preprocessing pipelines needed to normalize that data for training. * Own the training infrastructure: experiment tracking, config management, checkpointing, mixed\-precision and multi\-GPU training, and profiling, built well enough for the rest of the team to rely on. * Define the evaluation strategy: metrics, pre\-launch tests, and regression checks that tell us when a model is actually better. * Debug numerical and performance problems, for example NaNs under mixed precision, silent shape bugs, page\-cache thrashing, dead gradients, and GPU memory ceilings. * Build inference paths for full\-volume reconstruction and low\-latency real\-time decoding. * Work directly with our imaging scientists and neuroscientists to understand where the data comes from and what its artifacts mean, and help shape how future data is collected. * Track the relevant literature in neural operators, neuroimaging, and neural decoding, reproduce the results that matter to our roadmap, and propose where we should go next. * Review code and designs, and help onboard new engineers and interns as the team grows. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A PhD in machine learning, computer science, electrical engineering, computational neuroscience, physics, or a related field; or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in one of those fields plus 2 to 3 years of experience building and shipping machine learning systems in a research or product setting. * Strong Python and hands\-on PyTorch development (or an equivalent framework such as JAX or TensorFlow). * A track record of independently taking a model from a paper or a prototype to something that trains reliably on real data. * Evidence of owning an open\-ended technical problem end to end, such as a thesis, publications, open\-source work, or a shipped system. * Comfort with large numerical datasets, for example hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes, and memory\-mapped arrays. * Solid grounding in first principles, for example linear algebra and signal processing. * GPU proficiency: mixed precision, memory profiling, gradient checkpointing, and the ability to diagnose bottlenecks. * Strong software engineering practices: version control, testing, code review, and coding conventions. * Self\-directed and self\-motivated, with the ability to execute on a goal rather than a step\-by\-step guide. **Nice to have** * Experience with neural operators (FNO), implicit neural representations, or physics\-informed machine learning architectures. * Exposure to neural decoding, brain\-computer interfaces, or neuroimaging data. * Familiarity with complex\-valued neural networks or spectral methods. * Experience developing real\-time or low\-latency inference systems. * Distributed or multi\-GPU training at scale. * Publications at machine learning or neuroscience venues, or contributions to open\-source machine learning tooling. * Prior work in a startup or small team, or other evidence of thriving without much scaffolding. **What we offer** ----------------- * Real ownership of core technical infrastructure at a seed\-stage company, with a direct path to growing into a senior or lead role as the team scales. * Mentorship from our ML/AI Engineering Lead, and direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Work on a modality early enough that the tooling does not exist yet. Much of what you build will be the first of its kind. * Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k). Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Backend & AI Infra

jobs.description: **5C DATA CENTERS** **Join the Future of Digital Infrastructure** Are you a passionate ***Senior Cloud System Administrator*** looking to make a meaningful impact? kernel modules, and device drivers. * Troubleshoot system performance, boot failures, kernel issues, networking, storage, authentication, and security\-related problems. * Analyze logs and system metrics to diagnose crashes, kernel panics, resource constraints, and hardware\-related operating system failures. **Server Hardware, Firmware, and Out\-of\-Band Management** * Support enterprise problems related to VLANs, MTU mismatches, routing, DNS, packet loss, link degradation, and high\-availability configurations. * Collaborate on network deployments, upgrades, fabric stability investigations, and validation of infrastructure changes. **Storage and Filesystem Support** * Support and troubleshoot enterprise, distributed, and parallel storage platforms, including NFS, Lustre, and storage teams to resolve service\-impacting events and optimize workload performance. **Incident, Problem, and Change Management** * Lead and support incident response activities, coordinating troubleshooting efforts and communications during critical outages. * Conduct root\-cause analysis, develop corrective action plans, and track recurring issues through resolution. * Manage infrastructure changes by assessing risk, ensuring operational readiness, mai memory, storage, and network interfaces. * Experience troubleshooting hardware failures using operating\-system logs, BMC logs, vendor diagnostics, and hardware\-management tools. * Experience with NVIDIA drivers, CUDA compatibility, DCGM, Fabric Manager, nvidia\-smi, or related GPU\-management tools. * Working knowledge of Ethernet and high\-performance networking technologies such as InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, and NVIDIA/Mellanox adapters. * Experience with out\-of\-band management technologies such as Redfish, IPMI, iDRAC, or iLO. * Experience with one or more automation or scripting technologies, including Python, Bash, or Ansible. * Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, DCGM Exporter, or UFM. * Ability to troubleshoot across hardware, firmware, operating system, network, storage, and cluster\-management layers. * Experience working with incident, problem, change, and escalation\-management processes. * Ability to work effectively during production outages and high\-priority incidents. * Strong written documentation, communication, and customer\-service skills. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across distributed technical teams. * Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on\-call rotation. **Preferred infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration\-management platforms such as Terraform and Ansible. * Experience with Git\-based change control and CI/CD workflows for infrastructure automation. * Linux\+, CCNA, or equivalent practical experience. **Why Join 5C Data Centers?** At 5C, we believe great people build great companies. This is a Project Hire role without any guarantee of full time placement. **What You Will Do:** The Senior Production Systems Reliability Engineer (SPSRE) is responsible for automating production application processes in support of the production used by DKF to produce its digital production products. This includes the following: * Architect, deploy, and maintain Unreal Engine and Perforce P4 infrastructure on\-prem and in the cloud, including build, caching (DDC), and version\-control services. * Administer and scale Perforce P4 including depot design, replica/edge/proxy topology, and Helix Code Review, to support distributed animation and virtual\-production teams. * Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for Unreal Engine projects. * Support rendering and pipeline automation for Unreal\-based production animation, including integration with existing render orchestration workflows (e.g., AWS Deadline). * Deliver cloud native (AWS, Azure, GCP) and in\-house infrastructure solutions for a wide range of applications. * Responsible for the architecture, deployment, and support of CI/CD pipelines. * Migrating applications and servers between local and cloud platform deployments. * Manage, configure, and implement tools such as Terraform, Helm, GitLab, Docker, and Kubernetes. * Develop software to automate, monitor, and maintain deployed infrastructure. * Work closely with product developers to ensure new features have proper operational support and maintainability. * Responsible for implementing complex solutions to provide hosting services and platforms to various development teams and working in partnership with the team to help drive the standardization and operational support of infrastructure solutions to support the firm’s infrastructure needs. * Create, build, and deliver new technologies or platforms. This will include consultation, designing, building, and supporting development pipelines, automating infrastructure and operations, creating telemetry for monitoring, engineering high reliability, and reinforcing best practices to secure our company and guest data. * Design and development of front\-end applications as needed for automation and tools. * Work closely with the Software Development group to manage and develop tools for managing and automating hardware and software resources. * Generate reports and statistics for various systems using various analytical tools. * Automate and support physical and virtual environments for web and application servers for both production and development. * Participates in researching, testing and implementing optimized technical solutions for our production technology infrastructure and user base. * Provides 3rd tier, extended support to the Systems Engineering, Support Engineering and Software Development groups. * Performs technical administration functions and other miscellaneous technical special projects as assigned by department management. * Influences the direction of product and service development. **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * A minimum of 5 years of experience supporting high\-end graphics workflows. * A minimum of 5 years of experience supporting (advanced troubleshooting and configuration experience) Linux / UNIX, Mac OS, and Microsoft Windows\-based systems in a network environment. * A minimum of 5 years of experience working with network administration utilities. * Experience with Unreal Engine in an animation, live\-action, and/or virtual production environment. * Experience with Perforce P4 at an administrative level (server topology, replication, and Code Review). * Understanding of real\-time / production\-animation workflows and how Unreal integrates with DCC and render pipelines (Maya, Nuke, AWS Deadline). * Strong Linux/Unix/Windows administration background. * Previous work experience in a similar discipline (Cloud Engineer, Automation Engineer, Full Stack Engineer). * Strong experience with scripting and programming languages for Web App Development (Python, PowerShell, React, Reach, Rust, bash, etc.) * Ability to use a wide variety of open\-source technologies. * Cloud management platforms and services (experience with AWS, Azure, and Google GCP). This includes cloud migration strategies. * Experience with CI/CD tools (GitLab, Jenkins, etc.) and containerization/orchestration tools (Docker/Kubernetes). * Experience with Virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V, Docker) automation. * Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or an equivalent product. * Experience with infrastructure as code workflows in Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, etc. * Experience with MySQL and SQL databases. * Experience with Load Balancers (NginX, F5, AWS types). * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, production\-critical environment. * Knowledge of Active Directory and Identity Management services and their application integration (IDP, SAML, LDAP). * Experience with creative applications: ToonBoom, Maya, and Nuke are a plus. * Knowledge of pipeline automation and rendering with AWS Deadline. * Able to communicate technical information effectively, both written and verbally. * Must have a strong customer service orientation and have the ability to work with a diverse user community. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent work experience required. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT PROMPT.IO Inc.** Prompt.io Inc. is the winning and influence engine partnered with organizations of all size and scale to engage and activate supporters. Prompt.io Inc. is a non\-partisan company and we work with customers of all political stripes. We help companies, political campaigns, advocacy organizations, unions, nonprofits, and other mission\-driven organizations connect with their audiences through texting, and engagement tools. We're a growing tech company where individual contributions can have an outsized impact. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas, move with purpose, and are excited to help build what comes next. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Prompt.io Inc. is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design, build, and scale the technology that powers our platform. You'll take ownership of complex technical work, contribute to architecture and technical decisions, and partner closely with Product to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. We're looking for an experienced engineer with strong technical judgment who can take a problem from concept through production, navigate complex systems, and help raise the quality of the engineering team. You'll have meaningful influence over how we build while remaining hands\-on in the code. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design, build, test, and maintain scalable applications, services, and APIs. * Own complex technical projects from design and architecture through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. * Contribute to the architecture and technical direction of our SaaS platform. * Collaborate with Product to translate business and product needs into effective technical solutions. * Design and build reusable services, components, and patterns that improve the broader codebase. * Identify and address performance, scalability, reliability, and security challenges. * Work across front\-end, back\-end, and service layers as needed to solve complex problems. * Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs between immediate needs and long\-term maintainability. * Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive solutions to their root cause. * Provide thoughtful code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing that helps elevate the engineering team. * Contribute to improving engineering standards, practices, and processes. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** * 5\-7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience demonstrating Senior\-level scope and impact. * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science * Significant experience building and maintaining production SaaS or web applications. * Strong experience with Java and modern server\-side application development. * Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern web application development. * Strong experience designing and working with APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. * Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including designing and working with data\-intensive applications. * Experience developing and operating applications in cloud environments. * Strong understanding of application architecture, software design, testing, performance, scalability, security, and data protection. * Experience with Git and modern software development practices. * Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex technical problems and make sound technical decisions. * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across a fully remote team. **HOW YOU WORK** * You take ownership of complex problems and see them through from idea to production. * You make thoughtful technical decisions and can clearly communicate the tradeoffs behind them. * You're a creative problem solver who finds practical solutions when challenges arise. * You care about building systems that are reliable, scalable, secure, and maintainable. * You balance long\-term technical quality with the need to deliver value to customers. * You provide constructive feedback, share your knowledge, and help make the engineers around you more effective. * You work independently while knowing when collaboration will lead to a better outcome. **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience working in a startup or high\-growth technology environment. * Experience building and scaling SaaS products. * Experience with high\-volume applications, messaging systems, or distributed architectures. * Experience with communications or messaging technology. * Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to other engineers. **BENEFITS** **We believe great work starts with supporting great people.** Prompt.io Inc. offers a wide range of benefits, including a 401(k) match, health benefits for you and your family, unlimited flexible time off, philanthropic endeavors, annual team gatherings, professional development opportunities, and more. **COMPENSATION** The salary range for this position is **$125,000–$175,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. **A NOTE TO APPLICANTS** We don't expect every great candidate to check every box. If you're excited about the work and believe you can be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn't perfectly match every item above. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** Prompt.io Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States or Canada and not require sponsorship of a visa, unless otherwise specified in the posting.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Credit
jobs.description: Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. ### **THE ROLE** A collector borrows against a card sitting in our vault. We size the advance off its Alt Value, underwrite it, disburse the money, and manage the loan until the last dollar comes back or the collateral is released. Today too much of that path runs on people: manual approvals, hand\-checked disbursements, a triage queue that grows when a transfer goes sideways, and screens that don't always tell the borrower where their money is. Your job is to turn that into a product. You'll implement our new underwriting design hand in hand with our data scientists, automate the loan workflow end to end, own disbursement failures until they stop happening, and ship the borrower and operator experiences on top, built from our designs. This is a full\-stack seat: the same engineer who fixes the idempotency bug builds the screen that tells the borrower their funds are on the way. The north star: T7 (trailing 7\-day) Disbursement within SLA rate, with a target of 99%. Every underwriting change, automation, triage fix, and screen you ship either moves that number or protects it. Supporting KPIs: time from application to underwriting decision, share of loans that go from application to funded with no manual touch, disbursement exceptions per week, and support tickets asking "where is my money," driven toward zero. In lending, a disbursement that "probably went out" is a failure. The people who are great at this have owned a lending or payments product where it mattered, from the state machine to the pixels. They think in idempotency and reconciliation because they've been on the wrong side of both, and they care that the UI tells the truth about what the system is doing. ### **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The underwriting revamp.** We're redesigning how we underwrite cash advances and term loans, and you'll implement the new design end to end, working hand in hand with our data scientists. That means turning their models and credit policy into a production decisioning service: inputs computed reliably, every decision versioned and explainable, and every rule or model change shipped through shadow mode and backtests before it goes live. Done looks like the new logic deciding every application, with Data Science able to iterate on it without an engineering rewrite. * **The automated loan workflow.** Application, underwriting decision, offer, acceptance, disbursement, servicing, repayment, delinquency, and collateral release, modeled as an explicit state machine with every transition logged. Manual steps become rules, and rules become auditable. Done looks like a standard advance funding with no human in the loop, and a non\-standard one landing in front of the right person with the context already attached. * **Disbursement triage, fixed at the root.** Failed, duplicated, delayed, and stuck disbursements. You'll find out why each class of break happens (a retry without an idempotency key, a webhook that arrived out of order, a rail that returned after we marked it settled) and close it for good. Done looks like the triage queue shrinking week over week, with the T7 SLA rate to prove it. * **The borrower experience, built to design.** The cash advance offer, acceptance, disbursement status, repayment, payoff, and loan history screens across web and mobile, implemented faithfully from our designs and improved through what you learn in production. You own design fidelity, accessibility, and performance, and you make sure the status a borrower sees is the status the loan is actually in. * **Operator and triage tooling.** The internal console where Credit, Operations, and Support see every loan and disbursement, spot the stuck ones, and resolve them with the context already on screen. Watch what they do in spreadsheets today, then delete the spreadsheet. * **Loan servicing and money movement.** Scheduled auto\-pay, partial payments, payoff quotes, reversals, and the edge cases between them, over ACH, RTP, and wires. Every movement integrates cleanly with the ledger so it posts, reconciles, and has an owner. You'll work closely with the Ledger team and own the product consequences of settlement timing, not just the API call. * **Risk controls in the workflow.** Limits, holds, loan\-to\-value checks, and step\-up review triggered by risk signals rather than blanket friction. You'll know what each control costs in conversion. * **The bar.** Rigorous code reviews, clear technical docs, and mentorship for the rest of the Credit team. You'll be the team's closest partner to Design and Data Science. ### **WHAT GREAT LOOKS  . We ask. If you've built agents, wired up connectors, written skills or MCP servers, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on, lead with that. Name the artifact, not the tool. ### **WHAT YOU BRING** * 5\+ years building and scaling production applications across the stack: backend (Python, Postgres, AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure) and frontend (React, React Native, TypeScript). Both halves are load\-bearing here. * You've built or owned a lending, credit, or payments workflow in production. Loan origination, servicing, or disbursement, and you can explain a design decision you'd make differently now. * You've moved real money on real rails. ACH origination and returns, RTP or FedNow, wires, or equivalent. You know what an R01 is and why return windows matter to a disbursement. * Workflow and state\-machine design. You model long\-running processes explicitly, with retries, timeouts, compensation, and a clear audit trail. * Operational debugging instinct. You've taken over a noisy exception queue and made it quiet by fixing causes, not by adding alerts. * You've implemented complex designs faithfully and quickly, and you can talk a designer through a trade\-off without losing the intent. * Database mastery. Expert SQL and relational design, and transactions that hold under load during scheduled auto\-pay batches. * API\-native. Webhooks, idempotency, eventual consistency, and reconciliation are your default vocabulary. * Product\-owner thinking. You understand the flow of funds and how to tell a worried borrower exactly where their money is. * Pragmatism. You know when a queue and a lambda are the answer and when they are three new partial\-failure modes. * You've implemented credit decisioning or underwriting logic in production alongside data scientists: turning a model or policy spec into a reliable, versioned, testable service, with shadow mode, backtesting, and a clean rollout. **Bonus:** workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions or similar); credit or risk modeling; direct experience with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, or Increase; asset\-backed or secured lending; design systems or internal tooling for operations teams; KYC/KYB, bank partnerships, or audit\-readiness exposure. You collect, or you have a view on where this market is going. ### **HOW WE'LL INTERVIEW YOU** We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and try selling. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. For this role, go through the cash advance flow: how an offer is presented, what happens after you accept, what you're told while you wait for funds, and where it made you hesitate. We will ask. * Recruiter screen, 30 minutes, Google Meet. Come ready to talk about the metric you own today and how you're performing against it, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll align on comp and answer your questions. * Hiring manager, Mina Quon, 30 minutes * Technical Assignment \- 45 minutes * Architecture and system design, 60 minutes. * Culture interview, 30 minutes. * Leore, our founder and CEO, 30 minutes. Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take Alt's credit product first. * Reference checks, 15 minutes with a former manager(s) . **Compensation:** $200,000 – $220,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $200K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Applied AI [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payers, and government agencies run their patient\-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre\-visit intake, care navigation, post\-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single\-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments, and not just one narrow use case. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you. **About this role** =================== Our Applied AI team is a group of forward deployed engineers (FDEs). They take Concurrence from signed contract to production at our customers, usually across several accounts at once. Each account has its own data, integrations, clinical workflows, and deadlines. This role reports to the Head of Applied AI. Our FDEs are excellent builders. What we need now is someone who makes the whole operation legible. That means knowing at any moment what every FDE is working on, what's at risk, what's blocked and why, and whether we'll hit what we've committed to. This is a hygiene role in the best sense. If work isn't tracked in Linear, we can't plan capacity, judge workloads, measure on\-time delivery, or help people get better at estimating and meeting dates. You'll make Linear the trustworthy source of truth for applied work. You'll do it with the follow\-through, judgment, and technical credibility that make engineers see it as useful rather than bureaucratic. You've been an engineer, and that matters. When an FDE says they're "blocked on platform," you need to know whether that's true. Is it a real platform gap, or applied\-side work that hasn't been done? You need to be able to push back credibly in either direction. Above all, you have *relentless* follow\-through. You don't let things drop, you don't wait to be asked, and you don't stop chasing until it's done. **What you'll own** =================== * **The cross\-account delivery plan.** You'll own the plan across every active deployment: dates, dependencies, FDE capacity, and risk. You're the person who sees conflicts coming two weeks before they hit. * **Linear as the source of truth.** You'll design how Applied AI works in Linear and then hold the team to it. That includes the project structure per account, labels that separate applied blockers from platform blockers, an estimation scale, and a shared definition of done. The result: tickets are current, statuses are honest, and due dates are set and met. * **Accountability on progress.** You'll check in on work before it becomes a surprise. You'll chase updates, surface slips early, and make sure nothing goes quiet. * **Capacity and workload.** You'll know how loaded every FDE really is. That includes the unplanned work that never shows up on a roadmap, like production issues, customer escalations, and safety reviews on live agents. You'll build plans with buffer grounded in real data. * **Fair delivery metrics.** You'll measure on\-time delivery, estimation accuracy, and how early risks get flagged. When something slips, you'll attribute it honestly to customer, platform, or applied causes, so people are judged on what they control. * **The field\-to\-platform loop.** You'll triage blockers between applied and platform, and turn field needs into well\-specified platform tickets. You'll spot patterns across accounts: when three FDEs build the same workaround, that's a platform feature. You'll work with platform leadership on priority and make sure fixes make it back to the account. * **Grounded commitments.** You'll partner with our deployment strategists, who own the day\-to\-day customer relationship, so that the dates we give customers reflect real capacity. * **A lightweight operating rhythm.** Think modern, nimble scrum master, without the dogma. You'l and the interface with platform. * **It isn't ceremony for its own sake.** If a meeting or process isn't producing better decisions, you kill it. **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've shipped software as an engineer before moving into program management, and you can still read code, follow a system design discussion, and reason about APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and LLM\-based systems well enough to evaluate a blocker yourself. * You've run delivery as a technical program manager, engineering manager, or delivery lead, including across multiple concurrent teams, customers, or deployments. * You've built a team's execution system from scratch, not just operated one someone else designed. * You're deeply fluent in Linear or a comparable tool, and you've used its API, integrations, or automations to make tracking cheaper for everyone. * You've measured delivery and estimation in a way engineers trusted, and you know how to keep those metrics from being gamed. * You earn engineers' respect rather than their tolerance. You're direct, you ask the uncomfortable question, and people still want you in the room. * You have *relentless* follow\-through. This is the job. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in healthcare or health IT, such as EHR integrations, hospital security reviews, clinical validation cycles, or HIPAA environments * Experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or professional services organization * Familiarity with Databricks or other modern data platforms **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $175K \- $230K

You'll work with platform leadership on priority and make sure fixes make it back to the account. * **Grounded commitments.** You'll partner with our deployment strategists, who own the day\-to\-day customer relationship, so that the dates we give customers reflect real capacity. * **A lightweight operating rhythm.** Think modern, nimble scrum master, without the dogma. You'l and the interface with platform. * **It isn't ceremony for its own sake.** If a meeting or process isn't producing better decisions, you kill it. **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've shipped software as an engineer before moving into program management, and you can still read code, follow a system design discussion, and reason about APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and LLM\-based systems well enough to evaluate a blocker yourself. * You've run delivery as a technical program manager, engineering manager, or delivery lead, including across multiple concurrent teams, customers, or deployments. * You've built a team's execution system from scratch, not just operated one someone else designed. * You're deeply fluent in Linear or a comparable tool, and you've used its API, integrations, or automations to make tracking cheaper for everyone. * You've measured delivery and estimation in a way engineers trusted, and you know how to keep those metrics from being gamed. * You earn engineers' respect rather than their tolerance. You're direct, you ask the uncomfortable question, and people still want you in the room. * You have *relentless* follow\-through. This is the job. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in healthcare or health IT, such as EHR integrations, hospital security reviews, clinical validation cycles, or HIPAA environments * Experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or professional services organization * Familiarity with Databricks or other modern data platforms **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. buses **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Test experience on aircraft, UAS, spacecraft, or automotive systems * Experience with real\-time simulation platforms such as Speedgoat, dSPACE, or NI * Experience with environmental testing to DO\-160 or MIL\-STD\-810 * Experience with actuators, motor controllers, or power systems * Experience with continuous integration jobs.description: ### **Description** **Location:** Remote; candidates must reside within two hours of Charlotte, NC. **Schedule:** Full\-time; Exempt. Relocation and per diem are not provided. **Why Join ORC?** **The Right Work. The Right People. The Right Culture.** Right of Way is where infrastructure meets innovation—shaping roads, utilities, and communities for the future. At ORC, we offer more than a job—we offer purpose, stability, and growth. You’ll join a team that values collaboration, workplace flexibility, and long\-term opportunity. **The Role** We’re looking for a hands\-on Software Engineer to help design and build applications, data solutions, and AI\-enabled capabilities that solve meaningful business problems. You’ll bring software development skills and experience or familiarity with Document AI, data warehousing, and modern data technologies. You’ll work directly with business stakeholders to understand their workflows and challenges, partner with the Software Development Manager to determine the right technical approach, then build, implement, and improve the solution. You’ll report to the Software Development Manager, who sets technical direction and architecture. This is primarily a hands\-on engineering role: approximately 80% of your time will focus on development, with the remainder spent collaborating with stakeholders and contributing to solution design. **What You’ll Do*** Design, develop, test, and implement software applications and technical solutions that address business needs. * Help design, build, and implement Document AI capabilities, contributing to pilots and broader rollout. * Design and develop data solutions involving warehouses, pipelines, integrations, and data shared across enterprise systems. * Work with business stakeholders and end users to understand workflows, pain points, and requirements. * Build, support, and improve solutions from development through production, with growing ownership over time. * Develop and maintain data transformations, integrations, and pipelines using SQL, dbt, Snowflake, APIs, and related tools and concepts. * Build applications and supporting services that bring data, automation, and AI capabilities into practical business workflows. * Identify opportunities to apply Document AI and automation to business workflows. * Contribute to technical design decisions with scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, and cost in mind. * Use prototypes and pilots to validate solutions before broader rollout. * Maintain software quality through testing, documentation, code review, source control, deployment practices, monitoring, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis. **What You’ll Bring*** 3–5 years of professional software development experience, with strong hands\-on coding skills and experience delivering production software. * Experience designing, building, and implementing software solutions through production deployment and ongoing improvement. * Experience with Document AI, intelligent document processing, OCR, data warehousing, or closely related technologies. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational data. * Experience or familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, data pipelines, data transformation, and data integration. * Experience designing or integrating APIs and connecting applications with systems and data sources. * Experience contributing to a small or collaborative engineering team and delivering solutions from design through implementation. * Experience working directly with business stakeholders or end users to translate needs into effective technical solutions. * Ability to navigate ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, evaluate approaches, and move work forward. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical decisions to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic databases. * An iOS or Android smartphone capable of accessing ORC systems. * Authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable application\-development technologies. * Experience building AI/ML or LLM\-enabled application features. * Experience in right\-of\-way, utilities, infrastructure, real estate, or professional services. **What Success Looks Like*** Develop a strong understanding of ORC’s business, systems, data, users, and operational workflows. * Contribute to designing and building ORC’s Document AI pilots and supporting their rollout. * Contribute to data warehousing, pipelines, and integration across systems. * Grow into owning technical solutions with increasing independence. * Build trusted relationships with stakeholders and turn their challenges into practical, maintainable software. * Deliver reliable software and data solutions that solve validated problems and are adopted by their users. * Build sound technical judgment about when to build, integrate, or automate. * Contribute to a small engineering team through ownership, clear communication, and hands\-on delivery. **What We Offer** This posting covers a single level. The pay range is $121,479– $140,916\. Every candidate is assessed and evaluated during the hiring process to determine their level based on factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. Your offer will reflect the level that best matches your experience.* Medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 401(k) with company match, plus disability coverage. * Paid time off, sick time, and paid holidays. * Tuition reimbursement and paid professional development. * ClassPass and Breethe memberships. * Recognition programs and room to grow. That’s the quick version — learn more about benefits at ORC.### **Ready to Apply?** Make your mark on projects that matter. Apply now to join a supportive team that invests in your future. Employees must avoid any relationship or activity that might impair, or even appear to impair, their ability to make objective and fair decisions when performing their jobs. To avoid conflicts of interest, employees are prohibited from performing any services for clients or perceived clients during nonworking time that are normally performed by ORC, including the sale of real estate. Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, it requires a combination of office\-based and field work. Employees will spend prolonged periods sitting and performing computer\-based tasks, including typing, data entry, and virtual communication, while also regularly traveling to landowner properties, project sites, and government facilities, some of which may be in rural or remote locations with limited accessibility. Driving is an essential function of the role and may involve extended periods and long\-distance travel. Fieldwork may require walking over uneven terrain, standing, or navigating outdoor environments, with routine exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, rain, and snow. The role also involves frequent interaction with a diverse range of individuals, including landowners, government officials, and members of the public, requiring the ability to communicate effectively and maintain professionalism across differing personalities and potentially challenging situations. Flexibility in scheduling is necessary to accommodate travel, site access, and stakeholder availability, along with adherence to safety protocols in both office and field settings.### **About O.R. Colan Associates (ORC)** Since 1969, ORC has been a leading ROW service provider for public agencies, utilities, and energy clients, driving responsible infrastructure progress nationwide. With over 400 experts across 30 offices in 18 states, headquartered in Charlotte, N.C., we’re committed to community\-focused solutions.
