jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a full\-stack Product Engineer to turn Pramaana’s research into products that customers and developers can use and trust. You’ll make complex reasoning accessible through intuitive interfaces and thoughtful developer experiences, helping users understand, inspect, and verify AI outputs. This is a hands\-on, early\-stage role spanning customer\-facing applications, developer APIs, and new product experiments. You won’t be confined to one feature or product. You’ll help discover what users need, build the experience across the stack, and improve it through real\-world use. You’ll work closely with product, design, engineering, and research, taking ownership of projects from the MVP through production. We’re looking for someone who cares about both how AI works and how people experience it \- and who enjoys making complex technology feel straightforward. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build complete product experiences.** Take problems from initial exploration to working software, owning the frontend, backend, data models, integrations, and testing needed to deliver a useful result. * **Create thoughtful, responsive interfaces.** Build workflows that help users bring in knowledge, review rules, ask questions, and inspect results and supporting evidence. Pay attention to interaction details, accessibility, loading states, and errors. * **Develop reliable APIs and services.** Build the systems behind document processing, asynchronous jobs, verification workflows, and customer integrations. Make progress, failures, and recovery understandable to users. * **Turn research capabilities into usable products.** Partner with researchers to integrate models, agents, and verification services. Help bridge the gap between a promising technical demonstration and an experience customers can depend on. * **Learn directly from users.** Work with customers and internal stakeholders to understand their workflows, test assumptions, and identify useful improvements. Instrument features and use feedback and usage data to guide iteration. * **Own quality beyond launch.** Write tests, review code, monitor the features you ship, and investigate production issues. Improve performance, security, and reliability as usage grows. * **Build foundations that support multiple products.** Create reusable components, services, and integration patterns. Make practical decisions about what to share, what to keep simple, and when a prototype needs a more durable implementation. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * **Minimum 2–3 years of software engineering experience**, with examples of products or features you’ve shipped and improved. We value meaningful hands\-on ownership more than a particular title or background. * **Strong full\-stack fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building interfaces with TypeScript and React, backend services with Python or Node.js, and working with APIs and relational databases. You may be stronger on one side of the stack, but you’re willing to work across both. * **Product judgment and attention to detail.** You think about the user’s goal, question unnecessary complexity, and care whether the final experience is understandable—not just technically functional. * **Practical experience delivering production software.** You’re familiar with testing, version control, code review, deployment, and debugging. You understand the basics of authentication, authorization, and handling user data responsibly. * **Comfort working through ambiguity.** You can break a loosely defined problem into manageable steps, test an approach, and adjust as you learn. * **Ownership, curiosity, and clear communication.** You follow through on what you build, surface problems early, and work well with people across engineering, design, product, and research. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Experience building applications with LLM APIs, retrieval, agent workflows, or evaluation systems. * Experience with enterprise software, developer tools, or workflows involving complex documents, structured knowledge, or auditable decisions. * Strong frontend craft, including experience building editors, data visualizations, or other information\-rich interfaces. * Experience taking a startup product, substantial side project, or open\-source tool from an idea to active users. Prior experience in formal verification is not required. We’re looking for strong builders who are curious about the technology and motivated to make it useful.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Bonus** --------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: CFD Engineer, Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking a hands\-on **Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Engineer** to join its Data Center team in our Buildings and Places (B\+P) group in our Arlington, VA office; however, this position can be fully remote. This individual\-contributor role is responsible for executing internal and external airflow, thermal, and equipment\-discharge studies with minimal oversight. The successful candidate will convert complex simulation results into practical design actions, clearly communicate assumptions and limitations, and help establish repeatable, high\-quality CFD workflows across multiple concurrent projects. *This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.* *Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance* **AECOM** is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high\-profile, fast\-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility. **Key Responsibilities:** * Own the full CFD study lifecycle: clarify the design question, define scope and acceptance criteria, develop the methodology, build geometry, generate the mesh, establish boundary conditions, solve, verify convergence, post\-process results, and issue technical reports. * Perform internal data hall studies addressing rack inlet temperatures, airflow distribution, hot\- and cold\-aisle containment, bypass and recirculation, raised\-floor or slab configurations, cooling\-unit placement, rack density, failure modes, and capacity\-expansion scenarios. * Perform external studies for cooling towers, chillers, dry coolers, generator and boiler exhaust, mechanical yards, relief air, outdoor\-air intakes, heat rejection, plume behavior, short\-circuiting, and thermal re\-entrainment. * Conduct steady\-state and transient analyses for cooling\-system outages, equipment failures, load changes, control sequences, thermal ride\-through, and other operating scenarios defined by the project team. * Develop defensible modeling assumptions using design documents, equipment data, controls narratives, weather data, commissioning information, and field measurements; identify data gaps and document their impact on conclusions. * Apply sound verification and validation practices, including mesh\-sensitivity checks, mass and energy balance reviews, convergence assessment, comparison with hand calculations, and correlation to measured or monitoring data when available. * Evaluate results against project\-specific criteria and relevant guidance, including ASHRAE TC 9\.9 thermal guidance and applicable client, code, and industry requirements. * Translate findings into prioritized, actionable recommendations for equipment selection, airflow management, containment, intake/exhaust separation, controls, phasing, redundancy, and operational resilience. * Prepare concise, client\-ready reports and visualizations that clearly communicate methodology, assumptions, scenarios, results, risks, limitations, and recommended next steps. * Present findings and coordinate directly with multidisciplinary project teams to resolve issues and confirm implementation of recommendations. * Contribute to standardized templates, modeling procedures, quality\-control checklists, libraries, and lessons learned; support technical knowledge sharing and mentoring of less\-experienced staff. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. * 6\+ years of hands\-on CFD experien  environments. * Proficiency with at least one data\-center or general\-purpose CFD platform, such as Cadence 6SigmaDCX, Ansys Fluent, Ansys CFX, or OpenFOAM, and the ability to learn and apply project\-required tools. * Strong fundamentals in fluid mechanics, heat transfer, thermodynamics, turbulence modeling, and HVAC system operation. * Experience modeling both internal environments, such as IT spaces and containment systems, and external environments, such as mechanical yards, cooling equipment, intakes, and exhaust discharges. * Working knowledge of data center cooling architectures, HVAC systems, redundancy concepts, controls and failure scenarios, and common thermal performance metrics. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering * Professional Engineer (PE) * Experience with US codes and standards. * Demonstrated success independently delivering CFD studies from scoping through final report, including geometry preparation, meshing, solver setup, convergence assessment, post\-processing, and engineering interpretation. * Ability to develop appropriate boundary conditions from design information and equipment performance data, and to explain the sensitivity of results to key assumptions. * Strong technical writing, visualization, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex results to engineering teams, project managers, and clients. **Additional Information** **Additional Information:** * Relocation is not available for this role * Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position. * **THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY JANUARY 9, 2027** At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

critical services. * Develop and maintain robust observability tooling including logging, metrics, and tracing (e.g., Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus). * Proactively conduct postmortems and and response systems. * Establish and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and escalation protocols for system support. * Contribute to chaos testing and failure injection to proactively uncover weaknesses. jobs.title: Medical Director, AI Safety
jobs.description: **About Avo** Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI\-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence\-based decision\-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high\-quality care. Avo changes that. We are product\-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro\-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities. **The Role** We are seeking a Medical Director, AI Safety that will own the safety of Avo's AI\-generated clinical content. That means deciding what "safe enough to ship" means for a discharge summary, a pre\-visit summary, or a decision\-support module, building the tests that enforce it, and signing off before it reaches a clinician. You will design the grading rubrics, run the evaluations, classify failures by clinical severity, and turn the findings into changes the Studio and engineering teams make. Roughly 85% of your time goes to safety. The remaining 15% splits two ways: building clinical modules yourself in Avo's Studio, so your safety judgments are grounded in how the content is actually produced, and joining sales and customer conversations as the physician who can explain how we test and why a CMIO should trust the output. You report to the CMIO, with a dotted line to the Chief Commercial Officer. #### **What You'll Do** * *AI safety (core of the role)* + Define the safety standard for each product line: what counts as a hallucination, an omission, or a clinically material error, and how severe each is + Design and run evaluation protocols for clinical AI modules, including hallucination detection, omission analysis, and accuracy checks against source records and evidence\-based guidelines + Build and maintain a clinical harm taxonomy and grading rubric (NCC MERP\-style severity scoring) and apply it across benchmark sets + Review AI\-generated clinical content directly, and grade the automated graders so we know when to trust them + Own the release gate: write the go/no\-go safety assessment for new modules and major prompt or model changes + Investigate reported clinical errors from customers, trace root cause, and drive the fix through Studio and engineering + Write the safety reports, validation summaries, and white papers that buyers and their clinical governance committees ask for + Track the regulatory and standards landscape for clinical AI (FDA, ONC, CHAI, Joint Commission) and translate it into internal requirements*Clinical builder (\~5\-10%)* + Build or revise clinical modules in Avo's Studio, applying evidence\-based guidelines and your own practice experience + Feed what you learn from building back into the safety protocols, and vice versa*Sales\-forward clinician (\~5\-10%)* + Join prospect calls and pilot evaluations as the physician who can speak to how Avo's content is validated + Present the safety program to CMIOs, CIOs, and clinical quality leaders, and answer their hardest questions about failure modes + Challenge the status quo in the room: name where legacy documentation and CDS workflows fail patients, and show how a tested AI alternative does better #### **What You Bring** * Active clinical license (MD/DO, NP, or PA) with hands\-on patient care experience * 3\-7 years of clinical practice; you can read a discharge summary and spot the missed anticoagulation plan in under a minute * Experience with or strong interest in clinical AI, CDS, or health informatics * A testing mindset: you like designing the rubric, arguing about edge cases, and finding the error nobody else caught * Ability to write a clear, defensible safety report for a clinical governance committee * Comfort presenting to C\-suite clinical leaders and answering pointed questions about AI failure modes * Willingness to define the role's scope as the product and company grow * ***Travel:*** Some travel expected for customer meetings and demos, up to 10% #### **Nice to Have** * Experience with EHR systems (Epic, Meditech, Athena) * Background in clinical informatics, quality improvement, or patient safety * Prior experience in a sales engineering, solutions, or customer\-facing clinical role * Familiarity with AI/LLM evaluation methodologies **Why Join Avo** **Impact:** Avo's products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful. **Ownership:** We have a bias for action; you'll work alongside teams who take initiative, follow through on commitments, and take accountability for results. **High Agency:** We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy. **Great Team:** Work alongside a talented, low\-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft. **Remote\-First:** Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you're in the area we'd love the chance to work in\-person together 2 days/week. **How We Take Care of Our Team** * **Generous Time Off:** Flexible and generous PTO * **Comprehensive Health Plans:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family * **401K Matching:** Contribution matching to help invest in your future * **Personal Device Allowance:** Tax\-free funds for personal device usage * **Compensation and Equity:** $175,000 \- $200,000 OTE and equity

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Advantage Design Group** Advantage Design Group, a multimedia production and software development firm, is the largest online orientations producer in North America. Advantage Orientation is the company's cloud\-based solution currently deployed by over 400 higher education institutions in three countries. The platform invites engagement with interactive and media\-rich content, transforming enrollment into an onboarding experience for students and staff. Advantage Design Group provides customized creative and technical services, including content development, branded interface design, video production, advanced programming, and unlimited training. The platform also features a robust administrative panel for managing content and tracking, monitoring, and analyzing user data. **About the Opportunity** We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who wants to stay close to the code and have a real say in how our next platform is designed and built. You'll spend about 70% of your time writing C\# and .NET code and 30% on architecture and design. The work includes multi\-tenancy, data at scale, domain boundaries, messaging, performance, and the long\-term evolution of the platform. You will also work with client technical teams, so you can hear the problems firsthand and build solutions that work across hundreds of organizations. **Why Jacksonville?** Grow your career at Advantage and make coastal Northeast Florida home. Jacksonville offers 22 miles of beaches, the nation's largest urban park system, the St. Johns River and a creative food and arts scene. Florida also has no personal state income tax, which means more of your paycheck stays with you. **What You Do** * Design and build production applications in C\# and .NET. * Help shape the architecture of ADG's next platform, including multi\-tenancy, domain boundaries, messaging, and scalability. * Solve complex SQL Server performance problems and build APIs and client integrations. * Evaluate technical options and explain the tradeoffs behind your recommendations. * Work with client technical teams and contribute to the standards our engineering team uses. **Required Experience** * At least six years of professional C\# and .NET development experience, including current hands\-on production work. * Experience contributing to application or platform architecture. * Strong SQL Server skills and experience building APIs and integrations. * Ability to solve complex technical problems and explain your approach clearly. * Multi\-tenant SaaS applications or Microsoft Azure. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field preferred. In lieu of a degree, candidates with at least six years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, including demonstrated expertise in software architecture and the design and development of scalable platforms, will be considered. **How You Work** The way you work with people matters as much as the technical decisions you make. In this role, we will be expected to: * Explain technical choices clearly to engineers, client teams, and colleagues outside engineering, and listen closely when they see a problem differently. * Look past the initial request to understand what a client needs and how a decision will affect the people using the platform. * Ask good questions, test assumptions, and weigh the long\-term consequences before committing a solution. **Preferred Experience** * Event\-driven systems, messaging, queues, or event buses. * Large\-scale data environments or platform modernization. * Work directly with clients and partners with technical teams. **Compensation and Benefits** The salary is $140,000–$168,000, depending on experience. Benefits include a 401(k) match, profit sharing, health, dental and vision coverage, paid vacation, flex time, gym membership, and company\-funded training. **Work Location** This full\-time role is based in Jacksonville, Florida, and begins onsite so you can work closely with the team while learning about our platform and clients. Once you're established in the role, the schedule moves to hybrid, with two remote days per week. **Interested in Joining Our Team?** Apply Here! (https://advantage\-design\-group.breezy.hr/) Learn more about us at AdvantageDesignGroup.com (https://advantagedesigngroup.com/), and explore Welcome.AdvantageDesignGroup.com (https://welcome.advantagedesigngroup.com/). *Advantage Design Group® is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Software Developer I
jobs.description: **About Advantage Design Group** Advantage Design Group is a creative and technology company and the largest producer of online orientation programs in North America. Our platform, which powers Advantage Orientation and HR Engage, has more than 400 deployments across higher education and the private sector in three countries. It turns enrollment and hiring into digital orientation experiences for new students and employees, with interactive video and content built around each client's brand. Our team of about 50, based in Jacksonville, Florida, creates every part of that experience, including content development, branded interface design, video production and software engineering. **About the Opportunity** We are looking for an early\-career developer who wants to write real production code and grow with a team that will invest in them. This role is the first step on our Web Developer career path. As you build experience, you will take on larger pieces of work and more ownership, with a defined path to .NET Developer, Senior .NET Developer and, for those who want to lead, Developer Team Lead. We support that growth with internal training, mentorship, and company\-funded learning. **Why Jacksonville?** Grow your career at Advantage and make coastal Northeast Florida home. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Software Engineering
jobs.description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. ***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.*** AHEAD is looking for an experienced Principal Engineer to help shape, build, and evolve the platforms that power our business. We’re a leading IT services provider, trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to design, build, run, and modernize their most important technology across cloud, data, AI, and security. You’ll join an experienced engineering team that builds real products, adopts new tools early, sweats the details, and trades ideas constantly. Our current stack includes Next.js, JavaScript, Golang, dbt, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL. You’ll work across application, service, data, and platform layers, with the autonomy to make a visible impact on important enterprise systems. This is a principal\-level role for someone who can move comfortably between user needs, business outcomes, system architecture, implementation, and production support. We care about the depth of your engineering judgment more than a specific list of languages. Experience with equivalent technologies such as Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, Elixir, Kotlin, or similar is welcome. ### **Building in the Age of AI** AI has changed what great engineering looks like, and we’ve leaned in. We are building with an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) first mindset. AI tools and coding agents should accelerate research, design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational analysis, while human judgment remains accountable for what ships. We’re looking for engineers who use these tools fluently without trusting them blindly. * Use AI tools and coding agents throughout the development lifecycle to move faster on exploration, scaffolding, refactors, tests, documentation, and research. * Spend your judgment where it counts: architecture, product decisions, data quality, security, reliability, edge cases, and correctness. * Help push the practice forward with better tooling, prompts, guardrails, and workflows that make the whole team more effective. ### **What you'll do** * Own complex initiatives end to end, from understanding the user’s need and business outcome through architecture, delivery, production support, and continuous improvement. * Design and build pragmatic, secure, and scalable solutions across Next.js applications, JavaScript services, Golang services, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations, data pipelines, and platform integrations. * Use AI tools and coding agents to accelerate delivery, then review, test, secure, and harden everything you ship. * Engage across the full development lifecycle: problem framing, analysis, design, implementation, integration, testing, deployment, observability, debugging, and support. * Lead architecture reviews and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and raise the bar on quality, security, reliability, and maintainability. * Partner directly with product, design, data, security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into executable plans. * Identify and reduce technical risk, including fragile integrations, poor data quality, unclear ownership, security gaps, operational blind spots, and unsustainable technical debt. * Mentor engineers, shape the engineering roadmap, and help define how AHEAD builds and operates software. ### **What does the ideal candidate look like?** * 8\+ years building and operating software systems, with 10\+ years preferred and a track record of leading significant work end to end. * Principal\-level engineering judgment. You can simplify complex problems, recognize weak solutions, explain tradeoffs clearly, and make decisions that hold up in production. * An AIDLC\-first mindset and demonstrated fluency with AI development tools or coding agents, paired with the discipline to inspect, test, secure, and own everything you ship. * Strong experience with modern web and service development, especially Next.js, JavaScript or TypeScript, and Golang. * Strong experience with data engineering and relational systems, including dbt, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, schema design, query performance, migrations, data quality, and data integrity. * Stack\-agnostic adaptability. Equivalent experience with Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, Elixir, Kotlin, or other modern languages and frameworks is welcome. * A strong foundation in software architecture and the practices that keep systems reliable, including secure development, automated testing, continuous integration, deployment automation, observability, and containerization. * Clear, direct communication. You can express technical intent precisely to engineers, stakeholders, and the AI tools you work with. * The instincts of a technical leader: you influence through credibility, mentor others, raise the level of the people around you, and help teams deliver with accountability. ### **Why you'll love it here** * Join an experienced team that lives on the forefront of technology, where innovation, curiosity, and practical engineering judgment are the norm. * Help define how a modern engineering organization applies AI across the software development lifecycle while maintaining a high bar for security, quality, and reliability. * Influence architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy beyond a single project or team. * Competitive salary, benefits, and an environment where sustainable, effective work matters. *The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On\-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.* **Why AHEAD:** Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. **USA Employment Benefits include:** * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) * Paid company holidays * Paid time off * Paid parental and caregiver leave * Plus more! jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: **About AiDASH** AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com. The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\. Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together! **The Role** We're looking for a Staff Engineer to architect and build the services behind new products incubated in our product pods. jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer
jobs.description: Lead Product Engineer \- Electrical / Mechanical **AirPro Diagnostics \| Jacksonville, FL (On Site)** **Department:** Hardware Product Engineering **Reports To:** Chief Technology Officer **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt **Travel:** Occasional About AirPro AirPro Diagnostics designs, builds, and supports diagnostic and ADAS calibration technology used by collision repair and auto glass professionals. We engineer our own hardware, develop our own software, and manufacture products in our Jacksonville facility. Our engineers work across the full product lifecycle, from concept and prototype through production and field support. The Opportunity We are seeking a hands\-on Lead Product Engineer with strong electrical engineering expertise and broad mechanical design capability. This role will own the development of electromechanical products used daily in automotive repair environments. A primary focus will be leading the transition from aging commercial tablet\-based hardware to a new single\-board\-computer platform with a custom carrier board. You will oversee electronics integration, mechanical design, manufacturing readiness, validation, and continuous product improvement. As our first dedicated hardware engineer, you will help establish engineering standards, influence product architecture, and build future technical teams. Embedded \& Control Systems * Configure and troubleshoot single\-board computers, industrial PCs, sensors, and control systems. * Work with USB, CAN, RS\-232/485, I2C/SPI, Bluetooth, and Wi\-Fi interfaces. * Develop engineering utilities, automation tools, calibration software, and test scripts in Python or C/C\+\+. * Collaborate closely with software and firmware teams. Mechanical \& Product Design * Design enclosures, frames, fixtures, mounts, and adjustable mechanisms using 3D CAD. * Create production drawings with appropriate tolerances and GD\&T. * Prototype and iterate designs using in\-house equipment. * Own critical alignment and accuracy requirements related to ADAS calibration systems. Manufacturing \& Quality * Apply DFM/DFA principles to improve manufacturability and reduce cost. * Develop assembly procedures, work instructions, fixtures, and test methods. * Support pilot builds, production launches, and ongoing manufacturing operations. * Investigate product failures and implement corrective actions. * Participate in DFMEA, PFMEA, validation testing, change control, and compliance activities. Supplier \& Cross\-Functional Support * Work directly with PCB vendors, machine shops, molders, and contract manufacturers. * Support sourcing, supplier qualification, first article inspections, and product launches. * Partner with Product, Quality, Purchasing, Technical Support, and Operations teams. * Contribute to intellectual property development and patent activities. Qualifications Required * 6\+ years developing electromechanical products. * Strong electrical engineering foundation with experience reviewing schematics and PCB designs. * Experience taking physical products from concept through production. * Manufacturing support experience, including pilot builds and production ramp\-up. * Hands\-on experience with soldering, wiring, harness fabrication, and electronic troubleshooting. * Proficiency with 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred; equivalent platforms accepted). * Experience with embedded systems, industrial computing platforms, or control systems. * Ability to write or modify engineering software, scripts, or test utilities. * Strong root\-cause analysis and technical documentation skills. * Comfortable working between engineering labs and manufacturing environments. ADAS Knowledge Required Candidates should have a strong understanding of modern ADAS systems, including cameras, radar, LiDAR, ultrasonic sensors, and calibration procedures. The ability to understand OEM calibration requirements, sensor alignment tolerances, and calibration workflows is highly desirable. Preferred * Automotive, ADAS, diagnostics, collision repair, instrumentation, or precision equipment experience. * Experience with machine vision, cameras, radar, LiDAR, IMUs, or alignment systems. * Injection molding, tooling, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, or battery systems experience. * Familiarity with OBD\-II, J2534 PassThru, and CAN\-based vehicle diagnostics. * Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, ISO 9001, or IATF 16949 experience. * Experience in fast\-growth or private\-equity\-backed organizations. What Success Looks Like **90 Days** * Become fully proficient with AirPro products and calibration processes. * Identify opportunities to improve manufacturability and reliability. **6 Months** * Own the design and support of at least one product line. * Implement production\-ready improvements and DFM enhancements. **12 Months** * Lead a product from concept through production release. * Establish robust documentation, validation, and supplier processes. Work Environment This position is based on\-site in Jacksonville, Florida. Work is performed across engineering labs, prototype benches, manufacturing areas, and vehicle calibration environments. Occasional travel may be required. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Who You'll Work With:** The Senior AI Engineer works with the Data Engineering team under the Center of Excellence (Data Science). This role operates at the intersection of AI engineering, data engineering, agentic AI, platform engineering, and investment technology. It emphasizes Python, enterprise integration, reliable data products, security, CI/CD, observability, model and agent evaluation, and rigorous validation of production AI systems. **What You'll Do:** We are building a next\-generation enterprise AI and data platform that enables teams to design, deploy, integrate, and scale intelligent applications and agents across investment research, portfolio management, risk, client, and operational workflows. The platform provides standardized infrastructure, reliable data products, commercial and self\-hosted model access, retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, security, and governance. It enables teams to rapidly deliver AI\-powered capabilities in a scalable, secure, and production\-ready manner. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Build reliable, reusable, and AI\-ready data products for investment and enterprise use cases. * Design and develop production\-grade AI applications, agents, and intelligent workflows using Python. * Implement agent orchestration, tool integration, retrieval, memory, and multi\-step workflows. * Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, data platforms, and business systems. * Contribute to the shared AI and data platform that powers these capabilities at scale. **What We're Looking For:** **Core AI and Data Engineering** * 5\+ years of experience in software, data, AI, or platform engineering. * Strong production development experience with Python and SQL. * Proven ability to build and operate AI applications, data pipelines, APIs, data products, and distributed systems. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business workflows. * Strong understanding of: + Object\-oriented and asynchronous Python + APIs, microservices, and application integration + Data modeling, contracts, quality, reconciliation, metadata, and lineage + Batch, streaming, event\-driven, and API\-based architectures + Workflow orchestration, distributed processing, and production operations * Experience with cloud data and AI platforms such as Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Snowflake. * Ability to design scalable, reusable, resilient, and operationally supportable services. **Generative AI and Agentic Systems** Hands\-on experience with: * Large language models, embeddings, prompt engineering, context engineering, and RAG architecture. * Commercial and open\-source model APIs and ecosystems. * AI agents, agentic workflows, reusable skills, tool calling, structured outputs, and multi\-step orchestration. * Vector, keyword, metadata\-filtered, graph\-based, and hybrid retrieval. * Agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Pydantic AI, or equivalent platforms. Preferred experience includes: * MCP servers and clients, agent\-to\-agent communication, and enterprise search. * Semantic layers, ontologies, and knowledge graphs. * Agent memory, state management, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Document intelligence and multimodal processing. * Reusable agent tools, skills, manifests, and registration standards. **Model Hosting and Inference** Experience with one or more of the following: * Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or Vertex AI. * Hugging Face, vLLM, Ollama, Qwen, or other approved open\-source model technologies. * Containerized model deployment and GPU\-based inference. * Model serving, API gateways, quantization, memory optimization, and model configuration. * Context\-window, token, concurrency, batching, throughput, and caching optimization. * Benchmarking and monitoring model quality, latency, availability, resource utilization, and cost. **Platform Engineering, Security, and DevOps** Strong experience with: * CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated provisioning, and governed deployment. * API\-first and microservices architectures. * Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, or equivalent container platforms. * Authentication, authorization, secrets management, OAuth, managed identities, RBAC, and Microsoft Entra ID or equivalent technologies. * Repository governance, branch protection, pull\-request validation, dependency controls, and software supply\-chain security. * Metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging, monitoring, and alerting. * Designing observable, resilient, secure, and production\-ready AI systems. Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, or comparable tools for: * Code generation, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Data\-pipeline, infrastructure, and CI/CD development. * Codebase understanding, modernization, architecture extraction, and pull\-request review. * Governed development supported by automated testing, peer review, security scanning, and controlled deployment. Candidates must be able to independently validate AI\-generated code for: * Functional correctness and test coverage * Security and data\-access risks * Performance and scalability * Maintainability and architectural alignment * Dependency, licensing, and software supply\-chain concerns * Compliance with enterprise engineering standards **Evaluation, Observability, and Testing: Required** * Hands\-on experience with data\-quality, model\-evaluation, LLM\-evaluation, or AI\-observability frameworks. * Experience building: + Model benchmarking and evaluation pipelines + Data\-quality and reconciliation tests + Retrieval and RAG evaluations + Agent test harnesses and scenario\-based simulations + Continuous validation and regression testing + Production monitoring for data, retrieval, model, and agent quality * Ability to measure: + Data accuracy, completeness, freshness, and consistency + Retrieval relevance and coverage + Groundedness, factual consistency, citations, and provenance + Tool selection, execution, and structured\-output compliance + Agent workflow success, failure, and escalation behavior + Latency, throughput, reliability, resource utilization, and cost * Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, OpenInference, Datadog, Arize, LangSmith, MLflow, Microsoft Foundry evaluation capabilities, or equivalent tools. * Ability to use evaluation results to inform model selection, routing, release, rollback, and production\-readiness decisions. **About AB** We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work. Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us! All are encouraged to apply. AB does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status or any other basis that is prohibited by applicable law. AB’s policies and practices seek to ensure that employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants based solely on job\-related criteria. Nashville, Tennessee

jobs.title: Agentic Data Engineer, Frontier AI Tooling
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to build the products that help AWS ProServe and Frontier AI teams understand customer needs, develop the right solutions, and deliver them at scale? We are looking for a Data Engineer to own the data foundations behind the products and experiences that span ProServe, Frontier AI, and services teams within AWS Sales, Marketing and Global Sales. Your pipelines and datasets will let these teams deeply understand customer challenges, rapidly develop tailored solutions, and orchestrate delivery, directly accelerating how AWS delivers business outcomes to our customers. You will build and operate the pipelines and datasets that feed the context layer and agentic workflows: ingesting external insights, internal data, and insights collected by sales and delivery teams, and turning them into reliable, well\-modeled datasets that models and agents can reason over. You design data models, ETL, and integration services that are flexible, extensible, and scalable, then support and grow them over time. This is a hands\-on role where the playbook is written in real time. You ship to production and own the correctness of the data that downstream agents depend on. You are comfortable with ambiguity and partner with business leaders to build the pipelines that answer their key questions. You will unify fragmented data pipelines, build robust data models, and ensure reliable data lineage across multiple product areas, working closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and high opportunity for impact. Key job responsibilities * Own end\-to\-end delivery of data pipelines: design, build, test, deploy, and operate * Build and optimize ETL/ELT jobs that produce the foundational datasets powering the team's products and agentic workflows * Model structured and unstructured data (external insights, internal data, sales and delivery insights) so it is queryable and consumable by AI agents at scale * Design the data structures, schemas, and contracts that downstream services and agents depend on * Build and own data\-quality tooling: validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring so bad data does not reach agents or models * Ship to production regularly in a high\-ambiguity environment, balancing speed against reliability * Raise operational\-excellence hygiene (data tests, monitoring, runbooks) for the pipelines you own * Write clear data models, pipeline design notes, and runbooks a peer can act on About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, EBS Server Agility
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- If leading a team that builds secure, autonomous systems to test, deploy, and patch server software for one of the world's largest storage services excites you, the EBS Server Agility team is the place to do it. EBS is a foundational AWS service on which most other AWS services depend, and our teams build and operate the Continuous Integration platform and the deployment and patching infrastructure that keep EBS server software fast to ship, current, and secure across 400,000 bare\-metal servers, infrastructure that serves millions of AWS customers and exabytes of data every day. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team in our DevOps space. This is the space that spans Continuous Integration, which builds the platform that decides whether a change is safe to ship, and Deployments and Patching, which safely rolls that change out to a stateful storage engine serving live customer I/O. Both sit in the critical path for feature velocity and security compliance, and both are places where strong engineering leadership has outsized impact. You will not be writing the code or designing the systems yourself. You will lead the engineers who do: hiring and growing the team, setting clear technical direction, removing ambiguity, and delivering results predictably. You will decide where your systems sit in their lifecycle, define goals tied to business needs, and build the mechanisms that let the team deliver consistently without wearing out its best people. The guiding philosophy is simple and demanding: every manual step in the operator path is a defect in the system, and your team builds the test frameworks, CI infrastructure, and deployment services that engineer that toil away. Server CI and deployment at EBS shape how the software evolves to support new hardware platforms, new partitions (including edge and Outpost), and new operational models. You will partner with principal engineers and leaders across EC2 and EBS, and represent your team's work in discussions that shape how EBS evolves. If you want your leadership to have real impact at AWS scale, and you are excited by building a team that builds systems that test, deploy, and patch themselves, we would love to talk to you. You might align the team on a roadmap for the quarter, coach an engineer through a design, review progress against goals, and make a principled call that trades a little speed for safety on a change headed to the fleet. You will remove blockers, set priorities, and keep on\-call sustainable while the team ships. You will partner with principal engineers and leaders across EBS and EC2, and you will represent your team's work to senior leadership. This is a high\-visibility role. The work in this space affects every EBS customer, and your team's output is regularly reviewed by senior leadership. You will collaborate across organizational boundaries, influence technical direction beyond your immediate team, and build a team that is better for your presence but does not need you to be successful. We value managers who lead through ambiguity, reduce toil through smart automation, make principled tradeoffs between speed and safety, hire and grow strong engineers, and elevate everyone around them. About the team EBS Server Agility is the DevOps space for EBS Server, owning the Continuous Integration platform and the server deployment and patching infrastructure. Our engineers build distributed test orchestration and qualification systems, deployment pipelines that safely deliver validated server software to 400,000 bare\-metal servers, automated patching that keeps software secure on a biweekly cadence, metrics and crash observability, and secure operational tooling for autonomous operations. We move fast to deliver for customers while maintaining operational excellence across these mission\-critical services. We are a Boston\-based group building toward a future where server software tests, patches, and deploys itself: safely, securely, on schedule, with full visibility. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Sponsored Products and Brands Off-Search
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through state\-of\-the\-art generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. Key job responsibilities This role will be pivotal in redesigning how ads contribute to a personalized, relevant, and inspirational shopping experience, with the customer value proposition at the forefront. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Contribute to the design and development of GenAI, deep learning, multi\-objective optimization and/or reinforcement learning empowered solutions to transform ad retrieval, auctions, whole\-page relevance, and/or bespoke shopping experiences. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with other scientists, engineers, and product managers to bring scalable, production\-ready science solutions to life. * Stay abreast of industry trends in GenAI, LLMs, and related disciplines, bringing fresh and innovative concepts, ideas, and prototypes to the organization. * Contribute to the enhancement of team’s scientific and technical rigor by identifying and implementing best\-in\-class algorithms, methodologies, and infrastructure that enable rapid experimentation and scaling. * Mentor and grow junior scientists and engineers, cultivating a high\-performing, collaborative, and intellectually curious team. This is a rare opportunity to redefine how ads are retrieved, allocated, and/or experienced—elevating them into personalized, contextually aware, and inspiring components of the customer journey. You will have the opportunity to fundamentally transform areas such as ad retrieval, ad allocation, whole\-page relevance, and differentiated recommendations through the lens of GenAI. By building novel generative models grounded in both Amazon’s rich data and the world’s collective knowledge, your work will shape how customers engage with ads, discover products, and make purchasing decisions. If you are passionate about applying frontier AI to real\-world problems with massive scale and impact, this is your opportunity to define the next chapter of advertising science. About the team The Off\-Search team within Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) is focused on building delightful ad experiences across various surfaces beyond Search on Amazon—such as product detail pages, the homepage, and store\-in\-store pages—to drive monetization. Our vision is to deliver highly personalized, context\-aware advertising that adapts to individual shopper preferences, scales across diverse page types, remains relevant to seasonal and event\-driven moments, and integrates seamlessly with organic recommendations such as new arrivals, basket\-building content, and fast\-delivery options. To execute this vision, we work in close partnership with Amazon Stores stakeholders to lead the expansion and growth of advertising across Amazon\-owned and \-operated pages beyond Search. We operate full stack—from backend ads\-retail edge services, ads retrieval, and ad auctions to shopper\-facing experiences—all designed to deliver meaningful value. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Security is moving from something builders stop for to something that runs quietly inside how they already work: guidance that shows up in their tools as they code, and continuous checks that replace the weeks\-long review queue. Behind that shift is data. Knowing which controls a service actually needs, surfacing where real risk lives across a massive portfolio, whether the guidance we give is accurate enough to trust, and whether any of it is genuinely reducing risk. You'll lead the data science and data engineering team that answers those questions and makes that whole model measurable. Proving efficacy at scale is where you'll have the biggest impact. It's easy to ship guidance, but hard to know it's working: that it's accurate, that builders act on it, that fewer issues reach production because of it. You'll own the data that turns those into answers leaders can act on, and the feedback loop that uses every issue we find to make the guidance smarter so the same problem never recurs. You'll be the leader who gets the craft of data scientists, data engineers, and business intelligence engineers, and can bring them together as one group with a shared direction. You'll set the vision, raise the technical bar, and build the foundations good science depends on: trusted data, reliable pipelines, and reproducible research. You'll love this role if you enjoy: * Turning security from a gate into a default, and proving with data that the shift actually works. * Finding where risk really lives, using data and models to surface the issues and high\-risk code that matter most before they reach production. * Answering hard measurement questions at scale: is our guidance accurate, are builders acting on it, are fewer issues reaching production? * Working across disciplines, using science, analytics, and engineering together so each makes the others stronger. * Standing up something new: shaping the strategy, culture, and standards for a team ready for its first dedicated data leader. * Growing engineers and scientists and watching them take on bigger scope because of how you invested in them. Key job responsibilities * Set the strategy, roadmap, and technical direction for a combined data science and data engineering team, turning an ambiguous, fast\-moving security mission into clear, prioritized work and partnering with tech and business leadership to shape the vision. * Own how we measure whether embedded security is working: build the metrics, experiments, and analysis that show whether guidance is accurate, whether builders act on it, and whether fewer issues reach production because of it. * Lead the data science behind risk identification and the compounding feedback loop: surface where real risk lives across a large portfolio, scope which controls each service needs, and make sure every issue found feeds back into smarter guidance so the same problem does not recur. * Determine the right mix of science, data engineering, and BI resources, use those disciplines to complement rather than duplicate one another, and lead senior individual contributors credibly across both the science and engineering sides of the team. * Hold the bar on quality and delivery: judge whether outputs are trustworthy and ready to inform decisions or ship, without letting work be under\-scoped or over\-engineered, and invest in the data foundation of trusted data, reliable pipelines, and reproducible research. Own the results and credit the people who deliver them. * Grow the team and manage ambiguity: develop scientists and engineers into bigger scope, support in\-flight discipline transitions, establish the shared standards and data culture that let the team deliver without you, and mitigate risks and escalate with good judgment before they become roadblocks. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end\-to\-end products that surprise and delight out\-of\-the\-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do — with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need a full suite of governance capabilities: an identity for every agent, human\-in\-the\-loop controls to audit and approve what agents do, and the ability for a human intervene in an agent's session when required. Our team is building these systems end to end. Upcoming launches will give every agent a verifiable identity, record every desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and let a human take control of an agent's session mid\-task before handing it back to the agent, which resumes with full context of what changed. Identity and agentic governance present hard problems in our industry today, and we're excited to on the forefront of solving them. We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end\-to\-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year and an ambitious 2027 roadmap. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you. Key job responsibilities * Own features end\-to\-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production * Build new services for policy enforcement, session recording and replay, human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows, and human takeover of agent sessions * Integrate with AWS services and make build\-vs\-compose decisions with your team * Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product * Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces * Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response A day in the life Your mornings are usually free for focus work \- writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work cross\-team syncs or design reviews. Our pipelines are full CD our ticket queue is small and when something pages us we fix the root cause \- not just the symptom. We encourage responsible AI usage across our development workflow \- it's one way our team moves fast. The problems are interesting and the pace is high but we believe we can move fast do exceptional work and have a full life outside of it. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. inspection systems, ensuring systems are properly configured, documented, and capable of meeting plant and customer quality requirements. * Develop, refine, and support standards for inspection system setup, testing, calibration, troubleshooting, documentation, and ongoing performance monitoring. * Identify opportunities to reduce false rejects, improve defect detection, reduce scrap, and improve production efficiency through better inspection system performance. * Evaluate new inspection technologies, suppliers, system architectures, and application approaches to support future capability needs across RPS. * Provide technical input for capital projects involving new inspection systems, production lines, automation upgrades, quality improvements, and equipment modernization efforts. * Support supplier and OEM engagement, including technical reviews, design input, FAT/SAT participation, issue resolution, and performance follow\-up. * Train and coach plant personnel on inspection system operation, basic troubleshooting, system care, and performance expectations. * Document system performance, improvement actions, lessons learned and recommended best practices to enable repeatable deployment across sites. **Required Qualifications** * Degree in Engineering, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Technology, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered. * Experience supporting inspection systems, automation systems, quality systems, manufacturing equipment, or production line technology in a manufacturing environment. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical equipment issues and implement sustainable corrective actions. * Ability to travel approximately 50\-60% to support manufacturing sites globally. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document findings, recommendations, standards, and improvement actions. * Ability to work effectively in plant environments and interact with cross\-functional teams at all levels of the organization. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with industrial vision systems, camera setup, lighting design, image processing tools, reject tracking, sensor integration, PLC/HMI interfaces, or machine controls. * Experience with bottle, container, closure, injection molding, blow molding, thermoforming, packaging, or high\-speed manufacturing environments. * Familiarity with quality validation, defect libraries, recipe management, inspection standards, calibration methods, and customer quality expectations. * Experience working with OEMs, integrators, equipment suppliers, and plant technical teams during equipment design, startup, commissioning, and performance improvement. * Practical knowledge of continuous improvement, root cause analysis, Lean manufacturing, reliability improvement, or process capability methods. **What We Value** * Strong hands\-on technical problem\-solving skills in manufacturing environments. * Practical understanding of vision systems, lighting, cameras, sensors, reject mechanisms, leak detection, metal detection, controls interfaces, and automated inspection equipment. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with plant teams, technical teams, suppliers, OEMs, quality leaders, and operations stakeholders. * High attention to detail, especially when working with quality\-critical systems, customer requirements, validation expectations, and production performance data. * Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify root causes, implement practical solutions, and standardize improvements across multiple locations. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to operators, technicians, engineers, quality teams, and leadership. * Commitment to safety, quality, customer success, teamwork, and developing capability across the organization. **Our Expectations** ==================== We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values
