The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure uninterrupted, high\-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights. The Enterprise AI Platform organization partners with business and technology teams to shape the Enterprise AI strategy, bring emerging technologies to the forefront, and build scalable, reusable AI platforms. This team plays a pivotal role in enabling American Express to operate as an AI\-powered enterprise by equipping teams with the skills, platforms, and seamless deployment capabilities needed to accelerate responsible AI innovation, enhance decision\-making, and drive customer impact with speed and scale. Join a team shaping the future of AI at American Express. You will work directly with business and product leaders to turn high\-value opportunities into trusted, secure, and responsible AI solutions, while helping successful ideas become reusable capabilities across the enterprise. FDE partners across American Express to transform high\-value business opportunities into trusted, secure, and scalable AI solutions delivering measurable outcomes, accelerating adoption, and turning successful innovations into reusable enterprise capabilities. **Role Summary** As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will partner closely with business units, product teams, and engineering organizations to identify and reframe high\-value opportunities, translate business challenges into clear value propositions, and build working solutions using Generative AI, agentic systems, and intelligent automation. You will take opportunities from discovery and demonstration through proof of value, production scaling, adoption, and transition to long\-term ownership. Demonstrations are a means of validating grounded value propositions, not the end goal. You will be accountable for advancing credible opportunities into real adoption and durable ways of working, with each stage tied to measurable outcomes and balanced with enterprise requirements for security, reliability, and responsible AI. This is a hands\-on engineering role with a significant stakeholder engagement component. You will influence without direct authority, communicate across levels of seniority and technical familiarity, and work alongside engineers to build and deploy reliable software. You will challenge assumptions about how work is performed, analyze processes as systems, and identify the technical, operational, and organizational levers that can improve them. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full\-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All\-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.** **Job Details** **Job Objective:** The Data Engineer will design, build, and support the data pipelines that power our analytics, reporting, and operational systems. This role's primary focus is developing and maintaining data pipelines within our Databricks environment, serving as an escalation point when production pipeline issues arise, and leading the migration of existing Azure Data Factory workflows and Azure Functions into Databricks. jobs.title: EnaChip - Engineering Manager, Microfabrication
jobs.description: **Engineering Manager, Microfabrication** **About EnaChip** EnaChip is building a new foundation for power delivery—bringing together advances in materials science, semiconductor processing, and system architecture. Our mission is to remove power delivery as a constraint on technological progress, enabling the next generation of compute systems to reach higher performance, efficiency, and scale. **The Opportunity** EnaChip is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our microfabrication R\&D team. This is primarily a people and project management role: organizing a small, talented team that is optimizing our fabrication process while also producing customer parts in small quantities. It's an opportunity to help push the boundaries of what's possible in high\-frequency power magnetics, working at the leading edge of a platform that's bringing magnetics directly into the semiconductor stack. You'll join a young, growing team, with an opportunity to own a key leadership role as the company scales. This position will work onsite in Philadelphia five days per week. **Key Responsibilities** *Team leadership** Lead the microfabrication team (clean room processing and electroplating) with ownership of day\-to\-day execution, reporting to the COO * Set clear weekly priorities and deadlines with each engineer and keep the team on track to meet them * Run a brief daily stand\-up and a weekly planning review, and flag risks to the COO early so problems can be solved together * Foster a culture of reliability and professionalism: consistent lab hours, a well\-kept shared space, and good lab etiquette * Serve as the on\-site partner to a remote COO, providing clear, organized written updates on progress and needs * Balance process optimization work with the production of customer parts in small quantities, keeping both on schedule *Process infrastructure (first\-year focus)** Build out the fabrication documentation system: standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process travelers, and run sheets * Develop standard analysis and reporting templates so characterization results are captured consistently and easy to compare across runs * Establish a simple document control practice (naming, versioning, storage, review) and coach the team on using it * Translate device design requirements into a weekly fabrication schedule for development lots, process optimization runs, and customer builds * Identify process and scheduling bottlenecks and propose practical improvements to cycle time and yield * Drive process improvement and materials selection, working with vendors to source the right materials, chemistries, and consumables for the process *Hands\-on technical support** Learn EnaChip's microfabrication and electroplating processes through structured training, with the goal of running tools and steps independently * Provide hands\-on support in processing or plating when the team needs extra capacity or coverage **Qualifications*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field * 1 to 5 years of experience managing an engineering or technical team * Industry experience or knowledge of semiconductor wafer level packaging (i.e. MEMS, photolithography, electroplating, WLCSP redistribution layers, or similar) * Excellent written and verbal communicator who keeps stakeholders informed without being asked * Strong collaborator who builds trust with a small team and holds people accountable with respect * Highly organized, with a track record of creating structure (schedules, documentation, process) where little existed * Comfortable learning new hands\-on processes and stepping into the lab when needed **Nice to Have*** Direct experience with semiconductor microfabrication, clean room operations, or electroplating * Experience building SOPs, process travelers, or document control systems * Experience in a startup or early\-stage hardware environment * Experience managing small\-volume production alongside R\&D **Compensation*** Base salary range: $120,000–$150,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications * Total compensation includes equity in a rapidly growing start\-up **EnaChip is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. aHoqyQ2vGC

From the buildings we live in to the products we use to the movies that inspire us, Autodesk software helps our customers design and make a better world for all. Our customers rely on Autodesk to discover, evaluate, and purchase the right products to support their education, businesses, and careers. We're looking for an experienced Senior Experience Designer to help shape the future of Autodesk's digital commerce experiences, creating intuitive, engaging, and customer\-centered journeys that serve millions of users around the world. As a Senior Experience Designer on the Worldwide Marketing Digital \& eCommerce team, you will design seamless end\-to\-end commerce experiences across Autodesk.com, from product discovery and pricing to purchase, subscription management, and post\-purchase engagement. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, content strategists, and analytics partners to create experiences that balance customer needs with business goals while supporting Autodesk's Product\-Led Growth (PLG) strategy. Your work will help customers discover value quickly, reduce friction across key touchpoints, and enable self\-service experiences that drive activation, conversion, adoption, and long\-term customer success. The ideal candidate has a strong track record designing customer\-facing digital products, with deep expertise designing customer\-facing ecommerce experiences across discovery, purchase, subscription, and post\-purchase journeys. You are skilled at simplifying complex workflows, using customer insights and behavioral data to inform design decisions, and creating experiences that support experimentation, personalization, and continuous optimization. Experience designing for SaaS, subscription, or Product\-Led Growth (PLG) environments is highly valued. Success in this role requires a systems\-thinking mindset, strong interaction and visual design skills, and the ability to translate customer insights, business strategy, and product objectives into intuitive experiences. You'll help define how Autodesk's digital storefront evolves, combining world\-class UX, compelling storytelling, AI\-assisted design practices, and data\-informed experimentation to create experiences that inspire customers and drive measurable business growth. For consideration, candidates must include both a resume \+ portfolio with password when applying. **Responsibilities** * Lead the design of customer\-facing experiences across Autodesk.com and related digital touchpoints, ensuring a cohesive and engaging end\-to\-end experience * Create end\-to\-end user experiences that support Autodesk's Product\-Led Growth (PLG) strategy by reducing friction, enabling self\-service, and increasing activation, conversion, and customer engagement * Leverage AI\-powered design tools throughout the design process to accelerate ideation, content creation, prototyping, and design exploration while maintaining a high standard of quality, accessibility, and usability * Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Content Strategy, Research, Analytics, and Business teams to define opportunities, solve complex customer problems, and deliver measurable business impact * Present design concepts, rationale, and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels, incorporating feedback to achieve alignment and drive informed decision\-making * Drive visual experience, quality and interaction design excellence, establishing high standards for usability, accessibility, storytelling, and brand expression * Translate customer insights, business objectives, and behavioral data into compelling digital experiences that improve engagement and measurable business outcomes * Stay current on emerging UX, ecommerce, AI, and digital experience trends, bringing new ideas, technologies, and best practices to improve Autodesk's customer experiences **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of related professional experience in UX design * Demonstrated experience designing end\-to\-end user experiences, including information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, interaction design, and high\-fidelity visual design * Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools (such as Figma) and the ability to communicate ideas through multiple levels of fidelity * Experience incorporating AI\-powered design tools into the design process to accelerate ideation, content creation, prototyping, or design exploration while maintaining a high standard of craft and usability * Up\-to\-date expertise in human\-centered design best practices. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Content Strategy, Analytics, and cross\-functional stakeholders * Experience using customer research, analytics, usability testing, and A/B experimentation to inform design decisions and optimize customer experiences * Excellent visual and verbal communication skills with the ability to distill complex ideas, and large amounts of data and viewpoints, to their essence * Ability to present designs to a wide range of audiences, including software development, product managers, quality assurance, learning content development, marketing, and sales * Demonstrated experience in research \- interviews, ethnography, user testing, etc * Effective collaboration with multi\-disciplinary global Agile teams **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in interaction design or related field * Experience in eCommerce * Experience designing customer experiences that leverage machine learning (ML) such as personalization, recommendations, or intelligent automation * Experience with Autodesk or comparable competitive products * Experience designing for large\-scale .com ecosystems and global digital platforms * Experience leveraging AI tools and workflows to accelerate design, content creation, and customer engagement **Learn More** **About Autodesk** Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! **Benefits** From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting https://benefits.autodesk.com/ **Salary transparency** Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.\-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $106,000 and $189,970\. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. **Equal Employment Opportunity** At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law. **Belonging** We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global\-belonging **In\-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification** This role may require in\-person onboarding and/or in\-person ID verification.

You will own end\-to\-end solution design and delivery across the full engineering lifecycle and use spec\-driven development and agentic systems to build, operate, and support Product Access in production, including agent\-based automation for engineering and operational workflows. This role includes shared production on\-call responsibilities as part of end\-to\-end service ownership. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager and collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, Domain Leads, and cross\-functional stakeholders across Product Access and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and operate resilient, scalable, high\-performing cloud\-native Java microservices and distributed systems on AWS for the Product Access platform * Own business features and platform initiatives end to end, from requirement analysis through production support, working with product and engineering partners on design, testing, and operational readiness * Enhance system resiliency, reliability, scalability, and security; jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avaya** --------------- Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections. The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships. We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way. Learn more at https://www.avaya.com **Job Description** ------------------- **Connect the Enterprise. Engineer for Reliability.** Are you passionate about network engineering, enterprise connectivity, and building resilient infrastructure that keeps critical business applications running? Do you enjoy solving complex routing and switching challenges, optimizing network performance, and supporting secure, highly available cloud environments? We’re looking for a Network Engineer to help design, implement, maintain, and evolve our enterprise network infrastructure. **The Opportunity** In this role, you’ll support the network infrastructure that connects our enterprise systems, cloud environments, data centers, and business applications. You’ll work across routing, switching, network security, and voice technologies, helping ensure reliable connectivity, strong security controls, and consistent network performance across a distributed enterprise environment. Working with Juniper routers, Dell switches, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN technologies, and enterprise voice infrastructure, you’ll collaborate with engineering teams, service providers, and business stakeholders to deliver network solutions that meet current operational needs and support future growth. This role is ideal for an experienced network engineer who combines deep technical knowledge with strong troubleshooting skills, project execution, and a commitment to operational excellence. **Your Mission\-Critical Responsibilities** ------------------------------------------- **Network Infrastructure Engineering:** Configure, implement, maintain, and support enterprise network infrastructure, including Juniper routers, Dell switches, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN tunnels, security appliances, and related data center equipment. **Routing \& Switching:** Design, configure, and troubleshoot complex routing and switching environments to support reliable connectivity across enterprise networks, cloud infrastructure, and critical business applications. **Network Architecture \& Standards:** Maintain and enforce enterprise network design, security, and configuration standards. Evaluate existing infrastructure and recommend improvements that support performance, reliability, and business requirements. **Cloud \& Enterprise Connectivity:** Support network connectivity across LAN, WAN, data center, and cloud environments, helping ensure secure and reliable access to business\-critical applications and services. **Network Security:** Configure and maintain network security appliances, firewall policies, and VPN connectivity in accordance with established security and infrastructure standards. **Network Protocols \& Performance:** Apply in\-depth knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, SNMP, SMTP, BGP, EIGRP, MPLS, SIP, and related networking technologies to maintain connectivity, investigate issues, and optimize network operations. **Voice \& Unified Communications:** Support the implementation and maintenance of Juniper and Dell voice\-related solutions and associated network infrastructure. Troubleshoot voice connectivity and signaling issues involving SIP, H.323, relevant G\-series voice codecs, and PSTN gateways. **Troubleshooting \& Problem Resolution:** Diagnose and resolve complex network hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Proactively investigate recurring problems, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement effective solutions to restore and maintain service. **Project Delivery \& Implementation:** Execute assigned network projects, installations, upgrades, and infrastructure changes in accordance with established objectives, schedules, and operational requirements. **Documentation \& Configuration Management:** Develop and maintain accurate documentation covering network designs, configurations, hardware, firmware, software, installations, upgrades, and operational procedures. **Vendor \& Stakeholder Collaboration:** Coordinate with service providers, internal teams, and customers through ticketing systems, email, and telephone to resolve issues, manage service requests, and support successful implementations. **Strategic Planning \& Technology Evaluation:** Participate in network planning and technology reviews, evaluating existing hardware and software and recommending solutions that align with evolving business and end\-user needs. **What You Bring to the Team** ----- t:** Practical experience configuring and maintaining Palo Alto firewalls, VPN tunnels, and network security appliances. **The Voice Networking Knowledge:** Strong understanding of voice signaling and transport technologies, including SIP, H.323, G.711, G.723, G.729, and PSTN gateways. **The Enterprise Perspective:** Demonstrated experience supporting network infrastructure and delivering projects within large, distributed, multi\-department organizations. **The Troubleshooter:** Ability to analyze complex network issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions that minimize disruption and maintain service availability. **The Project Delivery Mindset:** Experience executing infrastructure implementations, upgrades, and configuration changes while meeting established objectives and delivery timelines. **The Documentation Discipline:** Ability to produce clear, accurate technical documentation and communicate network changes, findings, and recommendations effectively. **The Educational Foundation:** A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience. **Extra Credit (The Nice\-to\-Haves)** **Advanced Network Design:** Experience designing and implementing complex enterprise routing and switching architectures across distributed environments. **Cloud Networking:** Experience supporting connectivity between enterprise networks, data centers, and cloud\-based business applications. **Network Security \& Resilience:** Experience evaluating network security controls and improving infrastructure availability, reliability, and operational resilience. **Voice Infrastructure Integration:** Familiarity with enterprise VoIP environments, SIP signaling, PSTN gateways, and voice quality troubleshooting. **Continuous Improvement:** A track record of identifying opportunities to improve network performance, strengthen security standards, and streamline operational processes. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- **Complex Engineering Challenges:** Work across enterprise routing, switching, network security, cloud connectivity, and voice infrastructure. **Business\-Critical Impact:** Help maintain the secure, reliable network services that support essential business applications and enterprise operations. **Collaborative Delivery:** Partner with engineering teams, service providers, and business stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve challenging technical issues. **Long\-Term Innovation:** Contribute to network architecture planning, technology evaluations, and the evolution of enterprise infrastructure. The pay range for this opportunity is from $143,100 to $198,300 \+ benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies. \#LI\-CS1 **Experience** -------------- 7 \- 10 Years of Experience **Education** ------------- Bachelor degree or equivalent experience **Preferred Certifications** ---------------------------- **Footer** ---------- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting\-edge AI\-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes. As trailblazers in end\-to\-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post\-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance. Our vision extends beyond mere problem\-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors. Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Salesforce Ventures, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing. **About the Role** ------------------ We're building our first Forward Deployed Engineering team to turn those opportunities into software customers use. You'll be one of the first two engineers shaping the function, with the responsibility to understand a customer's problem, decide what is worth building, and take the solution from an initial idea to a reliable deployment. This is a hands\-on software engineering role. You will write and review code, work through messy data, design integrations and applications, and own how your software behaves after release. You'll also spend time with customers: asking questions, observing workflows, explaining tradeoffs, and testing whether what you've built actually solves the problem. You'll report to our Head of Strategic Accounts and work alongside our account\-facing Solutions Directors, and have a dotted\-line relationship with Engineering. You'll combine direct customer engagement with substantial hands\-on build time. The role is based in New York or San Francisco with 25\-50% travel. **Two paths into the role.** You may have already worked as an FDE or customer\-facing software engineer, with real ownership from discovery through deployment. You may also be a strong software engineer ready for more customer exposure. For that second path, meaningful manufacturing or industrial workflow experience is particularly important. We care more about what you've built and owned than whether you've held the FDE title. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Understand and scope.** Work directly with customer business and technical teams to identify a valuable use case. Turn broad requests into a focused scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a practical delivery plan. Know when existing Axion capabilities are sufficient, when new software is needed, and when a request should be narrowed or declined. * **Build and deploy.** Design and implement the data integrations, business logic, APIs, applications, and AI\-enabled workflows needed for the solution. Deliver usable software iteratively, with tests, clear interfaces, appropriate access controls, and a deployment approach agreed with Engineering. Use AI where it helps; use deterministic software where correctness and repeatability call for it. * **Validate and own.** Reconcile outputs against source data and agreed business rules. Evaluate model behavior when AI is part of the solution. Work with users to validate accuracy, usability, and business value. Monitor deployments, resolve issues, document how the system works, and establish a clear ongoing support model. * **Help the work scale.** Partner with account teams to connect technical delivery to customer adoption and new use cases. Work with Product and Engineering to identify patterns worth reusing, rather than creating a separate product for every customer. Help establish the engineering practices, delivery standards, and working relationships for the FDE team. **What you Bring** ------------------ * **Engineering.** Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of personally shipping and maintaining production software. You can work independently across backend/application logic, data models, APIs, testing, and debugging. You're comfortable reasoning about reliability, permissions, failure cases, and the tradeoffs between a fast first release and a maintainable system. + **Useful experience.** Python and SQL; full\-stack application development with TypeScript/React or comparable tools; enterprise data and API integrations; applied AI or agent workflows with rigorous evaluation; and manufacturing, quality, reliability, supply\-chain, or service operations. You do not need every item on this list. Strong engineering judgment and demonstrated delivery are more important than familiarity with a particular framework. * **Customer ownership.** You enjoy understanding how people work and translating an ambiguous problem into a useful solution. You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues, take responsibility for outcomes, and can push back constructively when a request is not the right thing to build. You're comfortable operating in a small team without waiting for a fully specified backlog. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Customers are using new workflows that would not otherwise have been delivered, can explain the value those workflows create, and have a clear reason to expand their use of Axion. Your software is dependable, your scope decisions are thoughtful, and the work leaves the next deployment easier—not harder—to deliver. **Who You Are** --------------- You’re a builder and operator who thrives in fast\-moving, high\-accountability environments. You take pride in getting things done — thoughtfully, efficiently, and without drama. You’re energized by ambiguity, skilled at bringing clarity, and comfortable flexing between strategy and execution. You value feedback — giving it, receiving it, and acting on it — and you see collaboration as a competitive advantage, not a burden. You’re low\-ego but high\-agency: you care about winning as a team more than being right individually. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data. You don’t need constant direction — you create momentum. You take ownership for outcomes, and you expect the same from those around you. **How We Operate** ------------------ We move fast, work smart, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Axion is a place for people who take pride in their craft and are motivated by meaningful work. We respect time off and boundaries, but we’re also realistic: hard problems sometimes require weekend pushes or late\-night thinking sessions. We support that balance — intensity with respect for recharge. We stay highly collaborative and connected throughout the day — much of our communication happens over Slack. We move quickly, share feedback often, and keep discussions open so decisions and context flow freely. If you value crisp communication, rapid iteration, and a steady hum of collaboration, you’ll fit right in. **We** ------ * **Collaborate deeply.** Feedback is part of how we build — everyone has a voice, and ideas win on merit. * **Leave ego at the door.** Titles don’t define value; contribution does. * **Bias toward action.** We iterate fast and favor progress over perfection. * **Communicate with clarity.** Direct, transparent, and always in service of the mission. * **Act like owners.** Everyone is accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. * **Sustain excellence.** We push hard but don’t glorify burnout — we’re in this for the long game. If you want to help shape a company redefining how manufacturing operates — and you thrive in a culture that rewards ownership, speed, and candor — you’ll feel at home here **What We Offer** ----------------- * Work with cutting\-edge AI technology making a tangible impact in manufacturing * Collaborative, mission\-driven team and supportive leadership * Generous time off * Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits Ready to drive the future of manufacturing with AI? Apply today to join our team and help us build the category\-defining platform for quality intelligence. Axion is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Compensation Range: $220K \- $270K

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer, Axon 911
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer, helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most. 911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job. It means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world. * **This role will be hybrid: 4x a week in the NY office.** **Your Impact** * Lead network projects, including network establishment, upgrades, expansions, and migrations. * Configure and maintain traditional networking infrastructure, including Fortinet firewalls and Cisco switches and routers, and implement security best practices. * Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues, ensuring maximum uptime and reliability in a mission\-critical live system. * Thrive in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and shifting priorities while resolving complex problems independently. * Collaborate with vendors and service providers to build and resolve network\-related challenges. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior network engineers. **What You'll Do** We are currently seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer to join our Global Operations team. In this role, you will focus primarily on network design and Infrastructure as Code, helping us scale the network that powers our innovative public safety products for national first responder systems (911\) and government sectors worldwide. You will play a key part in designing, deploying, and supporting the infrastructure that delivers the highest level of service to our customers 24/7\. **What You Bring** * Cloud Network Engineering (top priority): Strong hands\-on experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Route 53, and ingress/egress traffic flow. * Traditional Networking: Solid foundation in TCP/IP, VLANs, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VPNs, and DNS. Experience with Cisco and Fortinet equipment and SD\-WAN solutions is a plus. * Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in network engineering, preferably in a fast\-paced or critical service environment. * Responsibilities: Network design and deployment, with support as needed. * Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to analyze network logs, perform packet captures, and track down root causes for production issues. Exposure to monitoring tools (Datadog, PRTG) is a plus. * Soft Skills**:** Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical details clearly to team members and non\-technical stakeholders. #### **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, Vision plans * Fitness Programs * Emotional \& Mental Wellness support * Learning \& Development programs * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) * And yes, we have snacks in our offices *Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.* Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.* Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. cycle platforms, APIs, databases, and other enterprise applications. * Build and maintain cloud\-based data infrastructure primarily within AWS. * Create standardized and trusted data models for clinical, operational, financial, and executive reporting. * Build data integration capabilities to support Beacon's growing portfolio of practices and acquired organizations. * Partner with business and technology teams to translate reporting and analytics requirements into scalable data solutions. * Establish data quality, validation, monitoring, lineage, and documentation practices. * Optimize data pipelines and warehouse performance, reliability, and cost. * Develop APIs, data services, and reusable datasets to support applications, automation, analytics, and AI use cases. * Help establish data platforms. * Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and AWS data services. * Advanced proficiency with SQL and Python. * Strong experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating data from APIs, databases, files, and third\-party platforms. * Experience with data modeling, dimensional modeling, data quality, and pipeline orchestration. * Experience building and maintaining production\-grade data pipelines and cloud data infrastructure. * Understanding of data governance, security, access controls, and sensitive data management. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast\-growing environment. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Healthcare data engineering experience strongly preferred. * Experience working with EHR/EMR, clinical, claims, billing, eligibility, or revenue cycle data. * Understanding of healthcare data standards such as HL7, FHIR, X12, ICD\-10, CPT, engineer who enjoys building the data foundation, not simply maintaining an existing environment. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer - Entry Level
jobs.description: Battelle delivers when others can’t. We conduct research and development, manage national laboratories, design and manufacture products and deliver critical services for our clients—whether they are a multi\-national corporation, a small start\-up or a government agency. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. **Job Summary** --------------- We are currently seeking an **AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level**. This position is a full\-time opportunity located in **Columbus, Ohio.** Battelle is seeking an AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level to help improve laboratory efficiency through practical AI, automation, and data solutions. Working alongside scientists, technicians, quality staff, and technology teams, this role will identify repetitive or time\-consuming work and develop tools that simplify laboratory workflows, reduce manual and redundant efforts, improve data quality, and support faster, more consistent operations — while capturing data for use in larger AI and machine learning initiatives. This is a hands\-on learning role. Initial projects may include AI\-assisted data review, sample and inventory tracking, workflow automation, dashboards, laboratory scheduling, document search, and tools that help staff access and use laboratory information more effectively. **Responsibilities** -------------------- As an AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level, the selected individual will develop and deploy practical AI and automation solutions that enhance laboratory operations and data quality. Responsibilities may include: * Assist with building practical AI tools, low\-code applications, dashboards, forms, and automated workflows using approved platforms * Help organize and analyze laboratory data to improve sample tracking, inventory, scheduling, instrument utilization, reporting, and turnaround time * Learn and document laboratory workflows to identify bottlenecks, manual steps, and opportunities for AI or automation * Use approved tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Visual Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, SharePoint, Python, and SQL * Support integration among laboratory systems, instrument data, spreadsheets, databases, and business applications * Help develop and maintain internal data management systems and electronic notebooks across multiple laboratory environments * Participate in requirements gathering, testing, validation, documentation, training, and end\-user support * Capture and report metrics such as time saved, reduced manual entries, fewer errors, improved data access, and increased user adoption * Follow requirements for cybersecurity, data protection, responsible AI, quality, safety, and change control within both internal and client frameworks **Key Qualifications** ---------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Laboratory Science, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Zero to two years of relevant experience, including internships, co\-ops, research, coursework, or significant projects * Interest in applying AI, data, software, or automation to improve laboratory operations * Foundational experience with one or more of the following: Microsoft Power Platform, generative AI tool use and development, Python, SQL, data visualization, workflow automation, or application development * Ability to learn laboratory processes, collaborate with end users, solve practical problems, and communicate clearly * Basic understanding of data quality, testing, documentation, and the responsible use of technology * \[INSERT TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS] * Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of any employment Visa at this time. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Laboratory, research, manufacturing, environmental, healthcare, or other technical operating experience * Exposure to LIMS, electronic laboratory notebooks, scientific instruments, sample tracking, inventory, or quality systems * Experience developing AI\-assisted tools, prompts, workflows, dashboards, or applications through coursework or projects * Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, root\-cause analysis, Git, APIs, or cloud services **Compensation Data** --------------------- Battelle is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is $71,200 – $101,400 per year, in addition to our comprehensive benefits package. A candidate's salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to education, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. Salary ranges may vary based on geographic location and market conditions. **Benefits: Live an Extraordinary Life** We care about your well\-being, not just on the job. Battelle offers comprehensive and competitive benefits to help you live your best life. * **Balance life through a compressed work schedule**: Most of our team follows a flexible, compressed work schedule that allows for every other Friday off—giving you a dedicated day to accomplish things in your personal life without using vacation time. * **Enjoy enhanced work flexibility, including a hybrid arrangement:** You have options for where and when you work. Our Together with Flexibility model allows you to work 60% in\-office and 40% remote, with Monday and Tuesday as common in\-office days, dependent on team and position needs. * **Take time to recharge**: You get paid time off to support work\-life balance and keep motivated. * **Prioritize wellness**: Stay healthy with medical, dental, and vision coverage with wellness incentives and benefits plus a variety of optional supplemental benefits. * **Better together**: Coverage for partners, gender\-affirming care and health support, and family formation support. * **Build your financial future**: Build financial stability with an industry\-leading 401(k) retirement savings plan. For most employees, we put in 5 percent whether you contribute or not, and match your contributions on top of that. * **Advance your education**: Tuition assistance is available to pursue higher education. **A Work Environment Where You Succeed** For brilliant minds in science, technology, engineering and business operations, Battelle is the place to do the greatest good by solving humanity’s most pressing challenges and creating a safer, healthier and more secure world. jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **About Beazley Security** Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017\. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients. As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world\-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges. **Summary** Beazley Security has Claude and Microsoft Copilot deployed across the company. The next step is putting agents to work across every team in the business. This is our first hire dedicated to making that happen. You’ll work with operations, sales, finance, and other non\-technical teams to find manual work worth automating. You’ll build agents in Claude and Copilot Studio, get them into daily use, and measure the time they save. Early on you’ll build most of them yourself, while teaching teams to build their own. You’ll have a big say in what we tackle first and how we build it. This is the first hire for what we plan to grow into a team, so a lot of what you set up early will stick. Beazley Security protects client data and systems for a living, so you’ll build security and privacy into every agent from the start. You’ll help us establish safeguards to ensure that agents can go into production quickly and safely, by building upon our existing agentic security tooling and capabilities.**Responsibilities** * Spend time with teams across the business, watch how the work gets done, and pick the problems where an agent saves hours or removes a manual, error\-prone step. Agree on what success looks like before you build. * Turn a stream of AI ideas into a short, ranked backlog with a clear call on each: build it, help the team build it, or leave it alone. * Estimate what each agent will cost to run, including licensing and token consumption. Use our pre\-agreed guardrails so low\-risk agents go live quickly, and bring in Security, IT, Legal, or Privacy when a use case needs a closer look. * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and supporting automation using the Claude Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio. * Build a group of champions across the business, run hands\-on build sessions and office hours, and create the templates and playbooks teams use to build their own agents safely. * Help maintain a record of every agent in production with its owner, data sources, and access. Evaluate new AI tools when teams ask about them and recommend whether we adopt them. **Your First 90 Days** * **Days 1 to 30:** Get to know Beazley Security. Sit with at least three teams, map their most painful workflows, and build your first agent yourself. Get it into real use, even if it’s small. * **Days 31 to 60:** Two or three agents in production, each measured against a baseline of “value”. A published intake process, and your first AI champions identified. * **Days 61 to 90:** At least one team can point to manual work that’s gone. The agent register and build playbook are live. * **After that:** Champions build their own agents using your patterns, and your results justify the next hire onto this team. **What You'll Have** * Executive buy\-in and support. You report to our Chief Product and Technology Officer, who uses AI every day and has built several agents for internal use. Expect quick decisions and direct help when a project gets stuck. * A first project. A business sponsor and workflow lined up before day one. * A fast review path. Guardrails agreed with Security and Legal before you start, so low\-risk agents don’t sit in a queue. **Qualifications** * You’ve built AI agents or automations that are in daily use, with low\-code tools like Copilot Studio or with code (Python, TypeScript, and the Claude API). * You have hands\-on experience with prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and evaluating agent output, and you know where LLMs fail. * You’ve integrated with REST APIs, MCP servers, connectors, and enterprise authentication. * You’ve typically spent four or more years in a business\-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, solutions consulting, business analysis, automation, or platform delivery. * You can learn a finance or sales operations workflow from the people who run it and build something that improves it. * You know when a use case needs a security or privacy review before it goes anywhere, and you can estimate what an agent will cost to run on Copilot credits or Claude API usage. * You’ve run workshops or training for non\-technical audiences, and you write clearly. * You’d rather ship a small agent that works than constantly plan and iterate on a big one. **Preferred** * Experience in cybersecurity. * Experience running an AI champions program, community of practice, or citizen developer program. * Experience setting up lightweight AI guardrails, like an agent inventory or risk tiers, that keep teams moving quickly. * Familiarity EU data protection requirements. * **When you apply, please** **include a link or a short screen recording of something you built.** **Beazley Security Offers** * Competitive salary and bonus. * Flexible working arrangements. * Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental. * 100% of employee\-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision). * Up to 5% matched 401k contribution. * Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training. * Participation in industry conferences and events.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following: (*Other duties may be assigned.)* **Microsoft Intune \& Endpoint Management** * Administer and maintain Microsoft Intune for Windows, iOS, and Android devices. * Manage Windows device enrollment and provisioning using Windows Autopilot, including Hybrid Autopilot and Microsoft Entra ID joined environments. * Create, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, security policies, and device restrictions. * Manage Windows Update policies, update rings, feature updates, quality updates, and endpoint patching. * Package, deploy, update, and troubleshoot applications through Intune. * Manage device groups, assignments, filters, and deployment targeting. * Troubleshoot device enrollment, synchronization, compliance, application deployment, and configuration issues. **Mobile Device \& Application Management** * Administer iOS/iPadOS and Android devices through Microsoft Intune. * Manage mobile application deployment and configuration. * Support Apple Business Manager and Android Enterprise environments. * Maintain mobile device compliance, security, configuration, and application policies. * Troubleshoot mobile enrollment, application, licensing, and device\-management issues. **Cybersecurity \& Endpoint Security** * Apply cybersecurity best practices across endpoints, servers, identities, and cloud services. * Administer endpoint security controls including Microsoft Defender technologies, BitLocker, Windows Firewall, and security baselines. * Review and implement security recommendations and remediation activities. * Assist with vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and penetration\-testing findings. * Maintain secure endpoint configurations while balancing security requirements with business needs. **Active Directory \& Microsoft 365** * Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Active Directory. * Manage users, computers, groups, organizational units, and Group Policy. * Support hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments. * Administer Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, and Entra ID. * Manage users, licensing, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, and permissions. * Troubleshoot authentication, access, licensing, and Microsoft 365 service issues. **Virtualization \& Server Administration** * Administer and support Nutanix and VMware virtual infrastructure. * Create, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot virtual machines. * Assist with Windows Server administration, server upgrades, maintenance, and troubleshooting. * Coordinate infrastructure maintenance while minimizing business disruption. **Patch \& Application Management** * Manage Windows operating system and third\-party application patching. * Monitor endpoint patch compliance and remediate devices that fail to update. * Coordinate application upgrades and deployments. * Test updates and configuration changes prior to production deployment. * Assist with organization\-wide Windows upgrades and migrations. **Networking, VPN \& MSP Coordination** * Work directly with networking MSPs and vendors to maintain and improve network infrastructure. * Coordinate network, firewall, wireless, and infrastructure upgrades. * Administer and troubleshoot VPN and remote\-access solutions. * Assist with DNS, DHCP, routing, firewall, wireless, and general connectivity troubleshooting. * Coordinate technical changes and troubleshooting between internal IT and external service providers. **PowerShell \& Automation** * Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for system administration and endpoint management. * Deploy PowerShell scripts and remediation tasks through Microsoft Intune. * Automate repetitive administrative tasks, reporting, configuration changes, and troubleshooting. * Utilize PowerShell for Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Entra ID, Exchange Online, and endpoint administration. **Minimum Qualifications** * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Experience with strategic thinking and future planning while also being able to provide tactical assistance. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Intune policies, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, and Windows Update management. * Experience with Windows Autopilot, including an understanding of Hybrid Autopilot and Entra ID joined deployments. * Experience managing Windows 10/11 endpoints. * Experience managing iOS/iPadOS and Android devices through an enterprise MDM platform. * Working knowledge of PowerShell scripting and automation. * Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience administering Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online. * Experience with Nutanix, VMware, or comparable enterprise virtualization technologies. * Working knowledge of networking, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and enterprise network infrastructure. * Understanding of cybersecurity principles, endpoint security, least privilege, vulnerability remediation, and system hardening. * Experience with operating system and third\-party application patch management. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. * Ability to independently manage technical projects and work effectively with MSPs, vendors, internal IT teams, and end users. **QUALIFICATIONS** To perform this job successfully, a Systems Engineer typically include a combination of education, technical skills, and experience: **Proficiency in various technical areas, including:** * Apple Business Manager experience. * Android Enterprise device\-management experience. * Microsoft Defender for Endpoint experience. * BitLocker and Windows security\-baseline management. * Advanced PowerShell scripting and automation. * Experience with hybrid Microsoft environments. * Experience migrating workloads, policies, or devices to Microsoft Intune. * Experience supporting enterprise virtualization and Windows Server environments. * Experience participating in cybersecurity remediation **EXPERIENCE REQUIRED** * Bachelor’s degree (B. A.) or equivalent in computer science, information technology, computer engineering, or a related field or, relevant experience. * Minimum of 4 years of professional IT experience in systems administration, endpoint administration, infrastructure, technical support, or a related IT role. * Minimum of 2 years of hands\-on Microsoft Intune experience managing devices in a production environment. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities but may lead other staff members as part of ongoing projects and technical support issues, as needed. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. #### **Education** Preferred* Bachelors or better in Computer Engineering * Bachelors or better in Computer Science Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description: **Job title:** AI Architect / Senior AI Engineer **Location:** Morrisville, NC (onsite, Raleigh–RTP area) **Job type:** Full\-time **About the role** We’re hiring for a hands\-on AI engineering leader to join a global technology leader at their Raleigh–RTP campus. You’ll design and build multi\-agent AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and an internal AI development platform used by engineering teams across the organization. This role is ideal for a strong senior AI or software engineer ready to step up into architecture. You’ll write production code every day while shaping the technical direction of the platform, working alongside engineering teams and stakeholders. **What you’ll do** * Design and build multi\-agent AI systems, including task delegation between agents, state management, and secure communication. * Build MCP servers and clients that securely connect large language models (LLMs) to enterprise data sources and developer tools. * Contribute to the architecture of an internal AI platform, with a focus on performance, low latency, and a smooth developer experience. * Write high\-quality, production\-ready code, build prototypes, and help set engineering best practices for AI development. * Write clear design documents, mentor engineers, and explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. **What we’re looking for** * 8–12 years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong programming skills in Python or Java. * Solid system design skills: you can break down complex problems, weigh trade\-offs, and design services that hold up at scale. * Experience building and deploying on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with Docker and Kubernetes. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Nice to have** * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications: RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering. * Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI. * Experience with MCP, or with tool calling and function calling in LLM APIs. * Experience with TypeScript or Go. * Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot. **Work location and authorization** * This is an **onsite role** in Morrisville, NC. This role is remote, which means you would work virtually from home or another non\-Best Buy location. **What you'll do*** Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks and tools. * Partner with development and product teams to ensure strong test coverage. * Lead quality and automation initiatives that improve efficiency and reliability. * Mentor engineers and help grow automation capabilities across the team. * Investigate issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive solutions. * Support and optimize cloud\-based testing environments and infrastructure. **Basic qualifications*** 3\+ years of Test Automation/SDET experience using a modern programming language such as Java, C\#, Typescript, or Python. * 3\+ years of experience with Git\-based source control and continuous integration practices. * 2\+ years experience in understanding of both relational and non\-relational databases (preferably MongoDB and SQL Server). * 1\+ years experience maintaining automation frameworks like: Playwright, Selenium, TestNG, pytest, NUnit, Kotlin, or similar. * 1\+ years of experience maintaining solutions built with tools like Postman, Playwright, Appium, Robot, or similar **Preferred qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. * Professional experience working in Agile development environments. * Background in SaaS, mobile (Android/iOS), or API test automation. * Experience delivering high\-availability enterprise software products. * Experience with these automation frameworks like Playwright, Appium, Postman, or Kotlin. * Strong understanding of software design patterns, algorithms, and data structures. **What’s in it for you** We’re committed to helping our people thrive at work and at home.
