jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: New York Engineering In office Full\-time **What is Bilt?** Bilt is the membership for where you live. What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants. Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once. We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens. This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here. **What is Bilt?** ----------------- Bilt is the membership for where you live. We started by rewarding people on their biggest expense, rent, and have grown into a network connecting members, property managers, and local merchants across dining, travel, fitness, and everyday spending. **The role** ------------ Concierge runs in the Bilt app, on the web, and over SMS, iMessage, and email. Members use it for dining, rent, payments, travel, and support. Restaurants and property managers use it to talk with their customers, and their staff use it as an assistant. It handles tens of thousands of conversations a day, with 2–3x spikes at the start of every month, and you'll build and run the backend behind all of it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- * Agent capabilities end to end: tools, workflows, prompts, and the integrations with Bilt and partner systems behind them * The agent runtime: multi\-agent orchestration, context and memory, prompt caching, and routing across frontier and open\-weight models * Performance: p50 and p99 across the full request path, bursty traffic, and cost per conversation * Eval harnesses, LLM judges, and conversation replay, so every model and prompt change is measured before it ships * Assistants for merchants' staff that work from the business's own data, and browser agents that can act where no API exists * Proactive features that drive engagement with members and merchants' customers: briefings, follow\-ups, and outreach that land at the right moment * The conversation platform: one inbox where the agent, merchant staff, and Bilt support share threads across SMS, iMessage, email, web, and in\-app chat * Messaging: realtime streaming replies, attachments, message ordering and idempotent delivery, carrier and iMessage sending limits, and handing off to a person at the right moment * Authentication and fine\-grained authorization, so the agent only sees and does what it should for members, merchants, and staff **How we build** ---------------- We are an AI\-native team. Agents are part of how we write, review, debug, and operate everything. * **Writing.** Coding agents like Claude Code and Devin write much of our code. You design it, review it, and own what ships * **Reviewing.** Every PR gets AI review against rules we write down (prompt\-cache pitfalls, security, performance) before a human codeowner signs off * **Debugging.** Agents have access to our production tooling through an internal MCP gateway: logs, traces, analytics, feature flags, and the service catalog. Investigations usually start with an agent pulling the evidence * **Sharing context.** Repos carry agent instructions, and we keep a shared library of skills and playbooks, so recurring work becomes a single command and every agent starts with the team's context * **Owning.** Each engineer owns a large surface from design through rollout and on\-call. We ship daily behind flags, treat performance and availability as acceptance criteria, and read real conversations, not only dashboards **You have** ------------ * 4\+ years building and operating backend services in production * Strength in at least one backend language and experience running services in the cloud. We mostly use Python (FastAPI), Java (Quarkus), and Go on Google Cloud * Solid distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, caching), and you debug across services with logs, traces, and metrics * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, at work or on your own, and curiosity about making them reliable * Product judgment: you can read a bad conversation and tell whether the cause is the prompt, a tool, the data, or a service * Daily use of AI coding agents, and good judgment about when to trust their output * Clear writing. Design docs, PR descriptions, and the prompts you give agents all matter here **Bonus** --------- * Shipped an LLM\-powered feature to real users, and can explain what broke and how you measured it * Agent frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar), tool calling, evals, LLM\-as\-judge * Model serving and inference: provider routing, open\-weight models, latency and cost tuning * Messaging or realtime infrastructure * Browser automation or computer\-use agents * Identity and access: OAuth/OIDC, token exchange, fine\-grained authorization **Benefits** ------------ * **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program * **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one \-** Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one. * **401k plan with a match \-** Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there. * **Commuter FSAs \-** We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive. * **UNLIMITED PTO \-** Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for yourself as often as you need it. * **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points \-** We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt. * **Team Events \-** We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week. At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations. We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process. Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt Rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time. The salary range for a **Back End / AI Engineer** is **$170,000 \- $300,000** *(based on YOE/level)***,** and you will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus. Req ID: R349

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)
jobs.description: **Title:** Embedded Software Engineer (IoT) **Hours:** Full\-time **Location:** Midvale, UT (On\-site with occasional remote flexibility) \#LI\-Onsite **You report to:** Software Engineering Manager **Compensation:** A base salary range of $120,000\-$135,000 gross per year, depending on candidate experience. **Our Benefits:** * Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with BioLite covering 90–100% of monthly premiums, depending on plan selection. * 401(k) with Employer Match * Paid Time Off: Paid holidays, vacation, sick time, and family leave to support work\-life balance. * Equity \& Bonus Opportunities: Community bonus plan and stock option eligibility for all full\-time employees. * Adventure Stipend (after two years): PTO to go on an adventure that aligns with BioLite's mission of bringing energy everywhere, whether that's outdoor recreation, climate action, or social impact. * Employee Product Discount: Employees enjoy generous discounts on BioLite and Goal Zero products. **This Role:** BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces, and we are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Midvale\-based team. In this role, you will develop the firmware that connects our power products to the cloud (AWS IoT) and to our Flutter and React Native mobile apps. You will work on the wireless connectivity modules in our home backup and portable power products. These modules work alongside battery management, inverter, and power conversion subsystems. You will focus on provisioning, OTA updates, device\-to\-cloud messaging, fleet telemetry, and the protocols among modules in the rest of the system. Our current products use the ESP32, and you will help choose and bring up the wireless platform for our next generation of products. Options we are looking at include embedded Rust (Embassy), embedded Linux, and smart home standards such as Matter and Thread. A large part of this job is making existing firmware better. You will refactor, add tests, and pay down technical debt so the team ships faster with fewer field issues. You will work with firmware, electrical, cloud, and mobile engineers. You will debug at the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and your code will run on devices in homes and in the field. **You Will:** * **Develop connectivity\-module firmware:** Develop and maintain firmware for our Wi\-Fi and Bluetooth LE connectivity modules, including provisioning, configuration, OTA updates, and device\-to\-cloud messaging. * **Improve the codebase you inherit:** Refactor existing firmware, add unit and hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, and set coding standards that make changes safe and code reviews fast. * **Build communication protocols:** Develop the protocol libraries that connect our subsystems (battery management, inverter, IoT module) to each other and to the mobile app. * **Lead the firmware build and release pipeline:** Maintain CI/CD in GitHub Actions for firmware builds, tests, and releases for your projects. Make OTA releases reliable and traceable. * **Work across the device\-to\-cloud path:** Work with cloud and mobile engineers on device APIs (AWS IoT), fleet telemetry, and app integration. Debug issues end\-to\-end, from the radio to the app. * **Use modern tools:** Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to speed up prototyping, debugging, testing, and documentation. * **Review and document:** Take part in code and design reviews. Document designs for other developers, QA, manufacturing partners, and support. **You Have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; OR 5\+ years of directly relevant experience. * 3\+ years writing production firmware in C/C\+\+ for microcontrollers or SoCs (e.g., Espressif ESP32, Nordic nRF, ST STM32, or other Arm Cortex\-M). * Experience with a real\-time operating system (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and a wireless vendor SDK (e.g., ESP\-IDF, nRF Connect SDK). * Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and an IoT messaging protocol such as MQTT. * Working knowledge of bootloaders, OTA updates, and device provisioning. * Working knowledge of serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN). * Experience testing embedded code (unit tests, simulation, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop). * Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for build, test, and tooling scripts. * Experience with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD. * Experience with AI coding assistants in your daily work. **Nice to Have:** You do not need the following skills to apply, but please let us know if you have experience in any of these areas. * Experience with AWS IoT Core or another cloud IoT platform, including REST APIs. * Experience with mobile app development (native, Flutter, or React Native). * Experience with smart home protocols such as Matter, Thread, Zigbee, or Z\-Wave. * Experience with or interest in embedded Rust (e.g., Embassy) or embedded Linux (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot). * Experience with fleet monitoring, device telemetry, or crash reporting. * Experience with consumer electronics, batteries, or power conversion. **To Apply:** * Please include a cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for this position. Feel free to link or describe a relevant personal project, hobby build, or open\-source contribution that highlights your firmware or software skills. * **You must be authorized to work for an employer in the U.S.** BioLite cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position. **About BioLite:** BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces to power life, anywhere. Together, we provide clean energy solutions that serve two distinct yet connected markets: families living in energy poverty and outdoor adventurers seeking fuel\-independent power and light. From solar panels and portable power stations to cookstoves and lighting systems, our technologies help people cook, charge, and stay connected, whether at home, on the road, or off the grid. jobs.description: **About Bitdeer AI:** Bitdeer AI, a full\-stack AI cloud provider (AI Data Center, IaaS, PaaS, MaaS) under Bitdeer Technologies Group and a preferred NVIDIA Cloud Partner, is engineered to power the AI of tomorrow. With the group's 3 Gigawatts of power capacity deployed and under development globally, Bitdeer holds a decisive advantage in the AI era: the massive energy, physical infrastructure, and compute foundation required to run intelligence at global scale. Operating across strategic international hubs, including the United States, Singapore, and Europe, we build on one core promise: One Cloud, Infinite Possibilities. **Our Two Core Missions**: * Transforming Hyperscale Power into Useful AI: We take the extreme complexity of gigawatt\-scale energy grids, liquid\-cooled data center topologies, and low\-latency networking fabrics, and turn that raw physical power into accessible, high\-performance AI Cloud that directly drives real\-world intelligence. * Building an Integrated Full\-Stack Cloud Platform: We engineer the complete software layer, spanning bare\-metal provisioning, managed Kubernetes, distributed training pipelines, high\-throughput AI Inference engines, and Model\-as\-a\-Service (MaaS) with serverless APIs, empowering enterprises to seamlessly train, fine\-tune, deploy, and serve next\-generation AI intelligence. **We are seeking** **2027 New College Graduates:** Why Start Your Career at Bitdeer AI? We don't just look at the infrastructure layer, we build across the entire value chain for our full\-stack cloud. At Bitdeer AI, you will architect the actual backbone of global artificial intelligence. From foundation\-level hardware orchestration and low\-latency Inference systems to upper\-layer MaaS platforms and AI Agents environments, you will solve high\-scale systems challenges that few companies on Earth have the power capacity to attempt. Your work will directly power the global AI ecosystem, from ambitious startups and elite research institutions to global enterprises. Artificial intelligence is reshaping human potential, but the future of AI relies on real\-world compute, reliable infrastructure and engineering, and massive power. Don't just witness the AI revolution. Power it. Join Bitdeer AI, and build the intelligence for infinite possibilities. **What you will be responsible for** We are looking for key talents to develop in the following areas: * Cloud Service Platform: Development of large\-scale, highly available AI cloud services, including GPU virtual machines, bare\-metal services, container services, cloud networking, storage, billing, monitoring, security, and multi\-region resource management. * Kubernetes Service Platform: Development of managed Kubernetes services with GPU\-native orchestration, intelligent scheduling, distributed workload management, cluster lifecycle management, observability, resource isolation, and support for large\-scale AI training and inference workloads. * AI Model Training and Inference Platform: Development of distributed training, model fine\-tuning, model deployment, inference acceleration, serverless inference, model APIs, model evaluation, and production\-grade LLM and multimodal model\-serving capabilities. * AI Agent Platform: Development of enterprise AI Agent platforms, including Agent building, workflow orchestration, tool integration, retrieval\-augmented generation, memory systems, sandbox execution, multi\-Agent collaboration, evaluation, observability, security, and large\-scale Agent runtime infrastructure. * Advanced AI Systems: Development of GPU resource scheduling, distributed systems, high\-performance networking, cloud\-native infrastructure, MLOps and LLMOps platforms, AI application marketplaces, and automated operation systems for large\-scale AI infrastructure. Career Opportunities within the Program: * Cloud Platform Engineering * AI Operations, MLOps \& Site Reliability Engineering * MaaS, Model Serving \& AI Training Infrastructure * AI Agent \& Application Engineering * AI \& Cloud Security Engineering * AI Research Successful candidates will start in one of the above areas based on the interview assessment and business needs. Opportunities to rotate across different roles will also be provided as part of career development. **How you will stand out** * Fresh graduates (Bachelors, Masters, PhD) from all disciplines and/or candidates with up to 2 years of related work experience. * Strong programming ability in one or more languages, including Go, Python, C\+\+, Java, Rust, or related technologies. * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Terraform, OpenStack, Prometheus, Grafana, Argo, Istio, PostgreSQL, Redis, message queues, distributed storage, or other cloud\-native technologies is highly preferred. * Experience in developing or operating large\-scale cloud platforms, Kubernetes platforms, AI training platforms, inference platforms, or Agent platforms is highly preferred. * Deep enthusiasm for cutting\-edge AI infrastructure, cloud\-native technologies, and building large\-scale, globally distributed systems. * Proven achievements in academics, engineering projects, top\-tier publications, open\-source contributions, or programming/algorithm competitions. * A strong ownership mentality, engineering discipline, and a commitment to creating a meaningful impact early in your career as we build the foundation for next\-generation AI. **What you will experience working with us** * A culture that values authenticity and diverse perspectives. * An inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start\-up spirit. * A fast\-growing company with opportunities to network with industry pioneers and enthusiasts. * The ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset and AI computing industry. * Involvement in new projects and in developing processes/systems. * Personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities. * Attractive benefits and development such as training and mentoring. jobs.description: Locations: **San Francisco, California; Sausalito, California** Additional Locations: **Sausalito, CA** **Job description** ------------------- **About this role** **Team Overview** BlackRock SMA Solutions helps clients customize portfolios for unique tax, values\-alignment, or investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi\-asset. jobs.title: Director of Engineering Integrated Platform | Platform Engineering, SRE & DevOps
jobs.description: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. **Build the platform. Grow the leaders. Shape what comes next.** Broadridge is building a new Integrated Platform at the heart of its wider company strategy. Connecting enterprise applications and client\-facing experiences across Capital Markets, Wealth Management, Investor Communications, and other business domains, the platform brings together a common ontology, standardized APIs, and scalable event\-driven capabilities to enable connected services and innovation. This newly created Director of Engineering role is directly embedded in that strategy and critical to making it a reality. You will turn strategic ambition into reliable, scalable capabilities by leading multiple engineering managers and team leads across a multi\-layer organization. Your mandate spans platform reliability, incident and release management, DevOps transformation, and responsible AI adoption. This is a role for a builder of teams and technology who wants to shape a company\-wide strategic priority—not simply run an operational function. Partner with senior leaders to translate goals into engineering outcomes, empower your managers, and guide architecture and critical technical decisions while delivering through your teams. **Your leadership and delivery mandate** Lead leaders and build the organization. Manage and coach engineering managers and team leads across SRE, DevOps, and release engineering. Own organizational design, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development. Establish clear decision rights, delegated ownership, and sustainable on\-call practices. Own the DevOps and platform engineering roadmap. Translate company strategy and platform priorities into a multi\-quarter roadmap for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment consistency, self\-service tooling, and toil reduction. Align capacity, dependencies, and investment with product, architecture, security, and operations. Lead incident management. Establish major\-incident readiness, escalation, incident command, and stakeholder communication. Ensure timely recovery, blameless reviews, and closure of corrective actions. Partner with service owners to reduce recurring incidents and improve recovery performance. Own release management and readiness. Establish release governance, delivery calendars, quality gates, and production\-readiness criteria. Advance automated testing, security checks, artifact traceability, progressive delivery, and safe rollback or roll\-forward across API, database, and event\-schema dependencies. **Your leadership and delivery mandate, continued** * Create and deliver the AI roadmap. Identify high\-value opportunities in engineering productivity, testing, knowledge retrieval, incident investigation, and controlled remediation. * Lead pilots and adoption of approved tools; measure benefits and quality, protect sensitive information, and retain human authorization for production changes. * Make reliability and resilience measurable. Define SLIs, SLOs, and error\-budget practices with service owners. Improve observability, capacity planning, performance, and data integrity across AWS, Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL. Validate failover, backup restoration, and disaster recovery against agreed objectives. * Provide leadership reporting and strategic delivery accountability. Connect engineering milestones to company goals through an executive scorecard covering service health, release performance, roadmap progress, AI outcomes, talent, cost, and risk. Surface dependencies and investment trade\-offs early; align leaders on the decisions needed to deliver. * Build a platform engineers want to use. Treat shared capabilities as products: create reusable patterns and self\-service experiences, gather developer feedback, and measure adoption. Partner with security and risk teams on auditable controls and software supply\-chain integrity; improve cloud cost efficiency without compromising resilience. **What you bring** * **Sustained production ownership:** 10\+ years in engineering, including sustained, direct ownership of production SRE or cloud reliability for business\-critical distributed systems. A record of improving availability, recovery time, and operational toil—not simply overseeing teams that own reliability. * **Deep AWS fluency:** Designing and operating resilient services across IAM, networking, compute (EKS, ECS, or Lambda), observability, and infrastructure as code. Demonstrated improvements in capacity, failure isolation, multi\-AZ resilience, and tested recovery against RTO/RPO targets. * **Proven major\-incident leadership:** Directing cross\-service response, making recovery decisions under pressure, and communicating business impact. Evidence of reduced detection and recovery  time while improving delivery speed. * **Applied SRE depth:** Establishing SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, actionable observability, and sustainable on\-call practices. A record of using reliability data to prioritize engineering investment and replacing recurring manual work with tested automation. * **Strong production troubleshooting:** Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL—including runtime performance, consumer lag and delivery semantics, query and transaction behavior, and data integrity. Ability to challenge designs and guide evidence\-based diagnosis beyond infrastructure symptoms. * **Leadership rooted in the discipline:** Experience leading engineering managers and team leads in SRE, DevOps, or production engineering. Ability to turn reliability and release priorities into funded roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and clear executive reporting; practical judgment on safe, evaluated AI\-assisted engineering. **Experience that will help you stand out** Financial services or other regulated environments; globally distributed engineering leadership; Kubernetes, Terraform, Open Telemetry, Kafka Connect, or PostgreSQL high availability; progressive delivery, developer platforms, policy\-as\-code, or measurable AI\-enabled engineering improvements. **The impact you can make** Help turn a company\-wide strategy into capabilities that teams and clients can rely on. Build a leadership bench that scales, create a safer and faster path to production, and use automation and AI to unlock engineering potential. Bring your curiosity, ambition, and passion for developing people—and help shape the next chapter of the Broadridge Integrated Platform. *"Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education."* *Salary Range: 235,000\.00 – 250,000\.00 USD annual* *Bonus Eligible* *Please visit* www.broadridgebenefits.com *for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings.* *\#LI\-NO1* We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. **Use of AI in Hiring** As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration. US applicants: Click here to view the EEOC "Know Your Rights" poster. ***Disability Assistance*** We recognize that ensuring our long\-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. Broadridge provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, and other protected characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you need assistance or would like to request reasonable accommodations during the application and/or hiring process, please contact us at 888\-237\-7769 or by sending an email to BRcareers@broadridge.com.

jobs.description: **Compensation:** $175,000\-$250,000 per year **Location:** United States – Remote or Omaha, NE \- Hybrid **The job:** As a Principal Cloud Engineer, AI Platform at Buildertrend, you’ll shape the cloud foundation that allows AI agents to support real customer workflows while protecting data, controlling costs and maintaining performance. You’ll own critical platform architecture, establish standards that help engineering teams move independently and make the technical decisions that determine how safely we scale AI across our products. AI agents are already changing how work gets done, and the infrastructure behind them determines whether that change is secure, reliable and sustainable. Your work will help builders and remodelers spend less time managing processes and more time growing their businesses. **What you will do:** * Design and maintain the infrastructure behind production AI agents, including workload identity, ingress and egress gateways, network isolation and platform\-level sensitive data redaction. * Lead decisions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) networking, private connectivity, zero\-trust egress and service perimeters to protect workloads without limiting the platform’s ability to grow. * Develop reusable Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines that help product teams deploy safely and independently, including temporary environments for validating changes before merge. * Establish a centralized, approved path for large language models (LLM) access, including routing, virtual keys, provider onboarding, observability and cost attribution. * Document platform and vendor decisions with total cost of ownership, barriers to entry, trade\-offs and open questions clearly defined so teams can make informed decisions and build on a consistent foundation. * Serve as a technical counterpart to major cloud and AI providers, escalate complex issues and validate roadmap commitments before they influence platform architecture. * Take incident command during critical production issues, make informed go/no\-go decisions under pressure and communicate risks and status clearly to technical leaders and executives. * Implement safeguards for credentials, secrets and AI usage, including automated secrets rotation and policy\-as\-code controls that reduce the risk of unauthorized AI deployments. * Lead blameless postmortems, identify systemic weaknesses and turn incident findings into measurable improvements in platform security, resilience and operational readiness. * Embrace using AI as a tool to enhance your work, while remaining open to learning, applying critical thinking, and owning the quality of your final work. **Who you are and what you need:** * 10\+ years of experience architecting enterprise\-grade GCP environments, with advanced knowledge of GCP\-native networking, including VPC Service Controls and Private Service Connect, as well as IAM perimeters and Workload Identity. * Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company. * Strong infrastructure as code practice. * Hands\-on experience running AI or ML workloads in production, such as model serving, agent runtimes or inference gateways, and understand how their needs differ from traditional web applications. * Practical depth in workload identity and machine\-to\-machine authorization, including service accounts, short\-lived credentials, certificate\-based identity, and token delegation, and the challenges of on\-behalf\-of authorization flows. * Track record\-owning production incidents, including calling deployments under pressure and updating executives during an outage. * Experience with agent development frameworks, agent runtime platforms and the emerging tooling around them. * Approach incidents without blame, communicate directly, take ownership of platform outcomes and turn lessons learned into practical improvements that help other engineers deliver reliable software. * Experience with automated secrets rotation, policy as code and governance that limits unauthorized “Shadow AI” deployments, with an eye on the new attack surfaces AI creates. **We are giving you:** * Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability benefits * A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future * Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge * Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments * Volunteer time off – because giving back matters Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best * Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need * Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home * Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team **Who we are:** Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. If you want to learn more about us, check out: https://buildertrend.com/about/ **Working at Buildertrend:** At Buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. What makes Buildertrend so special is a commitment to ensuring you can have the best job, work with the best people, and live your best life outside of work. Our goal is to create a culture where everyone can make an impact on our customers, communities, and each other. The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics on applicants.* *Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A “reasonable accommodation” is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Buildertrend Solutions, Inc. To see the complete list of Essential Job Functions, visit* *https://buildertrend.com/essential\-job\-functions\-notice/*

Team Leadership and Management * Manage, mentor, and develop a team of Databricks engineers, data engineers, architects, and technical consultants. * Assign resources and responsibilities based on project needs, employee strengths, availability, and technical complexity. * Establish measurable goals, performance expectations, development plans, and technical competency standards. * Conduct practices. * Knowledge of data integration tools and APIs. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **4 weeks** ***(Paid time off that accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy)*** **\+ 10 paid holidays in your first year** * **Comprehensive benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance * **Retirement plans**: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI services, and other CMT\-approved technologies. * Coordinate solution development with Technology, Data Analytics, Dev, cybersecurity, legal, jobs.description: **Pricefx Solution Architect — Independent Contractor (1099\)** **Position Type: Independent Contractor (1099\)** **Engagement Duration: Anticipated 6 months (subject to project milestones and phase extensions)** **Estimated Effort: Variable, 20–40 hours/week** **Location: Remote (US\-based)** **Hourly Compensation Rate: Commensurate with specialized expertise** **Canidium is a market leader in Sales Performance Management (SPM), Pricing, and Configure\-Price\-Quote (CPQ) solutions. We partner with mid\-sized and Fortune 500 enterprise clients to deliver high\-impact technical implementations on leading SaaS technology platforms.** **We engage highly skilled independent technical professionals to execute specialized, milestone\-based scope of work deliverables. This engagement is open to remote independent contractors in the United States or qualified offshore/nearshore contractors with direct Pricefx implementation experience.** **Engagement Mission \& Scope Overview** ======================================== **The Pricefx Solution Architect Contractor provides expert\-level solution design, technical leadership, and architectural oversight critical to the successful delivery of complex SaaS pricing implementations.** **Operating as the primary technical authority on assigned project modules, you will translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable, and maintainable Pricefx architecture designs while providing technical governance to configuration and integration engineers across the project lifecycle.** **Contracted Deliverables Across Implementation Lifecycle** =========================================================== **The contractor will independently execute and manage the following key technical deliverables:** **1\. Architecture Design \& Solution Blueprinting** ---------------------------------------------------- * **Formulate high\-level and detailed solution architecture designs aligned with client business objectives and Pricefx platform best practices.** * **Define system boundaries, data flow models, and architectural specifications for core Pricefx modules (Price Setting, Quoting, Rebates, Agreements, Analytics).** * **Design data integration patterns between Pricefx and external enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, CPQ).** **2\. Requirements Formalization \& Story Specification** --------------------------------------------------------- * **Lead technical discussions to capture, analyze, and translate complex client business logic into formalized technical specifications and user stories.** * **Identify conflicting logic, contradictory pricing rules, or architectural edge cases, providing formal written risk assessments and resolution proposals.** * **Define rigorous technical acceptance criteria for configuration and integration components.** **3\. Technical Oversight \& Configuration Strategy** ----------------------------------------------------- * **Establish configuration guidelines and coding standards for native Pricefx script development using Groovy.** * **Provide architectural direction to Configuration Engineers and Integration Engineers to ensure alignment with approved solution blueprints.** * **Conduct technical code reviews and validate custom logic implementations.** **4\. Integration Design \& System Interoperability** ----------------------------------------------------- * **Define integration specifications for data exchange via REST APIs, web services, and ETL middleware (e.g., Apache Camel, Pricefx Integration Manager).** * **Validate data models, transformation rules, and schema mappings connecting Pricefx with enterprise systems such as SAP ECC, S/4HANA, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics.** **5\. Defect Resolution \& Quality Governance** ----------------------------------------------- * **Provide senior\-level technical triage and root\-cause analysis for complex bugs and architectural defects.** * **Liaise directly with Pricefx product support and client technical teams to resolve core platform or integration issues.** * **Deliver evidence\-backed technical quality gate evaluations and sign\-offs prior to key deployment milestones (Sprint completion, SIT, UAT, and Go\-Live).** **Contractor Qualifications \& Expertise** ========================================== **Required Technical \& Domain Qualifications** ----------------------------------------------- * **Certifications: Valid Pricefx Solution Architect Certification is required. Pricefx Configuration Engineer (CE) or Integration Engineer (IE) certifications are strongly preferred.** * **Professional Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience in enterprise software implementations, with demonstrated history serving as a Solution Architect on full lifecycle Pricefx projects.** * **Programming Proficiency: Advanced working knowledge of object\-oriented programming principles, with proven proficiency in Groovy and Java.** * **Pricing Domain Expertise: In\-depth domain knowledge of B2B pricing strategies, discount structures, rebate management, price optimization, live price grids, and CPQ workflows.** * **Data \& Web Technologies: Hands\-on experience with relational databases (SQL, schema design, complex query optimization) and web technologies (REST APIs, JSON, Web Services, HTML).** * **Enterprise Integration: Proven experience designing data integrations connecting SaaS solutions with enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.** * **Communication \& Autonomy: Fluent written and spoken English, with exceptional technical writing ability and client\-facing facilitation skills. Ability to drive deliverables independently in a remote setting.** **Preferred Technical Experience** ---------------------------------- * **Proficiency with AI\-assisted code development tools (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent developer assistants).** * **Hands\-on experience with Apache Camel or specialized ETL tools.** * **Proficiency with version control tools (Git, GitHub, or GitLab) and Agile project management suites (Jira, Confluence).** **Evaluation \& Assessment Process** ==================================== **To verify technical capabilities and architecture proficiency, qualified applicants will undergo a streamlined evaluation process:** * **Initial Technical Discussion: A 30\-minute review of prior Pricefx architecture projects, engagement terms, and availability.** * **Practical Architecture Assessment: A 45\-minute practical exercise in a Pricefx sandbox environment. Candidates will be provided with a complex client pricing scenario and user story specifications to evaluate architectural strategy, Groovy configuration approach, and technical problem\-solving capabilities in real time.** **How We Interview** ==================== **Our evaluation process is focused on practical capabilities rather than passive resume reviews:** * **Initial Introductory Call: A brief conversation to review your background, communication skills, and engagement availability.** * **Practical Working Session (45 Minutes): A live practical exercise where you will review a set of sample pricing user stories, evaluate data results, identify logic contradictions, and write up a reproducible defect report using your standard tools.** **Contractor Compensation \& Engagement Terms** **Proposed contract rates for this engagement depend on experience and scope of deliverables. As an independent contractor, services will be provided on an invoice basis without eligibility for employee benefits or bonus programs.**

turn their knowledge into the model and a shared glossary. * Treat the ontology and mappings as code: versioned, tested (competency questions as SPARQL tests, SHACL conformance) and run in CI. * Write the documentation, schema summaries and example queries that ground the diagnostic agents. * Maintain the competency questions and expected answers used to test the agents on historical incidents.Clearly communicate component status and issues in MS\-Office applications e.g. PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook * Review CAD and 2D drawings for components including GD\&T **Mandatory Skills:** * 4\+ years building knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic data platforms that were used in production. * Hands\-on RDF/RDFS, OWL 2, SPARQL 1\.1 and SHACL. * Solid Python (rdflib, pySHACL or similar), git and CI. * Ability to work with domain experts and to explain modelling choices to software engineers. * Data preparation and entity resolution on messy, multi\-source asset data (relational, spreadsheets, JSON). * Mapping data to RDF (R2RML/RML or equivalent ETL). **Preferred Requirements:** * Electrical power\-chain or data\-center domain knowledge (UPS, busway, switchgear, PDUs) and maintenance vocabulary (failure modes, FMEA, condition monitoring). * Standard vocabularies: Brick, RealEstateCore / ASHRAE 223, SOSA/SSN, QUDT, ISO 14224, IEC 81346\. * Combining knowledge graphs with LLMs: GraphRAG, text\-to\-SPARQL, ontology\-grounded prompting. * Property graphs (Neo4j/Cypher), with an informed view of when each approach fits. * Protégé, TopBraid or LinkML used at scale. jobs.title: Identity Resolution Engineer
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double\-digit rates. Its molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data support software that helps ensure a cancer patient's report is right, complete, and on time. The Senior Software Engineer \- Identity Resolution \& Master Data Management designs, builds, and operates the production identity capabilities that regulated clinical workflows depend on: matching, linking, merging, and separating identity records under auditable controls, so that clinical information lands on the correct patient and provider records across complex healthcare data flows. The engineer improves resolution quality, data integrity, and operational reliability, and every change ships through controlled, testable delivery practices. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay serve as executable evidence, and onboarding is harness\-first: the engineer builds or extends those tests to capture current behavior as repeatable validation evidence. Delivery runs on CI/CD, automated testing, application\-level observability, and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. The specific technology stack is discussed during the interview process. Reporting to an Engineering Manager or Senior Engineering Manager in Clinical Software Engineering, this senior individual contributor leads technical delivery in the identity\-resolution domain, participates in architecture and design decisions, and maintains software subject to SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements. Location: Irving, Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth), on\-site/hybrid, minimum three days per week on campus; co\-located with Caris's laboratory and clinical operations. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, and maintain identity\-resolution and MDM services for patient and provider data. * Develop and tune deterministic and probabilistic matching across names, addresses, dates of birth, contact information, identifiers, and other approved attributes. * Implement workflows to merge, unmerge, link, and separate records, with durable audit trails and safeguards for downstream clinical use. * Define and monitor resolution\-quality, data\-quality, performance, and reliability measures; investigate anomalies and strengthen controls. * Own the data models, APIs, and integration patterns that connect upstream and downstream clinical systems. * Partner with product management, data governance, clinical operations, compliance, and engineering to refine requirements and manage identity\-related risks. * Write and maintain the technical record: design documents, architecture decision records, data\-flow documentation, and operational runbooks. * Review code and submit work for review; contribute automated unit, integration, regression, and performance tests. * Automate recurring engineering and operational tasks: repeated manual steps become scripted, reviewed automation rather than standing process. * Instrument and support production services; participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, and corrective\-action work. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers through code review, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. * Work AI\-first: use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as daily practice across design, implementation, and test generation, with peer and engineering review as the quality gate. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software systems. * 3\+ of those years designing or operating entity\-resolution, record\-linkage, MDM, or comparable identity systems in production. * 2\+ of those years building system integrations through APIs, event\-driven patterns, or batch data pipelines. * A track record of implementing matching logic across multiple identity attributes and evaluating it against measurable quality controls. * Experience designing data models and remediation workflows for duplicate, conflicting, or incomplete records. * Command of full SDLC practices, automated testing, code review, and controlled production delivery. * Operating experience with high\-volume production services: observability, incident response, and root\-cause analysis. * Hands\-on fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development workflows in real engineering work. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Experience with MPI or enterprise identity\-resolution platforms. * Familiarity with HL7 messaging and FHIR. * Depth in relational and document databases: SQL, indexing, and query optimization. * Experience applying graph databases, probabilistic methods, or ML to entity resolution. * Experience with CI/CD, automated regression testing, and production observability. * Experience implementing or operating controls aligned with SOX ITGCs or FDA requirements under 21 CFR. * Experience in CLIA\- or HIPAA\-governed environments. Regulated\-domain experience is preferred, not required. **Physical Demands** * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. **Training** * All job\-specific, safety, and compliance training is assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * This role may require periodic travel to other Caris sites or partner locations. After\-hours response to critical patient\-identity or clinical\-data issues and participation in periodic scheduled on\-call rotations may be required. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer, AI Solutions
jobs.description: The exciting world of scientific research is fueled by people with a passion for solving complex problems. At Cayuse, we are committed to our customers' success by empowering organizations to conduct globally connected research that advances their impact on science, discovery and society. We build on that commitment with proven, integrated and easy\-to\-use technology that delivers exceptional value, and world class service and support that accelerates outcomes. But we are more than just an empowering platform powered by advanced technologies. We are a collaboration of exceptional, highly skilled people with multi\-disciplinary expertise, and are building our team to support our ambitious growth plans. Cayuse's foundational strength comes from our customer and employee focused values and commitment to industry\-leading solutions. It's an exciting time to become a key member of our growing team. Join our remote first culture as an Associate Engineer, an entry\-level, hands\-on engineering role focused on building AI capabilities directly into Cayuse products. You will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, test, and ship AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and LLM\-powered features that help research institutions and their administrators work faster and with less manual effort. This is not a data science or ML research role. It is a software engineering role for someone early in their career who writes solid code, learns quickly, and wants to grow into a strong AI engineer by shipping real features to real customers. #### #### **Responsibilities** As an Associate Engineer, you will contribute across the full development cycle of AI\-powered product features, with mentorship and code review from senior engineers. Success in this role means delivering well\-tested, maintainable code, understanding the problems you're solving, applying feedback, and progressively taking on more complex engineering responsibilities. * **AI Agent Development:** Build and maintain AI agents that use large language models (such as Claude) to complete multi\-step tasks within Cayuse products — calling tools, retrieving data, and taking actions on behalf of users. Implement prompts, tool definitions, and orchestration logic under the guidance of senior engineers. * **MCP Server Development:** Help build and extend Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that allow AI assistants to securely interact with Cayuse products. Work with senior engineers to implement tools, APIs, authentication, and permission checks using established engineering standards. Write clear documentation and tests to ensure these integrations are reliable and reusable. * **Hybrid AI Validation:** Help turn AI\-extracted rules, such as requirements parsed from funding opportunity instructions, into deterministic, auditable validations that run alongside existing form rules and are reviewed by people before use. * **Product Integration:** Integrate AI features into existing Cayuse applications through platform APIs. Build on the shared capabilities and patterns set by the architecture team instead of one\-off implementations, and partner with product teams so AI fits naturally into customer workflows. * **Testing \& Evaluation:** Write unit and integration tests for AI features, and help build evaluation sets that measure the accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost of LLM outputs. Contribute to time\-boxed AI pilots and help document whether each should go, pivot, or stop. Investigate failures, identify root causes, and propose fixes. * **Deployment \& Operations:** Ship code through CI/CD pipelines to cloud environments (AWS, including Amazon Bedrock). Add logging and monitoring to AI services and help troubleshoot production issues. * **Learning \& Collaboration:** Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint ceremonies. Keep current with the fast\-moving AI tooling ecosystem and share what you learn with the team. * **Governed AI Platform:** Develop AI features using Cayuse's shared AI platform and established engineering standards. Learn how our platform handles model access, security, tenant isolation, usage tracking, and auditing. Work with senior engineers to ensure new features follow these patterns rather than introducing one\-off solutions. * **Responsible AI \& Security:** Follow established security and privacy standards when developing AI features. Learn to recognize and test for risks such as prompt injection, unauthorized data access, and inaccurate AI outputs. Work with senior engineers to ensure AI features respect user permissions, protect customer data, and maintain proper tenant isolation. Raise potential security or reliability concerns early. #### **Qualifications** **Core Experience** * 0–2 years of professional software development experience, including internships, co\-ops, or apprenticeships. * Demonstrated ability to build working software through coursework, internships, personal projects, open\-source contributions, or hackathons. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend (Clearing)
jobs.description: **Job Description:** -------------------- **Building trusted markets — powered by our people** At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting\-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. We're building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we've earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities. To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model. **Location Overview:** Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River. With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas. **Role Overview** Cboe Clear U.S. (CCUS) is a regulated clearinghouse. We clear the event contracts and prediction markets listed on Cboe's exchanges, and we are building toward tokenized collateral, 24x7 operation, and the infrastructure that carries traditional finance onto DeFi rails. CCUS Software Engineering is a high trust environment. Failure leads to inquiry rather than blame. Working across team boundaries is expected rather than tolerated. We solve the problem, then we write the code. Design documents and architecture decision records come first. The engineers we value most close their feedback loop. They write tests, and they instrument what they ship so it fails fast, explains itself in production, leaves an audit trail and rolls back cleanly. The Software Engineer builds and runs the services that clear trades. You would own features inside a design your team sets, write the tests and observability that ship with them, and carry the on\-call that comes from owning your own code. Java is our stack choice, but we hire polyglots. The engineers who do well here grow into shaping the design rather than working inside it. **Your responsibilities will be:** * Designing, developing and maintaining scalable microservices in Java. * Optimizing PostgreSQL schemas and queries. * Building services that support clearing workflows including trade processing, margin and settlement. * Ensuring data integrity, consistency and reconciliation across integrated systems. * Operating what you build, including the metrics, logs and traces that let you diagnose it in production. * Helping define the service level objectives for your services and the alerting that defends them. * Contributing to architecture decision records and design documents before implementation begins. * Leveraging AI responsibly, using tools such as Claude or Copilot, to improve code quality and productivity. * Documenting relevant details in the team wiki. **Required:** * Supporting delivery across the full software lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing and production support * Experience building and operating distributed, service\-based systems in production * Production engineering discipline, meaning you have owned services you also had to keep running * Solid grounding in object\-oriented and functional programming, software engineering principles, design patterns, data modeling and SQL * A record of turning ideas into things that actually shipped, and of changing your mind when the evidence says to * The ability to work with non\-technical partners and turn a concept into a working solution * Strong command of Java, with at least three years of job experience in it **Preferred:** * Container orchestration with Kubernetes, Nomad or similar orchestrators * Event streaming with Kafka or an equivalent * Capital markets clearing or post\-trade systems * Solid Linux fundamentals and disciplined use of version control * AI\-assisted development tooling **Nice to have:** * Python, which we rely on for analytics work and rapid prototyping * JVM languages such as Clojure, Scala or Kotlin * The FIX messaging protocol * Distributed tracing and observability tooling **Current technology stack:** Java on Kubernetes. Application code and CI pipelines live in GitHub with GitHub Actions. Container images and build artifacts live in registries such as Harbor and Artifactory, and Helm charts are deployed by ArgoCD from a GitOps repository. PostgreSQL, Kafka and Linux. This is representative rather than exhaustive. *You do not need experience with every technology in our environment. We hire for competencies over pedigree, so if you have built similar systems and learn quickly, we encourage you to apply.* Minimum Work Experience: 5\+ years in backend development Minimum Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience **This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.** **Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)** At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $107,525\-$139,150, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location. This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long\-term equity programs. Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE. *Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.*

jobs.description: **SAP Warehouse Management Technical Lead** =========================================== **Date:** Oct 13, 2026 **Location:** Allentown, PA, US **Summary** ----------- Chobani is seeking a highly experienced SAP Warehouse Management Technical Lead to drive the design, implementation, and optimization of our next\-generation warehouse automation ecosystem. technical architecture for warehouse management processes including inbound/outbound logistics, slotting, labor management, yard management, and value\-added services. * Drive integration design between SAP EWM and integration with other S/4HANA modules (MM, SD, PP, QM) ensuring data integrity and process continuity. * Establish and maintain technical design documents, functional specifications, and integration architecture diagrams for the full WM solution landscape. **E80 Group AMR \& Automation Integration** * Serve as the primary technical liaison between SAP EWM and E80 Group Laser Natural Navigation (LNN) automated systems, including autonomous forklifts, pallet shuttles, and conveyor systems. * Design and implement the bidirectional integration between SAP EWM Task Interleaving / Warehouse Orders and E80's Fleet Management Software (FMS) using standard and custom interfaces (IDoc, REST API, SOAP, RFC). * Configure and fine\-tune E80 unit assignment logic, resource management, and task dispatching within the SAP EWM control framework. * Develop exception handling workflows for AMR faults, traffic management events, and manual intervention scenarios ensuring minimal operational disruption. * Collaborate with E80 integration engineers and robotics teams during commissioning, testing, and hypercare phases of AMR deployments. **Warehouse Control System (WCS) Integration** * Architect and implement WCS integration with SAP EWM leveraging the Material Flow System (MFS) component, SCADA interfaces, and PLC/sorter communication layers. * Design integration patterns for conveyor management systems, sorters, put\-to\-light, goods\-to\-person systems, and automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS) communicating via SAP EWM MFS telegrams. * (e.g., Dematic iQ, Honeywell Intelligrated, Vanderlande VISION, Knapp) with SAP EWM via standard or custom adapters. **Technical Leadership \& Delivery** * Lead and mentor a team of SAP EWM functional and technical consultants, offshore resources, and developers. * Manage the full project lifecycle for WM workstream deliverables including requirements workshops, blueprint documentation, build, SIT, UAT, go\-live, and hypercare support. * Define test strategies and oversee execution of integration test scenarios between SAP EWM, E80 FMS, WCS, and peripheral automation equipment. * Participate in steering committee meetings, providing status updates, risk assessments, and technical decision recommendations to project leadership. **Operational Excellence \& Continuous Improvement** * Establish SAP EWM monitoring frameworks including MFS workbench alerts, integration middleware dashboards, and warehouse KPI reporting. * Identify and implement performance optimizations for high\-throughput warehouse operations including parallel processing, resource pooling, and queue management. * Support business process improvement initiatives translating operational requirements into SAP EWM configuration and development changes. * Develop runbooks, operational procedures, and knowledge transfer materials for support teams and end\-users. **Requirements** ---------------- **Experience** * Minimum 12–15 years of total SAP experience, with at least 8–10 years of dedicated SAP EWM or SAP WM hands\-on implementation experience. * Minimum 3 full lifecycle SAP EWM implementation projects in complex, high\-volume warehouse environments. * Demonstrated experience integrating SAP EWM with Warehouse Control Systems (WCS) using SAP EWM Material Flow System (MFS). * Proven hands\-on experience with E80 Group automation systems (LNN forklifts, pallet shuttles, conveyor systems) in a SAP\-integrated environment. * At least 2 implementations on SAP S/4HANA 2021 or later * Experience leading teams in complex, multi\-vendor warehouse  erience in lieu of formal education will be considered for candidates with exceptional SAP EWM track records. **COMPETENCIES \& SOFT SKILLS** * Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills — able to translate technical complexity into business impact for non\-technical audiences. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability with a track record of resolving complex integration issues under go\-live pressure. * Collaborative leadership style with experience working in globally distributed, multi\-cultural teams. * Detail\-oriented with strong documentation discipline; able to produce and maintain high\-quality architectural and design artifacts. * Adaptable and comfortable operating in fast\-paced environments with evolving requirements and aggressive delivery timelines. **About Us** ------------ Chobani is a food maker with a mission of making high\-quality and nutritious food accessible to more people, Chobani manufactures its products in New York, Idaho, Michigan and Australia, and its products are available throughout North America and distributed in Australia and other select markets. jobs.title: Change & Release Manager
jobs.description: **Company Description** We're partnering with **Quant**, a global leader in digital transformation and technology solutions, seeking a **Change \& Release Manager** to join their team. **About Quant:** Almost all the money in the economy is commercial bank money, and almost none of it moves on chain. Quant is a leading provider of programmable money infrastructure, and our technology changes that: it lets banks issue, move and settle tokenized deposits around the clock, automatically and securely, while staying connected to the systems they already run on. It is already deployed in regulated environments with central and commercial banks in the UK and around the world, including work on the digital pound and the digital euro. The Clearing House, whose networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion a day, has now selected Quant to power its On\-Chain Money Initiative: a new interoperable payments network that will let financial institutions of all sizes clear and settle tokenized deposits, with connectivity to the RTP® and CHIPS® networks. Our technology provides the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction\-management layer, enabling payments that settle immediately and transactions that trigger automatically once agreed conditions are met. Through our Tokenized Deposits\-as\-a\-Service solution, banks of any size can join without building new infrastructure themselves. The network is expected to become available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027, with use cases across corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross\-border payments and digital asset settlement. We are building the New York team that will run it. **Job Description** **Change \& Release Manager** **Role summary** Owns the change\-management function for the engagement: ensures every production change flows through either automation or a governed, auditable manual procedure. Directs the Release Engineers and Infrastructure Engineer on execution and owns the AWS tenancy relationship. **Key responsibilities** * Own the change\-control process and chair the change\-advisory board. * Ensure every production change flows through automation or a governed, auditable manual procedure. * Own the AWS tenancy relationship and its governance. * Direct the Release and Infrastructure Engineers on the Terraform estate, Helm charts and CI/CD pipeline for chain\-node deployments. * Report on change success and change\-related incidents to the Engagement Director. **Qualifications** **Required experience \& qualifications** * 5\+ years in change/release management (ITIL\-aligned), ideally with infrastructure\-as\-code environments. * Strong coordination across engineering and operations. * Risk\-assessment and rollback\-planning discipline; comfort with formal audit requirements. * ITIL certification preferred. **Success measures** * Change\-success rate. * Change\-related incident rate. * Audit findings on change\-governance evidence. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/11/2026 Meet the Team We believe that world\-class security starts with great people. The SBG Security Operations (SecOps) Team is the frontline defense for Cisco’s Security Business Group. At Cisco SBG we build solutions that defend the world’s most critical infrastructure. Our mission is to instill absolute confidence in our engineering partners and global customers that Cisco security solutions are designed, built, and operated securely.
