jobs.title: Director, Analytics & Semantic Layer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** Clayco is building a data and AI organization from the ground up, and the semantic layer sits at the center of it. We are looking for the person who will own it. We run a Snowflake\-based platform that has to answer questions about billions of dollars of construction work: what a project costs to complete, where a schedule is slipping, whether a trade package is trending over. The hard part is not the pipelines. It is that cost to complete means one thing in finance, another in project controls, and a third on the job site — and until someone settles that, no dashboard and no AI agent can be trusted. That is this job. You will define what a Clayco number means, build the governed models behind it, and lead the analytics engineering team that grows to eleven people over the next two years. Most semantic layer roles are maintenance jobs on someone else's architecture. This one is a build. The strategy is set and funded, the executive sponsorship is real, and a dozen agents are already running on semantic models we have built. There are hundreds more to come, and you will set the standard they follow rather than inherit one **Specific Responsibilities:** * Own Clayco's semantic layer, the certified definitions, the models behind them, and the process by which a definition gets approved, versioned, and retired. * Build the core conformed models: project, cost code, vendor, contract, schedule activity. * Stand up domain models for finance and WIP, project controls, and safety and risk. * Hire and lead the analytics engineering team, growing from two to eleven. * Own the schedule for retiring our legacy reporting estate onto governed models. * Partner with our data platform, AI products, and governance leads on where your layer starts and stops. **Job Requirements and Competencies:** * You have built a semantic layer before. Not dashboards on top of one — the layer itself, in Snowflake, dbt, or equivalent, at a scale where definitional consistency was a real problem you had to solve. * You know AEC. You have worked in construction, engineering, or architecture, or you studied it. You know what a schedule of values is, why percentage\-of\-completion accounting is contentious, and what a superintendent actually needs to see. We are not going to teach this. * You have led analytics engineers. Hiring, performance, and setting standards. We would like to hear about a team you grew rather than inherited, but leading one well matters more to us than how much it grew. * You can hold your ground with the business. Half this job is telling a finance executive and an operations executive that they cannot both be right, and getting them to a shared definition anyway. * You bring outside perspective. We have made real architectural decisions and we are not looking for someone to ratify them. Bring ideas from wherever you have been, make them work with what already exists, and push us to change what should change when you can show the benefit. * Nice to have: metric certification under audit, experience retiring a legacy BI estate, Procore or similar project systems. * Not required: AI or machine learning background. That work lives elsewhere on the team. **Some Things You Should Know** * Our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required. * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! * This position is classified as a safety\-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing. **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The Clayco Nationwide salary range for this position is approximately $180,000 \- $230,000 \+/\- annually (not adjusted for location).

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: #### **About Clockwork Systems** **Clockwork.io – Software Driven Fabrics to increase GPU cluster utilization** Clockwork Systems was founded by Stanford researchers and veteran systems engineers who share a vision for redefining the foundations of distributed computing. As AI workloads grow increasingly complex, traditional infrastructure struggles to meet the demands of performance, reliability, and precise coordination. Clockwork is pioneering a software\-driven approach to AI fabrics by delivering **cross\-stack observability** to catch and quickly resolve problems, **workload fault tolerance** to keep jobs running through failures, and **performance acceleration** that dynamically routes and paces traffic to avoid congestion. #### **To learn more, visit** **www.clockwork.io****.** ### **About the Role** We're building infrastructure for fault\-tolerant, high\-performance distributed GPU training. You'll work at the intersection of GPU systems, high\-speed networking, and distributed coordination—designing and implementing systems that run at scale. This is a systems building role. You'll dig into internals, understand why things break under pressure, and design solutions that handle the messy reality of distributed systems. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and implement low\-level systems software for GPU clusters * Work with internals of frameworks like PyTorch, NCCL, CUDA runtime—not as a user, but modifying and extending them * Build components that make large\-scale GPU training more reliable and efficient * Debug complex distributed/concurrent systems where failures are subtle and non\-deterministic * Own systems end\-to\-end: from design through production ### **What We're Looking For** Required: Systems building experience You've designed and built complex systems—not just deployed or operated them. Examples: * Kernel subsystems, device drivers, or OS\-level components * Distributed storage, databases, or coordination systems * Runtimes, profilers, or performance tooling * Network stacks, protocols, or high\-performance I/O systems * Large\-scale infrastructure at the systems layer Core technical skills: * Strong C/C\+\+ in systems contexts * Deep understanding of concurrency, memory models. * Experience reasoning about distributed system behavior: consistency, ordering, partial failures * Comfortable reading and modifying large, unfamiliar codebases Nice to have: * GPU programming (CUDA) or GPU systems experience * High\-performance networking (RDMA, InfiniBand) * ML framework or runtime internals * Cluster scheduling or orchestration systems *We believe strong systems engineers pick up domain\-specific tools quickly. We value your ability to reason about complex systems over checkbox familiarity with our specific stack.* **Enjoy** * Challenging projects. * A friendly and inclusive workplace culture. * Competitive compensation. * A great benefits package. * Catered lunch. Compensation for this position will vary based on the skills and experience you bring, as well as internal equity considerations. For candidates hired at the posted level, the expected base salary range is $150,000 \- $210,000\. In addition to cash compensation, this role is eligible to participate in the **company's equity program**, which may include stock options granted in accordance with the company's equity plan and subject to approval and applicable vesting schedules. **Clockwork Systems is an equal opportunity employer.** We are committed to building world\-class teams by welcoming bright, passionate individuals from all backgrounds. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Revenue Operations **Compensation** ---------------- * $210K – $250K **About CodeRabbit** -------------------- CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open\-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things. We are a fast\-moving, well\-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1\.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve. **The Opportunity** ------------------- At CodeRabbit, our agents already write, review, and ship our Salesforce and internal tooling code. A Linear label or Slack emoji starts a pipeline: an agent plans the change, a human approves, the agent builds and tests it in a sandbox and opens a pull request, a second model reviews it, and guard hooks stop anything that could hurt production. This is our GTM Systems harness. We're looking for a Staff GTM Systems Engineer to own it and to architect the systems it builds: the pipeline generation, quote\-to\-cash, provisioning, and billing integrations behind a company growing from PLG into enterprise sales, and the internal tools our GTM teams run on. You'll be the senior technical voice in Business Systems, setting the patterns that engineers, analysts and agents all follow. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own and evolve the agentic engineering harness: the Agent Build pipeline, guard hooks, worktree tooling, CI, model routing and the permission tiers that keep agents safe around production. * Design and build internal tools and agents as full\-stack applications (TypeScript, Next.js, Postgres, MCP servers) where off\-the\-shelf software falls short. * Build in Salesforce at a deep level: Apex service and selector patterns, triggers, LWC, Platform Events, permission sets and the metadata deployment model. * Set the engineering standards for Business Systems: architecture reviews, code review, testing, release and production runbooks, and how agent\-written work gets reviewed and shipped. * Give the analysts and engineers on the team the platform to build their own agents, such as the Sales OS Agent and Data Quality Agent. * Partner with Finance, GTM, Deal Desk, and the Data teams to turn ambiguous business needs into systems that hold up at the next stage of scale. * Raise the technical bar across the team through pairing, reviews and design docs, and reduce our dependence on outside consultants over time. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Deep, hands\-on Salesforce engineering: Apex, LWC, data modeling, sharing and security, and source\-driven deployment with the Salesforce CLI. * Strong full\-stack software engineering beyond Salesforce, with production web apps, APIs and databases you have built and run. * Real experience building with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex, including the guardrails that make agent output safe to ship: tests, CI gates, Staff\-level judgment: you have owned architecture across systems you did not build, made decisions with teams that do not report to you, and changed how a team works. * Clear writing. Your design docs, PR descriptions and runbooks let others act without a meeting. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * At least 7\+ years of Salesforce and full\-stack engineering. * Production experience with Python, TypeScript and Next.js. * Experience with Chargebee, Stripe, Zuora or another subscription billing platform, including usage\-based or marketplace billing (AWS, GCP, GitHub Marketplace). * Experience building MCP servers, LLM evaluations, or human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows for agents. * Experience with BigQuery, dbt, Clay, or event\-driven integration patterns. * Familiarity with developer\-tools or technical B2B SaaS go\-to\-market, including a PLG to sales\-led transition. jobs.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Senior Programmer Analyst provides technical leadership in the design, development, implementation, integration, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications that support Columbus Water Works operations and strategic objectives. The position independently leads complex assignments, improves the reliability and quality of business systems, and serves as a senior technical resource within Information Services. The position develops software solutions, SQL Server databases, reports, Power BI dashboards, REST API integrations, and Microsoft 365 solutions while supporting Lawson ERP, ADP, AUS Infinity CIS, Cityworks, and other enterprise platforms. The role mentors team members, coaches business stakeholders, and works with departments to improve processes, train users, and support successful adoption of technology. **Essential Functions** ======================= **Application Development and Technical Leadership** ---------------------------------------------------- * Lead the analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of complex enterprise applications and integrations; evaluate solution options and recommend sustainable designs. * Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases, T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data processing solutions; resolve performance and data integrity issues. * Develop and maintain REST API integrations and data exchanges between on\-premises and SaaS applications, including validation, error handling, monitoring, and recovery procedures. * Develop Power BI dashboards, SQL reports, Crystal Reports, and operational analytics; validate business definitions and results with stakeholders. * Develop Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and Power Automate solutions that improve workflows and reduce manual effort. * Conduct code, SQL, design, and documentation reviews; support onboarding and cross\-training to build depth of support for critical systems. * Coach business stakeholders and department champions on requirements definition, data interpretation, process improvement, and effective use of enterprise applications. * Create and maintain technical documentation, support runbooks, data definitions, and training materials that enable others to operate and support solutions. **Business Collaboration and Department Training** -------------------------------------------------- * Work directly with department leaders, subject matter experts, and end users to understand operations, document requirements, map workflows, and identify practical technology improvements. * Facilitate requirements sessions, solution demonstrations, and user acceptance testing; clarify priorities, document decisions, and communicate technical concepts to nontechnical audiences. * Plan and deliver training for team members and other departments, including individual coaching, group instruction, demonstrations, and job aids tailored to user responsibilities. * Coordinate with Application Specialists and department champions to support system changes, reinforce effective use, gather feedback, and evaluate whether training and solutions meet business needs. **Project Delivery and Enterprise Support** ------------------------------------------- * Lead assigned application, reporting, integration, and modernization projects; define scope, tasks, estimates, dependencies, and risks, and provide timely status updates to IS leadership and stakeholders. * Support Lawson ERP, ADP, AUS Infinity CIS, Cityworks, and other enterprise applications; provide Tier III support and lead root cause analysis and corrective action for recurring issues. * Troubleshoot across applications, APIs, databases, Windows and Linux servers, and networks in collaboration with Network Administrators, Application Specialists, and vendors. * Coordinate testing, approved change implementation, rollback planning, and post\-deployment validation; contribute to disaster recovery planning and testing for supported applications and data. * Protect sensitive information through appropriate access controls, secure development, and adherence to CWW policies; perform other duties as assigned in support of Information Services. **Minimum Qualifications** ========================== * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Five (5\) years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise application development, database programming, reporting, or systems integration, including independent delivery of complex solutions. * Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership on projects and mentoring or training team members, business stakeholders, or end users. * Proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL, including database design, stored procedures, query optimization, data manipulation, and troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, GitHub or comparable Git\-based source control, Power BI, Microsoft 365, SQL reporting, and Crystal Reports. * Demonstrated ability to gather business requirements, work across departments, manage assigned projects, and communicate technical information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with Python, C\#/.NET, PowerShell, SharePoint Online, and Power Automate. * Experience supporting Lawson ERP, ADP, AUS Infinity CIS, Cityworks, and other enterprise SaaS applications in a utility or comparable operational environment. * Working knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, cloud services, TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, SSL certificates, and application security. * Experience with project management, ITIL change management, data governance, disaster recovery, and development standards. * Experience developing training programs, facilitating workshops, and building sustainable cross\-training and knowledge transfer practices. **Core Competencies** ===================== Customer Focus; Analytical Thinking; Technical Leadership; Mentoring and Coaching; Collaboration; Adaptability; Initiative; Continuous Learning; Technical Communication; Project Ownership; Quality and Accountability. **Technical Competencies** ========================== Enterprise Applications; SQL Server and T\-SQL; Reporting and Data Analytics; Power BI; REST APIs; GitHub and Source Control; Microsoft 365; Systems Integration; SaaS Platforms; Business Process Automation; Secure Coding; Solution Design and Troubleshooting. **Physical Demands** ==================== Work is primarily performed in an office environment with occasional work in server rooms and utility facilities. Must occasionally lift up to 20 pounds and travel between facilities. **Working Conditions** ====================== Primarily indoor office environment with occasional exposure to industrial utility environments. Participation in after\-hours maintenance, system upgrades, and emergency support is required. **Acknowledgement** =================== This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. **JOB ANNOUNCEMENT: 26\-90** **PAY GRADE: 15**

jobs.title: Mobile App Developer
jobs.description: Duties \& Responsibilities: \-Build a functional prototype of a mobile warehouse utility app designed to instantly count stacked warehouse supplies using on\-device artificial intelligence. * Train a lightweight, commercially viable custom object detection model (using frameworks like YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLO\-NAS, or YOLOX) to recognize pallets, top frames, and layer pads across varying lighting conditions and angles. * Prepare and organize data by setting up a lightweight annotating workflow (e.g., Roboflow or CVAT) to label a dataset of 300–500 images of inventory. * Export and optimize the trained model (via CoreML or TensorFlow Lite) to ensure it can run locally and offline inside the mobile application. * Build a simple, clean user interface (UI) that integrates the model to display real\-time counting overlays and bounding boxes on a live camera feed or uploaded photo. * Co\-work directly with one of the company owners to develop, iterate, and test the prototype. Job Requirements: * Authorization to work within the United States. * A problem solver capable of working independently and researching deployment bugs. * Candidates must provide a portfolio or GitHub link demonstrating past projects where an object detection model was successfully trained and deployed to production or an edge device (webcam, phone, Raspberry Pi, etc.) Compensation \& Hours: Start Date: Available immediately. jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer (Emerging AI)
jobs.description: **About DAT** DAT Freight \& Analytics is an award\-winning employer of choice and a next\-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million\+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi\-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com **Job Application Deadline:** 11/30/2026 **The Opportunity** As a Sr AI Engineer, you'll build and own the platform that power our agentic solutions at DAT. Freight is an uncertain business, and the models we ship reduce that uncertainty: rate forecasts, load\-to\-truck matching, document extraction, fraud signals, and the agentic workflows our brokers and carriers use to move freight faster. None of that reaches a customer without a platform that makes training, serving, evaluating, and monitoring models routine instead of heroic. You'll help build the platform, from the model gateway and inference layer through feature and vector storage, evaluation harnesses, production observability, agentic framework (A2A) all on a spine based on secure access and utilization. This is a highly visible role for an engineer who wants their work multiplied across every AI team in the company. **What You'll Do** * **Platform Ownership:** Design, build, and operate the shared services that engineers and business users use to ship models: a model gateway for LLM access, inference endpoints for real\-time and batch scoring, feature storage, vector search, and a common SDK. * **Technical Leadership:** Lead architecture for large\-scale AI systems, write the design documents, and drive alignment across Product, and Engineering and Business users on how models get built and shipped at DAT. * **Cloud Architecture:** Architect and run scalable, reliable AI infrastructure on AWS, including Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, Redpanda, MSK (Kafka), Lambda, and S3, all defined in Pulumi.. * **Evaluation and Quality:** Build the offline and online evaluation systems that tell us whether a model or prompt change is an improvement, including regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, A/B and shadow testing, and drift detection. * **Cost and Performance:** Own inference cost and latency as first\-class metrics. Right\-size GPU and serverless capacity, tune batching, caching, and quantization, and give teams clear visibility into what their workloads cost. * **Safety and Governance:** Implement guardrails, prompt and output logging, PII handling, access controls, and model and dataset lineage so AI systems meet our security and customer data commitments. * **Best Practices:** Drive the adoption of modern software development practices across AI work, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * **Mentorship:** Mentor engineers and data scientists on production ML and distributed systems, and raise the operational bar of every team that builds on the platform. * **Incident Management:** Lead the response and resolution for complex production incidents involving AI services, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventative measures. **The Skills and Experience You'll Bring** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant time as a senior or staff engineer owning production infrastructure that other engineering teams depend on. * 4\+ years building and operating machine learning or AI platforms, with models you've taken from notebook to production traffic and then kept healthy. * Strong development language skills ideally using TypeScript/js, Java, or Go, with the software engineering discipline to build libraries other teams adopt willingly. * Extensive AWS experience with production systems, ideally including EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, Redpanda, MSK/Kafka, S3, and Secrets Manager, Experience working in operationally complex or data\-intensive industries such as energy, logistics, weather, or agriculture. * **What You Can Expect from DTN:** --------------------------------- * Competitive Salary * Unlimited PTO * Flexible working hours * Remote work model (position dependent) * Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans * 6% 401K matching * Unlimited access to 13k\+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * **Compensation:** ----------------- *The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between* ***$110,000 and $145,000*** *. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.* \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-TH1 **About DTN:** DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather\-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision\-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world. At DTN, we value **clarity,** **trust** , and **action** . We’re a team of problem\-solvers, outcome\-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do. * **Trust Built:** We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non\-negotiable. * **Confidence\-Driven:** We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act. * **Built for Industry:** We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts. * **Future\-Forward:** We see what’s coming\- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning. **Recruitment Fraud Notice:** DTN is aware of incidents where external parties have impersonated our organization, issuing fraudulent communications and/or job offers. Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address. Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process. If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. jobs.description: **About Us:** Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers' most difficult problems. We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications. **The Role:** The Datacor Engineering Software Group (DESG) is seeking a curious, motivated early\-career Software Engineer to join our Flow Simulation team and help build the future of our software. You will work on Fathom, Arrow, Impulse, and xStream, our industry\-leading fluid flow simulation applications, which engineers around the world use to design and analyze piping systems, from steady\-state operation to transient events like a pump trip. This is a generalist role for someone with a solid computer science foundation who wants to grow into a well\-rounded engineer. There are no skill silos here: you will work across the whole application, from user interface and application logic to data models, file formats, integrations, and the tooling that builds and tests it all. You will join a team of software engineers and mechanical and chemical engineers in a mature codebase that is being actively modernized. Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. This team is core to Decagon’s ability to scale: the tools you build directly support agents for all our customers, each with unique workflows, data, and requirements. **About the Role** You'll be a technical leader for a full\-stack product engineering team, shaping the platform that empowers customers to create and optimize their AI agents. You'll work day\-to\-day with the core product and design teams, joining discovery, defining requirements, reviewing designs, and iterating through launch. the team, to build enterprise ready platform that scale with our customer base and features, by applying the right architectural principles and design patterns. * Lead complex initiatives from ambiguous requirements to shipped products * Create AI\-powered tools that enable non\-technical teams to create and manage sophisticated workflows without writing code * Build monitoring and analytics that surface actionable insights, helping customers identify where their agents can improve * Partner directly with customers and cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities and validate product direction * Mentor engineers and elevate team practices through code review, technical design, and knowledge sharing **Your background looks something like this** * 6\+ years building full\-stack software products, with demonstrated impact on technical direction and strong product thinking * Deep expertise in TypeScript and/orPython, with strong architecture and system design skills * Proven ability to design abstractions and platforms that serve diverse use cases elegantly * Track record of leading technical initiatives and driving consensus across teams * Experience balancing technical excellence with rapid iteration and customer needs * Strong product intuition and history of translating user feedback into technical solutions * History of mentoring engineers and establishing technical standards **Even better** * Experience building security\-sensitive product systems, such as authentication and data access controls. * Experience building and scaling developer tools, APIs, platforms, or infrastructure products * Familiarity with LLMs, AI agent systems, prompt engineering, or building products on top of AI capabilities * Familiarity with asynchronous programming and building scalable systems * Experience with observability, data visualization, or analytics products * History of establishing technical standards, design patterns, or architectural principles adopted across teams **Compensation** $200K – $400K \+ Offers Equity This range reflects the expected compensation for this role. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in program management. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with AI/ML model launches, inference infrastructure, capacity planning, and Large Language Model (LLM) serving stacks like Gemini and GenMedia. * Experience working effectively with distributed engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones. * Proven ability to lead fast\-moving launch programs and establish repeatable governance, tracking workflows, and executive reporting. **About the job** ----------------- Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers. Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs. As a Technical Program Manager for Model Launches, you will drive serving readiness and execution for Google's newest Gemini and GenMedia models. In this 6\-month fixed\-term contract (FTC) role, you will act as the platform launch lead across the GenAI serving stack. You will own the end\-to\-end launch lifecycle from intake and workback planning through private preview, early access, and general availability. Sit at the intersection of model research, platform engineering, SRE, and product areas, you will ensure multimodal and LLM launches land smoothly on schedule. You will orchestrate readiness checklists, quota/QPS planning, bug triage, and launch war rooms to support rapid release timelines across global time zones. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 0% bonus target Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Act as the primary liaison between model development, platform engineering, SRE, and product teams to align launch scope, schedules, dependencies, and readiness. * Maintain model launch checklists and tracking hotlists across Engineering, SRE, and Safety teams to proactively unblock P0 bugs and mitigate technical risks. * Partner with product teams and SREs to collect QPS forecasts, verify capacity provisioning, and coordinate pre\-launch endpoint access. * Lead launch war rooms and cross\-team syncs, maintain the model launch roadmap, and deliver executive updates and post\-launch retrospectives to scale workflows. * Own the end\-to\-end serving platform launch lifecycle for new Gemini and GenMedia LLMs across all milestones, from intake to general availability. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: AI Development & Agent Ops — Product Manager
jobs.description: **AI Development \& Agent Ops — Product Manager** **Product Management — Infrastructure Solutions Group** Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Product Manager** on our **AI Development \& Agent Ops** team in **Hopkinton, MA.** **The Opportunity** Dell Technologies is at an inflection point in how software is built. Our Infrastructure Solutions Group — home to one of the industry's largest developer organizations — is undergoing a fundamental transformation: from traditional SDLC to an agentic development model where engineers orchestrate AI agents across the full software lifecycle. This newly created, hands\-on role sits at the center of a broad and evolving portfolio of agentic operations work — designing, building, and refining the services, platforms, and practices that will enable \~9,000 engineers to develop with agents at scale. **Why This Role** This is not a support role. Dell's AI Development \& Agent Ops organization is operating at the frontier of what it means to build software with AI — and this individual will be in the engine room making it work. You will partner directly with a VP who is deeply engaged in the work, contribute to shaping how one of the world's largest technology companies builds software, and operate at a scale where your individual contributions have outsized organizational impact. You will also be joining at the right moment: early enough to shape the architecture of the transformation, with enough organizational commitment that the work has real resources and real stakes. **About Dell Technologies — ISG Developer Experience** Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group is a global leader in Solutions, Storage, Compute, and Networking. The Developer Experience organization within ISG is responsible for developer productivity, tooling, observability, and platform engineering for approximately 9,000 engineers. Our current mandate spans agentic SDLC transformation, AI tooling governance, and the operating model changes required to make AI\-assisted development the norm — not the exception. **Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale. **Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.** Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology\- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters. We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer\-first, first\-to\-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo\- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it. If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here. **Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.** **What You'll Achieve** As a **Product Manager — AI Development \& Agent Ops**, you will be responsible for shaping the agentic portfolio strategy and designing capabilities that enable \~9,000 engineers to develop with AI agents at scale. You will work with cross\-functional stakeholders across ISG on Dell's agentic SDLC transformation — driving how the organization scales and integrates agentic capabilities across the full software development lifecycle. **What We're Looking For** The right candidate is a versatile technical practitioner who combines deep fluency and domain expertise with a genuine passion for the emerging agentic AI landscape. We are looking for someone who is a builder — think prototypes, frameworks, dashboards, documentation — and who thrives in environments where the playbook is still being written. You will: * Influence the agentic portfolio strategy, roadmap, and prioritization framework, defining how Dell scales and integrates agentic capabilities across the am in the SDLC * Establish and govern specification standards, quality gates, and operational best practices to ensure consistent, scalable, and high\-quality adoption of agentic solutions across the SDLC * Research emerging trends, technologies, and market developments within the AI and agentic landscape; conduct proofs of concept, pilots, evaluations, and experimentation to identify opportunities for innovation and value creation * Manage and assess the agentic vendor and partner ecosystem, evaluating solution capabilities, market offerings, and strategic partnerships to strengthen Dell's AI portfolio * Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across ISG to align priorities, influence decision\-making, and build consensus on agentic strategy, investments, and portfolio direction * Develop executive\-level recommendations, business cases, and portfolio insights that enable leadership alignment and accelerate adoption of agentic capabilities across the organization **Take the First Step Towards Your Dream Career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * 8\+ years in a product management role within software\-intensive organizations, with experience contributing to large\-scale transformation * Deep hands\-on familiarity with modern software development practices — CI/CD, DevOps, developer tooling — and a strong working knowledge of the current AI/agentic development landscape * Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems, structure them, and deliver concrete outputs: analyses, prototypes, specifications, or frameworks * Experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, product, security, and infrastructure stakeholders * Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical complexity into clear documentation for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-directed work style with a track record of delivering high\-quality work with minimal oversight **Desirable Requirements** * Direct, hands\-on experience with agentic development tools and platforms (e.g., Windsurf/Codeium, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) * Familiarity with MCP ecosystems, LLM token economics, and AI governance frameworks at enterprise scale * Experience in a large enterprise environment with gated release cycles, compliance requirements, and non\-negotiable human oversight needs * Background in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal developer tooling * Experience building dashboards, measurement frameworks, or data instrumentation for developer productivity * Comfort operating in ambiguity: defining structures and processes where few exist, and creating clarity without waiting for it **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $175,200 to $240,900\. **Benefits and Perks of Working at Dell Technologies** Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member — right now at MyWellatDell.com **Who We Are** We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you. Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. **Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy**. Visit our ***Culture Code*** page to learn more about how we work and lead.

jobs.title: Sr. Cybersecurity Compliance Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Det\-Tronics is a $200M global technology leader in industrial life safety solutions, specializing in high\-end flame and gas detection and automation control systems. As part of Spectrum Safety Solutions with 1,700 employees across 20\+ countries we serve mission\-critical environments in oil \& gas, clean energy, marine, and infrastructure. Backed by Sentinel Capital Partners, we’re driving innovation and growth across our portfolio. **The Opportunity** The Senior Cybersecurity Compliance Engineer leads certification projects by collaborating with various agencies to achieve product compliance and certification with Cybersecurity standards. As a key member of the Det\-Tronic’s Approvals Engineering Team, this engineer supports the ongoing processes necessary to meet and uphold industry regulations. In this role, the engineer will conduct in\-depth product analyses and hands\-on testing to ensure compliance, preparing and submitting necessary documentation to regulatory bodies for certification. Additionally, they act as a compliance advisor, assisting other teams by consulting on compliance\-related matters working with design teams on sustaining and new product development (NPD), responding to customer and internal inquiries on cybersecurity. \*\*This position can be remote from the US or Canada.\*\* **Key Responsibilities:** * Interpret applicable Cybersecurity standards and apply the requirements to the products * Act as the business unit subject matter expert on Cybersecurity compliance and applicable standards including IEC 62443 * Understand product requirements and develop certification strategies to meet those requirements * Work with development teams to derive cybersecurity requirements and technical requirements * Collaborate with development team to develop, communicate, and implement a cybersecurity strategy and roadmap for products compliant with industry standards including IEC 62443 * Provide expert guidance to Det\-Tronics business unit and development teams on cybersecurity concerns and recommended security controls * Evaluate, develop and implement cybersecurity compliance plans for existing products and new developments * Develop, refine, and review product cybersecurity requirements to be implementable and testable * Utilize and maintain cybersecurity evaluation tools (e.g. SD Elements, Threatmodeler, etc.) and processes required for ensuring product cybersecurity **What You Bring** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering * At least 5 years of industry experience * At least 5 years of hands\-on firmware development experience. * At least 3 years of cybersecurity engineering experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** Other qualifications you may have that would be beneficial in this role include: * Bachelor’s degree in software/electrical engineering (highly preferred) * Experience designing and implementing security and safety solutions for products * Experience with sustaining and new product development projects, and strong working knowledge of product development processes particularly software * Understand requirements in Cybersecurity standards and apply that knowledge in the evaluation of a product via technical analysis and/or testing * Follow department operating procedures and have an open attitude for continuous improvement * Solid excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly present data and articulate test results to agencies and other internal working groups * Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects at once * Demonstrated experience with Cybersecurity and Functional Safety standards (IEC 62443\) **Why Join Us?** * Workwith a globally respected brand in life safety * Influence strategic decisions at the executive level * Drive innovation and transformation in a high\-growth environment * Enjoy development opportunities within a dynamic, private equity\-backed company **Benefits:** At Det\-Tronics, we believe in taking care of our people. Our comprehensive benefits package includes: * Health \& Wellness:Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans with company contributions * Financial Security:401(k) retirement plan with company match,lifeand disability insurance * Time Off:Generous paid time off (PTO), holidays, and flexible scheduling options * Professional Growth:Career development programs, training opportunities, and tuition reimbursement * Employee Support:Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness resources, and global mobility support * Ownership Culture:Participation in our Ownership Program, empowering employees to share in our success **Ready to shape the future of industrial safety?** Apply now and join us in making **every life safe and sound.**

jobs.title: R&D Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY** DI exists to relieve the world of mediocre experiences and to create remarkable ones. Our people make the remarkable possible through an unwavering display of uncommon commitment each day. The R\&D team drives continuous operational excellence by empowering interdepartmental collaboration, integrating systems, and refining processes within physical and digital workflows. Through direct assistance with client projects and internal operational initiatives, The Lab helps to ensure that Dimensional Innovations consistently delivers remarkable experiences. Reporting to the R\&D Manager, the R\&D Engineer I (OPS) role is responsible for executing, maintaining, and documenting internal R\&D operations workflows. This role contributes to the effective operation of existing tools and systems while helping identify opportunities for process improvement and cross\-functional alignment. It plays a meaningful part in enhancing operational efficiency, supporting margin improvement, and eliminating silos within the organization. This position combines developing process knowledge with foundational data analysis skills to support trend identification, system improvements, and monitoring of implementation progress. The R\&D Engineer I (OPS) works closely with the rest of the R\&D team and other department leads to provide training, offer technical support, and contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes. Once updates to systems or procedures are made, this role helps document those changes clearly and consistently to support internal communication and future scalability. The R\&D Engineer I (OPS) learns the team's tools and systems, ensures data and asset integrity, and builds foundational domain expertise under the guidance of more senior team members. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES/FUNCTIONS** may include but are not limited to: **Execute*** Execute assigned tasks reliably on client projects and internal initiatives, contributing hands\-on to established workflows. * Make routine decisions within established guidelines and escalate complex issues to senior team members when appropriate. * Conduct data reporting across operations and accounting, covering capacity planning, labor tracking, inventory oversight, and project performance metrics. * Manage project system setup by organizing project folders, configuring Wrike projects, and maintaining associated documentation. * Support Wrike data integrity in collaboration with department leaders and project teams. * Deliver performance visibility to operations teams through the data and reporting infrastructure. * Identify issues and gaps in own work and immediate procedures; raise them for review and seek input to resolve them. * Check details with supervisors to maintain accuracy; follow SOPs closely; flag inconsistencies for review. **Steward (Tools \& Systems)*** Perform routine maintenance to keep the team's tools and systems healthy across physical and digital workflows. * Stay current on software updates and emerging technologies; surface observations and ideas that support innovation, automation, and process improvement. * Manage Wrike maintenance, project folder integrity, and BIM template library upkeep. * Maintain BI dashboard and report integrity along with capacity tracking systems. * Support data reporting and automation tools for operations and accounting, including capacity planning, labor tracking, inventory management, and project performance analysis. * Ensure data and asset integrity within established practices, particularly for internal performance and reporting systems. **Document \& Share.*** Develop clear, accessible documentation for R\&D operations workflows and processes to support understanding and ease of use across teams. * Contribute to team training sessions focused on R\&D operations workflows and continuous process improvement, expanding scope and ownership over time. * Contribute to training materials for both current staff and new hires, aligning content with evolving tools and practices. * Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) using written guides, video tutorials, and organized file storage; support department\-level training using these resources. **Collaborate*** Participate in cross\-functional team activities; build relationships across DI departments. * Work across departmental lines to identify friction points, resource and knowledge gaps; collaborate with stakeholders on solutions aligned with project goals and client expectations. * Communicate clearly with team members; ask questions to stay aligned with team goals. * Maintain active presence in relevant DI departments (Engineering, Design, Operations, Accounting) to understand each team's specific workflows and challenges. **Learn \& Develop*** Build foundational understanding of the R\&D OPS domain: operations systems, computational/BIM workflows, BI/data analytics, change management. * Demonstrate curiosity and apply fundamentals u al construction methods, material application, and manufacturing processes is a plus. * Strong attention to detail and data accuracy. **Core Abilities*** Takes responsibility for assigned work and follows through reliably under general supervision. * Passion and integrity with the drive to excel and deliver exceptional results. * Responsive: resolves problems as they come up; escalates appropriately; uses available resources when prompted. * Understands the basics of how systems interact across physical and digital workflows; supports team efforts to maintain established systems. * Process\-oriented while maintaining awareness of the big picture. * Confident in providing well\-supported, data\-driven recommendations * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a customer\-first mindset. * Clear written and verbal communicator; demonstrates leadership by example. * Adaptable to fast\-paced, creative, and custom environments across all team levels. * Able to multitask effectively, meet deadlines, and solve problems under pressure. * Authentic team\-player attitude; willing to help; uncommon commitment to clients and internal teams alike. **EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION/EXPERIENCE*** Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field. * Previous experience in fabrication, construction, or architecture industry is a plus. * Operations Management, Information Systems, Architecture (with computational focus), Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design. * 1–3 years of relevant experience in Operations, Project Management, Account Management, or Business Development, with a focus on business operations and process development. * Strong preference for experience with Salesforce CRM and Microsoft Excel. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. * The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, climb, crouch, or crawl * Employee must be able to talk and hear * The employee must be able to occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds * Specific vision abilities required for this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus **WORK ENVIRONMENT**Due to our onsite Fabrication process, the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, employee may be exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles and outside weather conditions. **INTERESTED IN JOINING OUR TEAM?** Permission to play at DI starts with the ability to be a team player, possess a positive attitude while under a tight deadline and demonstrate an uncommon commitment to your work. Please visit our website (www.dimin.com) to see some of the amazing work we do! This is a salary (exempt) position. DI offers a full benefit package including Medical, Dental and Vision insurance along with Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance and Supplemental Accident, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity. Additionally, we offer a 401(k) with a match, Health Savings Account match, Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays plus an employee chosen Floating Holiday annually, and paid Parental Leave. In 2018, DI incorporated the Great Game of Business principles into the way we do things. The program is designed to create a business of business people, provide transparency into company performance and directly tie daily behavior to impact DIs performance. GGOB allows for the potential of quarterly bonuses as company goals are achieved. Please submit a cover letter, resume and salary requirements. No phone calls please. For more information about working at DI and a full list of available opportunities, please visit https://dimin.com/about/careers.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **If you are an internal applicant, please log into Workday and submit your application via the Jobs Hub.** Join the Discovery family, where quality and service are at the heart of everything we do! **This role will be located at one of Discovery Land Company’s Corporate Office locations in Beverly Hills, California.** **Discovery Land Company** is seeking a full\-time, year\-round **Principal AI Engineer** to join the **Artificial Intelligence** Department. **Job Summary:** Discovery Land Company (DLC) develops and operates private club communities across the U.S. and internationally. DLC's AI team builds the platforms, agents, and workflows that help corporate and club teams work faster with less manual effort. The Principal AI Engineer is the senior technical leader for DLC's AI program, reporting to the VP of Artificial Intelligence. You will co\-own DLC's AI strategy and roadmap with the VP of AI, set the technical direction and engineering standards for all AI solutions, and own the highest\-impact AI use cases end to end: scope the business problem with department leaders, design the solution, build it, ship it, and measure the hours saved. Time will be split across technical strategy and standards, product ownership, and hands\-on engineering. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Set Technical Direction and Standards: + Co\-own DLC's AI strategy and 1\-year and 3\-year roadmap with the VP of AI, including platform choices and investment priorities. + Define and own DLC's AI reference architecture across agents, MCP integrations, retrieval, and Microsoft 365 automation. + Set and enforce engineering standards for evaluation, logging, guardrails, security, and code review across all production AI solutions. + Lead technical evaluation and selection of AI platforms, models, and vendors. + Mentor engineers and Department AI Leads, and serve as final technical reviewer on AI solution designs. * Own Product Delivery: + Partner with departments across DLC to identify and prioritize use cases by hours saved and risk. + Write clear requirements, success metrics, and solution plans for each AI use case. + Manage the backlog and maintain a consistent delivery cadence. * Drive Adoption: + Deliver training, documentation, and feedback loops for end users at the corporate and club levels. + Track adoption metrics and use them to improve deployed solutions. * Build and Deploy AI Solutions: + Build agents, skills, and automations on Claude (Claude Enterprise, Claude Code, Claude API, and Claude Agent SDK). + Build and maintain MCP server integrations that connect Claude to business systems (CRM, marketing automation, ERP, and document stores). + Build workflows in n8n and/or Microsoft Power Automate and Copilot Studio, integrated with SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Outlook via Microsoft Graph. + Build retrieval and knowledge base solutions on Microsoft 365 and related tooling. + Implement evaluation, logging, and guardrails for all production AI solutions. * Co\-lead AI Governance and Security: + Follow DLC data classification rules and ensure member, guest, and employee data is handled under the strictest applicable privacy standard (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA). + Lead technical vendor security reviews for new AI tools and connectors. * What Success Looks Like: + First 6 months - Ship 3 or more production AI use cases with documented hours saved. - Define reusable MCP and Power Automate integration patterns that scale across properties and publish them as DLC standards. - Track adoption metrics and report them monthly to the VP of AI. - Publish DLC's AI reference architecture and engineering standards, applied to all new AI builds. Deliver the technical portion of DLC's 1\-year and 3\-year AI roadmap jointly with the VP of AI. - **Skills \& Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of combined experience in software engineering and product management, including at least 3 years shipping LLM\-based products or internal tools to production. * Hands\-on production experience with Claude and the Anthropic ecosystem: Claude Code, the Claude API (tool use, prompt caching, structured outputs), MCP, and Agent Skills. * Strong experience with the Microsoft 365 stack: Entra ID, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and Teams. * Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and SQL. * Experience integrating enterprise SaaS platforms via REST APIs and connectors. * Track record of translating ambiguous business requests into shipped solutions with measurable outcomes. * Demonstrated ownership of technical strategy, reference architecture, or engineering standards adopted across multiple teams or business units. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews. * Clear written communication for executive and non\-technical audiences. * Experience with Oracle CX (Sales Cloud, Eloqua), Sage Intacct, or CData Connect AI preferred. * Experience with Copilot Studio, Power BI, or Dataverse preferred. * AWS experience (Bedrock, IAM, Lambda) preferred. * Experience with RAG, evaluation frameworks, and LLM observability. * Background in hospitality, real estate, or multi\-site operations preferred. Experience building internal AI training or enablement programs preferred. * **Additional Requirements:** * Flexibility and ability to pivot to new projects and desire to work in fast\-paced environment. * Positive attitude, professional demeanor, and exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to deliver service to members, guests, and team members. * Ability to work in a team environment. * Ability to stay calm and focused during the busiest of times. * Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English; additional languages preferred. * Must be able to work flexible work hours/schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Long hours may be required due to business demands. Ability to meet the physical demands of the position including, but not limited to, working indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions, standing, walking, and moving for periods of greater than eight (8\) hours, and lifting and carrying items sometimes greater than fifty (50\) pounds. * **Benefits** * Competitive Pay * Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits * 401k Contribution * Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays * Employee Meals, Referral Incentives, and Recognition Programs * Holiday Pay * Professional development and upward mobility opportunities Work\-Family Culture * Discovery Land Company's good faith estimate of the salary range it reasonably expects to pay for this position upon hire is $250k plus bonus. **About Us** Discovery Land Company is a U.S.\-based real estate developer and operator of private residential communities with a world\-renowned portfolio of domestic and international properties. The mission of Discovery Land Company is to create one\-of\-a\-kind environments that provide individuals and families the freedom, security, and resources to learn, grow, and play in some of the most beautiful places in the world. For more information about our company, please visit: http://www.discoverylandco.com .

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, New Verticals Agentic Foundations
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ Agentic Foundations, part of New Verticals ML, builds the core AI/ML intelligence that powers high\-quality, scalable agents at DoorDash, and proves it through flagship agent experiences such as the Ask grocery assistant. We operate as a closed loop: new models, evals, and representations make our agents better, and real\-world agent usage surfaces the gaps that drive our next foundations work. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join Agentic Foundations with a primary focus on Vertical Agent Development. You will own the continuous improvement of our flagship agents, starting with the Ask Assistant, using an eval\-driven loop to make them faster, more cost\-efficient, and more reliable for millions of customers. You will also help us bring this approach to new agentic experiences for Merchants and Dashers, turning promising ideas into production\-ready agents. This is a chance to work at the intersection of LLMs, agents, post\-training, and evals on problems that ship. You will partner closely with engineers working on agentic memory, agent\-compatible product representations, and post\-training of small language models (SLMs), so that what we learn from production agents feeds directly back into our foundations, and what we build there makes our agents better. You will report into the engineering lead on our New Verticals AI/ML team. We expect this role to be hybrid with some time in\-office and some time remote. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * **Raise the quality of our Consumer agents:** build and refine our eval harness\-optimization loop to pinpoint failure modes, then iterate on prompts, tools, skills, and context, and measure the impact on real customer tasks. * **Find the best balance of quality, latency, and cost:** run rigorous experiments, including fine\-tuning open\-weights models and deploying small language models (SLMs) where they can replace or augment larger LLMs. * **Launch new agents:** take agentic opportunities for Merchants and Dashers from early exploration to production. * **Turn foundations into product impact:** work with teammates on agentic memory, agent\-compatible product representations, and post\-training SLMs for steerable generative recommendation, and bring those capabilities into production agents. * **Shape the roadmap:** partner with engineering, product, and business leaders to define an ML\-driven strategy for our fast\-growing grocery and retail delivery business. **We're excited about you because you have…** --------------------------------------------- * 3\+ years of industry ML experience, including hands\-on work building and shipping LLM\-based agents (tool use, context management, prompting, guardrails) and improving them with evals and data * Experience with post\-training or fine\-tuning of open\-weights models (e.g., SFT, preference optimization, or RL), ideally including small language models, and sound judgment on quality, latency, and cost trade\-offs * Strong foundation in NLP and machine learning, with proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow * M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Math, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience, plus a collaborative, growth\-minded approach and a drive for measurable impact **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
