jobs.title: Sr. Process Engineer
jobs.description: Team up with the most innovative company where Imagination becomes reality! E Ink is the originator, pioneer, and commercial leader in ePaper technology. The Fremont Research \& Development team is thriving and growing as we help develop products that are changing how people access information every day. We are seeking qualified candidates who are self\-driven, looking to advance their career and become a high\-impact player on a team. Our diversity of people, backgrounds, experiences, thoughts, and perspectives are fostered to create an inclusive work environment. We offer a competitive/generous benefits package that fits the needs of our employees. It includes health, dental, vision, wellness programs, employee discounts, 401k matches, ongoing development, advancement opportunities and more. This position is also eligible for our bonus program. (see E Ink Our Company) (https://www.eink.com/about?company) #### **About the position:** The Sr. Process Engineer will provide technical leadership to build and operate the process capability for a new Copper Clad Laminate (CCL) research and development program. This hands\-on role owns small\-scale equipment, hot\-press and lamination process development, the CCL process laboratory, integrated process development, automation, process specifications, and transfer toward larger\-scale operation. The engineer will convert material and interface concepts into repeatable processes and will work with the analytical and reliability engineer to correlate process conditions with signal loss, physical performance, and reliability. The ideal candidate combines strong process\-engineering fundamentals with deep hands\-on hot\-press experience, equipment expertise, laboratory discipline, automation capability, and practical problem solving. #### **Responsibilities:** * Source, evaluate, specify, and commission small\-scale equipment—including laboratory hot presses, associated tooling, and auxiliary systems—needed to establish flexible CCL process\-development capability. * Modify and integrate commercial or custom equipment when needed, including fixtures, material handling, controls, sensors, data acquisition, ventilation, guarding, and safety interlocks. * Set up and manage the CCL process laboratory, including equipment layout, utilities, EHS controls, SOPs, training, preventive maintenance, calibration, material flow, and daily operational readiness. * Develop and integrate the end\-to\-end CCL process from incoming materials through finished research samples, with direct ownership of hot\-press and lamination operations, while protecting confidential process details and research direction. * Translate particle\-treatment and material concepts from the material scientist into repeatable, scalable, and increasingly automated chemical\-processing workflows. * Develop and optimize hot\-press tooling and platen configuration; pressure\-temperature\-time profiles; heating and cooling rates; material flow and consolidation; thickness and pressure uniformity; defect control; cycle repeatability; and safe operation. Establish critical process parameters, operating windows, process specifications, control plans, sampling requirements, and acceptance criteria for individual operations and the integrated process. * Design and execute DOE to determine how equipment settings and process conditions affect uniformity, defects, signal loss, mechanical and thermal behavior, and reliability. * Develop process monitoring, automation, and data\-collection methods that improve control, repeatability, traceability, throughput, and efficient learning. * Own equipment and process troubleshooting, support cross\-functional root cause analysis, and implement process corrective and preventive actions; improve safety, yield, repeatability, capability, and transferability toward larger scale. * Provide technical guidance to project team members; document equipment and process requirements, experimental results, and specifications; collaborate with the Director, material scientist, analytical and reliability engineer, suppliers, facilities, and EHS. #### **Qualifications:** * M.S. or PhD in Chemical, Mechanical, Materials, or Polymer Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field; typically 7\+ years of relevant industrial process\-development or equipment\-engineering experience. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience developing and operating hot\-press, compression\-molding, or lamination processes is required, including press setup, tooling, pressure\-temperature\-time profiles, heating and cooling control, uniformity, defect reduction, and cycle repeatability. Experience with related material, film, coating, thermal, or chemical processes at laboratory or pilot scale is also valued. * Ability to write equipment specifications, source qualified vendors, conduct technical evaluations, manage installation and commissioning, and modify equipment for new applications. * Experience establishing or managing a   automated chemical processing, instrumentation, process controls, data acquisition, and safe equipment integration. * Ability to interpret process and product data, including uniformity, defects, signal loss, mechanical and thermal behavior, and reliability results. * Experience with CCL, PCB materials, electronic materials, polymer composites, or other precision multilayer products is preferred. * Strong equipment and chemical safety mindset, including process\-hazard review, machine guarding, ventilation, interlocks, safe maintenance, and scale\-up practices. * Strong project management, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with scientists, engineers, suppliers, contractors, EHS, facilities, and business teams. **Benefits:** * Competitive Total Compensation Package * Medical, Dental and Vision on 1st day * Company 401K match * Paid Time Off \& Holidays * Sick Leave Policy * Casual day to day work environment * Hybrid/flexible work environment (for some positions) **Compensation Disclosure:** At E Ink, we believe in rewarding employees with competitive total compensation through a combination of base salary and performance\-based bonuses, with a larger portion of total compensation delivered through our annual bonus program than is typical at many companies. To provide applicants with a more complete picture of our compensation philosophy, we are disclosing both the estimated annual total compensation and the annual base salary range for this position. The annual base salary range for this position is $120,000 \- $162,000\. The annual base salary range reflects the Company's good\-faith estimate of the base salary it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual starting base salary is determined based on job\-related factors, including experience, skills, education, certifications, and other qualifications. Annual bonus payments are based on Company performance, are not guaranteed, and may be higher or lower than the estimate reflected above. This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions and provide detailed feedback. * Ability to work independently in a fully remote, contractor\-based environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working at a top\-tier technology company or within a highly technical software engineering environment. * Based in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, or another English\-speaking country. * Experience conducting code reviews, developing technical assessments, or designing programming challenges. * Familiarity with evaluating AI\-generated code or working with AI\-assisted software development tools. * Ability to create challenging programming problems, reference solutions, and comprehensive test cases. * Strong Join EY and help to build a better working world. **The opportunity** We are seeking a senior leader for our AI Platform Engineering group, the team that builds and operates the foundational substrate powering EY’s AI\-native platform. This role is accountable for the infrastructure and cloud\-native platform layers of our AI runtime, from bare\-metal and GPU infrastructure through Kubernetes, cluster fabric, secure inference, and multi\-tenant scaling. You will set the technical direction for a team of AI Infrastructure and AI Systems Engineers, and be accountable for standing up and running EY AI environments across cloud, on\-prem, edge, client\-managed, and air\-gapped targets. jobs.title: Embedded Software Specialist
jobs.description: Eaton’s PCS division is currently seeking an Embedded Software Specialist to join the team. This is a hybrid role based at the Moon Township, PA location and relocation assistance is available. The expected annual salary range for this role is $122000 \- $179000 a year. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- The Embedded Software Specialist will serve as the technical lead and system\-level subject matter expert for Eaton’s energy metering and power quality products. This role provides technical leadership for product architecture, design, development, and integration, ensuring robust, scalable solutions that enable high precision energy measurement, advanced power quality analytics, reliable event recording, and secure digital connectivity. The Specialist must maintain a comprehensive understanding of product functionality and the interactions among sensing hardware, embedded firmware, measurement algorithms, communications, and standards from both IEEE, IEC and UL. The role is responsible for translating product and marketing requirements into product / functional requirements, guides technical decisions, resolves complex software / system issues, and supports teams in evaluating design trade\-offs and system behavior. This position collaborates closely with product management, firmware, hardware, verification and validation, and manufacturing teams throughout the product lifecycle. The Embedded Software Specialist requires deep expertise in embedded software, real\-time data acquisition and processing, energy measurement, power quality analysis, and industrial communications. **Essential Functions:** ------------------------ * **Product Architecture:** Define robust, modular software and system architectures for Eaton’s energy metering and power quality products, enabling scalable, reliable solutions across product families and serving as the primary technical authority for software and system\-level decisions. Provide technical leadership for embedded software development in C/C\+\+ across bare\-metal, embedded Linux, and RTOS platforms, including FreeRTOS and Zephyr, ensuring deterministic high\-rate sampling, effective multitasking, and reliable bootloaders, BSP/HAL layers, drivers, and inter\-processor communications. * **Requirements and Compliance:** Collaborate with product management and marketing to translate customer needs into clear, traceable product specifications from system requirements, software requirements, and acceptance criteria targeting the metering industry. Drive compliance with applicable metering and power quality standards, including ANSI accuracy standards, ANSI C12\.46, IEC 61000\-4\-30, and NEMA/ANSI submetering requirements, with IEEE C37\.118 applied where synchro phasor functionality is required; work with validation teams to demonstrate compliance under harmonic distortion and environmental variations. Establish and champion software quality, cybersecurity, and verification practices, including code reviews, Black Duck/Coverity scanning, secure boot, code signing, CI/CD and compatibility testing across hardware and software variants. * **Product Development and Integration:** Lead the development and integration of high\-precision measurement algorithms, including RMS, power, energy, demand, vector calculations, and phase compensation, to achieve required accuracy across operating ranges and real\-world electrical conditions. Guide advanced power quality measurement and analytics, including waveform capture, harmonic analysis, flicker, anomaly detection, circuit health monitoring, and event sequencing, using precise timestamping and NTP/PTP synchronization to deliver reliable diagnostic information. Partner with hardware engineers to ensure accurate sensing and acquisition, address current and voltage sensing, Rogowski coils, DC sensing, ADC interfacing, sampling theory, noise, and analog front\-end behavior to achieve system\-level measurement performance. * **Product Connectivity:** Guide secure communications and platform integration, including TCP/UDP, Modbus, BACnet, CAN, EtherNet/IP, SNMP, MQTT, AMQP, and GOOSE as applicable, and integrate metering applications with our proprietary platform team, APIs, logging, and event\-management capabilities. Establish software architecture and interface practices for metering visualization, including embedded web servers, React\-based interfaces, waveform and trend displays, and JSON/XML APIs, ensuring accurate presentation of energy and power quality data and secure access to product functionality. * **Product Support:** Lead investigations, research, and prototyping to resolve complex system issues, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide roadmap decisions; collaborate with quality, manufacturing, and customer\-facing teams to i r distribution products for data center, industrial, and commercial applications. * Experience implementing high\-precision measurement algorithms and advanced power quality functions, including waveform capture, harmonic analysis, anomaly detection, circuit health monitoring, and high\-rate sample streaming. * Experience integrating current and voltage sensing technologies, including Rogowski coils and DC sensing, with knowledge of ADC interfacing, sampling theory, phase compensation, noise mitigation, and analog front\-end behavior. * Experience with embedded Linux, FreeRTOS, or Zephyr; MCU/MPU architectures; BSP/HAL and driver development; interprocess communications; and Yocto\-based build environments. * Experience with industrial and connected\-device protocols such as Modbus, BACnet, CAN, EtherNet/IP, GOOSE, SNMP, MQTT, and AMQP, together with TCP/UDP networking and NTP/PTP time synchronization. * Experience integrating embedded applications with Eaton’s proprietary platform or comparable connected\-product platforms, including APIs, logging, event engines, and data services. * Familiarity with embedded web servers and metering visualization using React, component\-based architectures, High charts or similar libraries, and JSON/XML interfaces. **What will make you successful?** An ideal candidate has a background of strong technical leadership and mentorship across embedded engineering teams, including strong cross functional collaboration driving architecture and design meeting customer requirements and business schedules. Success in this role requires excellent communication and interpersonal skills as well as robust problem\-solving and analytical skills. A passion for innovation, scalable and reusable designs promoting modern engineering practices aligns with continuous improvement approach of this team. All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job\-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law. Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws. You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. To request a disability\-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1\-800\-836\-6345 to discuss your specific need. jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Aviben, and it’s sister company, EFS Advisors, is seeking a motivated and resourceful Software Developer to help build, integrate, and enhance the technology platforms that support our business operations, advisor tools, and client experiences. This role is on site in our Cambridge MN office and will focus on software development, API integrations, data management, and process automation. You'll work with a variety of internal systems and third\-party applications, helping connect platforms, improve data flow, troubleshoot issues, and develop solutions that make our business more efficient. We're particularly interested in someone who embraces modern AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity and accelerate delivery. Equally important is having the technical foundation and critical thinking skills to understand, review, test, and troubleshoot AI\-generated code. We see AI as a valuable development tool, but not a replacement for sound software engineering practices. The ideal candidate is a curious, adaptable problem solver who enjoys learning new technologies, collaborating with technical and nontechnical teams, and turning business challenges into practical technical solutions. **Who We Are** Aviben is a third\-party administrator specializing in employee benefit plans, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Reimbursement Arrangements (HRAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), COBRA administration, and retirement plan administration. **What You'll Do** **Software Development \& Systems Integration** * Build, maintain, and consume RESTful APIs to support secure and reliable data exchange between internal and third\-party platforms. * Develop and support integrations between CRM platforms, financial systems, vendor applications, and other business technologies. * Work with relational databases, SQL queries, and data transformations to support applications, reporting, and business processes. * Create scripts, applications, and automation solutions that streamline workflows and reduce manual effort. * Troubleshoot application issues, investigate data discrepancies, and help resolve integration problems. **AI\-Assisted Development** * Use modern AI\-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies to assist with coding, testing, documentation, and problem\-solving. * Review and validate AI\-generated code to ensure it functions as intended and follows good development practices. * Identify and troubleshoot errors, security concerns, and inefficiencies in AI\-generated or existing code. * Maintain a strong understanding of the code being developed, including the ability to explain, modify, and support it independently. * Stay curious about emerging AI development tools and identify opportunities to improve development efficiency and quality. **Technical Collaboration \& Problem Solving** * Work with business stakeholders to understand needs and help translate them into technical requirements and solutions. * Review vendor API documentation and integration options to help determine appropriate implementation approaches. * Investigate technical issues involving multiple interconnected systems and work with others to resolve them. * Collaborate with internal technology teams and external vendors on integration and development projects. * Look for opportunities to simplify processes, improve data accuracy, and enhance existing applications through automation and integration. **Minimum Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience through relevant projects and technical work. * Experience building, consuming, or troubleshooting RESTful APIs. * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. * Experience working with SQL and relational databases, such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with JSON, HTTP, API authentication, and common data integration concepts. * Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude, with an understanding of the importance of reviewing and validating generated code. * Ability to read, understand, debug, and modify existing code. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills. * Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and nontechnical team members. * Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving development tools and practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing integrations with CRM platforms, financial systems, or other enterprise business applications. * Experience with API development and testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, or OpenAPI. * Familiarity with OAuth 2\.0, token\-based authentication, webhooks, and other common integration technologies. * Experience with data transformation, ETL processes, or integrating data across multiple systems. * Experience using Git or similar version control tools and familiarity with basic software testing practices. * Understanding secure coding principles and experience working with sensitive or regulated data. * Experience developing automation scripts or workflows to improve operational efficiency. * Exposure to financial services, wealth management, or other regulated industries. **Compensation \& Benefits:** We offer a collaborative work environment where developers can make meaningful contributions and work closely with our team. * **Job Type:** Full\-time, exempt * **Pay:** Annual Salary Range of $80K \- $95K. Compensation will be based on experience, technical qualifications, and the ability to contribute independently to our software development projects * **Benefits:** Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision; 401(k) plan with company match; paid holidays; paid time off (PTO); and more We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * AD\&D insurance * Bereavement leave * Dental insurance * Dependent health insurance coverage * Disability insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Prescription drug insurance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Experience: * Software development: 3 years (Required) Ability to Commute: * Cambridge, MN 55008 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: **At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!** **As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.** **At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.** **Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!** **Your day\-to\-day will include:** * Leverage Elanco’s Enterprise Data and PaaS/SaaS Platforms to deliver mission\-critical product safety solutions. * Directly accountable for re\-imagining the digital backbone of global Pharmacovigilance (PV) systems, transitioning legacy platforms into a modern, automated, and AI\-driven ecosystem. * Provide technical leadership in the design and execution of systems engineering solutions, driving standards across the R\&D landscape to ensure a balance of modern innovation and pragmatic stability. * Partner with enterprise architects to shape the technical roadmap for next\-generation safety platforms, ensuring scalability, compliance, and seamless integration with the broader enterprise landscape (e.g., SAP ERP, Veeva RIM, Ennov). * Act as a lead mentor and coach, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and decentralized command within product squads. * Drive a continual modernization plan to bring legacy systems and data products in line with new enterprise standards. * Partner with core engineering and security groups to ensure application integrity and safety. * Use modern product approaches, such as rapid prototyping and continuous discovery, to influence and shape the business through partnership with Product Management, ensuring reliable and consistent delivery of solutions that end\-users love. **You have the following technical skills and qualifications:** * Education requirement – Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, a related field, or a foreign equivalent * Relevant experience requirement – 5 years of progressively responsible post\-baccalaureate experience in job offered or any related engineering/data science roles. Applicants must possess at least 5 years of experience in the following: (1\) PaaS/SaaS including R\&D SaaS platforms (Veeva RIM, PV, Aegis, and Ennov) and their application in life science drug research and product safety; (2\) ensuring systems are 'audit\-ready' through necessary controls in a regulated pharmaceutical GxP environment; (3\) Public Cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, GCP) and associated automation/integration services (Logic Apps, Databricks); (4\) Engineering and delivering enterprise scale data solutions, with examples in the cloud (Azure based, GCP based, Oracle); (5\) Software development practices including Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), Test\-Driven Development (TDD), and DevSecOps tooling; (6\) Programming \& Scripting including Python (OOP, Classes/Methods, custom packages) and Javascript; and (7\) Data architecture and engineering methodologies (Domain driven data architecture, Scalable data pipelines, API\-Centric Design, SQL/NoSQL, FAIR data principles). * 10% domestic travel required for support site\-based product discovery and implementation. * Must live within a commutable distance to the assigned Elanco Office location to meet 30 days per quarter work from office requirement. Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status Elanco may use automated tools, including AI, to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications against job‑related criteria and/or transferrable skills. jobs.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: At Element Biosciences, we are passionate about our mission to empower the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity. We have built a highly efficient product\-driven organization where employees can learn, grow, and thrive in a challenging but encouraging environment. We are committed to scientific integrity, collegiality, honesty, objectivity, and openness. We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Test Engineer** to help ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of software across Element's sequencing ecosystem. In this hands\-on role, you will independently own verification of complex features and workflows spanning instrument software, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data\-analysis interfaces. You will partner with cross\-functional teams to translate requirements, user needs, and product risks into clear test strategies and objective evidence. The ideal candidate is passionate about building robust tools for scientists and brings a strong background in software and systems testing, integration troubleshooting, and regulated product development. This role will report to the Senior Manager, Software Test Engineering and is expected to be a San Diego based, daily on\-site role. If you possess the following and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to explore this role. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** * Independently design, document, and execute verification activities for complex software features and end\-to\-end workflows used with Element sequencing instruments * Translate user needs, product requirements, system architecture, and risk controls into traceable test strategies, plans, cases, protocols, and reports * Perform hands\-on functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing across instrument software, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data\-analysis interfaces * Configure and maintain representative test environments, including control of software, firmware, hardware, and test\-data configurations * Isolate and troubleshoot defects using logs, command\-line tools, database queries, and reproducible test evidence; clearly communicate severity, impact, and risk * Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, assay, chemistry, product, UX, and quality partners to evaluate coverage, resolve integration issues, and improve the end\-user experience * Create accurate, review\-ready test documentation in accordance with Element's software development lifecycle and applicable design\-control processes * Identify high\-value automation opportunities and contribute to maintainable automated tests and supporting tools as products and interfaces mature * Communicate test status, quality risks, and recommendations to project leads and stakeholders, and share technical knowledge with less\-experienced team members **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, bioengineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience * Typically 3–5 years of hands\-on software or systems test experience; experience with life\-science, medical\-device, or laboratory\-instrumentation products is strongly preferred * Demonstrated ability to derive test coverage from requirements and user stories and to produce clear, traceable test plans, cases, protocols, defect reports, and test reports * Experience testing interfaces among software, embedded systems, firmware, hardware, cloud services, and data\-analysis applications * Proficiency with Linux and command\-line tools, log analysis, and SQL or NoSQL databases; scripting or test\-automation experience (for example, Python or TypeScript) is preferred * Experience working within a regulated software development lifecycle and quality system; working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, and ISO 13485 is preferred * Understanding of product risk management and root\-cause analysis; familiarity with ISO 14971 is preferred. * Knowledge of DNA sequencing workflows or genomics applications is preferred * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage priorities and work effectively across disciplines **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to perform computer\-based work and remain in a stationary position for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation * Ability to move between office and laboratory work areas and operate benchtop laboratory instrumentation, with or without reasonable accommodation * Ability to follow laboratory safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment **Location:** * San Diego (on\-site) **Travel:** * No anticipated travel **Job Type:** * Full\-time / Exempt **Base Compensation Pay Range:** * $118,000 \- $144,000 In addition to the base compensation noted above, you will be eligible for stock options, a discretionary annual bonus, no\-cost health insurance plans, a 401(k) with company match, and flexible paid time off. *Please note: Base compensation will depend on multiple factors, including geographic location, qualifications, and experience.* We foster an environment such that all people are afforded the freedom to pursue their passions without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Engineering and AI Operations Specialist
jobs.description: **\*\*No sponsorship/C2C is available for this position\*\*** **Engineering and AI Specialist** **Reports To:** Director of Technical Delivery **Location:** Remote **FLSA:** Exempt **Job Summary** The AI Operations Specialist builds and runs the internal AI tooling, automations, and pilots that make AI a practical, everyday part of how Elevate Digital's Engineering team delivers. Reporting to the Director of Technical Delivery, this role turns the AI operations roadmap into working software: maintaining agent pipelines and internal tools, testing new models and tools against real workflows, and keeping engineers unblocked as they adopt them. This is an execution\-focused role, not a standard\-setting one. Direction, governance, and org\-wide AI standards for Engineering remain owned by the Director of Technical Delivery; the AI Operations Specialist is the builder who makes that direction real, working alongside the Director on shared tooling projects rather than owning all of it independently. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Tooling \& Automation** * Build, maintain, and extend the AI tooling and agent pipelines Engineering relies on — including coding\-agent integrations, MCP servers, and internal bots or scripts — working alongside the Director of Technical Delivery on shared tooling priorities. * Keep existing automations reliable as models, APIs, and internal workflows change, monitoring for breakage and patching quickly. * Maintain a lightweight, current catalog of what tooling is live, what's experimental, and what's been retired. **Pilots \& Evaluation** * Run scoped pilots applying AI to specific internal workflows — ticket triage, documentation, code review assistance, onboarding, and similar — and report results back to the Director of Technical Delivery. * Hands\-on evaluation of new AI models, tools, and vendors as they emerge: what they're good for, what they cost, and whether they fit Elevate's delivery workflows. * Track basic usage, cost, and quality signals for AI tooling so adoption decisions rest on evidence rather than hype. **Enablement \& Support** * Support engineers adopting AI tooling day to day — answering questions, unblocking issues, and sharing practical techniques that actually work. * Produce lightweight documentation, guides, or walkthroughs so internal tools are usable by people other than the person who built them. * Surface friction, bugs, and gaps in existing tooling and pipelines back to the Director of Technical Delivery as input to the roadmap. **Required Competencies and Skills** * **Builder Mentality:** Genuine hands\-on drive to build and ship internal tools and automations — this role is defined by making things, not evaluating them from the sidelines. * **AI/LLM Practical Fluency:** Working knowledge of agentic workflows, prompt engineering, MCP, and RAG\-style patterns, gained through real building rather than credentials alone. * **Automation \& Scripting:** Comfortable writing scripts, integrations, and lightweight pipelines to connect tools and remove manual work. * **Judgment Under Ambiguity:** Able to size up a new tool or pilot quickly, form a point of view, and know when a decision needs to go to the Director of Technical Delivery rather than being made unilaterally. * **Documentation Habit:** Writes clear, lightweight documentation as a habit, not an afterthought, so tools and pilots are usable by others. * **Collaborative Execution:** Works well executing someone else's roadmap and priorities on shared tooling projects, without needing to own the strategy to stay motivated. **Experience and Education** * Solid grounding in programming fundamentals — able to read, reason about, and debug the code and systems they build, not just accept AI\-generated output at face value. This is not a "vibe coding" role. * Demonstrated experience building automations, scripts, or AI\-assisted tooling — through professional work, side projects, or hands\-on experimentation. What you've built and can explain matters more than where you learned to build it. * Practical, hands\-on experience with agentic coding tools, AI coding assistants, or LLM\-based pipelines, used deliberately rather than as a black box. * Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-changing technical territory where best practices are still being written. * Self\-taught and non\-traditional paths are welcome, provided they come with real engineering fundamentals. Some formal computer science background is preferred, but demonstrated ability to understand and reason about the code and systems being built matters more than the credential itself. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is a plus but not required given equivalent, demonstrable fundamentals. **Values Alignment** The AI Operations Specialist embodies Elevate Digital's core pillars and the way we work: * **People Advantage:** You build tools that make engineers faster and better at their jobs, not tools that quietly replace their judgment. * **Client Growth:** You measure your work by whether it actually gets used and actually saves time — not by how sophisticated it looks. * **Services Transformation:** You're energized by building in undefined territory, comfortable that today's tool may be rebuilt or replaced next quarter as the landscape shifts. * **Responsible by Default:** You hold your own tooling to a high bar for reliability and security, especially anywhere it touches client work or sensitive data. **Travel Required** This is a remote role with no regular travel expectation. Occasional participation in team gatherings or planning sessions may be requested. **Other Duties** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice, as business needs evolve.

jobs.title: Software Engineer- Full Stack
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Full Stack Software Engineer – Software Product Engineering Come develop great software solutions to solve exciting problems that help patients! The Software Product Engineering team is looking for a full stack engineer. Are you determined to own and complete complicated and technically ambitious work? Are you passionate about technology, with extensive full stack development experience across both front\-end and back\-end systems? Our team is actively adopting AI across the development lifecycle to help us build better software, faster, and we're looking for engineers who are excited to be part of that evolution while bringing strong engineering fundamentals. If so, please apply. **What You'll Be Doing:** As part of a collaborative team of versatile engineers, you will build reusable, composable software components, taking them from design and requirement specifications through implementation, testing, and integration into Software Product Engineering's next\-generation platform ecosystem. By continuously improving the design, building for maintainability, and ensuring the product meets both business and patient needs, your work will transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes. **How You'll Succeed :** * Develop, test, and deploy components into provisioned cloud platform environments through automated Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD) processes. * Review and implement technical designs, translating them into APIs, user interfaces, libraries, and services across a range of programming languages while adhering to Lilly's architecture, design, implementation, and security standards. * Use AI coding tools to accelerate design exploration, implementation, testing, and debugging, while owning the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship. * Build and integrate AI capabilities into products, such as LLM\-powered features and agent tools, where they improve patient and user outcomes. * Build working knowledge of medical device delivery models and quality systems, including GxP expectations, to ensure solutions align with regulatory requirements and timelines. * Integrate open source and licensed components into larger solutions, making practical reuse decisions and ensuring dependencies are sourced through approved enterprise channels (e.g., Artifactory) and meet security and licensing requirements. * Investigate and propose solutions to development and design problems through open collaboration and healthy debate, including scope estimation and forecasting. * Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, engineers, stakeholders, and vendors within the team and across Lilly. * Establish strong relationships with technical leaders and architects to influence technology direction for Software Product Engineering platforms and products. * Practice effective source control, code review, and collaborative programming to drive high\-quality outcomes. * Partner with data professionals to implement database and data warehousing solutions. * Complete projects with minimal supervision and direction. **What You Should Bring :** * Experience designing and building cloud\-native applications using containerized services and microservices architectures on AWS or Azure. * Exposure to large\-scale architectural patterns, ideally with hands\-on experience implementing event\-driven systems using Apache Kafka (or similar) for scalable, resilient processing. * Strong object\-oriented programming skills, excellent debugging skills, and expertise with data serialization, REST APIs, and version control. * Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, or a JVM language (e.g., Kotlin) for building front\-end and back\-end services, along with HTML, CSS, and SASS; Python experience is a plus. * Experience building applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, or Nuxt) and modern build tooling (e.g., Vite, Webpack). * Familiarity with build automation and containerization technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes. * Experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your development workflow; familiarity with LLM application patterns such as RAG, tool use, or MCP is a plus. * A proven track record of Agile software development, demonstrated through a portfo tems * Experience with multiple languages (polyglot programming), including JavaScript/TypeScript or a JVM language (e.g., Kotlin) * Professional experience delivering software solutions across the full development life cycle, including project initiation, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, support, and retirement * Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, J\-1, H\-1B, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, or L\-1\. Additional Information Position based in San Francisco, California with a hybrid work model. About the organization Tech @ Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using groundbreaking technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Tech @ Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business. Lilly's Software Product Engineering (SPE) organization is focused on building core foundational software platforms to accelerate our ability to reach and support patients, digitally. This organization is powered by software engineering experts that solve challenging problems around patient engagement and drug discovery with code. Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $66,000 \- $158,400 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (NetSuite, Python, Node.js)
jobs.description: Elite Wheel Distributors is one of the fastest moving B2B wholesale wheel and tire distributors in the country, with operations in Florida and Illinois. We run on NetSuite ERP, Zoho CRM, RF Smart, Pacejet and a growing stack of internal tools that handle thousands of orders every month. We are hiring a hands\-on Full Stack Developer who will also lead and manage our development team. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About Endiatx** Endiatx is a medical device company developing microrobotic systems for diagnostic use inside the human body. Our flagship platform, PillBot™, is a propeller\-driven endoscopic capsule designed to enable real\-time visualization of the stomach without traditional endoscopy. We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers, clinicians, and operators building a new category of medical diagnostics at the intersection of robotics, imaging, and AI. **Role Summary** We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to lead development and deployment of our endoscopic image analysis systems. This role owns the full ML lifecycle—from data strategy through production deployment—and contributes directly to how our devices interpret and interact with the physical world. You will work on computer vision models for gastric imagery, image enhancement under constrained in vivo conditions, and perception systems supporting navigation and localization. You will collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, and simulation teams to integrate ML into a real\-world medical device system. This is a mid\-level role with significant ownership and the opportunity to mentor junior contributors. **What You Will Do** \- Own the end\-to\-end ML pipeline: data curation, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring \- Design, train, and validate computer vision models using frameworks such as PyTorch \- Develop image enhancement pipelines \- Optimize models for performance across accuracy, latency, and compute constraints \- Implement neural compression techniques \- Build and maintain dataset infrastructure \- Deploy models into production environments with CI/CD and monitoring \- Contribute to localization and pose estimation \- Support perception systems for navigation and scene understanding \- Collaborate with simulation and visualization teams \- Mentor interns and junior engineers \- Communicate technical work clearly **Required Qualifications** \- 4\+ years of ML engineering experience or equivalent \- Experience deploying production computer vision models \- Strong foundation in deep learning \- Proficiency in Python and PyTorch \- Experience with MLOps tools \- Strong software engineering fundamentals \- Strong communication skills \- Experience in image enhancement, compression, or perception systems **Nice to Have** \- Medical imaging experience (e.g., DICOM) \- C\# or Unity familiarity \- SLAM or localization experience \- Robotics or autonomous systems experience **Location** On\-site in Hayward, CA. Limited hybrid flexibility. **Compensation** $130,000 – $180,000 base salary, plus equity and benefits. **Work Authorization** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. **Equal Opportunity** Endiatx is an equal opportunity employer. **Accommodations** Reasonable accommodations provided. **Employment Status** At\-will employment. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Experience: * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch: 2 years (Required) * Deep learning: 1 year (Required) * MLOps tools: 1 year (Required) * image enhancement, compression, or perception systems: 1 year (Required) * Machine Learning engineering: 4 years (Required) * deploying production computer vision models: 3 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description: Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine\-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI\-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e\-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community. **Job Description** As Chief Information Officer (CIO), you’ll lead the technology our teams rely on every day. That includes the systems employees use, the enterprise applications that run our go\-to\-market and financial operations, our data platform, our corporate website, and our cloud infrastructure. You’ll lead through strong domain owners, and you’ll stay close enough to the technology to set standards, weigh plans, and ask the hard questions. You’ll work alongside our product general managers, product AI organization, security team, and Finance.**What you’ll do** **Set direction and own the enterprise systems estate** * Set priorities for internal technology against company plans, and hold each domain accountable for delivery. * Own our enterprise applications, from CRM and marketing automation through ERP and financials, including the quote\-to\-cash flow between them. * Guide enterprise and data architecture, and lead the integration and data engineers who build it. * Run one intake, change\-control, and planning cadence so a change in one system doesn’t break another. **Lead operations, data, and IT** * Lead Enterprise Systems and Revenue Operations, aligning systems ownership with operating responsibility for the go\-to\-market stack. * Lead Cloud Operations across corporate and production environments (AWS and Azure), including availability, performance, cost, and security posture. * Lead IT and end\-user services: service desk, endpoints, identity and access, Microsoft 365, and Workday administration. * Own our Snowflake data platform and integrations, with access governance set jointly with Finance. * Own the corporate website, including development, vendor relationships, and change control. **Manage risk, spend, and AI** * Partner with our security team: you’re accountable for posture and execution, and they set standards and audit. * Govern internal process automation and AI agents, including approval gates and production\-readiness review, in coordination with the product AI organization. * Own the technology budget and major vendor relationships, including planning, negotiation, and ROI. * Build and retain a high\-performing team with a clear owner for every domain. **What you bring** **Required** * 15\+ years in technology leadership, with growing responsibility for teams, programs, and budgets. * 8\+ years directing technical leaders across multiple disciplines. * Deep expertise in enterprise and ERP architecture, data modeling, integration, and data engineering. * Experience across enterprise applications and cloud infrastructure, leading through domain owners. * Experience leading large\-scale technology transformation and consolidation. * Working knowledge of HIPAA and SOC 2 in a regulated, data\-sensitive environment. * A technical foundation, ideally including early\-career engineering experience. * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Preferred** * SaaS or healthcare experience. * Hands\-on credibility with modern data platforms such as Snowflake. * Contract negotiation experience that protects scope and delivers value. **How you work** * **You explain technology in business terms.** You build trust with product, finance, legal, and executive partners. * **You decide, then hold people accountable.** You set direction and empower owners to deliver. * **You respect the budget.** You bring the ROI discipline a finance team expects. **Additional Information** -------------------------- While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria. The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together! All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. At **En****sora Health**, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do. We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community. We will champion non\-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status. **Ensora Health** is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer / Product Engineer ONSITE -Scottsdale, Az
jobs.description: Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer \- LOCAL Candidates only **Public\-Posting Performance\-Based Hiring Profile** **Build the whole product. Own the outcome. Pivot fast without losing momentum.** **LOCATION** Scottsdale, Arizona \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site **SCHEDULE** Flexible start within the 7:00 a.m.\-6:00 p.m. work window **COMPENSATION** $100,000\-$130,000 base, depending on demonstrated capability **ROLE MIX** Approximately 50% front\-end / 50% back\-end development **CORE STACK** Python back end \| TypeScript front end \| AWS \| APIs \| Practical AI integrations **This is not a ticket\-taking developer role.** Envita is looking for a true full\-stack builder who can move comfortably between front\-end and back\-end development, take an incomplete request from a non\-technical stakeholder, clarify what actually needs to be built, and carry the solution through production. The role is approximately 50/50 front end and back end, with Python as the primary back\-end language. AI is an important part of the environment, especially practical AI and API integrations, but this is not a machine\-learning role and we do not want someone who relies on AI without understanding the code, architecture, risks, or output. **Position Purpose** ==================== The Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer will build secure, reliable, cost\-conscious products across Envita business units. The role requires strong full\-stack range, direct stakeholder communication, rapid learning, practical AI integration experience, and a high degree of self\-direction. A defining requirement is the ability to pivot immediately when business priorities change while preserving the state, visibility, and restart point of every other active project. **Why This Opportunity Stands Out** =================================== * End\-to\-end ownership from requirements and architecture through build, integration, deployment, testing, and production follow\-through. * True full\-stack scope with meaningful work on both the user\-facing front end and the Python back end. * Direct access to the people using what you build, including clinicians, pharmacy and laboratory operators, business leaders, and executives. * Practical AI work, including AI\-provider APIs and AI\-enabled product features, without requiring machine\-learning specialization. * Variety, autonomy, and visible business impact across multiple Envita entities rather than one narrow product lane. * A flexible daily start window designed to support an on\-site Scottsdale work environment. **What Exceptional Success Looks Like After the First Year** ============================================================ Envita leaders can bring this engineer an important business problem and trust that it will be clarified, translated into a practical technical solution, built across the full stack, deployed securely, and supported with clear status and documentation. The engineer is equally credible in front\-end and Python back\-end work, uses AI and external APIs intelligently, understands and can explain the code they ship, and is known for being able to change direction quickly when the business requires it without allowing lower\-priority projects to disappear or restart from zero. **SMART Key Performance Objectives** ==================================== These outcomes define success in the role. Demonstrated capability and comparable accomplishments matter more than years of experience, prior title, or exact framework overlap. **1\. Deliver the First Full\-Stack Product Fast** -------------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Take an assigned project from the initial stakeholder conversation through requirements clarification, front\-end and Python back\-end development, API integration as needed, testing, and production deployment. Target a meaningful demo by approximately day 21 and a production\-ready release by approximately day 45\. **Evidence of success:** The stakeholder confirms the solution solves the intended problem; the engineer can explain the architecture and code; appropriate testing, authentication, secrets handling, logging, and production controls are in place; and the solution operates reliably after launch. **2\. Pivot on a Dime Without Losing Momentum** ----------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Operate effectively across multiple active projects while being able to immediately redirect attention when leadership or business needs change. When one project becomes critical, shift the majority of effort to it without allowing other work to become invisible, confused, or difficult to restart. **Evidence of success:** Priority changes are acted on quickly; stakeholders are informed; paused work has a documented current state, next action, blocker, and restart point; the critical project accelerates; and previously active projects resume without unnecessary rework or loss of context. **3\. Own Requirements From Ambig modeling using Postgres or a comparable database, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and safe migrations. * REST/API design and integration experience, including authentication/authorization, validation, versioning, idempotency, structured errors, and reliability concerns. * Hands\-on AWS deployment ownership, including IAM/access control, secrets, networking fundamentals, logs/observability, and cost awareness. * Application\-security fundamentals, especially authentication vs. authorization, injection/XSS awareness, secret handling, transport security, least privilege, and sensitive data. * Unit and integration testing as a normal part of development, plus confidence standing up test coverage in existing or lightly documented systems. * Git fluency and the ability to navigate an unfamiliar repository and determine what the code actually does. * Meaningful practical AI experience, preferably integrating AI/LLM capabilities through APIs or building AI\-enabled product features. Machine\-learning model development is not required. * A recent, specific example of learning a new language, SDK, API, framework, or platform under deadline and successfully shipping with it. **What Separates Top Performers** ================================= * **Priority Agility:** Can change direction immediately when business priorities change, make the new priority successful, and preserve clean restart points for everything temporarily deprioritized. * **Full\-Stack Range:** Is genuinely comfortable delivering both user\-facing front\-end work and production Python back\-end services. * **AI Judgment:** Uses AI where it improves speed or quality, but never substitutes AI output for understanding, verification, security, or accountability. * **Requirements Discipline:** Asks clarifying questions before coding, confirms understanding, and avoids building the wrong thing quickly. * **Self\-Direction:** Creates structure when structure is light, keeps multiple projects visible, and escalates conflicts before they become surprises. * **Ship\-Quality Judgment:** Moves quickly while knowing which shortcuts are acceptable and which are not, especially around security, sensitive data, authentication, data integrity, and cost. * **Constructive Communication:** Explains choices and trade\-offs clearly and responds to changed priorities without defensiveness or loss of follow\-through. **The Environment** =================== This role is best suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, variety, speed, and incomplete problems. Requirements may arrive verbally. Priorities can change during the week or during the day. An engineer may be progressing several projects and then be asked to focus almost entirely on one urgent initiative. Success requires flexibility without chaos: make the pivot, communicate it, preserve the state of the other work, and keep commitments visible. There may not always be a mature product\-management process, complete design handoff, dedicated DevOps support, or perfect documentation waiting before work begins. **Culture and Working Style** ============================= * Patient and business impact comes before technology for technology's sake. * Integrity, humility, gratitude, learning agility, respectful collaboration, confidentiality, and accountability matter in how the work gets done. * Strong performers are comfortable receiving direct feedback, revisiting assumptions, and changing course when the evidence or business priority changes. * We value people who are curious, dependable, solution\-oriented, technically accountable, and willing to own the consequences of their decisions. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ Envita Medical Centers of America is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Facilities Engineering Operations Lead, Data Center
jobs.description: **About Etched** Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. **Job Summary** Etched is building a new category of AI hardware: frontier inference clusters. As our Facilities Engineering Operations Lead, you will own day\-to\-day operations of our AI data center: uptime, incident response, and escalation across power, cooling, and the white space. You'll be the first hire in this function and will build the operating system from scratch, including procedures, maintenance programs, on\-call, and alarming, then turn it into the playbook we copy to every site that follows. **Key Responsibilities** * Own day\-to\-day data center operations end to end: uptime, incident response, and escalation for power, cooling, and the white space. * Build the operating system from scratch: SOPs, MOPs, and EOPs; change management; preventive and predictive maintenance schedules; shift coverage and on\-call; incident and RCA process. * Define SLOs and response plans for outage events at the fleet, rack, and server level. * Run the liquid cooling plant for high\-density racks, including CDUs, secondary fluid loops, water chemistry and filtration, leak detection, and flow and inlet\-temperature monitoring. * Own electrical operations, including switchgear, busway and PDUs, power connector topology, load balancing across racks, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) and arc\-flash safety. * Manage electrical, mechanical, CDU OEM, and fire/life safety vendors and contractors: scope work, review quotes, and oversee onsite work. * Stand up monitoring and alarming with engineering across BMS/DCIM and rack and CDU telemetry, so problems reach the right person within minutes, not hours. * Run rack deployment logistics: receiving, staging, install, commissioning, and turn\-up handoff to the hardware and lab teams, plus decommissioning and RMA flows. * Track spares and critical parts inventory for facility equipment. * Report operational metrics to leadership, including uptime, PUE, incidents, open risks, and capacity headroom. * Help build the team, starting with facilities engineering technicians and a BMS specialist. * Design processes and site\-readiness checklists that can be replicated at our next sites. **You may be a good fit if you have** * 4\-8\+ years in critical facilities and data center operations, including time as a Lead or Senior Critical Facilities Engineer or a single\-site Facilities Manager * Hands\-on experience operating liquid cooling in production (CDUs, direct\-to\-chip / DLC, secondary fluid loops) * Deep working knowledge of data center electrical distribution (switchgear, UPS, busway, PDUs) and safe work practices (LOTO, arc flash, NFPA 70E) * Experience writing and drilling SOPs, MOPs, and EOPs, and running change management and maintenance programs * Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis * A track record of managing mechanical, electrical, and fire/life safety vendors * Working knowledge of BMS, DCIM, and power monitoring systems * Readiness to own the whole site, not just a shift or a system * Deeply creative and able to think from first principles **Strong candidates may also have experience with** * Running high\-density GPU / AI infrastructure at a neocloud, hyperscaler, or colocation provider * Standing up a new site or data hall, including commissioning and turn\-up * Building and staffing 24/7 operations and on\-call rotations * Familiarity with modern ML and LLM model architectures * Ability to program with Python or another scripting language * Familiarity with AI tools for programming/coding * Startup experience or comfort working in fast\-paced environments **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage * $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits * Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office * Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row) * Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more * Daily lunch and dinner in our office * Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification **How we're different** Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference\-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed. This role is onsite in the Bay Area at our data center and Milpitas sites, with regular time at our San Jose headquarters. **Compensation Range** **$150,000 \- $250,000, plus equity**
