jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Future Evolves Here** Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Position Summary** The Lead Software Engineer leads the design, development, and delivery of the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. This role defines the front\-end architecture and technical strategy for a React and Next.js (TypeScript) application that consumes Pydantic AI agents over the AG\-UI protocol and ensures the agent\-to\-human handoff is fast, accessible, secure, and auditable. This individual provides technical leadership and mentorship to a team of front\-end engineers, sets the standards others follow, and partners with architecture, agent, platform, design\-system, and product teams to prioritize work and deliver on schedule. The role is expected to use approved AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered. **AI\-Assisted Engineering Expectations** Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI\-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards. **Key Responsibilities** **Technical Leadership and Delivery** * Lead the design, development, and delivery of the agent\-to\-human handoff experience, ensuring alignment with business goals, product requirements, and regulatory decision timeframes. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the front\-end engineering team, fostering a collaborative and productive development environment. * Oversee the full front\-end development lifecycle, from initial concept to production deployment and ongoing maintenance. * Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, clinical stakeholders, and other engineers to prioritize work, set timelines, and deliver features on schedule. **Front\-End Architecture and Standards** * Define and implement the React and Next.js architecture, including Server and Client Component boundaries, an opt\-in caching standard, and read\-your\-writes behavior for decision forms. * Establish the self\-hosting standard for Next.js as containers on AKS, avoiding hosting\-specific features that limit portability. * Define the backend\-for\-frontend (BFF) pattern and the integration approach for .NET (C\#) and Python (FastAPI) services, and Entra ID / OpenID Connect authentication. * Partner with design\-system owners on a technology\-agnostic design token layer and a single Material\-based theme across component libraries (e.g., KendoReact, MUI). * Own npm supply\-chain controls, including SBOM generation, pinned lockfiles, dependency allow\-lists, and scanning through GitHub Actions, CodeQL, Dependabot, and JFrog Xray. * Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, accessibility requirements, and security guidelines. * Plan and lead framework and library upgrades, including annual Next.js major\-version migrations. **Agentic User Experience** * Architect streaming user interfaces (SSE) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative UI using the Vercel AI SDK, assistant\-ui, and CopilotKit over the AG\-UI protocol. * Define the AG\-UI event contract with the agent team, including shared state, frontend tools, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval interrupts raised by Pydantic AI tools that require approval. * Design human\-in\-the\-loop patterns that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations with structured rationale that supports the audit trail. * Establish patterns for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including resumable streams, retries, timeouts, and clear status for the reviewer. * Lead delivery of data\-heavy screens, including large sor ent\-driven user interfaces (e.g., Vercel AI SDK, assistant\-ui, CopilotKit, AG\-UI) or equivalent streaming, real\-time interfaces using Server\-Sent Events or WebSockets. * Experience designing and delivering data\-heavy enterprise screens, such as large grids, document viewers, rich\-text editors, and multi\-step workflows, using component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI. * Proven experience with the backend\-for\-frontend pattern and integrating front ends with services written in other languages, such as .NET (C\#) and Python (FastAPI). * Experience implementing authentication with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect. * Demonstrated expertise delivering applications that meet WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA and Section 508\. * Experience with front\-end testing using Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS preferred), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and OpenTelemetry. * Experience applying npm supply\-chain security practices, such as SBOMs, lockfile policy, and dependency scanning. * Strong, daily use of AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot. * Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to lead and mentor a team of engineers. * Experience in Agile development methodologies and working in cross\-functional, globally distributed teams. * Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges and make critical decisions under pressure. **Preferred Qualifications** * Working knowledge of Python and Pydantic AI, including agent tool approval and the AG\-UI and Vercel AI SDK adapters. * Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop experiences for AI agents, including approval, override, and audit workflows. * Experience with FHIR R4; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus. * Experience consuming events from Azure Service Bus or similar message brokers. * Experience with C\# and .NET. * Experience with design systems and design tokens, including Material Design. * Experience integrating AI services, models, or agents into production applications. * Healthcare domain experience, including handling PHI under HIPAA. **Education** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. **Technical Requirements:** We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router. **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.** The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $140,000 \- 160,000\. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

jobs.title: Project Engineer (Civil/Structural), Line Design Services
jobs.description: At Exo, engineering isn’t just a job — it’s a craft we love, a team we trust, and a place where great people come to do the best work of their careers. We’re a small, high\-performance engineering team built on clarity, quality, and deep expertise. That size is our advantage: we move fast, stay flexible, and keep our focus exactly where it belongs — on our people, our projects, and our clients. We’re a team of passionate engineers who genuinely enjoy the work and enjoy working together. You’ll find experts who freely share knowledge and leaders who backstop the team. We care about expertise, we care about growth, and we care about delivering outcomes that genuinely matter — for our clients and to each other. And yes — we have fun doing it. This role is part of Exo’s Engineering group, focused on designing transmission line support structures that are safe, efficient, and constructible. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and designers to develop steel lattice tower and steel pole designs, foundation designs and related structural components for projects that strengthen and expand the power grid. If you want to join a place where your performance is recognized, your growth is supported, and your impact is felt immediately, you’ll fit right in. Here, you’ll tackle challenging power\-delivery projects, collaborate with people who love this industry, and contribute to a company that’s shaping it. We’re building something special — nimble, ambitious, fair, and full of good energy — and we’re looking for people who want to help shape what comes next. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop deliverables and perform routine design and analysis independently. * Conduct engineering and design using engineering software and internal tools. * Design routine projects. * Lead project teams. * Coordinate scope, schedule, and budget with project manager. * Communicate effectively with team members to achieve project objectives. * Participate in project meetings. * Collaborate with clients, vendors, and other project stakeholders. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced staff. * Lead business development and proposal development. * Participate within the industry. * Confirm design work is produced following quality procedures. * Ensure designs meet client standards, safety, design code, constructability, and cost\-efficiency requirements. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree (civil or structural engineering). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Proficiency in software described in Key Competencies. * PE Licensed (Civil or Structural). * Knowledge of relevant codes and standards. * Knowledge of Project Management Principles. * 6 \- 20 years of relevant experience. **Key Competencies** * Experienced engineering capability. * Collaboration within team environments. * Team leadership experience. * Ability to manage project scope, schedule, and budget. * Willingness to accept mentoring and knowledge sharing from more experienced staff. * Proven experience mentoring and training less experienced staff. * Detail\-oriented with a commitment to quality. * Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking skills. * Effective communication and collaboration skills. * Microsoft Office Suite (Teams, Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint). * Engineering Software (e.g. PLS\-CADD, PLS\-TOWER, PLS\-POLE, FAD Tools, AutoDesk, Inventor, AutoCAD, and others). **Physical Requirements** * Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time while working on a computer or reviewing technical documents. * Ability to operate standard office equipment, including computers, keyboards, and monitors. * Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, clients, and project stakeholders. * Ability to occasionally move about construction sites, utility corridors, or industrial facilities during field visits or inspections. * Ability to traverse uneven terrain, stairs, or ladders when accessing project locations or viewing structural elements, when required. * Ability to occasionally lift or move items up to approximately 25 pounds, such as field equipment, documents, or sample materials. * Ability to travel periodically to project sites, client meetings, or fabrication facilities as project needs require. **Mental and Cognitive Work Demands** * Ability to analyze complex technical information and apply engineering principles to solve problems. * Ability to maintain attention to detail and accuracy while performing engineering calculations, modeling, and design review. * Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects or deadlines in a professional work environment. * Ability to interpret engineering codes, standards, and technical documents. * Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively in written and verbal formats. * Ability to exercise professional judgment and make informed engineering decisions. **Work Environment** * Work is performed primarily in a professional office environment, with periodic travel to construction sites, substations, or utility infrastructure locations. * Field visits may involve exposure to outdoor weather conditions, construction activity, and industrial environments, and may require the use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). FLSA Status: Exempt Pay Range: $120,000\-$180,000 Reports to: Vice President, Line Design Services Note: The above job description is a general overview of the responsibilities and requirements typically associated with the role of a Civil/Structural Project Engineer for Transmission Structures. The specific duties and requirements may vary depending on organizational requirements and industry standards. *Exo is committed to equal employment opportunity. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, disability, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

Today we are a New York Stock Exchange\-traded company leading the self\-storage industry in more ways than one. But in order to maintain this lead, we need exceptionally motivated, capable, and driven people like you. We offer a fast\-paced collaborative environment where each of us directly contributes to the company’s success. Come join us and find out why so many of our employees recommend Extra Space Storage as a great place to work.***\*\*\* Please note that this is a HYBRID role, requiring this person to work at our Cottonwood Heights office in SLC three days a week. We are not able to provide work sponsorship (i.e. OPT or H\-1B visa) for this role \*\*\**** We are looking for a Software Engineer to help build reliable, scalable, and intuitive internal enterprise web applications for Extra Space Storage. This role sits on the Internal Application engineering team and partners closely with product management, operations stakeholders, UX designers, and engineering peers to deliver software that powers our day\-to\-day store operations, transactional workflows, document management, and retail systems. The ideal candidate is self\-driven, thrives in a collaborative agile environment, and is adept at translating complex operational workflows into high\-quality technical solutions using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, scalable APIs, and robust engineering practices. **Duties \& Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * **Architect \& Build Internal Solutions:** Translate operational and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and reliable solutions across our suite of internal business and store\-management platforms. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with product managers, operational stakeholders, and UX designers to create streamlined workflows that improve day\-to\-day efficiency and user experience for internal teams. * **Technical Design \& Discovery:** Participate in technical design, discovery, and architecture planning sessions; document technical designs; evaluate tradeoffs; and ensure alignment with business goals, maintainability, and enterprise architecture standards. * **Integrations \& Platform Services:** Extend and modernize core platform capabilities, including integrations with third\-party services. * **UI/UX Implementation:** Ensure technical feasibility and high\-fidelity implementation of UI/UX designs, focusing on usability, responsiveness, and speed for high\-volume internal operational users. * **Modern Engineering Practices:** Leverage approved AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate routine development, explore implementation strategies, and improve overall team velocity. * **Operational Excellence \& Reliability:** Drive production readiness through automated unit/integration testing, peer code reviews, CI/CD pipeline improvements, observability/monitoring, SLA/SLO adherence, and incident response. **Qualifications** * **3\+ years** of hands\-on software development experience building web applications using modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular). * Demonstrated experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with enterprise backend services. * Experience working within an **Agile/Scrum** delivery lifecycle. * Proficiency with modern version control and collaboration workflows using **Git**. * Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on writing clean, modular, and well\-tested code. **Bonus Qualifications** * Strong proficiency and hands\-on experience with **React** and modern state management. * Experience building and maintaining backend services and APIs using Node.js / Express, with familiarity or experience in .NET / C\# for supporting services. * Experience with **Git\-based CI/CD automation**, **AWS cloud infrastructure**, and automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end). * Experience developing enterprise software involving complex domain workflows (e.g., retail/point\-of\-sale systems, document management, payment gateways, e\-signatures, or telephony integrations). * Hands\-on experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and NoSQL data stores (DynamoDB). * Familiarity with enterprise software performance tuning, caching strategies, and service reliability/observability (SLAs, SLOs, logging, and metrics). **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Close visual acuity required to perform work at computer terminal. No exposure to adverse environmental conditions. Requires repetitive typing motion, talking, hearing, grasping and feeling. We pride ourselves on hiring top talent and provide the following benefits and more: * Well defined career paths * Qualify for Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits on Day 1 * Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending (FSA) * Company paid Life, AD\&D, and Short \& Long Term Disability * 401K with company match after 90 days of service * Holiday pay and paid time off * Extensive Wellness Program and various Employee Discount Programs * Personal Health Advocate * Free soda, coffee, and drinks all day every day and much, much more! Disclaimer *The job description outlines the general nature and scope of work employees perform in this role. It's not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required for the position. The company reserves the right to modify, revise, or update the job description to meet business needs.* **If you are a current Extra Space employee, please apply through Jobs Hub in Workday.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Applications Deadline: Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Agentic Security Operations (remote)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== Our Security Operations Center (SOC) protects the enterprise by detecting, investigating, and responding to cybersecurity threats. As a member of our Threat Detection Engineering team operating within our SOC, you will build governed agent capabilities to support data onboarding, detection engineering, threat hunting, investigation, response, automation, and platform operations. Our goal is to expand threat visibility, accelerate security outcomes, reduce repetitive work, and improve operational consistency and resilience without compromising sound security judgment, human accountability, or control. The Principal Engineer provides hands\-on technical leadership to turn this strategy into secure, reliable, and supportable production capabilities across the SOC. * We are open to remote candidates for this role **What You’ll Do** * Lead the architecture and hands\-on implementation of Agentic Security Operations capabilities across the SOC. * Define and evolve the reference architecture for governed data services, agent capabilities, workload routing, execution environments, and deterministic orchestration. * Build reusable capabilities that translate operational intent into tested, reviewable, and auditable security outcomes. * Establish engineering standards for creating, testing, registering, approving, releasing, monitoring, and retiring agents and their capabilities. * Advance detection\-as\-code practices, including versioning, simulation, deployment, tuning, migration, and rollback. * Build governed knowledge and context services that provide authoritative documentation, policies, operational history, citations, freshness information, and permission\-aware retrieval. * Design workload identity, least\-privilege access, short\-lived authorization, spend controls, approval gates, audit trails, rollback, and emergency shutdown mechanisms. * Define autonomy levels that determine which activities may execute automatically, require human approval, or remain analyst led. * Establish agent evaluation and observability through historical replay, synthetic scenarios, expected\-versus\-actual comparisons, policy tests, traces, outcome verification, and regression testing. * Measure quality, security, reliability, latency, cost, analyst acceptance, and operational impact. * Engineer reliable integrations across search, case management, workflow, communications, and response systems, including retries, idempotency, partial failures, and reconciliation. * Ensure consequential response actions remain deterministic, attributable, reversible, and subject to appropriate human oversight. * Design production reliability, continuity, recovery, and support models for agent capabilities and security data services. * Lead proofs of concept and architecture evaluations using measurable criteria for security, fidelity, scale, reliability, portability, operating effort, and economic value. * Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, data, risk, privacy, legal, and compliance teams. * Mentor engineers, establish technical standards, review designs, and influence Threat Detection Engineering strategy. * Present complex technical decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations clearly to engineering and executive stakeholders. * Partner across Threat Detection and Response groups, including engineering, threat hunting, security analysis, investigation, and incident response stakeholders on initiatives and to translate operational feedback into improvements within our agentic harness, evaluations, safeguards, workflows, and other platforms. **What You’ll Bring** * Extensive experience designing and operating enterprise security, software, data, or distributed systems at scale. * Demonstrated success as a principal\-level technical leader while remaining actively involved in architecture, prototyping, coding, testing, and production delivery. * Hands\-on experience delivering production AI\-assisted or agentic systems that use tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and structured workflows. * Strong understanding of security operations, including telemetry m e of major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and the identity, networking, logging, data protection, and workload\-security controls required to secure them. * A minimum of 10 years’ experience in cybersecurity or relevant fields. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, a related field, or equivalent work experience. * Preferred certifications such as, GASAE, GAIPS, GDSA, GCDA, CEH, OSCP, CISSP, etc. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience modernizing a centralized security analytics environment into a decoupled architecture with customer\-controlled data and replaceable compute or control layers. * Experience with knowledge graphs, entity resolution, semantic normalization, retrieval\-augmented systems, or multi\-agent coordination. * Experience migrating security content while validating semantic equivalence, historical fidelity, and operational parity. * Background in detection engineering, incident response, threat hunting, adversary emulation, or security automation. * Experience defining governance and autonomy frameworks for AI\-enabled production systems. * Experience building internal platforms or shared engineering services used by multiple security functions. **What Success Looks Like** * A leadership\-approved Agentic Security Operations reference architecture and governance model. * Governed agent prototypes progressing into reliable production capabilities. * Reusable capabilities spanning data, detection, automation, and other SOC functions. * Measurable reductions in engineering effort and operational cycle time without sacrificing security or human accountability. * Continuous evidence that agent capabilities are accurate, secure, reliable, explainable, cost\-effective, and safe to operate. * A production platform with clear ownership, support procedures, recovery controls, and an intentional path away from vendor or architecture lock\-in. Pay Range: $170,900\.00 \- $227,900\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. **\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\*** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements. **What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Adoption
jobs.description: Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e\-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in\-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day \- building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. **Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Adoption \& Growth** As we continue to scale our global platform, the Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Adoption \& Growth will play a critical role in driving adoption and business impact of Fanatics Commerce's AI platform. **ROLE OVERVIEW** Fanatics Commerce is building an AI platform that makes it easier for teams to build, deploy, and scale AI\-powered agents and tools across the organization. The Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Adoption \& Growth owns the adoption and growth of that platform, identifying where teams struggle, removing friction from onboarding through production, and turning recurring customer needs into platform improvements. This role partners with business and technology teams, fellow AI platform PMs, and engineering leaders so that customer demand and adoption data shape the platform roadmap. The Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Adoption \& Growth delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI\-enabled insights. **HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT** Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. **Team \& Leadership Impact** (Build Championship Teams) * Build alignment across product, engineering, business, and senior leadership on the actions required to accelerate AI platform adoption, without relying on formal authority * Partner with the globally distributed AI platform PM team, including peers focused on AI/agentic solution capabilities and the platform's core control plane, and with engineering leaders to ensure adoption data and customer demand inform platform priorities * Route validated opportunities to the appropriate PM and engineering owners so delivery does not depend on a single person **Fan \& Customer Impact** (Obsessed with Fans) * Develop a deep understanding of internal customers, their workflows, and their pain points, and learn why teams adopt, struggle with, or move away from the platform * Own and continuously improve the customer journey from initial engagement through onboarding, first value, production deployment, and sustained usage * Partner with business and technology teams to define problems, desired outcomes, and potential value where AI can improve products, processes, and customer experiences * Help teams demonstrate and communicate the value they achieve through the platform **Innovation \& Problem Solving** (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit) * Rapidly validate promising AI opportunities through lightweight prototypes, experiments, and proofs of concept * Determine whether an opportunity fits existing platform capabilities, requires a new platform capability, or is better suited to a business\-specific solution * Identify recurring needs where reusable platform capabilities can unlock adoption across multiple teams * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and patterns for meaningful potential for Fanatics Commerce **Ownership \& Execution** (Determined \& Relentless Mindset) * Own the adoption strategy for Fanatics Commerce's AI platform and define the metrics that demonstrate successful adoption, activation, time\-to\-value, sustained usage, and business impact * Identify and remove barriers to adoption across onboarding, platform capabilities, documentation, tooling, and operating processes * Develop repeatable mechanisms and programs that help more teams adopt and scale their use of the platform * Own the operating rhythm and narrative with senior leadership, communicating progress, adoption barriers, emerging opportunities, and areas requiring additional investment **AI \& DIGITAL CAPABILITY** We are building a future\-ready organization. This role is expected to: * Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes * Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance * Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working * Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement **CAPABILITIES \& EXPERIENCE YOU BRING** **Required Qualifications:** * Significant product management experience with a track record of owning ambiguous, high\-impact problems and driving outcomes through in s, infrastructure, or enterprise technology products; experience with agent frameworks, MCP servers, or orchestration platforms; experience in e\-commerce, sports, or consumer technology **WORK LOCATION** Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in **Redwood City, CA** subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in\-office presence **(Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday)**. At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined \& Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast\-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. *At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset \- We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast\-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.* ***ABOUT US*** *Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.* ***ABOUT THE TEAM*** *Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically\-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site,* *www.fanatics.com**.* *Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint\-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).* *At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:* * *Build Championship Teams* * *Obsessed with Fans* * *Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit* * *Determined and Relentless Mindset* *By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our* *Candidate Privacy Policy.* *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect - Master Data, Product Data & AI Automation
jobs.description: **Job Posting:** Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best\-in\-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in. Principal Solutions Architect – Master Data, Product Data \& AI Automation The Principal Solutions Architect will lead the technical architecture for Ferguson’s master data capabilities, with an immediate focus on product data. This role will set architecture direction, guide solution design, and drive scalable, secure, and sustainable capabilities across data quality, AI\-enabled classification and automation, enrichment, and cross\-reference solutions. The architect will serve as a senior technical leader across product data and adjacent master data domains, translating sophisticated business and technical needs into solutions that improve data quality, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business value. This is a Principal\-level role requiring recognized expertise in Master Data Management, solutions architecture, product data architecture, and practical application of AI and automation. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical depth, enterprise architecture judgment, and the ability to influence business, technology, product, data governance, analytics, and vendor partners across sophisticated initiatives. Location: This role is approved to be either Remote within the United States or Hybrid for associates in Newport News, VA, in accordance with company policy. **Duties and Responsibilities:** ================================ * Defines strategic architecture direction for enterprise master data capabilities, with emphasis on product data, data quality, AI automation, enrichment, and cross\-reference solutions. * Translates complex business, data, AI, and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, roadmaps, implementation guidance, and architecture guardrails. * Leads architecture for product data models, hierarchies, taxonomies, mappings, transformations, validation rules, match and merge logic, and enrichment workflows. * Shapes responsible AI\-enabled patterns that improve data quality, accelerate enrichment, automate repeatable analysis, and support human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Reviews solution architecture to ensure security, compliance, scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational support requirements are met. * Provides technical leadership and mentorship to architects, engineers, analysts, product owners, and delivery teams building or consuming master data capabilities. * Identifies architecture risks, gaps, dependencies, and trade\-offs; recommends practical solutions that balance speed, quality, cost, supportability, and long\-term sustainability. * Partners with senior business and technology leadership, vendors and third\-party providers to evaluate capabilities, resolve complex issues, assess roadmaps, and align solutions to Ferguson’s master data and AI strategy. **Qualifications and Requirements:** ==================================== * 12\+ years of IT experience with significant depth in data architecture, solutions architecture, enterprise application architecture, or related disciplines. * 7\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, or governing enterprise Master Data Management solutions. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Management, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered. * Deep expertise in master data architecture, including domain modeling, data quality, governance, hierarchy management, stewardship, matching, merging, survivorship, and integration patterns. * Experience with major MDM platforms such as Stibo Systems, Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDG, Semarchy, or similar platforms. * Experience with modern cloud data, analytics, and AI platforms, including Databricks Lakehouse, Databricks AI/BI capabilities such as Genie, Claude or similar generative AI tools, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, cloud storage, SQL and NoSQL platforms, APIs, and modern integration patterns. * Good experience with product data capabilities, including product information management, enrichment, classification, cross\-reference, catalog data, and item setup. * Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, or automation to improve data quality, enrichment, classification, validation, matching, or operational workflows. * Proven Principal\-level ability to define target\-state architecture, influence senior leaders, solve complex problems, mentor technical teams, and deliver scalable architecture strategies. **Preferred Experience:** ========================= * Experience in wholesale, distribution, eCommerce, or other product\-data\-intensive industries. * Experience with product data governance operating models, stewardship workflows, data ownership models, and measurable data quality programs. * Experience shaping responsible AI patterns, human\-in\-the\-loop review models, AI evaluation approaches, and operational controls for AI\-enabled data processes. * Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks, data architecture, cloud architecture, or similar are a plus. **Why Join Us:** ================ You’ll play a central role in shaping Ferguson’s master data and product data strategy at a time when trusted data, AI\-enabled automation, and scalable data quality capabilities are critical to how we serve our customers and run the business. You’ll work across a broad technology landscape in a collaborative environment that values innovation, governance, operational excellence, and measurable business impact, with meaningful opportunities to influence enterprise architecture direction and modernize how Ferguson manages and activates master data. At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well\-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well\-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more! \#LI\-REMOTE * **Pay Range:** * *Actual pay rate may vary depending upon location. jobs.description: Fidelity TalentSource is your destination for discovering your next temporary role at Fidelity Investments. Our products and services inspire better futures by helping tens of millions of investors of all ages and affluence levels plan and manage their investments. **The Team** The Wealth Solutions Engineering organization is a subset of Fidelity’s Wealth business unit and is responsible for a variety of products and services aimed at helping customers to plan and manage their investments. jobs.title: Chief Engineer, Power Generation
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Austin, TX **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Development **Compensation** ---------------- * $263K – $330K *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Energy Team** ------------------- **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * **Put solar, storage and gas in the ground at an install rate no one in the construction market has hit.** We are building generation across multiple gigawatt sites at once, on a schedule traditional EPC delivery cannot meet. * **Secure supply at a scale and timeline the supply chain cannot meet, and reshore it ourselves.** Cells, containers, transformers and turbines are all constrained, so we qualify new suppliers and stand up domestic capacity instead of waiting in line. * **Make solar, gas and storage combine into power steady enough to run AI workloads.** A training run does not tolerate a dip, so the hybrid plant has to behave like firm generation even when the resource behind it does not. * **Clear balancing authority certification, firm load rights, permits and interconnection against long clocks and a shifting policy environment.** These approvals sit on the critical path to every gigawatt, so we work them years ahead of the build. **Role Scope** -------------- * Own the production system behind how Fluidstack builds generation, from module fabrication through field install and energization, as one standard set of work instructions repeated across concurrent gigawatt sites. * Set takt time and line balance for module and skid manufacturing, then hold the line to it with standard work, andon escalation and first\-pass yield targets rather than with expediting. * Drive install rate and rework down in the field through kaizen events and value stream mapping run with the crews doing the work, at the site, on the shift. * Take quality to the source at suppliers through process audits, error\-proofing and joint improvement work on their floor, and fold every fix into the standard design through change control so the next site inherits it. * Teach the method across the organization, coaching engineers, site leads and contractors through A3 problem solving so the system holds when you are not in the room. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would****.** * You've run a production system built on the Toyota Production System or a direct derivative of it, and you learned it by doing the work under someone who had already done it. * You've set takt time on a real line, balanced it against actual cycle times, and held it through a demand ramp that tempted everyone around you to abandon standard work. * You've cut cycle time or defect rate on a process and you can name the before number, the after number, and what you changed to get there. * You've stopped a line, or told a site to stop, when the standard was not being met, and you made that call stick with people who outranked you. * You've developed a supplier on their own floor, changed how they build a part, and watched incoming quality move as a result. * You've taught the method to people who did not want to learn it, and left behind engineers who now run their own A3s and kaizen events without you. * You write clearly enough that a fabrication supervisor, a site superintendent and a CEO each get the decision they need out of the same document. * **Bonus:** Practice inside a Toyota group company or a TPS\-derived operating system (Toyota, Danaher DBS, Boeing, Tesla). Modular and offsite construction (volumetric modules, skidded MEP, prefabricated power blocks). Lean Six Sigma at black belt level. Manufacturing quality and execution systems (MES, SPC, APQP and PPAP). Professional Engineer license. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. *You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $263K \- $330K

jobs.title: Software Engineer- Equity Derivatives Trading Desk
jobs.description: ***We are Gelber Group \- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology.*** ------------------------------------------------------------------------ For more than 40 years, Gelber has been one of the industry's leading proprietary trading firms, combining entrepreneurial thinking with disciplined execution. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices and remote team members throughout the United States and Europe, we have built a reputation for innovation, longevity, and consistent performance. Through regulated businesses that include a FINRA\-registered broker\-dealer, a self\-clearing Chicago Mercantile Exchange member firm, and an AFM\-licensed MiFID II investment firm, Gelber is positioned to trade across all major global financial markets. Our business is driven by a relentless pursuit of new trading opportunities and a deep commitment to technical excellence. We trade a diverse range of asset classes and financial instruments using strategies that span the full spectrum of trading—from high\-frequency and systematic approaches to longer\-term discretionary trading. This diversity creates an intellectually rich environment where ideas, perspectives, and expertise from across the firm contribute to our continued evolution. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and meritocratic. We empower talented people to take ownership, contribute meaningfully, and make an impact early in their careers. We believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage, and we invest in their development by providing meaningful responsibility, exceptional colleagues, and the resources they need to succeed **The Opportunity** ------------------- As a Software Engineer at Gelber Securities, LLC, you will work directly with a successful trading desk that trades derivatives listed on the U.S. markets. You will work side by side with experienced traders, quants, and other talented engineers to design, develop, and support systems and applications used by both human and algorithmic traders, having a direct and meaningful impact on PnL. An amazing opportunity to learn and grow from a team of intelligent and skilled individuals. This role is for someone who flourishes in a fast\-paced environment, has a strong work ethic, clear communication, and a very strong interest in working at a trading firm. ***This position can either sit in our Chicago Headquarters office or remote within the United States.*** ### ***What you'll do:*** * Communicate with engineers, traders, and quants to architect, design, develop, deploy, and support our proprietary trading applications and tools * Have a significant impact in development for our existing infrastructure in C\#, as well as adding new features and applications for our human and algorithmic traders * Become an expert in the entire trading pipeline and the software and technology that it is built upon, including the back end, front end, and everything in between * Provide real time support and bug fixes for live trading applications ### ***What you'll need:*** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field * 3\+ years of work experience working in C\#, Java, or C\+\+ * Strong understanding of and experience with an Object Oriented Programming language * Excellent communication skills specifically when it comes to understanding requirements and translating that into code and fixing bugs * Self\-motivation and ability to work with others in a remote environment * Understanding of the financial markets is not required, but preferred and must have a strong interest * Working knowledge of Options, Volatility, and SQL not required but is a plus **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- *The approximate annual base salary for this position in* ***Chicago, Illinois/Nationwide*** *is $100,000 to $150,000\. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package plus benefits, will be determined by a number of factors which include but are not limited to the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities; geographic location; and internal equity. In addition to your salary, our total rewards package includes health benefits, a 401(k) plan, PTO, parental leave, professional development, tuition reimbursement and discretionary bonus, enhancing your overall total rewards package.* Gelber offers a wide range of benefits to full\-time employees, including: * Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement program with discretionary employer match * Comprehensive health benefits including medical coverage provided by Blue Cross and Blue Shield (PPO and HDHP/HSA) and dental coverage; generous employer cost\-sharing * Tuition reimbursement for Undergraduate and Graduate courses * Flexible Spending Accounts for health care and dependent care; pre\-tax commuter benefits for parking and transit expenses * Life insurance and long\-term disability coverage * Health club membership with on\-site facilities (and reciprocal memberships) * Generous vacation time (23\-day accrual in first full calendar year of employment; prorated accrual in initial year), paid holidays, and paid maternity/paternity leave * Weekly catered lunches and monthly continental breakfasts (Chicago Headquarters Only) * Social events including sponsored 5k races and annual company party * Enjoyable work environment including golf simulator * Employee referral bonus program * Charitable giving and company matching opportunities * Casual, relaxed dress code *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read the Gelber Privacy Notice for California Employees and Applicants, linked* *here**.*

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Vehicle Quality Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description** **This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Warren Global Technical Center or Austin Technical Center three times per week, at minimum \[or other frequency dictated by the business if more than 3 days].** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **The Role** ------------ The Senior Data Scientist will develop and operationalize data science solutions that identify emerging vehicle, software, and product\-quality issues before they become larger customer or launch risks. This role partners closely with Product Quality, Warranty, Vehicle Engineering, software teams, and other subject matter experts to translate complex operational questions into trustworthy metrics, detection algorithms, dashboards, and alerting workflows. The successful candidate will combine strong statistical and analytical judgment with the ability to build production\-ready data products. They will work across the full lifecycle: understanding the customer problem, validating the data, developing and testing an analytical approach, deploying the solution, monitoring its performance, and continuously improving adoption and scalability. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Partner with subject matter experts to define meaningful metrics, analytical objectives, thresholds, and decision criteria. * Conduct comprehensive, unbiased analysis to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and emerging risks in vehicle, software, warranty, diagnostic, fleet, and product\-quality data. * Design, test, and deploy anomaly\-detection and pre\-emptive\-monitoring algorithms for customer\-impacting issues. * Build end\-to\-end analytical pipelines that transform raw data into reliable insights, dashboards, alerts, and operational workflows. * Create customer\-focused visualizations that allow engineering and quality teams to investigate fleet, VIN, and software\-version, * Develop alerting solutions that help internal customers respond quickly to high\-priority vehicle and product issues. * Establish validation approaches using historical data, controlled testing, domain expertise, and—when appropriate—real\-world observations. * Communicate findings, assumptions, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Improve solution performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency through model, query, pipeline, and architecture improvements. * Reduce complexity and redundant data handling by standardizing analytical processes and adopting modern Azure\-based technologies. * Support vehicle and software launches by delivering readiness insights and analytical tools. * Document analytical methods, data lineage, operating procedures, and known limitations so solutions can be maintained and adopted across teams. Contribute reusable patterns, best practices, and mentoring that increase the impact of the broader analytics organization. * **Expected Business Outcomes** ------------------------------ * Deliver committed critical analytics features for internal customers with clear acceptance criteria and production support plans. * Launch or improve pre\-emptive monitors that identify emerging vehicle, software, or product\-quality concerns earlier than traditional reactive processes. * Provide trusted dashboards and alerts that enable real\-time, data\-driven decisions for engineering, quality, warranty, and launch teams. * Improve the performance, scalability, usability, and cost profile of existing analytics products. * Demonstrate measurable customer value through reduced manual effort, faster issue investigation, improved launch readiness, or earlier risk mitigation. * Increase adoption by working directly with software domains and operational teams to understand how insights are used and where capabilities should expand. * Strengthen analytical governance through documented definitions, validation methods, data quality checks, and repeatable operating practices. * Selects appropriate analytical methods based on the business question, data limitations, and decision context. * Tests assumptions and validates results using sound statistical and domain\-informed practices. * Balances detection sensitivity, false positives, explainability, and operational usefulness. * Starts with how internal customers make decisions and designs the solution around that workflow. * Converts complex data into clear, actionable insights. * Builds trust through responsiveness, follow\-through, transparency, and data quality. * Owns outcomes across discovery, development, deployment, support, and improvement. * Troubleshoots issues quickly and follows assigned work through completion. * Designs solutions that are maintainable, scalable, secure,  nitoring. * Experience with modern deployment practices such as Git\-based workflows, CI/CD, or Databricks Asset Bundles. * Familiarity with data modeling, data lineage, reusable analytical patterns, and scalable solution design. * Experience evaluating whether AI/ML methods can improve detection quality while controlling false positives and operational burden. * Experience mentoring peers, sharing technical best practices, or leading work across organizational boundaries. This job may be eligible for relocation benefits. **Compensation:** * The expected base compensation for this role is: $125,000 \- $168,650\. Actual base compensation within the identified range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. * Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more. * GM DOES NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION\-RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE. DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU WILL NEED GM IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. THIS INCLUDES DIRECT COMPANY SPONSORSHIP, ENTRY OF GM AS THE IMMIGRATION EMPLOYER OF RECORD ON A GOVERNMENT FORM, AND ANY WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIRING A WRITTEN SUBMISSION OR OTHER IMMIGRATION SUPPORT FROM THE COMPANY (e.g., H\-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc.) \#LI\-CC1 \&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Benefits Overview** From day one, we're looking out for your well\-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting **Total Rewards resources** . **Non\-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers. All employment decisions are made on a non\-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role\-related assessment(s) and/or a pre\-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit **How we Hire** . **Accommodations** General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, **email** us or call us at 1\-800\-865\-7580\. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

We are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and leveraging technology to deliver smarter, faster, and more scalable solutions. As an AI\-forward organization, we encourage employees at every level to embrace emerging technologies, continuously expand their AI capabilities, and actively incorporate AI tools into their daily work to improve productivity, decision\-making, collaboration, and business outcomes. **Position Summary** The Construction Field Engineer serves as the primary liaison between engineering, construction contractors, permitting agencies, utility companies, and the management team, overseeing the construction, installation, and quality assurance of Gigapower's fiber optic network. This role resolves field design conflicts and coordinates engineering revisions to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with market standards.
