engineering, construction contractors, permitting agencies, utility companies, and the management team. * Oversee construction, installation, and quality assurance of the fiber optic network to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with market standards. * Resolve field design conflicts and coordinate engineering revisions as required. * Verify that construction work conforms to approved designs, specifications, and quality standards. * Coordinate with permitting agencies and utility companies to maintain construction readiness and remove field blockers. * Monitor contractor performance, production, and safety compliance in the field. * Document field conditions, design changes, and revisions to support accurate as\-built records. * Communicate project status, risks, and issues to management and drive timely resolution. * Leverage AI\-enabled tools and technology to improve reporting, field documentation, and decision\-making. **Qualifications** * Experience in fiber optic network construction, installation, or field engineering. * Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, designs, and specifications. * Working knowledge of construction quality assurance and inspection practices for fiber optic networks. * Experience coordinating with construction contractors, permitting agencies, and utility companies. * Ability to resolve field design conflicts and work with engineering on design revisions. * Knowledge of safety practices and compliance requirements for field construction. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across engineering, contractors, agencies, and management. * Valid driver license and ability to travel regularly to active construction sites. * Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted tools and technology to improve productivity, analysis, reporting, and operational efficiency. **Preferred Qualifications** * FTTH deployment experience. * Municipality and utility coordination experience. * Experience with GIS and as\-built workflows. * OSHA 10/30, traffic control, or related certifications. **Key Competencies** **Field Engineering Expertise:** Understands fiber optic network construction and installation practices and applies them in the field. **Stakeholder Liaison \& Coordination:** Builds alignment between engineering, contractors, permitting agencies, utilities, and management. **Design Conflict Resolution:** Resolves field design conflicts quickly and coordinates engineering revisions. **Quality Assurance:** Verifies work against designs and standards and drives right\-first\-time execution. **Safety \& Compliance:** Promotes safe work practices and compliance with market standards. **Problem Solving:** Resolves complex field issues and removes barriers to project success. **AI Adoption \& Applied Productivity:** Uses AI tools to enhance reporting, documentation, analysis, and project execution. **Execution \& Accountability:** Delivers projects on schedule, within budget, and to quality expectations. **EEO** Gigapower is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Gigapower is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants throughout the recruitment process. If you require assistance or accommodation, please notify a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

jobs.title: Product Designer, AI (0 to 1)
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Zero\-to\-One Product Design for AI\-Native Ventures** Gitwit is hiring Product Designer to lead the product experience for new AI companies, and to set the standard of design quality the whole studio builds to. You will decide what the product should be and design it to a level of finish that holds up in front of real users. This is a seat for a designer with strong product judgment. This is a senior seat, and the designers who thrive in it tend to share a few things:* **5\+ years in product design**, hands\-on and deep in the craft. * **Experience taking products from zero to one.** * **A portfolio of work you can share that showcases your experience.** Most of all, we're looking for someone whose craft and judgment make the people around them better. Gitwit is an AI\-first venture studio built to find problems worth solving, validate them rigorously, and build the companies that earn the right to exist. We are on pace to launch **15\+ ventures** in the next four years. For a designer, that means repeated chances to work on the most interesting part of company building: the first version. You are not maintaining one mature product for years. You are helping create new companies from the beginning, shaping the ambiguity, getting close to users, making the product calls, building the prototypes, launching, reading early signal, and handing off to a founding team. The pace only works if design can make the first clear product calls before everything is figured out. We need someone who can jump into a half\-formed venture, figure out what the product needs to become, and help the team learn before we overbuild. You come in as a design lead from day one. We launch around five companies a year, and one or two of them will be yours to lead across the year. You own the product experience from early concept through prototype, first launch, user learning, and iteration. You help set the quality standard here. The ventures you lead carry your fingerprints on how they look, how they behave, and how finished they feel the day they meet their first users. When a founding team inherits a product from you, they should inherit a clear design system, resolved states and edge cases, and specs an engineer can build from directly. You will work shoulder to shoulder with discovery, product strategy, engineering, brand, and venture leadership to shape the first version of the company and product. The vision is shared. The product experience\- how it works, how it feels, where it earns trust, and where it gets out of the user's way\- is yours to lead. Early on, the work is hands\-on: wireframing in a room, shaping feature plans, prototyping with AI, sitting with users, and pulling apart what they say, what they do, where they hesitate, and what they actually need. You are never tossing screens over a wall. You build next to an engineer in tight rotation, make product calls, test them quickly, and keep the distance between decision and working product short. After the initial product, you stay close to what happens next: what users understand, where they hesitate, what breaks down, and what the early signal suggests, and turn that learning into sharper decisions and better next versions. When the product has enough shape and the right founding team is ready to carry it forward, you make the handoff clean, then move to the next early product problem.### **What You’ll Do** * Set and hold the visual and interaction quality standard for the studio's products. * Lead zero\-to\-one product design for new AI products, from blank canvas through first launch and iteration. * Resolve the hard parts: the states, edge cases, and interaction details that make a product feel finished. * Design AI workflows where the product may not behave the same way twice, changing outputs, wrong or uncertain answers, human review, approval moments, fallback paths, and clear next steps. * Generate multiple design directions, weigh tradeoffs, make the call, and explain the reasoning clearly. * Prototype quickly to help the team learn what is real before overbuilding. * Translate user observation, research, and usage signals into product hypotheses, experiments, and design decisions. * Work tightly with product strategists, researchers, engineers, designers, and venture leaders to turn a promising idea into something real enough to test. * Bring discipline and meticulousness to how design gets built across the studio, so each product does not have to reinvent the basics from scratch. * Help the studio get smarter with each AI product by capturing what we learn about review, correction, approval, uncertainty, failure states, and user trust, and sharing it so each new venture starts sharper than the last. In your first few months, you will have:* Stepped into an active venture, understood the product direction quickly, and identified the first design moves that would reduce risk, test key assumptions, and help the team move faster. * Brough ommunication.** You bring engineers, strategists, researchers, and venture leaders into the thinking so decisions do not feel mysterious or disconnected. You should be the kind of designer who already has these instincts and finally wants a seat that lets you use them. This is not a clean\-lane design job. If you want polished requirements, a tidy backlog, long cycles, layers of review, and a roadmap handed down from somewhere else, this will feel uncomfortable. We move quickly, with incomplete information, high trust, and a lot of direct collaboration. And this is not a brand design role. You do not need to invent a full identity system from scratch. But because our ventures are new, you do need to care about how the whole company shows up: a deck, an early website, a prototype, or how the product gets explained when it helps the venture become real. The product experience is where our standards are highest.### **What We Offer** This role comes with the things strong designers should expect: competitive salary, strong benefits, and **meaningful equity in every venture the studio builds,** but the real offer is bigger than a comp package alone. You get a rare zero\-to\-one seat in an AI\-first venture studio built to launch multiple companies, not just maintain one. You get the intensity and authorship of early\-stage building, with the structural advantages of a studio: stronger validation, shared resources, repeated shots on goal, and the chance to help build multiple high\-impact ventures over time. Practically, that includes:* Competitive salary * Meaningful equity in every venture the studio builds * 8 weeks off per year: 5 weeks vacation \+ 3 weeks paid holidays * Excellent health, vision, and dental insurance, with 99% of employee premiums paid * 401(k) with 4% match * Life insurance * Paid parental leave * Cell phone reimbursement * Monthly parking stipend * Weekly team lunches * Dog\-friendly office * High\-trust, high\-autonomy culture * The chance to work on multiple high\-impact ventures each year * Your own private office, and collaborative workspaces in one of the coolest office buildings in Tulsa The package matters. But for the right person, the bigger offer is where you get to place your next years. This is a **full\-time role** built around real collaboration (with room for real life). This role is based in **Tulsa or Bentonville**. We're open to exceptional candidates who would relocate for the right opportunity, but this is not a remote role. We want designers who want to build closely with the team in the room, in the work, and in the real decisions that shape what gets built. That being said, we are very flexible with real life. Some days you might need to work from home, for when the plumber shows up, to step out for a kids' appointment, or just for a day of heads\-down building. What we can't flex on is the overall proximity and regular in\-person presence that keeps the studio engine running fast. Send us a link to your portfolio or website, along with your resume. **Then answer one question:** *Pick one project from your portfolio and tell us about a decision you'd make differently if you did it over, and why.* Keep it short and honest. We care more about how you think than how polished the answer sounds. Click "Apply Now" to dive in.### **About Gitwit** Gitwit is a venture studio that finds problems worth solving, validates them rigorously, and builds AI\-native companies from the ground up. We invest early, build cross\-functionally, and work to create ventures that earn real traction, not just good stories. A big part of that comes from working closely with design partners who give us deep access to real workflows, urgent pain points, and early market truth. That helps us find better opportunities and build ventures with stronger validation and traction, faster. We are on pace to launch **15\+ ventures in the next four years**. That is how we turn insight into products, and products into companies.

jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** Glean is seeking a highly analytical individual to sit within the Support Organization and focus on making our Support team more effective through metrics, AI‑powered tooling, and operational excellence. **You will:** * Metrics, Reporting \& Insights + Define, track, and continuously refine Support metrics, including ticket volume, TTR, CSAT, deflection, automation rate, containment, backlog health, and agent effort. + Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports in spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Sigma / Looker / Tableau) to give Support and CX leadership clear visibility into performance and trends. + Present insights and recommendations to Support and CX leadership on a regular cadence, highlighting risks, opportunities, and the impact of AI/automation initiatives. * AI Tooling, Agents \& Automation + Serve as the operational owner for AI‑powered support tools (e.g., Glean agents, internal copilots, routing/triage bots, macros with AI, deflection experiences), including configuration, monitoring, and continuous improvement. + Analyze agent and automation performance (resolution rate, handoff quality, mis‑routes, downvotes) and run structured experiments on prompts, workflows, and routing rules to improve outcomes. + Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to scope and launch new AI use cases for Support (e.g., intelligent routing, duplicate detection, auto‑tagging, SLA risk prediction, backlog forecasting). + Ensure AI/automation features are rolled out with clear guardrails, runbooks, and monitoring, and that human support workflows integrate smoothly with AI experiences. * Program \& Project Management + Lead special projects that materially improve Support productivity and customer experience (e.g., new queue designs, channel strategy updates, AI rollout pilots, process re‑designs). + Own work‑back plans, stakeholder alignment, risks, and communication for these initiatives, ensuring projects land on time and with clear success metrics. + Partner with CX Ops and cross‑functional stakeholders to design and run A/B tests and quasi‑experiments across macros, forms, flows, and AI experiences, quantifying impact on FRT, TTR, CSAT, deflection, and agent effort. * Process Design \& Knowledge + Analyze support workflows and ticket data to identify operational inefficiencies and recommend process improvements across tools, queues, and channels. + Document support processes, SOPs, and runbooks; maintain internal knowledge base and enablement content for Support tooling and AI features. + Partner with Support leadership to define SLIs/SLOs for Support operations and AI tools, with clear alerting and actionable runbooks when thresholds are breached. **About you:** * 5\+ years of experience in CX Operations, Revenue Operations, or related GTM operations roles, ideally in B2B SaaS. * Track record of building or materially improving CS systems and processes (health scoring, renewals forecasting, playbooks, segmentation) and demonstrating measurable impact on retention, expansion, or health. * Strong understanding of key post\-sales metrics and leading indicators * Experience operating in high‑growth or startup environments where you’ve had to build structure in ambiguity. * Curious: Eager to tackle process, workflow, and AI‑related challenges to improve team outcomes. * Customer‑driven: Motivated by improving both internal support processes and the end customer’s experience. * Systems thinker: You enjoy mapping how tools, data, and processes fit together and simplifying complexity for others. * Data‑driven experimenter: You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, running experiments, and measuring impact, especially around AI and automation. * Continuous learner: Always looking for opportunities to document, measure, and refine team practices as AI capabilities evolve. * Nice‑to‑Have Skills: + Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI platform (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Metabase, Tableau). + Prior experience designing or operating support automations and AI agents (e.g., Fin, Glean agents, Zendesk bots, workflow tools). + Experience driving change management in support organizations, including training, communications, and adoption measurement. + Working knowledge of SaaS products and/or cloud technologies. + Familiarity with knowledge base management and content creation. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $120,000 \- 175,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Your expertise will help drive the development of robust, reliable, and user\-friendly products by designing comprehensive test plans, executing rigorous testing procedures, and collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams. jobs.title: Quality Engineer, Bring Up/ EOL
jobs.description: **About Harbinger** Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger's best\-in\-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first\-of\-its\-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium\-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation. **Job Overview:** We are looking for a **Quality Engineer (Bring\-up / EOL)** to lead quality validation during vehicle commissioning, first\-time bring\-up, and final End\-of\-Line (EOL) testing operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that all vehicle subsystems—including high/low voltage power, powertrain, software, diagnostics, and functional safety systems—are seamlessly integrated, flashed, calibrated, and fully validated prior to customer delivery. This role involves collaborating with vehicle testing, manufacturing, embedded software, and product design teams to establish robust quality gates, troubleshoot complex system\-level integration issues, and drive continuous improvement. The Bring\-up / EOL Quality Engineer will act as a key liaison across cross\-functional commissioning and production teams. Responsibilities include defining EOL test standards, performing root cause analysis on vehicle bring\-up failures, establishing inspection and testing quality gates, managing test equipment buy\-offs, and driving corrective actions. A successful Bring\-up / EOL Quality Engineer should have excellent system\-level troubleshooting skills and be able to ensure that production testing processes and finished vehicles consistently meet performance and safety standards. ### **What You'll Do:** * Monitor vehicle bring\-up and End\-of\-Line (EOL) quality performance metrics, proactively identifying and escalating emerging high\-impact issues using diagnostic logs, test yield data, and defect trends for early resolution. * Drive timely root cause analysis and resolution for complex bring\-up failures, software flashing errors, calibration faults, and test aborts by engaging cross\-functional software, electrical, and manufacturing teams with a data\-driven approach. * Implement continuous improvement by feeding bring\-up and EOL test insights and failure modes back into upstream design, software release, and assembly processes. * Develop and track data\-driven metrics for EOL test cycle times, first\-time\-through (FTT) yield, test coverage, and corrective action effectiveness. * Create innovative tools, diagnostic scripts, and standardized processes to enhance bring\-up efficiency, test automation, and scalability across factory operations. * Continuously develop vehicle bring\-up quality protocols, EOL test specifications, dynamic testing routines (e.g., chassis dyno/rolling road, track testing), and quality control gates. * Oversee thorough testing and validation of complete vehicle systems (including software flashing, ECU calibration, CAN/LIN bus diagnostics, Hi\-Pot safety tests, ADAS/sensor calibration, and functional safety checks) to ensure compliance with specifications. * Support factory commissioning teams with the buy\-off and validation of EOL test equipment, diagnostic tools, automated test benches, and software flashing infrastructure. * Formulate effective corrective actions, solutions, and process enhancements for integration, software release, and testing\-related challenges on the production floor. * Participate in design and process reviews (DFMEA/PFMEA) alongside software, electrical, and manufacturing engineering teams to mitigate risks associated with vehicle commissioning and EOL testing routines. * Lead and instruct interdisciplinary efforts to conduct Root Cause analysis (8D, 5\-Why) for bring\-up non\-conformances, DTCs (Diagnostic Trouble Codes), and system integration bugs, ensuring timely containment and preventative solutions. * Lead MRB (Material Review Board) disposition for non\-conforming vehicles/sub\-assemblies at EOL and act as a quality representative within the engineering change control board for software and test procedure updates. ### **Who You Are:** * You are a hands\-on engineer who thrives in dynamic production environments and loves solving complex system\-level problems. You have a strong bias for action and continuous improvement. * You are energetic, passionate about vehicle quality, and driven to ensure zero\-defect delivery of high\-tech vehicles. * Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field. * 3 to 5 years of pertinent experience in vehicle bring\-up, End\-of\-Line (EOL) testing, commissioning, or manufacturing quality engineering within automotive, EV/e\-mobility, commercial vehicle, or aerospace industries. * Deep experience with vehicle diagnostic protocols (UDS, OBD\-II), CAN/CAN\-FD/LIN bus tools (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, PCAN), so d Quality Manager (CQM), Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or higher preferred. * Proficiency in ISO 9001:2018 or IATF 16949 standards highly desired. * Familiarity with fundamental quality core tools including Quality Management Systems, APQP, SPC, GR\&R, PPAP, FMEA (DFMEA/PFMEA), Control Plans, and Functional Safety (ISO 26262\) principles. * Strong analytical, system\-level troubleshooting, verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. * Excellent project management skills, capable of managing multiple commissioning and testing projects concurrently. * Solid understanding of EV powertrain integration, battery systems, vehicle control units (VCU), thermal management routines, chassis dynos, and factory test cell infrastructure. * Ability to travel up to 30% of the time. **Equal Opportunity** Harbinger is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Harbinger is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at info@harbingermotors.com. **Candidate Data Privacy** Harbinger may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes ("Candidate Personal Data"). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Harbinger may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Harbinger may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our HR, legal, and finance teams, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Harbinger affiliates; and (iii) Harbinger's service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Harbinger may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services. Any unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles submitted in response to our job posting shall be considered the property of Harbinger and are not subject to payment of referral or placement fees if any such candidate is later hired by Harbinger unless you have a signed written agreement in place with us which covers the applicable job posting.

jobs.title: Project Engineer - Roadway/CPM Schedule Review
jobs.description: **Project Engineer – Roadway / CPM Schedule Review** **Contract \| $110 per hour \| Las Vegas, Nevada / Hybrid or Remote Depending on Experience** Gypsum Resources is seeking an experienced **Project Engineer with substantial roadway and critical path scheduling experience** for a short\-term consulting assignment involving review of the development schedule for a large land\-development and infrastructure project in Clark County, Nevada. This is **not a traditional design\-production role** and is **not initially an expert\-witness position**. We are looking for a practicing or recently practicing engineer who can independently evaluate the project’s **Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule**, identify the activities actually controlling project completion, and assess whether engineering redesign, agency review, right\-of\-way, permitting, or other project activities affected the critical path. The assignment will involve review of project schedules, engineering milestones, agency and permitting timelines, and contemporaneous project records. The engineer should be comfortable working independently and reaching conclusions based on the project record, including conclusions that may differ from the expectations of the client. **Primary Responsibilities** * Review baseline and updated project schedules and identify the **critical path and near\-critical paths**. * Evaluate logic relationships, durations, constraints, float, sequencing, and schedule assumptions. * Determine whether the critical path changed over time and identify the events responsible for any change. * Assess whether roadway engineering, redesign, permitting, agency review, right\-of\-way, utility coordination, or other project activities caused actual critical\-path delay or merely consumed available float. * Evaluate potential **concurrent delays** and independent project constraints. * Review relevant engineering and project\-control records necessary to understand the schedule. * Identify missing information or schedule deficiencies that prevent reliable conclusions. * Prepare a concise written assessment and discuss conclusions with project management and outside counsel. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in **Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Construction Management, or closely related field**. * Significant professional experience with **roadway, highway, transportation, or major civil\-infrastructure projects**. * Direct experience developing, maintaining, or critically reviewing **CPM schedules**. * Strong understanding of: * + Critical path and float + Schedule logic and constraints + Baseline versus updated schedules + Delay and concurrency + Sequence changes and recovery schedules + Design, permitting, utility, and right\-of\-way dependencies * Experience with **Primavera P6** or comparable professional scheduling software. * Ability to read roadway plans, profiles, grading plans, and related civil\-engineering documents. * Ability to explain schedule conclusions clearly to non\-engineers. **Strongly Preferred** * Professional Engineer (**P.E.**) license. * 10\+ years of roadway or civil\-infrastructure experience. * Experience as a **Project Engineer, Project Manager, Resident Engineer, Project Controls Engineer, or Scheduler** on major roadway projects. * Experience with public\-agency review and permitting. * Experience evaluating schedule impacts associated with design changes, utility conflicts, right\-of\-way, environmental approvals, or agency delays. * Nevada or Southwest roadway experience is helpful but not required. **Nature of Assignment** This is an **independent consulting review**. We are specifically seeking someone with current or recent real\-world project experience rather than a career litigation expert. The initial assignment is to independently evaluate the project’s CPM schedule and determine what activities actually controlled completion. The engineer will **not be asked to reach a predetermined conclusion**. Depending on the quality of the analysis and the engineer’s interest, the assignment could expand, but there is **no requirement that the engineer serve as an expert witness**. **Compensation: $110 per hour, contract basis.** Interested candidates should submit a résumé describing specific **roadway projects** and **CPM scheduling experience**. Please identify the scheduling software used and briefly describe one or two projects where you personally evaluated critical path, float, or delay. I would add that last sentence about describing **specific roadway and CPM experience** because otherwise you will get a pile of general civil\-engineering résumés from people who have seen a schedule but never actually interrogated one. For LinkedIn, I would probably lead with a shorter hook: **We are looking for a roadway engineer who actually understands CPM—not a professional expert witness.** **Benefits** * Private Health Insurance * Paid Time Off

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description: **About Harper** ---------------- Harper is one runtime for any workload. We combine database, cache, application logic, real\-time messaging, and APIs into a single process, so enterprise teams can retire a stack of point solutions and serve data in about a millisecond. Brands like Macy's, Ralph Lauren, Verizon, HP, Ford and Bass Pro Shops run on Harper, and we sell and deliver alongside partners including Akamai. www.harper.fast (http://www.harper.fast) **The role** ============ You own retention and growth across a focused book of Harper's most strategic enterprise accounts, with revenue targets tied to renewals and expansion. Strong relationships on the customer side and inside Harper mean you're the first to know when something isn't going to plan, and your project management discipline gets it back on track. This is not a technical support role. Harper's engineers, forward\-deployed engineers, and partner support teams own the technical work. You orchestrate them: route each ask through the right process, bring in the right people before the customer has to ask, and make sure nothing falls between the customer, Harper, and our partners. You'll need enough product fluency to match Harper's capabilities to a customer's business needs and to recognize when an issue needs engineering. The best person for this seat has grown large, multi\-stakeholder enterprise accounts and has the renewal and expansion numbers to show for it. You're a highly organized operator who takes personal ownership of outcomes. You write a clear weekly update without being asked, you prepare a day ahead rather than an hour ahead, and you spot the next expansion opportunity before the customer's team does. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Own the account** * Be the single accountable owner for some of our most strategic enterprise accounts, from day\-to\-day status through renewal and expansion, partnering with Sales leadership on pricing and approvals. * Know each account cold and keep a written plan for it: history, champions, what was piloted and promised, open commitments, risks, renewal date, and expansion opportunities. * Keep a finger on the pulse of every live implementation. Track adoption and usage, and make sure customers get full value from Harper so it never becomes shelfware. * Stay relevant as customer priorities shift. Know their roadmap, connect Harper to their new initiatives, and advocate for what's right for their architecture. **Run the work like a project manager** * Run active customer initiatives (pilots, upgrades, migrations, rollouts) with a clear plan, owners, and dates, and track every open item to closure. When a follow\-up is owed, it goes out within one business day. * Flag risk early and loudly. If a deal, pilot, or deliverable is stalled on the customer, a partner, or Harper, you say so in the right channel and keep pushing until it moves. * Keep a steady operating rhythm: agendas sent ahead of every customer and internal sync, notes and action items sent the same day, and a Monday plan and Friday wrap\-up to the team each week. **Manage relationships across three sides** * Build multi\-threaded relationships with champions, executives, procurement, and project leads at each customer, and navigate reorgs and leadership changes so every account always has an active champion and executive sponsor. * Partner with our channel partners' account teams as true co\-owners. Keep them informed on scope, services, and billing, and build the relationship before you need it. * Coordinate commercial items such as professional services scopes, SOWs, and contracts, so work is never delivered without paper. **Orchestrate Harper's internal team** * Route technical questions through the established support and escalation paths, and bring the right Harper experts into customer conversations, brief them in advance, and own the follow\-up afterward. * Write customer\-facing documents (responses, recaps, QBR decks, and proposals) that are accurate, complete, and reviewed before they go out. * Bring customer feedback, references, and case studies back to Product and Marketing. **What you'll bring** --------------------- **Must\-haves** * 6\+ years managing enterprise accounts in B2B software with Fortune 500 customers, multiple stakeholders per account, and a track record of negotiating renewals and expansions against a quota. * Real project management experience: you have run customer rollouts, pilots, or implementations with plans, owners, dates and status reporting. * Experience working with or through channel partners, resellers, or alliance partners on shared accounts. * Excellent communication skills. Your recaps, updates, and customer documents are clear, accurate and ready to send. * You can connect a customer's goals to the right product capabilities and spot expansion opportunities from their technical roadmap. * Fluency with a CRM and a project tracker (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce, and Asana). * Experience at a startup or small team, where you built the process instead of waiting for one. **Nice\-to\-haves** * Experience with data infrastructure, CDN, cloud or developer platforms. * Accounts in retail, e\-commerce, media or telecom. * Experience scoping and contracting professional services or SOWs. * A PMP, CSM or similar project management credential. * Experience with Harper **This role is not for you if** ------------------------------- * You prefer hunting new logos over growing within existing customers. * You need a manager to remind you about follow\-ups or deadlines. * You would rather escalate a problem than own it. * You prefer a slower\-paced environment where the day\-to\-day is predictable. Here, priorities shift with customer needs, and you'll be juggling several accounts and initiatives at once. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * Base salary: $125,000–$145,000, depending on experience On\-target earnings: $250,000 at 100% of plan Commission: uncapped, with accelerators above quota * Equity, health benefits and a 401(k). * Fully remote, with occasional travel to customer sites and team meetups. **Interview process** * 30\-minute screen with People Operations. * 45\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. * 60\-minute working session: you get a mock account brief and present a 30\-day plan, a risk log and a customer follow\-up email. * 45\-minute panel with an engineer and a partner\-facing teammate. * 30\-minute conversation with Harper leadership. **What success looks like** --------------------------- By 90 days, every account you own has a current written plan, a known renewal path and no surprises. **Timeframe** **Outcome** 30 days Met every key stakeholder at each account and partner. Written history and stakeholder map for each account. Weekly Monday/Friday updates running. 60 days Account plan and open\-items tracker live for every account. Running the recurring customer syncs yourself. Every in\-flight services engagement has signed paper or a dated path to it. 90 days Leading at least one active customer initiative to its milestones. Partner account teams engaged on every shared account. One expansion opportunity qualified and in the pipeline. 12 months Renewals closed on time. Expansion bookings against the agreed target. At least one customer reference or case study delivered to Marketing. **How we'll measure it** * Gross and net revenue retention on your book * Expansion bookings against target * Follow\-ups and weekly updates sent on time * Risks flagged before they slip a date, not after * Feedback from the customer, partner reps and Harper engineering on how easy you are to work with

jobs.title: OT Technical Security Architect
jobs.description: OT Technical Security Architect – Contract – Remote – $90\.00 \- $100\.00/hr. The final salary or hourly wage, as applicable, paid to each candidate/applicant for this position is ultimately dependent on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s/applicant’s qualifications, skills, and level of experience as well as the geographical location of the position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship not available. Our client is seeking a OT Technical Security Architect in for a remote opportunity Role Description The OT Security Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing cybersecurity architectures that protect industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) environments, manufacturing systems, and other operational technology assets. This role serves as the technical authority for OT cybersecurity strategy, ensuring secure operations while maintaining the availability, integrity, and safety of critical industrial processes. The OT Security Architect collaborates with engineering, manufacturing, infrastructure, cybersecurity risk, and compliance teams to develop secure OT environments aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISA/IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and CISA guidance. OT Security Architecture \& Strategy * Develop and maintain the enterprise OT security architecture roadmap. * Design secure architectures for industrial control systems, SCADA networks, distributed control systems (DCS), and manufacturing environments. * Support development and ongoing updates of OT cybersecurity standards, patterns, and technical requirements. * Partner with (and in some instances lead) technical lead/teams to ensure the integration of security\-by\-design principles into OT projects and modernization initiatives. * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend security controls for industrial environments. Network \& Infrastructure Security * Design OT network segmentation, Purdue Model architectures, and secure remote access solutions. * Define requirements for firewalls, industrial DMZs, jump hosts, and network monitoring capabilities. * Review configurations and security controls across OT environments. * Partner with infrastructure and plant operations teams to secure industrial networks and connected assets. jobs.description: **ABOUT US** HirexHire (pronounced hire by hire) is a Chicago\-based recruiting and talent consultancy that integrates with companies short\-term to provide long\-term talent solutions. We take a seat in our client’s everyday operations to understand their people's goals, gaps, and challenges. We then develop and implement processes and technologies to execute a sustainable, scalable talent plan. We partner with companies expecting or experiencing high growth who need to hire at scale or fill a critical role rapidly. Our clients are not looking for quick\-fix placements but are thoughtfully building a hiring strategy to scale their businesses. **OUR CLIENT** **Location:** Remote **Industry:** Fleet Management Software/EV Infrastructure **Company** **Size:** 20\-50\+ What They Do: Our client is a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming how organizations manage electric and mixed\-vehicle fleets. Their platform centralizes fleet operations, bringing together vehicle tracking, charging optimization, maintenance workflows, and real\-time analytics into a single, easy\-to\-use system. Serving logistics providers, municipalities, and enterprise operators, our client enables teams to streamline operations, reduce costs, and accelerate their transition to sustainable transportation. With strong early traction and increasing market demand, they are scaling their team to support continued product innovation and go\-to\-market growth. **THE ROLE** The Systems Security Engineer will serve as the technical front door for our client's partner integrations, validating APIs, identifying feasibility gaps, and ensuring integration work is fully de\-risked before entering engineering. This role will work closely with Product, Engineering, external technology partners, and Tier II Support to validate API capabilities, troubleshoot integration issues, and translate technical findings into clear product and implementation requirements. The ideal candidate brings strong API and integration experience, a product\-minded approach, and the ability to confidently drive external partners toward resolution. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Own the technical relationship with integration partners, including technical calls, support channels, credentials, documentation, and partner\-side blockers. * Perform hands\-on API discovery and validation using tools such as Postman or curl, testing authentication, pagination, throttling, webhooks, error handling, and sandbox environments. * Confirm that partner APIs can support product requirements before integrations are committed to an engineering sprint, identifying gaps and proposing viable alternatives when needed. * Create integration briefs and working Postman collections documenting authentication, endpoints, field mappings, sample payloads, known behaviors, and outstanding questions. * Serve as the primary technical counterpart to Product for integration work, helping shape technically accurate requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and roadmap sequencing. * Support Engineering during implementation as the integration subject matter expert, answering technical questions and coordinating directly with partners when additional information or resolution is needed. * Partner with Tier II Support to reproduce and triage integration issues, determining whether problems are related to configuration, data, partner systems, or application code. * Maintain internal documentation and reusable integration knowledge across areas such as HRIS/payroll, TMS, telematics, LMS, and job boards. * Monitor partner API changes, deprecations, and undocumented behaviors and communicate potential impacts to Product and Engineering. * Own the integration discovery process to ensure each integration has validated authentication, confirmed capabilities, and the necessary technical documentation before development begins. **WHAT YOU WILL NEED** * 3\+ years of experience in integration engineering, solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical consulting, or a similar technical role. * Strong understanding of REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, GraphQL, webhooks, and authentication protocols such as OAuth2, SAML, or OIDC. * Hands\-on experience using Postman, curl, or similar tools to explore, test, and validate APIs. * Ability to read and understand code in Python, JavaScript, or a similar language, with production software development experience not required. * Strong troubleshooting and technical triage skills, with the ability to identify whether an issue originates from configuration, data, a partner system, or application code. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical findings into clear documentation and actionable recommendations. * Product\-minded approach with the ability to evaluate technical limitations in the context of customer needs and identify practical alternatives. * Confidence working directly with external technology partners, including vendors with incomplete, changing, or inconsistent API documentation. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple integrations, partner relationships, and technical priorities at once. * Experience with Python, transportation technology, HRIS/payroll, TMS, telematics, or other regulated\-industry integrations is a plus.

jobs.title: Information Security Solutions Engineer II
jobs.description: **Holman is a family\-owned, global automotive services organization anchored by our deeply rooted core values and principles that have enabled us to continue Driving What’s Right throughout the last century. Our teams deliver the Holman Experience by treating our customers and each other as we would like to be treated, and creating positive, rewarding relationships all around.** **The automotive markets Holman serves include fleet management and leasing; vehicle fabrication and upfitting; component manufacturing and productivity solutions; powertrain distribution and logistics services; commercial and personal insurance and risk management; and retail automotive sales as one of the largest privately owned dealership groups in the United States.** **Holman** is looking for a Security Engineer to work where cloud infrastructure and software development meet. You will review and design security architecture for our cloud environments, maintain our application security tooling, and work directly with development teams to threat model applications and find and fix vulnerabilities. You will also perform third\-party vendor security reviews, support our work with external penetration testing partners, help secure our growing use of AI, and take part in incident response as part of the broader security team. **Principal Purpose of Position** --------------------------------- ### **Security Engineering** * Review cloud security solutions and contribute to secure architecture designs for Azure and AWS environments, turning business requirements into practical security controls. * Provide security architecture guidance and design patterns to Infrastructure, Cloud, and Development teams. * Build, deploy, and maintain security infrastructure as code with Terraform, Terragrunt, ARM, and Bicep, so that controls stay consistent, version\-controlled, and repeatable. * Perform third\-party vendor security reviews: assess vendor architecture, controls, and risk, document findings, and recommend mitigations or acceptance criteria. * Contribute to the security architecture and operation of enterprise AI platforms, including MCP gateways, LLM routers, and AI gateways. This covers access control and tool permissions, prompt injection and data leakage risks, AI usage and cost governance (FinOps), and observability and logging of AI activity. * Keep documentation of security controls, configurations, architecture decisions, and procedures accurate and current. ### **Software Security** * Perform threat modeling with development teams on new and existing applications, and work with developers to understand vulnerabilities and architectural security issues, supporting remediation through to verified closure. * Support the IAM team on cloud and application identity security, including workload and managed identities, service principals, least\-privilege role design, secrets handling, and application authentication and authorization patterns. * Administer and maintain application and cloud security tooling, including cloud security posture, runtime application security, and API security testing platforms. This covers configuration, tuning, integrations, and keeping findings accurate. * Help integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows. * Work with third\-party penetration testing providers to support scoping, ongoing attack surface assessment, results triage, and remediation tracking. * Report vulnerability exposure, remediation status, and risk to application owners and management. ### **Incident Response \& General** * Participate in incident response activities, contributing cloud and application security expertise to investigation, containment, and remediation. * Lead specific initiatives or workstreams when delegated. * Share knowledge with peers and developers on secure design and coding practices. * Stay current on cloud and application threats, attack techniques, and security technologies, and recommend improvements to Holman's security posture. * Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. **Relevant Work Experience** ---------------------------- * 5–7 years of combined information security and technical engineering experience, with significant time in cloud security, application security, or both. * Strong experience securing Microsoft Azure and Amazon AWS environments in cloud\-native and hybrid architectures. * Hands\-on experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code with Terraform (Terragrunt a plus), ARM, and/or Bicep. * Ability to read and reason about application code in at least one of .NET, Python, Ruby, or Node.js, well enough to explain a vulnerability and its fix to a developer. * Strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE), and secure software development practices. * Working knowledge of cloud and application identity: Entra ID and AWS IAM, managed identities and service principals, d, or equivalent work experience. \#LI\-BS1 \#LI\-REMOTE **At Holman, we exist to provide rewarding careers and better lives for employees and their families. We hire, train, empower, and reward exceptional people. Our journey is guided by our desire to get it right every time and the acknowledgement that we have an opportunity to be better. To be better, we have to do better, and to do better we must know better. That’s why we are listening, open to learning new things – about ourselves and each other. Our time off benefits include Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, bereavement, and jury duty. In addition, we offer paid pregnancy and parental leave, and supplemental paid military leave to eligible employees. ### **Click here for Washington State benefit information.** *Temporary or Part\-Time* In geographic areas with statutory paid sick leave, part\-time and temporary employees will receive a paid sick leave benefit that meets the mandated requirements. ### **Click here for Washington State benefit information.** **Pay:** We offer competitive wages that are commensurate with job\-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, and geographic location, starting in the range of $105,050\.00 \- $149,700\.00 USD annually for full time employees. jobs.description: Posted Date 10/12/2026 Description At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. **Organization Overview:** At Eli Lilly and Company, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Lilly has led global healthcare for more than 140 years, and today we're growing faster than ever, expanding our portfolio, modalities and manufacturing footprint. To keep delivering medicines faster, with greater quality and efficiency, we're investing in the next generation of digital and AI capability that will change how we research, develop and make decisions. **Position Overview:** We're looking for a visionary executive to lead the next paradigm shift in pharmaceutical development: agentic AI. This is the shift from human\-executed workflows supported by software to autonomous, AI\-enabled development ecosystems, where scientists and engineers spend their time on creativity, judgment and strategy while intelligent agents handle routine knowledge work, analysis, documentation, planning and execution. This Associate Vice President will define and execute Lilly's vision for Agentic CMC Development: building a pan\-DDCS/PRD AI capability platform and deploying agentic solutions that transform how development work gets done across drug delivery, devices, combination products, synthetic molecule development, biologics, formulation sciences, process development, analytical sciences, quality, regulatory and the manufacturing interface. The long\-term goal is an Autonomous Development Platform: one that continuously learns from enterprise knowledge, experimental outcomes, development history, manufacturing performance, regulatory interactions and scientific literature, and increasingly executes development work on its own. This platform will enable: * Agent\-driven knowledge discovery and technical intelligence * Autonomous technical workflow orchestration * AI\-generated development strategies and experiment plans * Automated documentation and regulatory content generation * AI\-assisted design, optimization, change control planning and risk assessment * Digital experts and copilots embedded across development functions * Enterprise\-scale scientific knowledge management Agentic coordination between development, manufacturing, quality and regulatory functions * **Key Responsibilities:** This is a leadership role that builds and grows a dedicated agentic AI team, establishes the DDCS/PRD wide capability platform, and integrates it seamlessly into all processes of CMC development. As the functional technical leader, you partner with scientists, engineers and senior leaders across DDCS/PRD, Manufacturing, Discovery, Business Units, and corporate AI leadership to turn this vision into production reality. You'll serve as a CMC champion for agentic AI in development sciences, setting direction, building durable platform assets, and proving measurable gains in speed, quality and productivity across the CMC development lifecycle. ***1\. Set the Agentic AI Strategy and Roadmap*** * Serve as the single point of accountability for DDCS and pan PRD agentic AI strategy, setting a multi\-year vision, roadmap and technology strategy for autonomous development systems. * Define the future\-state operating model for an AI\-enabled development organization and prioritize the highest\-value opportunities for transformation. * Build the business case and champion narrative that win support from scientists, engineers and senior leaders, addressing both the opportunity and the risks of agentic AI openly and directly. * Track Lilly's growing portfolio of agentic AI initiatives and external pharma agentic AI moves, translating industry and competitive trends into roadmap decisions. ***2\. Expertise in full\-stack AI application design from prototype to production, agent\-based systems, autonomous workflows, multi\-agent architectures and AI\-driven process transformation, including standards such as Model Context Protocol and Agent\-to\-Agent. * **Additional Preferences:** * Experience building AI platforms that serve large, matrixed organizations. * Familiarity with regulated environments, GxP systems, quality systems and regulatory expectations, including 21 CFR Part 11\. * Knowledge of CMC development, pharmaceutical development, manufacturing sciences or medical device development. * Experience integrating AI with modeling and simulation, digital twins, laboratory systems and enterprise data platforms. * Strong external reputation within AI, digital transformation, scientific computing or pharmaceutical innovation communities. * Enterprise platform thinking: reusable architectures, standards and durable capability over one\-off pilots * People leadership: recruiting, building and growing a high\-performing, multidisciplinary technical team * Responsible AI: governance, compliance and model risk management in regulated environments * Clear, confident communication of AI capability and business value to diverse audiences Systems thinking across data, models, applications, workflows and people * **Other Information:** * Travel: 10–20% * Location: Indianapolis, IN; Lilly Technology Center – North (LTC\-N) Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. Sitting at the helm of our digital platform and software engineering teams, you will drive the architectural, solutioning and operational evolution of our core digital domains. jobs.title: Sort/Test Quality & Reliability Engineer (QRE)
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Embark with us on a journey of growth and transformation as we create exceptionally engineered technology and bring AI everywhere. As a valued team member, your adaptability and attention to detail will contribute to our drive for results and relentless pursuit of quality, ensuring we meet our customers' needs with precision. Join us and build on our legacy of innovation and collaboration as we deliver world‑changing technology that improves the life of every person on the planet. jobs.title: Senior Software Developer - Databases
jobs.description: **Company Description** Improving healthcare through innovative technology is at the core of Intelerad’s work. Our scalable medical imaging platform connects clinicians to a powerful imaging ecosystem that is fast, smart, and tapped into the data they need, no matter their location. We’re focused on delivering a best\-in\-class medical image management solution that improves provider efficiency, decreases the cost of healthcare, and improves the overall health of populations. Intelerad offers one of healthcare’s most comprehensive imaging and analytics platforms. Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 700 employees located in offices across six countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Asia/Oceania in the 2021 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report. To learn more, visit intelerad.com and follow Intelerad on LinkedIn and Twitter. **Job Description** **Role Overview** When radiologists receive the right study at the right time, patients get answers faster, and behind every worklist, search, and assignment is a database that has to respond quickly and correctly. As a Senior Software Developer focused on the data layer of our InteleOrchestrator team, you’ll modernize the SQL Server\-backed platform that streamlines radiology workflows for healthcare providers around the world. You’ll write the code that changes the database: refactoring schemas and queries, untangling legacy data\-access code, and moving it to type\-safe, well\-tested patterns while the system stays live for clinicians. This is a hands\-on software development role, not a database administration role; your time will be spent in code, query plans, and pull requests rather than in backups, patching, or server operations. Success in this role means faster, safer, and more maintainable data access that reduces clinical burden and gives time back to the clinicians who depend on it. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead complex database refactoring across a large, mature SQL Server schema, including restructuring tables, keys, and indexes, retiring legacy structures, and backfilling and normalizing data, delivered as safe, incremental, version\-controlled migrations (e.g., Liquibase) with no disruption to clinical users. * Diagnose and resolve performance problems at the source by reading execution plans, rewriting queries to be sargable and set\-based, replacing row\-by\-row processing with batched writes and properly indexed temp tables, and designing covering and filtered indexes based on real workload evidence. * Modernize the data\-access layer by migrating legacy and inline SQL in PHP and C\# code into type\-safe Kotlin and jOOQ repositories, preserving behavior through characterization, regression, and scale testing. * Harden data access for security and reliability by eliminating SQL injection through parameterization and automated checks, establishing consistent locking, isolation, and query\-timeout conventions, and building query attribution and diagnostics that trace database load back to the code responsible for it. * Build the tooling that makes database change routine, including migration and upgrade pipelines in Gradle and CI/CD, containerized SQL Server test environments, and automated checks that catch regressions before release. * Shape technical direction by defining SQL and data\-access standards, documenting conventions, and contributing to architecture decisions and the InteleOrchestrator technical roadmap. * Partner with and mentor fellow developers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance, helping application teams write efficient, safe database code and fostering a culture of continuous learning. **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 7\+ years of professional software development experience, including 4\+ years in which writing and refactoring database code (SQL, schemas, and data\-access layers) for production systems was a core part of the role. * Expert\-level T\-SQL on Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, temp tables, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, and set\-based design; PostgreSQL experience is also valued. * Proven track record of incrementally refactoring a large, legacy relational schema and the application code that depends on it while in production, not only greenfield database design. * Proficiency in Kotlin or Java, or an equivalent language, building backend services with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework. * Hands\-on experience with database migration and version\-control tools such as Liquibase or Flyway, treating schema as code within Git\-based CI/CD pipelines. * Strong understanding of concurrency, locking, isolation levels, and transactional integrity, and how they affect application behavior under load. * Solid grounding in secure data\-access practices, including SQL injection prevention and safe handling of sensitive patient data. * Experience delivering in agile teams using Gradle, Git, and modern DevOps practices across Windows and Linux environments. **Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements** * Experience with jOOQ or similar type\-safe SQL libraries and code generation from database schemas. * Experience reading, maintaining, and porting legacy application code in PHP and/or C\# (.NET). * Experience with database testing approaches such as Testcontainers or Docker\-based SQL Server environments, golden\-master or characterization tests, and load or scale testing of queries. * Familiarity with SQL Server diagnostic tooling (Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events) and observability platforms such as Datadog or New Relic. * Experience with AWS data services such as Amazon RDS for SQL Server. * Experience working with healthcare data standards such as HL7 and DICOM, or building software in other regulated industries (e.g., FDA\- or FAA\-regulated environments). * Location: This role is open to candidates based in the United States or Canada. *This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.* **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Applicants may be required to complete an online technical and/or personality assessment as part of your application. \#LI\-REMOTE The base pay for this position ranges from $100,000 to $140,000/yr USD within any geographic market in Canada. Pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits. Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. Intelerad uses the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”)as a standard for global recruiting and hiring purposes. This prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. The ADA defines “disability” as a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more of the major life activities of an individual, a record of such impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
jobs.description: **About Jitsu** Jitsu is a last\-mile delivery service that allows brands to give their customers a consistent delivery experience all the way to the doorstep. Using a proprietary AI\-powered technology platform, Jitsu helps its customers deliver on their promise of affordable, reliable, expedited shipping with a 99\+% on\-time delivery rate. Logistics teams can now provide a differentiated delivery experience at a competitive cost through successful first delivery attempts, fewer claims, coverage in the markets that matter, and upfront pricing with no hidden surcharges. Jitsu operates in urban areas across the U.S., enabling high\-volume shippers to exercise control over their end\-to\-end delivery network. Learn more at gojitsu.com **Role Overview** We're looking for a **Senior Mobile Engineer** to lead the design and architecture of **mission\-critical apps** our delivery fleet and operations teams rely on in the field and in our logistics facilities. Thousands of delivery partners and Jitsu staff use these apps at any given moment, and our operations run on them. That means **you'll own real solutions to real business problems**. You'll become a trusted member of a team that **cares deeply about quality and craft**, because we believe that's the best way to serve our clients, customers, partners, and teammates. AI is changing how software gets built week to week, and **we see that as an opportunity**. Together, we'll turn each new capability into better tools and better ways of working.**What You'll Do** ================== We're not hiring someone to close tickets. We're hiring someone to understand real operational problems and own the solutions, using whatever technology the problem calls for. * **Start with the problem.** Spend real time with the people who rely on our work: operations leaders, site leads, warehouse teams, and delivery partners. You'll do whatever it takes to deeply understand the problem and the people you're serving, which may include visiting warehouses, working a sort shift, or riding along on a delivery route. * **Own the solution, not just the code.** Take problems from discovery through design, delivery, and adoption, and stay with them until they're actually solved in the field. * **Build technology that holds up in the real world.** Our Flutter apps move millions of shipments a year, in warehouses and on the road. You'll make them work offline, scan fast, track location reliably, and ship releases our operations can count on. * **Work across the stack.** If the right solution needs a backend service, a data fix, new tooling, or a process change, you'll make sure it happens, building it yourself when needed, and also partnering with the broader engineering team. * **Shape how we build with AI.** Help us figure out what new AI capabilities mean for our tools, our workflow, and our craft, and turn the best ideas into everyday practice. * **Raise the bar for everyone.** Mentor teammates, set technical direction and quality standards for mobile, and make the engineers around you better. **What Matters Most** --------------------- We care more about how you solve problems than about any list of skills. The engineers who thrive here are the ones who see every unfamiliar problem as something they can figure out. We believe almost anything can be learned and accomplished if you ask the right questions and assemble the right context. We're looking for someone who: * **Owns solutions end to end.** You don't hand off a problem just because it's outside your area. You dig in and get it done instead of waiting for someone else. * **Uses AI to go beyond their specialty.** You can point to real work outside your core expertise that you shipped by working effectively with AI tools. * **Has good judgment about AI.** You know when its output is right, when it's subtly wrong, and how to give it the context it needs. * **Makes the people around them better.** You communicate clearly, explain your thinking to technical and non\-technical audiences, and people want you on their projects. **Permission to Play** ---------------------- These are the baseline for this senior role. They're necessary, but they're not what will set you apart: * 5\+ years building and shipping production iOS and Android apps, with deep Flutter expertise. * Solid mobile architecture skills: state management, modular structure, and patterns that keep a growing codebase maintainable. * Experience designing and consuming REST and gRPC APIs, and a working understanding of distributed systems. * A track record of performant, reliable features for a large user base, built alongside other engineers. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Native iOS or Android SDK experience (Swift or Kotlin). * Experience integrating on\-device or cloud AI/ML features into mobile apps. **Why Jitsu** ============= * Solve meaningful business problems that have a visible impact every single day * Be part of a well\-funded, fast\-growing company tackling complex and relevant challenges * Gain critical experience applying cutting\-edge AI technologies in a variety of settings * Competitive compensation and equity incentives * Health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Flexible time off * 100% remote **The pay range for this role is:** 125,000 \- 150,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))
