jobs.title: Vice President, Data Modernization — Data Readiness & Metadata Standards
jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** Data is at the heart of how JPMorganChase drives innovation and competitive advantage. Join a team that turns complex, high\-volume data into trusted assets that leaders can confidently use to make decisions and build new customer experiences. You will influence how data is defined, described, and governed—so it is easier to discover, interpret, and apply across analytics and artificial intelligence. This role offers meaningful visibility, cross\-functional partnership, and the opportunity to shape firmwide standards through tangible delivery and rapid prototyping. Job summary As a Vice President in the Data Modernization program within Consumer \& Community Banking Data \& Analytics, you will lead work that makes structured and unstructured data more discoverable, interpretable, and dependable. You will define practical metadata and data domain patterns—business, technical, and operational—that help teams find, understand, and trust data at scale. You will partner with data owners and engineers to identify quality and definition gaps, prioritize fixes, and convert one\-off improvements into scalable standards. You will translate technical progress into clear narratives and measurable outcomes that support roadmap decisions and executive updates. You will operate as a hands\-on standards leader: comfortable in detailed data conversations, credible with engineers, and effective with senior stakeholders. You will balance governance and speed—setting clear expectations while enabling teams to move faster through reusable patterns, scorecards, and prototypes. You will help create the conditions for high\-quality analytics, conversational querying, and generative AI experiences by improving the “readiness” of data upstream. Job responsibilities * Shape and drive adoption of the enterprise data readiness framework across Consumer \& Community Banking business units. * Define and champion standards for business, technical, and operational metadata so data is well\-defined, discoverable, and trustworthy at scale. * Establish semantic and context standards that improve the consistency, interpretability, and reuse of data across analytics and artificial intelligence systems. * Lead profiling of priority domains to surface definitional, lineage, and data\-quality gaps, and partner with data owners to close them. * Convert one\-off fixes into repeatable, scalable enrichment patterns and mentor others to apply them. * Advise data leaders and engineers on the quality and usability improvements that create the most value across large datasets. * Build and showcase prototypes that demonstrate improved data readiness for analytics and AI\-assisted use cases, including conversational and agentic experiences. * Own readiness scorecards and key performance indicators, translating progress into inputs for maturity assessments, roadmap decisions, and executive updates. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills * Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, scientific, or technical field (for example, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Economics), or equivalent practical experience. * Seven years of relevant experience in data science, data management, data governance, data quality, or analytics engineering, including setting standards and influencing across teams. * Deep knowledge of metadata management and data catalog tools, with emphasis on discoverability, lineage, and interpretability. * Hands\-on experience with structured and unstructured data at scale, including profiling, cleansing, standardizing, and documenting large datasets on enterprise platforms or data products. * Strong command of data quality frameworks and the ability to diagnose, measure, and drive remediation of quality issues. * Understanding of ontology and semantic/context layers, and how consistent definitions improve reuse across analytics and artificial intelligence systems. * Solid Structured Query Language (SQL) skills and analytical problem\-solving, including root\-cause investigation across large data volumes. * A first\-principles mindset that questions assumptions and ensures data makes sense in context, not just in aggregate. * Working knowledge of how conversational analytics, natural\-language querying, and agentic AI consume data, and the data conditions they depend on. * Strong attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to accuracy. * Proven experience collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams in a regulated environment, with clear written and verbal communication for senior stakeholders. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills * Experience in consumer banking or another large\-scale, high\-volume data environment. * Exposure to building or governing semantic models and metrics layers for enterprise analytics. * Familiarity with data domain modeling and standardization across multiple business units. * Scripting or full\-stack skills (for example, Python) that support data profiling, enrichment, and rapid prototyping. * Applied exposure to artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI concepts from the perspective of a consumer of well\-governed data. **ABOUT US** Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs. We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: James Hardie is the industry leader in exterior home and outdoor living solutions, with a portfolio that includes fiber cement, fiber gypsum, composite and PVC decking and railing products. Our family of trusted brands includes Hardie®, TimberTech®, AZEK® Exteriors, Versatex®, fermacell®, and StruXure®. With over 8,000 employees and our U.S. operating entities headquartered in Chicago, we boast 31 operating sites, 6 recycling facilities, and 6 research and development centers globally. Powered by a dynamic workforce, we’re united by our purpose of Building a Better Future for All™ through sustainable innovation, a Zero Harm culture, and a commitment to empowering our people and communities. For more information, visit www.jameshardie.com. **Summary** ----------- The Product Engineer translates product requirements, industry standards and building\-code evaluation criteria into practical, defensible testing strategies. This role combines standards interpretation, mechanical design, hands\-on fabrication including 3D printing, engineering calculations and statistical analysis to develop reliable test methods and purpose\-built test equipment for current and future products. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable studying technical standards, creating a 3D model (SolidWorks), building and instrumenting a test fixture, analyzing the resulting data, and presenting a clear technical argument for the recommended test plan. The position will also help develop nonstandard or adapted test protocols when established methods do not fully address the product or performance question, with the goal of producing repeatable methods that may support future internal specifications, acceptance criteria or consensus standards. The Product Engineer will report to the Codes \& Compliance Manager, Outdoor Living Solutions, at the Wilmington Innovation Center. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- Key Responsibilities * Interpret ASTM, ANSI, ICC\-ES acceptance criteria, building\-code provisions, agency requirements and other technical standards to define test intent, specimen configuration, conditioning, instrumentation, loading, acceptance criteria and reporting requirements. * Perform engineering calculations supporting test design and product evaluation, including statics, mechanics of materials, adjustment load factors, stress, strain, deflection, section properties, fastener behavior, tolerances and uncertainty as applicable. * Prepare, submit, and maintain compliance documentation (e.g., ESRs, CCRRs, technical files, and supporting packages) on specific projects. * Partner with R\&D, Quality, Operations, Applications, Marketing, external consultants and third\-party laboratories to align testing and certification activities with business objectives. * Develop adapted, improvised or novel test protocols when published standards do not adequately address the product, application or failure mode. * Coordinate with external laboratories and agencies (Intertek, QAI, ICC‑ES, CCMC, etc.) to define test programs, review results, and manage certifications. * Other duties as assigned. **What You’ll Bring:** ---------------------- Education \& Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. * 3\+ years of relevant experience in product engineering, mechanical design, laboratory testing, test engineering, product development or a related role * Hands\-on fabrication including 3D modeling and printing * Strong mathematical and engineering\-calculation skills with the ability to document assumptions, formulas, units and conclusions. * Proficiency in statistical analysis and data visualization using Excel, Minitab, or comparable analytical tools. * Working knowledge of ASTM standards, ICC\-ES acceptance criteria, IBC, IRC, ANSI requirements or certification/listing agency processes. (Canadian Codes a plus), and related compliance pathways. Other Skills * Experience testing building products, polymer composites, PVC, fiber cement, metals, fasteners, decking, railing, cladding or related construction products. * Hands\-on experience operating and maintaining laboratory test equipment, including universal test machines, instrumentation, data acquisition systems, environmental conditioning equipment, and calibration/verification systems; capable of designing, fabricating, and modifying test fixtures using rapid prototyping or additive manufacturing methods. * Provide technical support to sales, marketing, field service, quality assurance, production, and contract manufacturers. * Effective communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation) across all organizational levels. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix environment. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and project management systems (e.g., Excel, Smartsheet, MS Project). * Leverages AI\-enabled tools and digital technologies to enhance productivity, improve work quality, accelerate learning, and support data\-driven decision making. * Strong interpersonal skills, able to build relationships internally and externally. * Ability to travel an average of approx. 20% **What You’ll Receive:** ------------------------ As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this position is $75k to $90k. Placement in the range depends on several factors such as experience, skills, geography and internal equity and may change over time. This position qualifies for benefits and you will be eligible to participate in a bonus plan. At James Hardie, we recognize that our success depends on our people. We've worked hard to build a generous and competitive benefits program that demonstrates our commitment to our employees. * Compensation: competitive salary and bonus eligibility * Insurance: health coverage medical, dental, vision, life insurance * Paid Time Off: vacation and company holidays * Retirement: 401(k) with match * Work\-Life Balance: parental leave, wellness programs * Purpose. Impact. jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Engineer, Embedded Software
jobs.description: **About Knightscope** Knightscope (NASDAQ: KSCP) is a security technology company building the nation's first Autonomous Security Force — autonomous machines, AI\-driven software, and elite security professionals operating as one integrated managed service. The Company is on a mission to make the United States of America the safest country in the world. One Team. One Force. **The Role** We are looking for a hands\-on engineer to write the software that tests, calibrates, and releases every K7 vehicle that comes off our production line. This is primarily a software development role: you will design and write the test framework, station software, and embedded interfaces yourself, rather than configuring or maintaining an off\-the\-shelf test system. The software will talk directly to K7 embedded hardware: controllers, sensors, and onboard compute. It will verify each subsystem, calibrate sensors, load and check firmware and software images, and enforce the factory gates that keep a unit from shipping until it passes. **Location \- Sunnyvale, CA \- Onsite** **Starting Point** You will build the K7 end\-of\-line test software from the ground up: defining what gets tested and how, learning the hardware and firmware in detail, and designing the framework and station software yourself. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, autonomy, and manufacturing teams, and with the technicians who run the stations. We use modern tools, including AI assistants, as part of everyday development. **What You Will Do** * **Develop the test software:** Design and write the EOL test framework and station software from the ground up, including test sequencing, hardware drivers, logging, and pass/fail limits. * **Work with embedded systems:** Communicate with vehicle controllers and onboard compute over standard interfaces (e.g., CAN, Ethernet, serial); write low\-level tools and utilities to exercise and verify embedded hardware and firmware. * **Build factory software gates:** Flash firmware and software images, verify versions and configuration, and enforce pass/fail criteria so every unit is released in a known, approved state. * **Develop sensor calibration:** Implement calibration routines for vehicle sensors such as cameras, LiDAR, and IMUs, including target setup, algorithms, and acceptance limits. * **Create traceability:** Log serial numbers, calibration data, and test results to a central database, and build reports on yield, failure modes, and station performance. * **Build operator tools:** Create simple, reliable station interfaces that production technicians can run with minimal training. * **Support the line:** Debug test failures on the floor down to the hardware, firmware, or software level, and work with the owning teams on root cause. * **Maintain the codebase:** Use version control, code review, and automated testing; write test specifications and work instructions. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical, Robotics, or Controls Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of software development for hardware test, manufacturing test, or embedded systems on vehicles, robots, or complex electromechanical products. * Track record of designing and writing test software or tooling from scratch, not only maintaining existing systems. * Strong Python for test automation and tooling; solid C or C\+\+ for embedded and hardware\-facing code. * Hands\-on embedded experience: microcontrollers and/or embedded Linux, firmware flashing and bootloaders, and debugging with tools such as JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes. * Working knowledge of hardware interfaces and protocols such as CAN/CAN\-FD, Ethernet, USB, UART, SPI, and I2C. * Experience controlling test instruments programmatically (e.g., via SCPI). * Ability to read electrical schematics and wiring diagrams. * Software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, and automated testing. * Effective, everyday use of AI assistants (e.g., Claude) for coding, debugging, and research: writes clear, well\-scoped prompts, breaks problems into steps, and critically checks AI output before it reaches production or hardware. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience calibrating cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, or other sensors in a production environment. * Experience with automotive diagnostics (UDS, OBD) and end\-of\-line flashing. * Experience with RTOS\-based firmware or Linux device drivers. * Background in autonomous vehicles, mobile robotics, EVs, or automotive Tier\-1 suppliers. * Experience with ROS/ROS 2, test frameworks (e.g., pytest, OpenHTF), MES, or test databases. **What Success Looks Like** * **Test coverage:** Automated EOL tests and software release gates that the production team relies on for every unit. * **Calibration and traceability:** reliable sensor calibration, with every unit traceable by serial number to its test and calibration records. * **Continuous improvement:** A documented, measurable EOL process with tracked yield and cycle time, and a clear feedback loop into engineering. **Compensation and Benefits** * **Base Salary:** $150,000 \- $185,000 * **Equity:** Stock options * **Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off * **Location Requirement:** Full\-time, on\-site at Sunnyvale HQ

jobs.title: Vice President, Power & Infrastructure
jobs.description: Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last\-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo. Power has become the binding constraint on industrial and digital\-infrastructure value. Most owners treat it as a utility problem — Link is making it an in\-house capability that competitors can't easily replicate, and a new source of value for our customers and investors. As **Vice President, Power \& Infrastructure**, you will own the technical engine of that capability: Link's Industrial Power Program and on\-site generation engineering. You will build and lead a dedicated in\-house power engineering team — beginning with two Power Engineering Directors and scaling as the program matures — and stand up the standards, data, and repeatable processes that let Link say “yes” to high\-power opportunities, protect the portfolio from obsolescence, and transact faster. The mandate spans five connected areas: power and utility data acquisition, utility power audits, utility power upgrades, on\-site generation strategy, and power demand metering. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN:** Power \& Utility Data Acquisition * Build and maintain the portfolio's power data foundation — capacity, demand, and service\-level attributes — as the single source of truth for Leasing, Investments, Development, and Capital Markets. * Establish direct utility bill and interval\-data feeds through aggregators (e.g., UtilityAPI, Arcadia) and manage the LOA\-driven data pipeline. * Define and govern power data standards and benchmarks (W/SF by automation tier) and partner with Technology to operationalize power attributes in PIM. * Turn raw field and utility data into decision\-ready benchmarking, obsolescence\-risk scoring, and site prioritization. Utility Power Audits * Own the enterprise field\-audit program end to end — framework, standards, execution, and QA — producing verified, service\-connection\-level data and one\-line diagrams across the portfolio. * Prioritize audits by risk, starting with large, high\-power sites carrying near\-term lease roll and scaling toward full portfolio coverage. * Transition from third\-party engineering vendors to an internal team — retaining IP, quality control, and turnaround — while selectively using vendors for surge capacity. * Validate audit output for ingestion into the power data platform. Utility Power Upgrades (Tactical Intervention) * Lead the “Path to Power” upgrade program — advanced engineering assessments, ROM cost and schedule, and utility coordination for sites that fall below market power benchmarks. * Serve as the technical resource, and where needed the lead, for local field teams pursuing speculative or deal\-driven power upgrades. * Establish and manage regional electrical\-contractor relationships (MSAs) to compress lead times and standardize execution. * Partner with Leasing, Construction, and Market Officers on design options, capital\-recovery mechanisms, and deal structures. On\-Site Generation Strategy * Develop Link's on\-site generation (OSG) / behind\-the\-meter strategy — first as an enablement lever where utility capacity is insufficient, and over time as a potential infrastructure return stream. * Build and maintain the BTM solution toolkit — technology options, vendor RFIs, cost structures, lead times, and PPA / ownership structures. * Lead return / risk modeling for OSG deployments in coordination with Investments \& Underwriting. * Translate OSG capability into a repeatable commercial and technical playbook for constrained sites. Power Demand Metering * Stand up and scale Link's demand\-metering program to capture true customer demand and load profiles — moving from pilot to portfolio. * Evaluate and deploy the right mix of metering approaches (utility interval data, clip\-on submeters, pulse\-portal meters) against scope, scalability, and risk. * Use demand data to detect obsolescence risk early, refine benchmarks, and inform capital allocation. TEAM LEADERSHIP \& PLATFORM BUILDING * Recruit, onboard, and lead a dedicated in\-house power engineering team, beginning with two Power Engineering Directors, and scale the organization as the program matures. * Establish clear ownership, standards, and repeatable processes so the platform scales without re\-litigating priorities on every deal. * Manage the mix of internal and third\-party engineering resources to balan ransactions. FIRST\-YEAR PRIORITIES * Complete high\-priority field audits and initiate tactical interventions on the highest\-risk sites. * Hire and onboard the initial engineering team (two Directors) and establish the internal operating model. * Operationalize verified power attributes in PIM and stand up ongoing data governance. * Launch and evaluate the demand\-metering pilot and deliver an OSG execution\-strategy recommendation. * Complete the initial power\-education campaign across transaction and leadership teams. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 12\+ years in power / electrical engineering, utility interconnection, energy, or infrastructure delivery, including several years in a leadership capacity. * Deep expertise in electrical distribution systems — utility service, transformers, service and distribution capacity, amperage / voltage, and power service upgrades. * Demonstrated experience scoping and managing utility upgrades and coordinating with utilities and electrical contractors. * Experience building and leading teams and managing third\-party engineering vendors. * Strong data and benchmarking fluency; able to turn technical findings into commercial recommendations for senior audiences. * Excellent cross\-functional communication; able to translate engineering complexity for leasing, investment, and executive stakeholders. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * On\-site generation / behind\-the\-meter experience (solar, storage, natural gas, fuel cells) and familiarity with PPA and capital\-recovery structures. * Experience in industrial real estate, logistics, data centers, or other asset\-intensive, power\-sensitive environments. * Experience standing up demand\-metering / submetering programs. * Familiarity with utility data platforms and property / asset data systems. **HOW YOU WORK:** * Bias to action in a fast\-moving, still\-forming platform; comfortable building the plane while flying it. * Sound judgment and adaptability — audit and upgrade conditions vary widely across the portfolio. * A builder's mindset: creates scalable standards, processes, and teams, not one\-off fixes. * Outcome\-oriented — every workstream ties to a measurable transaction or portfolio result. $210,000 \- $250,000 represents the presently anticipated base compensation pay range for this position at Link. Actual pay may vary based on various factors, including but not limited to location and experience. Link provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off. As a critical member of our product engineering team, you will own and improve Localize's technical infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling, including monitoring, alerting, and maintenance. You will partner closely with leadership and fellow product engineers to translate business priorities and customer needs into execution, remove obstacles, and make thoughtful tradeoffs that keep the team moving forward. Like every product engineer at Localize, you are expected to be customer\-obsessed and business\-aligned: connect technical decisions to customer trust, product quality, and business outcomes. This role reports directly to the Engineering Manager. **Key Responsibilities:** * Oversee and manage Localize's infrastructure across AWS and Cloudflare. * Ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and security of Localize's data stores, specifically Redis and MongoDB, through effective configuration, monitoring, query optimization, and backup management. * Own and improve deployment \~\~process.\~\~and release processes, emphasizing automation, repeatability, safe rollouts, and reliable rollback procedures. * Partner with product engineers to improve the full SDLC, including development environments, CI/CD, automated quality and security checks, and release readiness. Treat this work as a core engineering responsibility alongside product delivery. * Take a leading role in infrastructure security and SOC 2 Type II compliance, partnering with engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders to operate and improve technical controls, maintain audit\-ready evidence, support audits, and remediate findings. Responsibilities include access management, vulnerability management, change management, logging, and backup and recovery controls. * Help lead incident response and blameless post\-incident reviews, translating lessons into improvements that protect customers and reduce recurring operational risk. * Prioritize infrastructure and SDLC improvements based on customer impact, business priorities, and risk. Communicate tradeoffs clearly and assess results through reliability, delivery speed, security, and cost\-efficiency. * Own and improve monitoring of uptime and performance using tools such as Datadog, Clickhouse, HyperDX, and more * Identify, plan and implement improvements and optimizations for infrastructure regarding cost, reliability, scalability. * Develop and maintain detailed documentation and maps of our infrastructure and dependencies. * Actively learn new technologies and systems to improve the efficiency and capabilities of our infrastructure. Technologies *Experience with the specific technologies below is a plus unless listed under Must\-Have Skills. Security and compliance, including support for SOC 2 Type II, are core responsibilities of this role—not optional areas of involvement.* * AWS: Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, Cloudfront, EC2, Elasticache, Route 53, VPS * Platforms: Kubernetes, AWS Beanstalk, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions * Languages: Terragrunt, OpenTofu, Terraform * Monitoring: Clickhouse, Datadog, HyperDX, Grafana * Security \& Compliance: SOC2 Type II * Cloudflare DNS, Workers, Zero Trust (WARP) * Business Intelligence: Stitch, Metabase, Snowflake * Application Technology: MongoDB (Atlas \+ Cloud Manager), Typescript, React **Must\-Have Skills:** * 5\+ years engineering experience. At least 4 years of experience in a Devops role. * Expertise in managing and optimizing infrastructure in AWS. * Redis and MongoDB, including configuration, monitoring, optimization, and management of backups. * Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools OpenTofu and Terragrunt * Experience with manual or automated deployment \& release management. * Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and tools. * Hands\-on experience securing production infrastructure, including least\-privilege access controls, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and security monitoring. * Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable engineering practices, maintain evidence of control operation, and support SOC 2 Type II audit readiness and remediation. * Experience partnering with product engineers to improve the SDLC and balance feature delivery with reliability, security, and developer productivity. * A customer\-obsessed, business\-aligned approach: understand how infrastructure decisions affect customers, prioritize work by impact, and explain technical tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Skills in assessing and optimizing performance of infrastructure and applications for improved performance, reliability, scalability, and cost\-efficiency. * Proficiency in command line scripting * Disaster Recovery Planning including data integrity and availability in case of emergencies. * Experience with APM and logging tools such as DataDog, New Relic, Sentry, or Kibana. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills or Experience:** * Product Engineering languages and frameworks such as Typescript, React, Mongoose, LESS, and more * Applied LLM engineering: + Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs into production systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar) + Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, and token management + Experience designing or implementing RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search + Familiarity with emerging LLM infrastructure patterns and protocols (e.g., MCP, tool/function calling, agents) * Working in a fast\-paced environment where you're accountable for your work and you're passionate in working with customers **Benefits \& Perks:** You'll be joining a close knit and talented team, with plenty of opportunity for professional growth. We offer compensation \+ benefits that are on par with large companies, while also placing a high value on maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. * Competitive salary * 401(k) plan \+ 4% matching * 100% company\-paid health, dental, and vision insurance * Company\-paid life insurance and AD\&D insurance * Work anywhere in North America (we are 100% remote) * New Macbook (or computer of your choice) * Monthly stipend for home internet costs * Generous PTO package **About Localize:** The Localize platform is used by 700\+ companies to automate the translation of their web and mobile applications and bring their products \& services to new markets at record speed. We support organizations like The Bay Area Toll Authority (https://www.bayareatollpaymentplan.org/s/) in translating their payments website, Baptist Health (https://www.baptistjax.com/) in making their healthcare site multilingual, and the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education (https://www.doe.mass.edu/) in offering their content in several languages. To see our product in action, click any of those links and use the website's language switcher to switch from English to another language. Localize works by providing a code snippet (similar to the Google Analytics JavaScript snippet) that our customers add to their website/web app. The Localize snippet pulls in content from the page into the Localize dashboard where our customers log in to add translations and manage their content. Localize automatically deploys those translations to the customer's production site, reducing development costs and accelerating time to market. We are a team of \~30 people working fully remote. We offer competitive pay, a full benefits package, and a culture with an emphasis on work \+ life balance. **To apply:** Along with your resume, send us a cover letter that showcases your personality and tells us why we should hire you. Previous experience working in a remote position is a must. *This position is only open to applicants who reside in and are eligible to work in the US.*

jobs.title: Data Engineer Sr - Level 3
jobs.description: **Standard Job Description** ---------------------------- You will be a Data Engineer Senior \- Level 3\. **What You Will Be Doing** In this position, you will deliver full\-stack data solutions across the entire data processing pipeline. You will rely on systems engineering principles to design and implement solutions that span the data lifecycle to: collect, ingest, process, store, persist, access, and deliver data at scale and at speed. You will hold knowledge of local, distributed, and cloud\-based technologies; data virtualization and smart caching; and all security and authentication mechanisms required to protect the data. **Key Responsibilities** Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following: * Building data pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate unorganized data into databases or data sources that are ready for analysis * Designing and implementing data solutions by defining functional capabilities, security, back\-up, and recovery specifications * Working through all stages of a data solution lifecycle, e.g., analyze / profile data, create conceptual, logical and physical data model designs, architect and design ETL, reporting and analytics * Maintaining data systems performance by identifying and resolving production and application development problems * Calculating optimum values for parameters; evaluating, integrating, and installing new releases * Defining standards, best practices, and certification processes for data objects **What’s In It For You** From onsite to remote, we offer flexible work schedules to comprehensive benefits investing in your future and security, Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here. Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus \- if you have the passion and courage to dream big, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you. **Further Information About This Opportunity** **This position is in Fort Worth, TX** **Discover Fort Worth****.** **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Experience with SAP HANA, Oracle, or SQL Server (i.e. relational database principles, SQL, SQLScript, PL/SQL, Transact\-SQL in support of Procedures, Functions, and Views) * Experience with Tableau, IBM Cognos, or other data visualization tools * Experience with data mining and cleansing, recognizing and correcting errors/discrepancies and ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness of data, and/or ETL data warehousing principles * Experience with problem\-solving and troubleshooting/resolving complex technical issues. **Desired Skills** ------------------ * Background in creating data solutions for Data Analytic products and services at scale and speed * Experience working with internal and external customers to develop and improve program deliverables, processes, and solutions that solve customer needs * Experience in coordinating changes to existing data products with minimal disruption to end\-user * In depth knowledge of GOLD, SAP (ERP), and/or PRIDE data systems * Background/working knowledge in multiple languages such as Python, Microsoft (VBA), SQL, or others and their various applications and use cases * Relational database principles and strong SQL * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $85300\.00 \- $158300\.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well\-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. **Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10\), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability. * Annual short\-term and/or long\-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. * For (Washington state applicants only) Non\-represented full\-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6\.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.description: Responsible AI Senior Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time Job No. R00363318 \| Multiple Locations **We Are:** Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 790,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, and we believe that scaling AI responsibly is what makes it durable. Technology is at the core of change today, and we combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data, and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise, and global delivery capability. Our Responsible AI capability, within our broader AI \& Data practice, sits at the intersection of deep industry knowledge, applied AI engineering, and trusted AI governance. We help the world's leading organizations build and run production\-grade AI and agentic systems that are safe, fair, transparent, and compliant by design, not by afterthought. We are not looking for generalists who advise on AI risk in the abstract. We need a practitioner who has built, shipped, and run AI systems at scale, who understands exactly where the technical, ethical, and operational risks live, and who can engineer the guardrails directly into the architecture and the delivery model, across both onshore and offshore teams. **You Are:** You are a Responsible AI Senior Manager who makes trustworthy AI real by building it, not just reviewing it. You bring that credibility because you are, at your core, a deeply technical AI and Data delivery leader: you have designed and shipped production AI, agentic AI, and data science solutions yourself, and you have led large, distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations to do the same at scale. You are equally comfortable in a model architecture review, an agentic workflow design session, and a governance committee, and you use that technical fluency to embed fairness, transparency, safety, and compliance directly into how systems are designed, built, tested, and operated. You set the technical and ethical standard for how generative and agentic AI gets built, secured, and run, and you lead the engineering, data science, and delivery teams who build it. **The Work:** * **Embed Responsible AI across the lifecycle —** define and operationalize Responsible AI standards, including fairness and bias testing, explainability, model and data governance, privacy, safety evaluations, and human oversight, and build these controls directly into engineering and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines rather than bolting them on after the fact. * **Own AI risk and governance —** serve as the senior technical authority on responsible use of generative and agentic AI, running model risk assessments, red\-teaming and safety evaluations, and advising clients and internal leadership on regulatory, ethical, and reputational AI risk. * **Lead large\-scale, global delivery teams responsibly —** manage and mentor large onshore and offshore AI, data science, and engineering teams delivering production\-grade AI and agentic AI solutions, owning staffing, technical direction, quality, and delivery outcomes across geographies and time zones, with Responsible AI checkpoints built into every stage of delivery. * **Architect and build production AI and agentic systems with guardrails in place —** personally guide the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise AI, agentic AI, and data science platforms spanning multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others) and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, Google), ensuring solutions are production\-grade, scalable, maintainable, and governed. * **Set technical standards and reference architectures grounded in Responsible AI —** define reference architectures and technical standards for LLMOps, agentic AI orchestration, data science workflows, security, reliability, and cost governance across the AI estate, and hold engineering teams accountable to them. * **Drive cost and security governance —** establish FinOps\-for\-AI cost optimization practices and embed AI security and governance controls into platform design and delivery. * **Shape responsible AI solutions and grow the business —** partner with clients and pursuit teams to shape solutions, architectures, and delivery models for major AI and Responsible AI programs, and contribute to Accenture sales and proposal efforts when needed. * **Build organizational capability in Responsible AI —** develop playbooks, training, and governance frameworks that raise the Responsible AI and technical delivery maturity of teams across the practice, and continue to deepen your own expertise in AI engineering, agentic AI, data science, and Responsible AI. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer: Back-end
jobs.description: **About LogicGate** LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real\-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best\-in\-class platform. **The GRC Market** Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104\.5 billion by 2031\. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale. **Senior Software Engineer: Platform** ====================================== **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Software Engineer: Platform, you will design and scale the foundational APIs and backend services powering LogicGate's Risk Cloud platform. As enterprise GRC demands expand, you will tackle critical system bottlenecks, optimize cloud data stores, and ensure high\-availability multi\-tenant reliability. Working in Java/Kotlin, Spring Boot, and AWS, you will solve complex architectural challenges while elevating technical standards across the engineering chapter. In this role, your technical leadership will directly ensure our platform remains scalable, resilient, and performant. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **System \& Data Architecture:** Design and build high\-throughput backend services, core platform APIs, and distributed data stores using Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ to expand multi\-tenant Risk Cloud capabilities. * **Quality \& Continuous Delivery:** Write robust unit, integration, and service\-level tests while partnering with DevOps to evolve cloud infrastructure and automated CI/CD pipelines (AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitLab CI). * **Observability \& Optimization:** Monitor operational metrics, tracing, and alerts in Datadog to proactively diagnose system bottlenecks, optimize database query performance, and ensure platform health. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Facilitate technical design reviews, decompose complex epics alongside Product and Design teams, and mentor engineers across squads to elevate code quality and execution. * **AI Workflow Efficiency:** Leverage AI coding assistants, LLMs, and modern developer automation tools to streamline engineering workflows, refactor legacy patterns, and accelerate feature delivery velocity. **What You Bring** ------------------ ### ***Required:*** * **Backend Expertise:** 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience developing enterprise backend systems using Java, Kotlin, or comparable JVM languages with Spring Boot. * **Distributed \& Cloud Systems:** Proven track record of designing, deploying, and maintaining high\-scale distributed systems and RESTful APIs in an AWS cloud\-native environment. * **Data \& Storage Proficiency:** Strong hands\-on experience with relational or non\-relational databases, caching mechanisms, and asynchronous message brokers (e.g., PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ). * **Testing \& Quality First:** Deep commitment to modern testing practices across the testing pyramid, treating test automation as an essential component of shipping software. * **AI Literacy \& Agentic Tooling:** Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience leveraging modern AI coding tools, LLMs, or AI agents (e.g., custom developer tools, agentic workflows, or automated assistants) to enhance problem\-solving, code quality, and engineering velocity. * **Distributed Work \& Team Engagement**: Thrives in a remote, highly collaborative engineering culture with willingness to attend occasional department onsites and company events. ### ***Nice to Have:*** * **LogicGate Tech Stack:** Direct hands\-on experience with LogicGate's tech stack: Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, Terraform, and GitLab CI. * **Architecture Knowledge:** Familiarity with graph database modeling, event\-driven architectures, or multi\-tenant SaaS application design. * **Full\-Stack \& SDLC Leadership:** Brings a holistic perspective to the software development life cycle \- combining deep backend expertise with a desire to work across the stack, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and apply infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) best practices. The anticipated base salary range for the role is $125,000 \- $165,000 per year \+ variable \+ equity \+ benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested. **How We Work** At LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high\-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers. Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported. **Global Total Rewards** We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK: * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region. * **Time Away:** Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best. * **Growth \& Development:** Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms. *Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain's Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.*

administration guides. * Interface with internal and external customers. * Coordinate with field personnel and/or engineering team to discuss any potential installation issues. * Document and provide jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are reimagining how people buy and navigate healthcare. More than 80% of Americans receive health insurance through an employer or purchase coverage through individual and Medicare exchanges. Yet the experience remains overpriced, opaque, and inefficient. We replace the traditional brokerage with an AI\-native platform built to streamline this process while helping people choose plans, find care, schedule appointments, call insurance, and fight bills. Our goal is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how healthcare is bought and managed across America. **Why Join Us** =============== * **Scaling quickly:** We are growing quickly and looking for zero\-to\-one builders who want an outsized opportunity to learn and shape the company’s future. * **High impact:** Healthcare costs are rising at record rates, while the user journey has never been worse. Join us as we rebuild an industry. * **Best\-in\-class talent:** Work alongside teammates from leading tech companies including Uber, Faire, Airbnb, Rippling, Google, Forward, and Collective Health, as well as brokerage industry leaders including Newfront, WTW, Marsh, and Sequoia. Our team works together in person in San Francisco. * **Well funded:** Seed\-stage startup well funded by top VC's **About the Role** ================== Our product depends on bringing together data that has never previously lived in one system: insurance plans and networks, provider and pricing data, employer and member information, claims and medical records, and the activity generated across our own products and operations. We are looking for our first Data Engineer to build the foundation that makes this information reliable and usable across the company. This person will own the systems that ingest data from APIs, files, vendors, customer systems, public sources, and legacy portals; model it into durable representations; and make it available to our products, AI agents, operators, and business systems. This is a hands\-on role with broad ownership across the data stack. You will make early architectural decisions, build the first versions yourself, and determine where rigor matters immediately and where simple systems can evolve. You will also help define how we use AI in data engineering to acquire, interpret, reconcile, and operate data more effectively. The right candidate has strong data engineering judgment, enjoys building from zero, and is excited to work with messy healthcare data where accuracy matters. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build our data foundation:** Own the systems that move, transform, organize, and serve data across the company, including the data warehouse (e.g. Databricks), ingestion and export infrastructure, orchestration and scheduling (e.g. Airflow or Dagster), transformation and modeling tools (e.g. dbt), semantic layers, data catalogs, quality, and observability. * **Unify fragmented healthcare data:** Ingest and connect data from paid vendors, carriers, providers, government sources such as CMS, customer and benefits administration systems, public files, APIs, legacy portals, and our own applications. Build durable workflows for large files, changing schemas, incomplete records, and sources that were never designed to work together. * **Make the data trustworthy:** Design canonical models for plans, networks, providers, employers, members, claims, and other core concepts. Preserve historical state, lineage, provenance, and source\-specific nuance so our products, agents, operators, and customers can rely on the results. * **Put data into production:** Make curated data available wherever it creates value, including our backend, member and employer experiences, AI agents, brokerage workflows, CRM, reporting, and other operational tools. Build reliable systems for moving data both into and out of the warehouse. * **Use AI to improve data engineering:** Apply models and agents to acquire information from portals and older websites, interpret unfamiliar files, map changing schemas, reconcile conflicting sources, investigate quality issues, and automate work that has traditionally been manual. * **Set the roadmap and standards:** Work across product, engineering, brokerage, and operations to identify the highest\-leverage data capabilities, prioritize the roadmap, and decide where we need durable infrastructure now and where a simpler solution can evolve. **Who You Are** =============== * **AI\-native:** You think from first principles about how models and agents can change data engineering, from acquiring data in legacy systems to interpreting files, mapping schemas, and investigating failures. You know when to use AI, when deterministic systems are safer, and how to build the evaluations and review loops needed for trustworthy results. * **End\-to\-end data engineer:** You have built and operated production data systems across ingestion, warehousing, orchestration, modeling, quality, and serving. You are hands\-on in SQL and Python and comfortable choosing and owning the surrounding tools. * **Comfortable starting from zero:** You can turn broad goals into a clear sequence of work and take responsibility from initial design through reliable production operation. * **Comfortable with messy data:** You have worked with data from external organizations, not only clean application events. You understand temporal modeling, idempotency, schema evolution, lineage, provenance, and how to establish trust when sources are incomplete or contradictory. * **Practical architect:** You can make important technical decisions without overbuilding. You know which choices will be difficult to reverse, where correctness is essential from the beginning, and where a simple first version is appropriate. * **Operationally minded:** You think beyond dashboards and analytical queries. You are comfortable designing data systems that directly support applications, automated workflows, customer\-facing experiences, and business operations. * **Able to work across disciplines:** You enjoy working with engineers, operators, and industry experts to turn complicated real\-world concepts into clear models, interfaces, and systems.

APIs. * Ability to lead engineering teams while remaining hands\-on with development. **Desirable Skills** * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. * Familiarity with application security jobs.description: As a Data Center Customer Deployment Engineer, you will oversee tenant fit\-outs and customer installations throughout a designated group of colocation facilities. This position centers on white space engineering with a heavy emphasis on electrical power. capacity and determining optimal redistribution strategies. * Assist in the execution of equipment additions, moves, and changes within operational data halls. * Create and evaluate floor layouts, rack elevations, cabinet placements, and cage designs. * Manage the installation and adjustment of cold and hot aisle containment systems. * Provide support for cross\-connects, pathways, cabling, and light fiber requirements. * Foster collaboration between vendors, construction teams, facility operations, and internal engineering departments. * Maintain project schedules and documentation while balancing multiple deployments across various sites to ensure client satisfaction. * Guarantee that all installations adhere to customer specifications and facility redundancy standards. * Facilitate the project turnover process, including testing and final customer sign\-off. **Essential Qualifications*** Proven background in mission\-critical, colocation, white space, or data center infrastructure. * Deep technical proficiency in electrical power distribution within data hall environments. * Hands\-on experience with the processes of weeding, stripping, grooming, and balancing power. * Comprehensive knowledge of load management, electrical capacity, redundancy, breakers, circuits, and rack power. * Demonstrated success in supporting deployment projects or customer tenant fit\-outs. * Capability to handle diverse project scopes, from single\-cabinet tasks to complex, multi\-site initiatives. * Practical familiarity with A and B side power configurations, branch circuits, busways, RPPs, and PDUs. * Ability to interpret construction drawings, rack elevations, floor plans, and electrical one\-line diagrams. * Strong communication skills to effectively document projects and coordinate with customers. * Commitment to maintaining safety and operational integrity within sensitive, active data center spaces. * Willingness to travel as needed, typically around one week per month, to support regional requirements. **Desired Skills*** Foundational mechanical knowledge regarding equipment heat loads, airflow, and cooling. * Experience working with hot and cold aisle containment solutions. * Familiarity with fiber pathways, structured cabling, and cross\-connect standards. * Proficiency in design software such as Revit or AutoCAD. * Ability to multitask by coordinating deployments across several data center locations at once. * Understanding of deployment turnover, quality assurance, and commissioning workflows. * Relevant certifications such as CDCP, RCDD, ATD, DCDC, PE, or EIT are considered a plus.

technology maturation plans that advance concepts from exploration through proof\-of\-concept, feasibility assessment, technology validation, and roadmap readiness. * Generate technical insights and recommendations that inform technology roadmaps, innovation investments, future product strategies, and potential intellectual property opportunities. **Provide Deep Technical Contribution Across Product Development** * Work directly with engineering and product team ntor and subject matter expert, helping elevate organizational capability in food systems, thermal management, modeling and simulation, experimental methods, and technology development. **Strong Foundation in:** * Thermodynamics, heat transfer, thermal management, and food\-equipment interaction * Food systems engineering, food texture, rheology, and product quality analysis * Modeling, simulation, mechanical design, prototyping, and instrumentation * Experimental design, DOE, and data\-driven problem solving **Skills and Experience We’re Looking For** * Experience developing commercial food equipment, collaborating with QSR R\&D teams, or advancing foodservice technologies in innovation\-focused environments. * equipment interaction. * Experience exploring, incubating, and maturing new technologies from concept through proof\-of\-concept and technical feasibility validation. * Deep expertise in food systems, jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Senior Software Engineer Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. Overview The Mastercard Open Finance Connect team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape the future of financial connectivity and consumer experiences through consistent innovation and problem\-solving. We are seeking an exceptional, hands\-on engineer with advanced expertise in React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, API engineering, and cloud\-native development. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with intellectual curiosity, customer focus, and practical AI fluency. You will build scalable experiences and backend platforms, use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor responsibly, and explore AI\-powered applications, agents, and agentic workflows while maintaining high standards for architecture, security, testing, reliability, and code quality. Role * Design, develop, and operate scalable customer\-facing applications and backend services using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Build secure, reusable, commercial\-grade REST APIs and integrations used by internal teams, financial institutions, data providers, and external partners. * Design microservices, distributed systems, and event\-driven solutions with strong availability, performance, observability, and operational readiness. * Own features and services end to end, including design, estimation, development, testing, deployment, documentation, production support, and continuous improvement. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, code reviews, and technical exploration without compromising engineering judgment. * Design and build AI\-powered capabilities, intelligent automation, agents, and agentic workflows that address meaningful customer and engineering needs. * Lead technical and architecture discussions, conduct high\-quality code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote reusable frameworks, standards, and engineering best practices. All About You The ideal candidate for this position should: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent practical software development experience. * Extensive experience in software engineering. * Demonstrate advanced full\-stack expertise in React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with a strong understanding of component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and modern testing practices. * Have deep experience designing and developing scalable backend services and REST APIs using Node.js and frameworks such as Express.js or NestJS, including API contracts, versioning, lifecycle management, gateways, caching, and asynchronous integration patterns. * Understand application security, authentication, and authorization, including OAuth2, JWT, OWASP secure coding practices, data protection, and vulnerability management. * Be experienced with microservices, distributed and event\-driven architectures, relational or NoSQL databases, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud platforms, monitoring, logging, and observability. * Use AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor effectively and responsibly for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and documentation, while validating outputs for security, quality, and maintainability. * Be an exceptional problem\-solver and systems thinker who takes ownership, communicates clearly, collaborates across Product, UX, QA, and Engineering, and consistently delivers production\-quality outcomes. Desirable Capabilities * Experience building AI\-powered applications, agents, agentic workflows, or LLM integrations using platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or Gemini. * Knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, model context protocols, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Redis, GraphQL, Next.js, or similar tools used in scalable platforms. * Experience in FinTech, Open Banking, payments, or another regulated industry. Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.**Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro\-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best\-in\-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on\-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on\-site fitness facilities in some locations. THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 01/05/2027\. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible. **Pay Ranges** Salt Lake City, Utah: $115,000 \- $184,000 USD

jobs.title: Lead AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **Lead AI Enablement Engineer** Position Summary We are seeking a **Lead AI Enablement Engineer** to drive the adoption and evolution of AI\-assisted engineering practices across product engineering teams. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role within the Platform team, partnering closely with the Platform Lead to improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency through practical AI enablement. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep, hands\-on experience using AI coding tools, LLMs, and agent\-based workflows. You will establish reusable AI\-first development practices, integrate AI workflows into the software delivery lifecycle, and build the foundations for validated, sandboxed, and orchestrated agent execution. You will also help shape reusable AI patterns for customer\-facing product capabilities and internal employee tools, balancing innovation with security, governance, reliability, and measurable engineering outcomes. Key Responsibilities AI\-First Engineering Enablement * Establish and scale AI\-assisted workflows across the software development lifecycle, including planning, coding, debugging, testing, design, documentation, code reviews, and production investigation. * Develop reusable agent instructions, prompts, skills, repository context, integrations, and reference implementations that engineering teams can adopt directly. * Evaluate emerging AI coding tools, LLM platforms, and agent frameworks to identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and software delivery. * Help teams transition from ad hoc, locally executed AI usage toward structured, repeatable, and validated AI\-assisted workflows. Platform Integration and Agent Orchestration * Partner with the Platform Lead to integrate AI workflows with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, development sandboxes, observability, release readiness, and developer productivity tooling. * Develop patterns for orchestrating multiple AI agents and parallel workflows, with appropriate human oversight and validation. * Build integrations with developer tools, repositories, APIs, and internal systems to provide AI agents with relevant context and controlled access to resources. * Contribute to the evolution of sandbox\-based agent execution environments that support safe, reliable, and scalable engineering workflows. Quality, Validation, and Governance * Design validation loops that ensure AI\-generated code and other outputs meet engineering standards through automated tests, code reviews, security checks, and release controls. * Establish evaluation methods and quality signals to assess the accuracy, reliability, usefulness, and consistency of AI\-assisted workflows. * Apply sound engineering judgment to security, privacy, access control, auditability, operational risk, and AI usage costs. * Collaborate with engineering and platform stakeholders to ensure AI adoption improves outcomes without compromising production reliability or software quality. Product and Internal AI Capabilities * Define reusable architectural patterns for AI\-powered product features and internal employee capabilities. * Support the development of AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, knowledge agents, workflow automation, and tool\-enabled applications. * Establish shared patterns for agent integrations, context management, permissions, governance, and reusable AI components. * Partner with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities to embed AI into existing workflows and customer\-facing capabilities. Developer Enablement and Continuous Improvement * Drive adoption through hands\-on demonstrations, pairing sessions, workshops, documentation, examples, and engineering office hours. * Coach engineers on effective AI\-assisted development practices, agent orchestration, and output validation. * Measure the impact of AI enablement using adoption, productivity, delivery speed, software quality, developer experience, and cost metrics. * Continuously refine workflows based on engineering feedback, evaluation results, and measurable business outcomes. Required Qualifications * **7\+ years of software engineering experience preferred**, with consideration for strong senior\-level candidates who demonstrate exceptional hands\-on AI engineering and enablement capabilities. * Significant practical experience using AI tools for real\-world software engineering, including AI coding assistants, agentic development workflows, and LLM\-powered developer tools. * Hands\-on experience with tools such as Claude Code, Warp, or comparable AI coding and engineering platforms. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application development, testing, code review, debugging, and production support. * Experience building reusable developer workflows, integrations, automation, agent instructions, prompt patterns, skills, or reference implementations. * Working knowledg  software quality, review confidence, and developer experience. * Improve the relevance and reliability of AI\-generated outputs through better repository context, business rules, engineering standards, and validation. * Enable engineers to orchestrate AI\-driven workflows with clear testing, review, security, and release\-readiness controls. * Build a strong technical foundation for sandbox\-based execution and parallel agentic development. * Establish reusable, governed patterns for AI assistants, retrieval, automation, and internal and customer\-facing AI capabilities. * Demonstrate tangible value through adoption, quality, productivity, delivery, and cost metrics. Work Model and Location We are based in the New York metropolitan area and hire across the **U.S. East Coast**, with working hours aligned to New York time. We value in\-person collaboration while recognizing the importance of flexibility and where our employees choose to live. * **Hybrid:** Candidates located near the New York metropolitan area are expected to work from the office two to three days per week. * **Remote\-friendly:** Candidates located farther away on the U.S. East Coast can work primarily remotely, with in\-person visits approximately four to six times per year. * **Onboarding:** Regardless of location, additional in\-person collaboration is expected during the initial onboarding period. This role offers the opportunity to shape how AI transforms software engineering practices across product teams while building practical, scalable solutions that deliver measurable results. **WHY JOIN US** Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast‑growing technology services and consulting company with **over 17,000 employees worldwide**. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market. We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors. With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning **Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security**—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio. At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success. Matrix’s success is built on a **challenging and engaging work environment**, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together. Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization. **To learn more, visit:** www.matrix\-ifs.com EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: Matrix is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind. Matrix is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Matrix are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in our locations. This technical leadership role elevates developer productivity and operational excellence across the organization. The Lead Application Platform Engineer operates as a technical leader — not a manager — bringing depth, influence, and mentorship. This engineer sets the patterns and standards the platform team builds on, serves as the escalation point for production issues, and is the technical voice engineering leaders consult before major commitments. The role combines deep expertise in application architecture, platform engineering, and distributed systems with the ability to mentor and influence other engineers. lead technical response to major incidents alongside SRE. * Set the technical standard for the platform team: define the bar for review approach, testing depth, instrumentation baseline, and what 'operationally ready' means in practice. * Mentor two to four Application Platform Engineers, including onboarding new hires into unfamiliar product domains and codebases; grow the technical capabilities of the team. * Represent platform constraints and capabilities in architecture discussions with engineering leadership; carry group constraints back into Release Engineering and SRE roadmaps. * Drive structural fixes after major incidents; manage and prioritize remediation across multiple teams. **About You** * 9\+ years in software, platform, or reliability engineering with deep hands\-on coding experience that is still current. * Demonstrated ownership of architecture patterns adopted by teams outside your own. * Experience operating high\-traffic distributed systems in production; leadership inincident response and post\-incident structural work. * Track record of raising the technical bar of a team through mentoring and standard\- setting. * Expert\-level proficiency in Go (Golang), Python, and Node.js/TypeScript;
