jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Meeru AI** Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — \*\*SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises\*\* — across \*\*AWS, Azure, and GCP\*\*. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. **The Role** We are looking for a \*\*Staff AI Engineer\*\* to own the AI and intelligence layer — and the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data. You own the machine\-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural\-language output, and the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You build per\-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect, and you set a high bar for evaluation and grounding across the layer. This is a senior, hands\-on role. You set technical direction for the AI layer, partner closely with the evaluation engineer to make quality measurable, and turn user feedback into durable improvements. **What makes this role different** * Grounding is a hard requirement no fabricated or unsupported output, ever. Faithfulness is a gate, not a tuning goal * Clear separation of concerns ML surfaces and prioritizes; generated text only states what is supported by verified data or confirmed by a human * Per\-customer intelligence models that learn each business's behavior, with strict anti\-leakage discipline * Deploys in customer clouds including managed LLMs in\-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment **Requirements** * **Staff\-level applied ML/AI experience in production.** You have shipped and owned real ML and AI systems used by customers, and you have set technical direction for others, not only built prototypes. * **Strong classical machine learning.** Hands\-on depth in time\-series modeling, anomaly and outlier detection, and gradient\-boosted models such as LightGBM or XGBoost, using Python, scikit\-learn and pandas or Polars. * **Modern LLM and agent patterns.** You have built retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool\-using agents, and structured (schema\-validated) output, and orchestrated them with LangGraph or a similar framework. * **Rigor on evaluation, grounding and hallucination control.** You know how to measure whether an LLM's output is faithful to its source data, and you have built guardrails that stop unsupported statements from reaching users. * **Discipline around data leakage and honest evaluation.** You design features, splits and validation so models are never trained or scored on information they would not have in real use. * **Clear thinking about what ML can and cannot claim.** You can explain to non\-ML colleagues where a model's output is evidence and where it is only a signal, and why that line matters when results sit next to reported financials. * **Real software engineering.** You write tested, production\-grade Python services, are comfortable with SQL against warehouses like Snowflake or PostgreSQL, and have shipped containerized software. * **Technical leadership.** You mentor engineers and work closely with backend, data, product and evaluation colleagues to turn feedback into lasting improvements. Nice\-to\-haves* **Finance or accounting domain experience.** Familiarity with ERP, billing or FP\&A data and the audit expectations around it. * **Feature\-attribution literacy.** Experience with tools like SHAP, and a clear view of where attribution explanations break down. * **Human\-in\-the\-loop systems.** You have designed review, confirmation or correction workflows and fed them back into models. * **Managed LLMs inside customer clouds.** Experience running AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI inside a customer's VPC so their data never leaves their environment. * **Sparse and zero\-inflated data.** Experience modeling rare events or data that is mostly zeros. * **Multi\-deployment enterprise software.** Exposure to products shipped as multi\-tenant SaaS, single\-tenant SaaS and on\-premises across AWS, Azure and GCP.

Uses advanced experience gained on scientific/technical issues to guide others to address non routine and/or difficult issues. * Develops a process and product development plan. jobs.title: Principal AI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Overview** Are you a customer\-obsessed, AI\-curious engineering leader who thrives in an inclusive, collaborative global team? The Azure Engineering Operations (EngOps) team's mission is to transform Microsoft Cloud customers into fans. Through our deep engineering engagements with customers and teams across Microsoft, we analyze and amplify customer needs and drive the vision to improve Cloud quality, security, and reliability. Our culture of growth mindset and empowerment are central to who we are and how we work. Our ACES engineering team is building domain specific agents and services that are fundamentally transforming Azure customer support — from reactive, human\-only workflows to AI\-first systems that resolve customer issues at Azure scale. We are seeking a Principal Applied AI Engineering Manager to build and lead a high\-performing AI engineering pod focused on shipping production agentic AI services. You will own the engineering execution for next\-generation AI agents — LLM orchestration, multi\-agent coordination, RAG\-based systems, and evaluation frameworks — that handle thousands of customer cases per month and drive measurable volume reduction across Azure. This is a leadership role building production AI services that directly impact millions of Azure customers. You will build the team, set the technical direction, own the delivery, and be accountable for engineering outcomes. Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help Azure EngOps provide our customers with the world\-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** Key Responsibilities * Build and lead the AI engineering pod — Hire, coach, and develop a team of Applied AI Engineers; foster an inclusive, high\-trust culture where engineers ship production AI services with ownership and velocity. * Own engineering execution for agentic AI services — Drive the end\-to\-end lifecycle of production AI agents from spec to deployment, including LLM orchestration, multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and evaluation systems. * Set technical direction and engineering standards — Define architecture patterns, code quality bar, evaluation frameworks, deployment practices, and observability standards for the AI engineering pod. Ensure production\-quality C\# and Python with TDD, CI/CD, staged rollouts, and full observability. * Own production health and reliability — Ensure deployed AI agents meet quality, performance, and safety standards. Drive incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement for agent systems in production. * Build and maintain evaluation systems — Establish evaluation frameworks including rubrics, golden datasets, and judge agents to validate agent correctness and safety before and after production deployment. Ensure agents graduate through shadow mode to autonomous operation with eval gates at each stage. * Influence product and platform roadmaps — Partner with product, platform engineering, and Azure service teams to shape the agentic AI platform direction. Translate customer support patterns and demand signals into engineering priorities. * Drive measurable business impact — Own KPIs including case volume reduction, automation accuracy, resolution time improvement, and customer satisfaction impact. Use data\-driven insights to set OKRs and demonstrate engineering ROI. * Ensure responsible AI and compliance — Partner with AI Governance to embed responsible AI practices, PII protection, action boundaries, and audit trails into all agent systems architecturally. * Develop engineering talent — Mentor engineers on applied AI engineering craft, including agentic system design, evaluation\-driven development, and the judgment to know where agents should and should not act autonomously. Build career growth paths across AI engineering competencies. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * 8\+ years in software engineering or applied AI roles, with 3\+ years in people management leading technical engineering teams. * Proven ability to hire, coach, and develop high\-performing engineering teams; experience driving inclusion and career growth. * Strong proficiency in Python and C\# with hands\-on experience building production AI/ML systems. * Experience with LLM\-based systems, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or agent frameworks. * Experience with cloud platforms (Azure) and cloud\-native service development (microservices, containers, CI/CD). * Demonstrated success owning end\-to\-end engineering delivery — from architecture through production operations. * Operational rigor with experience setting OKRs, tracking engineering KPIs, and improving service reliability metrics. **Other:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening: Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.**Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, or related field. * Experience building and shipping multi\-agent orchestration systems or agentic AI services in production. * Experience with AI evaluation frameworks (rubrics, golden datasets, judge agents, offline/online eval). * Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or similar enterprise AI platforms. * Familiarity with agent security patterns (prompt injection defense, tool access controls, data boundary enforcement). * Experience leading co\-development or cross\-org engineering delivery with multiple partner teams. * Strong business acumen with ability to tie engineering investments to measurable customer and business outcomes (volume reduction, resolution time, CSAT). * Experience influencing product engineering roadmaps and driving cross\-functional collaboration at scale. * Background in customer support engineering, supportability, or customer experience platforms is a strong plus. * \#EngOps \#EngOpsACES Software Engineering M5 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $142,800 \- $274,800 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $188,000 \- $304,200 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us\-corporate\-pay This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Principal Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ACES CØDE is a Microsoft engineering organization focused on reducing operational demand across the Microsoft Cloud, including but not limited to the avoidable support cases, repeated troubleshooting, and manual interventions that arise when cloud products, platforms, or processes do not work as intended. Our mission is to engineer this demand out of the Microsoft Cloud by turning customer and operational signals into lasting product improvements, intelligent diagnostics, autonomous resolution systems, and AI\-powered capabilities. As cloud services grow in scale and complexity, we are moving beyond simply reacting to problems after they occur. We work to understand why operational demand exists, prevent it at the source where possible, resolve it autonomously when it does occur, and continuously learn from those signals to make our products and support experiences more reliable. We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes. Within this mission, the ACES CØDE engineering team is building domain\-specific agents and services that are transforming Azure customer support from reactive, human\-dependent workflows toward AI\-first systems capable of resolving customer issues at Azure scale. We are seeking a Principal Applied AI Engineer to serve as a hands\-on technical architect and senior developer for these production agentic AI services. You will define and implement the architecture for next\-generation AI agents, including LLM orchestration, multi\-agent coordination, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool integration, and evaluation systems. You will write production code, lead complex technical initiatives, establish engineering standards, and guide engineers across organizational boundaries through technical influence rather than people management. This is a deeply technical individual contributor role with broad architectural scope and direct accountability for production outcomes. You will turn ambiguous customer and business problems into scalable systems, make critical design decisions, build foundational components, and help teams ship secure and reliable AI services that handle thousands of customer cases per month. Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help Azure EngOps provide our customers with the world\-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. jobs.title: Network and Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Job Purpose/Summary: ==================== The Senior Network and Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the design, security, and reliability of Mitchell Hamline School of Law’s network and technology infrastructure. Team and Operational Support ---------------------------- * Provide advanced technical guidance, mentoring, and support to IT team members. * Assist with troubleshooting and operational work when issues require senior\-level infrastructure expertise. * Maintain clear technical documentation, policies, processes, procedures, and system records. * Participate in after\-hours support for critical infrastructure issues as needed. * Perform other duties as assigned. *An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Physical and Mental Demands: ============================ * Regular computer, video conference, and telephone use. * Ability to communicate effectively with IT colleagues, vendors, faculty, staff, and other stakeholders in person and through electronic communication tools. * Ability to perform physical activities associated with technology infrastructure, including lifting equipment up to 30 pounds unassisted, bending, standing, climbing, or walking as needed. * This position requires extended periods of sedentary work and sustained attention to technical systems and details. jobs.title: Director, Onboard Core Software
jobs.description: Motional is at the forefront of the driverless revolution. We are looking for a Director of Onboard Core Software to lead the teams that deliver the software foundation Motional's products are built on: embedded firmware, the operating system, the runtime, and middleware on the vehicle's various computing platforms. You will own the onboard software infrastructure end to end and lead the teams responsible for it. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience with systems software on physical hardware and has led engineering organizations with several levels of management. You should be comfortable owning a large area that spans many teams, taking on problems that aren't well defined yet, and working out boundaries directly with other organizations. **Mission Summary:** As the Director of Onboard Core Software, you will lead the strategic vision and execution for the software foundation of Motional's autonomous vehicles, from embedded firmware through the operating system, runtime, and middleware. This leadership role is centered on establishing a single roadmap, intake process, and escalation path for the onboard stack, and serving as the primary engineering counterpart to Vehicle Platform Engineering, Autonomy, and Safety for everything that runs on the vehicle's compute platform. You will keep the current\-generation platform healthy in production while building the next\-generation platform program. You will own cross\-cutting system behaviors such as startup sequencing, storage lifecycle, compute, ECU bring\-up, and cross\-layer latency to ensure the platform performs safely and reliably, and that the entire product is a delight for our customers, from the autonomy features that drive the vehicle to the customer\-facing features riders experience in our cars. **What You'll Be Doing:** * **Stack Ownership:** Own the onboard software stack from firmware through middleware. That includes software on embedded platforms including SoCs, safety MCUs, and GPU compute; the operating systems, drivers, and interfaces to the physical world; task runtime and compute resource management; system health monitoring; and safety and diagnostics software. * **Organizational Leadership:** Lead and develop a team of engineering managers and technical leaders. You own hiring, leveling, performance, and career growth for the group, and you will build leaders who can run their teams autonomously. * **Cross\-Functional Accountability:** Be the main contact for onboard software for stakeholder and partner teams. You will settle boundary questions between organizations, run intake and prioritization, and handle escalations when your teams' software is on the critical path. * **Delivering Quality:** Define what "done" means for onboard software at each release, including quality metrics to ensure delivery of a safe and reliable product. **What We're Looking For:** * **Education:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent knowledge and work experience. * **Experience:** 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading organizations of 40 or more engineers as a manager of managers. This should be in a field where software runs on physical hardware, such as automotive, robotics, aerospace, or consumer devices. * **Systems Software Depth:** Hands\-on experience building, or leading teams that built, embedded firmware, Linux kernel or BSP software, real\-time middleware, or high\-performance runtimes. You can talk through boot sequencing, IPC latency, or resource scheduling with Principal Engineers. * **Production Operations:** Experience running software in production on a fleet or in the field, including keeping a current platform healthy while bringing up the next one. * **Technical Leadership:** Experience hiring, developing, and retaining talent as an organization grows. * **Cross\-Organizational Ownership:** Experience owning a large area that spans many teams. You build trust with peer organizations, work out boundaries directly, and make decisions people follow. * **Communication:** Clear writing and speaking. You can explain technical tradeoffs to executives, peers, and engineers across your team and others. * **Inclusive Leadership:** Experience building inclusive teams and making room for people with different working styles, ideas, and backgrounds. * **Engineering Rigor:** Ability to set and hold the team to high standards for engineering quality. **Bonus Points (Not Required):** * Experience with functional safety in automotive (ISO 26262, safety MCUs, safety monitors, diagnostics), or working closely with a safety organization on requirements and designs for safety\-critical/regulated environments. * Experience with high\-performance, high\-bandwidth, low\-latency systems, such as moving large amounts of data across numerous subsystems with tight timing requirements. * Familiarity with physical AI ecosystems, where machine learning models sense and act in the real world. That includes how those models run on embedded compute, how they depend on sensors and the onboard runtime, and how on\-road and simulation data is used to train and evaluate them. * Experience in the autonomous vehicle or robotaxi industry. **We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.** \#LI\-AE1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

jobs.title: Associate AI Engineer
jobs.description: At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world—making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose — as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right. The Associate AI Engineer contributes to the development, testing, deployment, and operation of AI\-enabled applications and services at NAVEX. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, you will develop well\-defined components of production AI systems, including data pipelines, application services, model integrations, retrieval workflows, automated evaluations, and monitoring capabilities. The ideal candidate brings foundational experience in software development, data engineering, statistics, or machine learning and demonstrates the ability and interest to develop deeper expertise in generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and production AI engineering. You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to innovation, speed, and measurable outcomes. Join us and help shape what’s next! **What you’ll get:** * Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people—at a scale few companies can match. * High\-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career. * Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas—not people—and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement. * Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth. * Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact. **What you’ll do:** * Develop and test Python components for AI applications, including generative AI, retrieval and agent workflows * Build APIs, services and integrations that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications and data platforms * Develop data pipelines to extract, clean, transform and validate data for AI and machine\-learning applications * Support predictive modelling, feature engineering and statistical analysis to evaluate data quality and model performance * Build automated tests and evaluation datasets; analyze errors and measure accuracy, reliability, latency and cost * Support cloud deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting using established source control, code review and CI/CD practices * Apply privacy, security and responsible AI safeguards; validate outputs and escalate quality, bias, compliance or model\-risk concerns * Collaborate across Engineering, Data and Product; document your work, communicate findings and risks, and apply feedback to strengthen your skills **What you’ll bring:** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or another related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience * Foundational professional, internship, academic, or project experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, or statistical computing * Experience programming in Python * Experience working with SQL and relational data * Understanding of data structures, data transformation, and data\-quality concepts * Foundational knowledge of statistical analysis and machine\-learning methods * Experience with common data or machine\-learning libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, or comparable technologies * Familiarity with APIs, automated testing, debugging, source control, and software\-development practices * Ability to analyze technical problems and communicate findings clearly * Ability to collaborate effectively within cross\-functional teams * Demonstrated interest in developing and operating production AI systems * Bonus experience: * Building data pipelines, Python APIs or predictive models, including feature engineering and evaluation * Working with LLMs, prompts, RAG, embeddings, semantic search or AI agents and tool calling * Using cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD or tools for model tracking, versioning and monitoring * Applying responsible AI, privacy and risk controls to complex, sensitive or regulated data * Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast\-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow\-through * Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values **Our side of the deal:** * We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way. * The starting pay for this role is $85,000 per annum. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

jobs.description: We are now looking for a Senior Signal \& Power Integrity Engineer! NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. jobs.title: Full-Stack Senior Developers
jobs.description: Natoli Engineering is hiring two senior full\-stack developers to design, build and run our software portfolio. For more than 50 years, Natoli has made tablet compression tooling, tablet presses and related equipment for manufacturers worldwide from its headquarters in St. Charles, Missouri. Our software includes instrumentation and control software for our presses, tooling management and inspection tools, customer portals such as TabletCAD and our online store, internal business systems, and natoli.com. This is a hands\-on, senior individual\-contributor role. You will write production code most days and take work from first conversation with a stakeholder through requirements, design, testing, deployment and support. The two developers share ownership of the portfolio and report to the Head of IT; neither role leads or manages a team. AI is central to how we will build software. We want developers who already use AI coding assistants and agents every day, know how to build AI into development tools and practices, and know where AI output needs a careful human check. You should also have shipped and maintained real enterprise software, care about quality and documentation, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical people. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Portfolio ownership and technical direction** * Share ownership of Natoli's software portfolio with the other senior developer: software sold with our equipment, customer portals, internal business systems and natoli.com. Divide the work and back each other up. * Shape the technical roadmap and architecture for each application, and agree priorities with the Head of IT: new features, customer commitments, security fixes and technical debt. * Help set and follow engineering standards: coding conventions, branching strategy, code review and definition of done. * Review code from peers and contractors, and pair on the hardest problems. * Recommend build\-vs\-buy decisions and evaluate frameworks, libraries, vendors and tools. ### **AI\-enabled development** * Use AI coding assistants and agents \[such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor] every day across the SDLC: design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review and documentation. * Review, test and take responsibility for every line of AI\-generated code before it ships. * Build AI into Natoli's development tools and practices: AI\-assisted pull request review, test generation inside a TDD workflow, documentation generation, and AI steps in CI/CD pipelines. * Maintain the shared context that makes AI tools effective here: repository instruction files, prompt libraries, coding conventions, and connectors (such as MCP servers) to internal systems and documentation. * Work with the Head of IT on AI guardrails: approved tools, what code and data may go to which AI service, security review of AI output, and licensing and IP. * Add AI features to Natoli products and internal apps where they earn their place, such as search and assistants over technical documentation, using LLM APIs, retrieval and evaluation. * Measure the effect of AI on cycle time, defect rates and review effort, and evaluate new models and tools as they appear. * Share what works with colleagues across IT through demos, short guides and pairing. ### **Requirements and SDLC** * Gather requirements from customers, sales, support and internal users, and turn them into user stories, acceptance criteria and technical specs. * Own the full SDLC: discovery, design, build, test, release, maintenance and retirement. * Work in an agile cadence (Scrum or Kanban as each product needs) and help run backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives. * Estimate effort, track delivery and report status, risks and trade\-offs to the Head of IT. * Plan releases and versioning for customer\-facing products, including release notes and upgrade paths. ### **Architecture, data and performance** * Design secure, scalable, maintainable systems: front ends, APIs, services and integrations with third\-party systems (ERP, CRM, payments, identity). * Design relational schemas: normalization, keys and constraints, indexing, and safe, versioned migrations. * Choose the right data store for each job (relational, document, key\-value, search) and tune queries for performance. * Design caching at every layer (CDN, HTTP, application, distributed caches such as Redis), including invalidation strategy. * Design multi\-tenant patterns for SaaS products, including tenant data isolation. ### **Quality and testing** * Practice and champion test\-driven development (TDD). * Maintain a layered automated test suite: unit, integration, contract and end\-to\-end tests. * Build quality gates into the pipeline: test coverage, static analysis, linting and dependency and security scanning. * Triage production incidents, find root causes and write blameless post\-incident reviews. ### **CI/CD, cloud and operations** * Build and mainta skills, which are still scarce. Local pay data for AI skills is thin, so revisit the band after the first round of applicants. * Budget for both hires: $270,000–$330,000 combined base, plus bonus and benefits. * Hire both into the same band and set each offer by skills and experience, so the two peers are paid fairly relative to each other. * Pay toward the top of the band for FDA\-regulated software experience (21 CFR Part 11\), commercial software experience, or a stack that is hard to hire for locally. * Expected total cash per hire: about $142,000–$182,000\. * Other levers if base is tight: a $5,000–$15,000 signing bonus, extra PTO, a $2,000–$5,000 yearly training budget, and paid AI tool subscriptions. ### **Market benchmarks** Payscale, Built In and Orbyt pages listed under Sources · St. Louis base pay · checked October 2026 Each source reports a different spread, so compare the dots rather than the line lengths. Orbyt's modeled figures run highest; self\-reported Payscale and Built In data run lower. **Benefits, work arrangement and EEO statement** ------------------------------------------------ Fill in the brackets with your actual plan details. * Medical, dental and vision insurance, with \[X]% of premiums paid by Natoli * 401(k) with a \[X]% company match * \[N] days of paid time off plus \[N] paid holidays * Annual bonus program (5–10% target for this role) * $\[X] yearly professional development budget for courses, certifications and conferences * Company\-paid AI development tools and model access * Hybrid schedule: \[3] days a week at our St. Charles, MO headquarters, the rest remote * \[Paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, home\-office equipment] **Work authorization:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. \[Visa sponsorship is / is not available for this role.] **Equal opportunity:** Natoli Engineering Company, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process on request. **Notes for the hiring manager** -------------------------------- * **Keep the title at senior individual contributor.** Avoid "Lead" or "Manager"; both attract candidates who expect direct reports and a higher band. * **Hire for complementary strengths.** Both hires must meet the same bar, but one could lean toward back\-end, data and equipment integration, the other toward front\-end, customer portals and natoli.com. * **Explain the two\-person structure.** Tell candidates how the two developers will split ownership and how decisions get made with the Head of IT, since neither one leads. * **Test AI skills directly.** Add a live exercise: a small task in a sample codebase using the candidate's own AI tools, then ask how they checked the output. Keep a system\-design session, a real pull\-request review and a requirements role\-play with a non\-technical stakeholder. * **Trim the must\-haves.** The required list has 15 items; move anything you would waive for a great hire into Preferred. * **Fill every bracket.** Your real stack and tools help candidates self\-select and cut screening time. * **Post the range.** Missouri does not require salary ranges in job posts. Illinois does for employers with 15\+ employees when the job may be done partly in Illinois, which can apply to hybrid hires living in the Metro East. jobs.title: Training Systems Engineer, Advanced
jobs.description: Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today! **Job Description** ------------------- The Naval Nuclear Laboratory (NNL) Training Applications \& Support (TAS) organization, part of the Naval Training \& Simulation (NTS) Department, plays a vital role in supporting the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Training Program (NNPTP). TAS is responsible for the engineering and maintenance of a suite of programs, data systems, and optimization models to assist personnel at the Moored Training Ships (MTS) and Kesselring Site (KS) in managing and improving activities critical to the Prototype phase of initial nuclear operator training. These tools include enterprise applications for qualification tracking, automated scheduling, reporting, exam administration, and integration services linking training databases together. You will also provide leadership to projects delivering new capabilities to the NNPTP by contributing to research, design, integration, and testing of new hardware and software systems such as a digitized student qualification tablet solution for the Next Generation Training Program. There is also the opportunity to grow skills in applied mathematics and optimization modeling used in automated scheduling tools. **Required Combination of Knowledge and Skill** ----------------------------------------------- * Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or * Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or * Doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering, science field; or * Currently an Advanced Reactor Training Engineer, Refueling Engineer, or Field (RPCO) Engineer at the Company. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Operational experience in the NNPTP such as Navy Training Coordinator, Nuclear Plant Engineer (NPE), or Crew Training Engineer (CTE). * Familiarity with Agile software development processes and Azure DevOps. * Project Management experience. * Ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence priorities across multiple organizations. * Applied mathematics or optimization modeling experience. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Health, Dental, Vision \& Voluntary Benefits * Disability, Life \& Accident Insurance * 401(k) Savings program \& Capital Accumulation Plan * Personal \& Medical Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Flexible Work Schedules * Tuition Assistance for Eligible Employees * Student Debt Benefit Personal Time Off Sell Program * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Wellness Program * Visit us online to view all NNL benefits! **Pay Range** ------------- $86,100\.00 \- $134,600\.00 annually Salary information provided is a general guideline only. Annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is operated for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) by Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC (FMP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Fluor Corporation. Naval Nuclear Laboratory personnel are FMP employees who work at four DOE facilities: Bettis Atomic Power Laboratory, Knolls Atomic Power Laboratory, Kenneth A. Kesselring Site, and Naval Reactors Facility, and at the U.S. Department of Defense\-owned Nuclear Power Training Unit\-Charleston. FMP employees also have an established presence at numerous shipyards, satellite, and vendor locations. For more than 75 years, the Naval Nuclear Laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world\-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program. We rely on the dedication and innovation of our nearly 8000 engineers, scientists, technicians, and support personnel. All candidates must be U.S. citizens. Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter. FMP is a government contractor and maintains a drug free workplace and workforce. All candidates must be able to pass a drug test in compliance with FMP company policy and 10 CFR 707\. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internal Tools
jobs.description: **About North Cloud** The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200 billion annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them. At North, we’re building the next\-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. **About the Role** ------------------ ### **Be Our First Internal Tools Engineer** You'll be North's **first dedicated Internal Tools Engineer**, joining our Engineering team to build this function from the ground up. This is an opportunity to establish the technical foundation, architecture, and best practices for how we develop internal tools, integrations, and automations across the company. You'll have significant ownership over identifying opportunities, setting technical standards, and building scalable solutions that can be reused as North grows. Rather than inheriting an established roadmap or legacy systems, you'll help define what internal tooling looks like at North and shape how we approach automation across the organization. While this is a hands\-on individual contributor role, **your work will lay the groundwork for a future Internal Tools team**. As the company scales, the systems, processes, and engineering practices you establish will serve as the foundation for expanding the function. We’re looking for an **Internal Tools Engineer** to join our Engineering team and build the systems, automations, and tools that make North operate faster and more effectively. You’ll work across all of North to identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient workflows and turn them into reliable software. That could mean building an internal application from scratch, integrating systems through APIs, automating a multi\-step operational workflow, or using AI to eliminate work that previously required significant manual effort. You won’t just receive a list of tickets. We want someone who can understand a problem, determine whether and how it should be automated, propose a technical approach, and own the solution through production. We care about building internal systems with the same engineering discipline we apply to our customer\-facing product. The goal isn’t to create a collection of one\-off scripts—it’s to build reliable, maintainable, reusable tooling that can scale with the company. You’ll sit within Engineering while partnering closely with teams across North, giving you visibility into how the entire business operates and the opportunity to improve it through software. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Build internal tools from end to end.** Design, develop, deploy, and maintain applications and services that help North’s teams operate more efficiently. * **Automate manual workflows.** Identify repetitive or time\-consuming processes across the company and replace them with reliable software and automation. * **Build AI\-enabled workflows.** Use LLMs, APIs, agents, and other AI technologies where they can meaningfully reduce manual work or improve decision\-making. * **Connect our systems.** Build integrations between the platforms North uses across engineering and the broader organization, creating reliable data and workflow connections between them. * **Build Python services and APIs.** Develop maintainable backend services that power internal applications, integrations, and automations. * **Create internal interfaces.** Build lightweight dashboards, applications, and interfaces that make internal systems intuitive for non\-engineering users. * **Design reusable systems.** Build service layers, libraries, abstractions, and integrations that can support multiple workflows instead of solving the same problem repeatedly. * **Own architecture decisions.** Determine the right technical approach for new tools and automations, including when to build, integrate, automate, or keep a process manual. * **Own tools in production.** Monitor, debug, maintain, and improve the systems you build as workflows and business requirements evolve. * **Build for reliability.** Implement strong testing, observability, error handling, permissions, and guardrails so internal automations can be trusted. * **Work directly with internal users.** Understand how teams actually work, translate their problems into technical requirements, and iterate based on feedback. * **Experiment quickly.** Prototype new approaches—including AI\-powered solutions—while knowing when an experiment needs to become production\-quality software. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3–7 years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems * Strong Python experience and the ability to write clean, maintainable, idiomatic code * Experience building backend services, APIs, integrations, or internal applications * Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and working with third\-party platforms * Experience automating workflows or building tools that meaningfully reduced manual work * Ability to take an ambiguous operational problem and independently turn it into a technical solution * Experience designing and operating production systems rather than only building prototypes * Ability to write reusable code and abstractions instead of relying on one\-off scripts * Strong fundamentals around Git workflows, code review, testing, and collaborative software development * Strong critical thinking skills—you reason from first principles, evaluate tradeoffs, and can explain why you chose a particular approach * Pragmatic use of AI and LLM coding tools: you use them to move faster while still understanding the code, architecture, and tradeoffs behind what you ship * Strong testing discipline and an understanding that internal tooling still requires reliability, security, and maintainability * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfort operating independently in a fast\-moving environment where priorities can change quickly * A builder mentality—you naturally notice inefficient processes and start thinking about how software could make them better **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building AI\-powered internal tools, agents, or LLM\-based workflows * Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG, or agentic systems * Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, or similar tools * Experience building internal admin panels, dashboards, or lightweight frontend applications * JavaScript or TypeScript experience * Experience integrating SaaS platforms across functions such as engineering, sales, recruiting, finance, or operations * Experience with AWS and cloud infrastructure * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with tools such as Terraform * Experience with databases, data pipelines, or event\-driven architectures * Experience in a startup or similarly fast\-moving environment * Experience owning an internal platform or tool from initial problem discovery through ongoing production support * Outstanding recognition in competitions, technical projects, open\-source work, or business ventures **Work Setup** -------------- We offer both hybrid work models based out of our Dumbo Brooklyn office, as well as remote US, with opportunities to travel to the office for team onsites. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 weeks at 50% pay) * Two company\-wide breaks per year: one around Labor Day and one at the end of the year * Aetna Medical PPO plan with the majority of the premium covered by North * Dental and vision insurance * Flexible spending account (FSA) for health expenses and commuter benefits * 30\-day sabbatical every 4 years **Compensation** ---------------- jobs.title: AI Engineer – Founding Member, NJ Office
jobs.description: **Hi, I'm Andreas. Come build the new Nu Image® with us.** I'm the CEO of Nu Image®, and we're opening a new office in New Jersey. I'm looking for an AI engineer to be a founding member of it, and yes, the desk next to mine is open. **Open to current New Jersey residents only (on\-site in Mahwah/Wyckoff, NJ). We are not offering relocation.** Here's the setup. We're building the next generation of our technology, and it's a small, tight core: you, working directly with our CTO, with AI agents as the force multiplier. You'll own the AI engineering and the hands\-on code development. AI agents do most of the typing here. But make no mistake: **you'll own the code, not just prompt it.** You'll understand the architecture, read every line the agents write, and be able to debug and fix it by hand when they get it wrong. When something breaks in production, "the agent wrote it" isn't an answer. You are the builder, and the result is yours. And here's the line I care about most: **I don't want someone who waits to be told what to do.** See a problem? Fix it. See a better way? Build it and show us. Initiative is the job. If you're the person at the meetup who can't stop talking about your agent setup, and you can also explain what's happening under the hood, keep reading. **Who we are** * Nu Image® is a US telehealth company. Founded in 2004, online since 2008\. * LegitScript certified, serving all 50 states. * We're opening a new office in the Mahwah / Wyckoff area of New Jersey. This role is based there, fully on\-site and in person. No relocation offered. * Home page: https://nuimage.com **What you'll build (with our CTO)** * **A modern web platform and internal tools** that people actually enjoy using. * **Integrations and automation** that connect systems and take busywork off people's plates. * **AI\-powered workflows**, plus the agent setups, guardrails and review steps that let a small core build like a much bigger one. * **Secure, reliable, well\-tested systems** with healthcare\-grade privacy and security baked in from day one. **What a week roughly looks like** No two weeks are the same, but expect a mix of: \- Agents running in parallel on branches while you review diffs, push back on bad code, and write the tricky parts yourself. \- Working through architecture and priorities with our CTO, then turning them into shipped code. \- Whiteboard sessions on new ideas, and turning the good ones into working prototypes. \- Digging into a weird bug by hand: logs, queries, a debugger, and some stubbornness. \- Spotting something nobody asked about (a slow query, a flaky job, a tool that would save us hours) and handling it. \- Showing what shipped, what broke, and what you want to try next. **Perks of the role (just for fun; these are about the job, not benefits)** * Founding member of the NJ office. You'll help shape how it works. * First dibs on the whiteboard. * You pick the office coffee machine. Choose wisely. * You get to name the agents. * The CEO is one desk over, so your ideas get a fast yes or no. * Your ideas don't sit in a backlog for six months. **Must\-haves** **AI (front and center)** \- You ship with AI coding agents daily: Cursor, the Grok ecosystem (including Grok Bot), and similar tools. You have a setup, opinions, and receipts. \- You're current with today's AI tools and how they're changing month to month. \- You've built real agent workflows: task breakdown, parallel agents, prompt and agent orchestration, and review loops that catch bad output before it ships. \- You verify agent output: tests first, reading diffs line by line, and not trusting anything that just "looks right." \- You keep sensitive data (customer information, secrets, credentials) out of prompts, logs, and tools that aren't approved for it. **Fundamentals (you own the result)** \- **You can build and debug it yourself, without AI, when needed.** Reading unfamiliar code, stepping through it, and fixing it by hand is normal for you. \- Solid software architecture: you can explain why a system is shaped the way it is, and spot when an agent's design is going to hurt later. \- Strong PHP and Laravel: queues, jobs, the scheduler, events, and Eloquent without the N\+1 drama. \- Real SQL skills (MySQL): schema design, indexing, migrations, reading query plans, and writing the query yourself. \- Debugging: logs, stack traces, Xdebug or similar, reproducing issues, and finding root causes, not just symptoms. \- Security and privacy best practices: authentication and authorization, input validation, encryption, least privilege, OWASP top risks, secrets handling. **The rest of the stack** \- Vue and Tailwind on the front end. \- REST APIs: designing them and integrating with third\-party ones. \- Redis for queues, caching, and locks. \- Cloud experience (AWS a plus). \- Testing with Pest or PHPUnit. \- CI/CD with GitHub Actions or similar. \- Admin panel tools like Laravel Nova or Filament. **How you work** \- Initiative. You find the work instead of waiting for it. \- Ownership. If you shipped it (or your agents did), it's yours to understand, fix, and improve. \- You work well in a small core: direct with our CTO, clear about your reasoning, and happy to explain it to an agent or to a person. \- You can show real, shipped work. We care about what you can do, not a years\-of\-experience number. \- You currently live in New Jersey, within a reasonable commute of Mahwah / Wyckoff, and want to be in the office. We are not offering relocation or relocation assistance. **Nice\-to\-haves** * Infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK, Pulumi, or similar). * Observability: structured logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts. * You've built your own MCP servers, agent tools, or custom agent integrations. * Evals for prompts and agents. * Laravel Horizon, Octane, Pulse, or Reverb. * Threat modeling and secrets management beyond the basics. * Open\-source work, side projects, or talks at meetups. **How to apply** Email **jobs@nuimagemedical.com** with the subject line **"AI Engineer – NJ"** and include: * Your GitHub, portfolio, or anything you've shipped that we can look at. * **A short note (a few paragraphs is perfect) on the coolest thing you've built with AI agents.** What it did, how you set up the agents, what went wrong, and how you fixed it. This is the part I'll read first. * Where in New Jersey you live (town is fine). No cover\-letter templates, please. Write it the way you'd explain it to a friend. *Nu Image Medical, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.* Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Do you currently live in New Jersey? Ability to Commute: * Mahwah, NJ 07430 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Sr. Backend Engineer Nashville, TN, or Santa Rosa Beach, FL Resumes must be submitted in English No third\-party recruiters, please! OMNICOMMANDER is a fast\-growing fintech company and three\-time Inc. 5000 honoree. We lead the industry in digital branches and marketing, giving financial institutions a single platform to create, host, and manage their digital branch. We have offices in Tennessee, Florida, and Bogotá, Colombia. This is an on\-site role based in Brentwood, TN, or Santa Rosa Beach, FL. We are hiring a senior backend engineer to design, build, and operate cloud\-hosted services for financial institutions. This is a hands\-on role focused on C\#/.NET, PostgreSQL, and AWS. You will build secure, multi\-tenant software, guide technical decisions, and mentor teammates while staying close to the code. This role reports to the Software Engineering Manager. Why You’ll Love Working Here * Be part of a fast\-growing fintech company with a fun, supportive culture. * Work in a dynamic, high\-tech environment with hands\-on experience working with AI. * Competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, including paid holidays, PTO, an additional day of birthday PTO, company\-paid life insurance, and 401(k) with employer match. * Global team with offices in Tennessee, Florida, and Bogotá, Colombia. Key Responsibilities * Own the design, implementation, maintenance, and evolution of REST APIs and backend services using C\#, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework Core. * Design PostgreSQL schemas and migrations; improve data access, query performance, transactions, and concurrency behavior. * Build and support workloads on AWS using Docker, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, SQS, and related services as appropriate. * Engineer secure authentication and authorization, including JWT/OIDC, role\-based access controls, least\-privilege permissions, and strict tenant isolation. * Implement resilient asynchronous workflows and integrations for assets, notifications, publishing, and other platform operations. * Deliver well\-tested code through unit and integration tests, GitHub pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and safe deployment and rollback practices. * Investigate production defects and performance issues; use logs and operational evidence to identify root causes and prevent recurrence. * Collaborate with Product, QA, Design, and engineering peers; review designs, mentor teammates, and communicate tradeoffs clearly. * Strengthen secure development practices, documentation, audit trails, and repeatable controls that support SOC 2 readiness. What We Are Looking For * Senior\-level engineering experience, 6\+ years or equivalent demonstrated expertise, with substantial ownership of production backend systems. * Advanced C\# and ASP.NET Core experience, including modern .NET, asynchronous programming, dependency injection, API design, error handling, and maintainable architecture. * Strong hands\-on PostgreSQL and Entity Framework Core skills, including schema evolution, query optimization, data integrity, and safe migrations. * Practical AWS production experience, including containerized workloads, IAM, service configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Experience building secure, multi\-tenant SaaS applications and implementing authentication, authorization, and defense\-in\-depth protections. * Evidence of automated testing, Git\-based code review, CI/CD ownership, and debugging complex production issues. * Strong written and verbal English communication (B2 level or higher), sound technical judgment, and experience mentoring engineers. * Experience working with Terraform or other infrastructure\-as\-code tools; AWS CloudFront, Secrets Manager, KMS, WAF, or Step Functions is a plus. * Experience with SignalR/WebSockets, Redis, DynamoDB, event\-driven systems, or advanced observability is a plus. * Experience with Python or Rust for supporting services; Amazon Bedrock, AI integrations, or vector search is a plus. * Fintech or enterprise SaaS experience, secure SDLC practices, and familiarity with SOC 2\-oriented evidence and controls are highly desirable for this role. Benefits: (waiting period may apply) * Company Paid Holidays * PTO Days (Paid Time Off) * PTO Day for your birthday * Medical Insurance * Dental \& Vision Insurance * Company Paid Life Insurance * 401(k) Job Type: Full\-time A criminal background check is required. high\-performance file services such as **NetApp ONTAP, Lustre, NFS, parallel file systems, scale\-out NAS, or distributed storage systems** . * Strong Linux, storage, and networking expertise, understanding of organizational technical operations. \-Creates and establishes internal policies, processes, and standards for security, scalability, and other product/service fundamentals related to jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: Overview: A great platform team is defined not by how many tickets it closes, but by how little friction stands between an engineer's idea and a running service. The DevOps Engineer, Platform builds and runs the pipelines, golden paths, service infrastructure, and AI\-augmented workflows that make delivery self\-service at Origami Risk. This engineer is a hands\-on member of the DevOps Platform team who onboards new services, builds and maintains CI/CD pipelines, authors infrastructure as code, deploys and operates containerized and serverless workloads, and keeps the path from lower environments to production reliable. Everything runs in AWS, on top of the landing zone the DevOps Infrastructure team owns. The role works from the team's established standards and patterns, contributes improvements back to them, and partners with Engineering, Release, SRE, and DevOps Infrastructure to deliver services and resolve delivery issues. On this team, manual work is a problem to be solved, automation is the default, and every Engineer is expected to use AI to work faster and diagnose more accurately, while understanding and owning every change they ship. Starting base pay for this role is between $100,000 and $122,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities: What This Team Runs: This is the developer platform and delivery layer that sits on top of the AWS landing zone: the systems Engineering uses to build, ship, and operate services every day. The team owns the platform for application and service delivery, not the landing zone underneath it, which the DevOps Infrastructure team owns. The team owns:* Delivery Pipelines \& Build: the CI/CD build and deploy pipelines, and the shared pipeline templates that Engineering teams across the org use to ship every day. * Service\-Layer IaC: the infrastructure\-as\-code that defines each service's cloud resources, versioned and deployed through Terraform. * Kubernetes \& Container Platform: the Kubernetes container platform and the self\-service golden path that lets a new service onboard with no bespoke infrastructure work. * Application Connectivity: the application\-facing API gateways, service DNS, and certificates that make services reachable and secure. * Service Data \& Configuration: the application data stores, configuration, and secrets that each service depends on. * Environment Promotion: the promotion path that moves a change safely from lower environments to production. * AI \& Internal Tooling: the AI tooling across the development lifecycle that speeds service onboarding, pipeline authoring, and day\-to\-day delivery. Key Responsibilities: Developer Platform \& Service Onboarding* Onboards new services and greenfield projects through the team's self\-service golden path, from repository scaffolding and infrastructure provisioning through pipelines, configuration, secrets, DNS, and alerting, taking each service from “we are building a service” to “it deploys to production on its own pipeline.” * Supports high\-velocity delivery for new product initiatives, including AI projects, by enabling Day\-1 deployment from initial repo creation through infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, observability, and production readiness. * Applies the team's naming and structural standards for repositories, container images, pipelines, configuration, and secrets, and flags gaps where a standard is missing or unclear. * Supports cost efficiency by right\-sizing service infrastructure, applying image and artifact retention policies, and cleaning up idle or unused resources. Pipelines, Build \& Release* Builds, maintains, and troubleshoots CI/CD build and deploy pipelines (build, test, scan, containerize, publish, deploy, and the environment gates between them) using the team's shared pipeline templates. * Contributes changes to shared pipeline templates in a backward\-compatible way, so new options carry safe defaults and existing consumers never break. * Maintains container image discipline, including immutable versioning, registry management, and retention policies, so a redeploy always runs exactly the image that was tested. * Executes promotions from lower environments to production through gated, repeatable pipelines, with roll\-forward as the default recovery path. * Supports the Release team in operating the pipelines DevOps builds, helping them read a failure, retry or approve a stage, and know when to escalate back to DevOps versus the service owner. * Investigates flaky and intermittent pipel nt, environment promotion, and release automation * Experience supporting both Windows and Linux workloads * Regular use of AI development tools and coding assistants, with the judgment to verify and explain what the AI produces * Familiarity with software engineering practices such as test\-driven design, dependency injection, DRY principles, rapid prototyping, and service\-oriented architecture * Strong problem\-solving skills, troubleshooting ability, and attention to detail, with clear written and verbal communication Preferred Qualifications:* AWS certification at the associate level * Kubernetes experience with Helm and workload identity patterns * Experience with GitOps deployment tooling * Experience with database schema\-migration tooling and relational databases * Experience with log search and analytics platforms * Experience with web servers and reverse proxies * Prior experience supporting client product implementations and production rollouts * Familiarity with SOC 2, NIST 800\-53, or ISO/IEC 27001 control evidence Benefits: * Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses * Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\* * All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote * Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance * Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements * Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account * Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential \& Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work\-related complications * Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role\-specific certifications * Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management * Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life \& AD\&D coverage *\*\*Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK* Who We Are: Origami Risk delivers single\-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management. Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results. A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award\-winning software solutions. *Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We do not discriminate against any individual based upon race, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, sex, national origin, age, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* ***Caution****: Be alert to recruiting scams. capture judgment and exceptions, and turn what works into tested, reusable capabilities. **Advance applied AI and machine learning** * Shape the applied AI agenda with business leaders, prioritizing by value, feasibility, data readiness and risk. * Develop, validate and deploy predictive models and decision support for problems from prioritization and routing to portfolio and distribution, choosing statistical, machine learning or LLM methods as the problem requires, with clear boundaries for automation and human review. * Measure decision quality and business impact against real baselines, monitor what ships, and work with Risk and Compliance to keep it within Palomar’s AI policies. **What we are looking for:** * Master’s or PhD in computer science, statistics, machine learning, operations research or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years shipping machine learning or AI systems in production, including recent hands\-on work with LLM applications: statistics and experimental design, and the judgment to tell predictive accuracy from business impact. * Hands\-on depth in supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering and model validation, including data leakage, uncertainty and drift. * Strong Python, SQL and software engineering fundamentals: APIs, Git, testing, CI/CD and cloud. This role writes code. * The ability to frame ambiguous problems with domain experts, explain tradeoffs plainly to executives and engineers, and help non\-engineers build with AI effectively. **Additional experience we value:** * Insurance or financial services, especially underwriting, operations or claims. * Forecasting, optimization, causal inference or decision science. * Operating an enterprise LLM platform at company scale. * Model risk management or AI governance in a regulated industry. **We love people who want to:** * Build strong relationships through transparency, trust, and respect for each other. * Work in an agile environment, with a resilient mindset to find creative solutions to challenges. * Collaborate and celebrate diverse perspectives, promoting inclusivity and equality. * Do the right thing with strong conviction and integrity. * Be bold and innovative to help make an impact. * Demonstrable track record of working autonomously and driving progress * Be intellectually curious, think creatively, and pragmatic ***If you thrive in a dynamic environment, and like working with happy, authentic, talented people, you'll enjoy a career with Palomar!*** **What will you get in return?** * Full Suite of Medical Benefits * Long Term Financial Incentives – STOCK! * 401k with 3\.5% Automatic Fully Vested Employer Contributions * Competitive PTO \+ Holiday Program * Lifestyle Spending Allowance * Professional Development Assistance * Career Exploration Opportunities * Regular company\-wide social events (even virtually!) * To learn more visit us at www.plmr.com **Diversity at Palomar** At Palomar, we are committed to diversity, equality and inclusion in all facets of the organization. We have built an open culture that celebrates the diversity of our workforce, while actively championing equality and inclusion practices that make us a company people want to work with and work for. We believe that diversity, equality and inclusion yields greater organizational creativity and productivity, which helps us serve our customers and partners more effectively. Delivering on our diversity commitment returns greater value to our shareholders and ultimately makes a positive impact to the communities in which we do business and to the people who live in them **\#PalomarPride \#Insurancejobs \#hiring** **Accommodations:** Palomar will consider reasonable accommodations to ensure a qualified applicant with a disability can be considered for the position. Ensure enterprise data capabilities support analytics, operational reporting, experimentation, decision support, and executive intelligence without relying on fragmented downstream data extraction. * Build governance into the architecture. Establish standards for data ownership, lineage, provenance, classification, quality, lifecycle management, access control, AI usage, auditability, and enterprise data governance. * Protect customer and tenant data. Establish architecture and controls for strict multi\-tenant client\-data segregation across storage, processing, analytics, retrieval,  organizational depth. 10\+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, data engineering, cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, or machine learning, including significant experience leading senior technical professionals. * Organizational leadership. Demonstrated experience forming, scaling, and leading multidisciplinary engineering and data organizations. * People management. Experience hiring professional employees, developing managers and technical leaders, evaluating performance, making promotion and compensation recommendations, planning organizational capacity, and allocating resources across teams and strategic initiatives. * Enterprise AI credibility. Deep understanding of production AI systems including LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, semantic and vector search, agentic architectures, AI orchestration, evaluation, observability, governance, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems. * Enterprise data architecture. Significant experience directing the architecture of platforms supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured enterprise data. * Document\-intensive domains. Experience with architectures where documents and unstructured information are important business assets supporting operational workflows, search, analytics, AI, and governance. * Cloud and modern data platforms. Experience establishing strategy around AWS\-native data services including S3, Redshift, streaming and event technologies, as well as platforms such as Snowflake and/or Databricks. * Modern data architecture. Strong understanding of operational, analytical, dimensional, event\-oriented, lakehouse, semantic, and domain\-oriented data architectures and their trade\-offs. * Production responsibility. Experience leading organizations responsible for enterprise reliability, availability, security, performance, and operational\-readiness requirements. * Governance depth. Experience establishing enterprise standards around data quality, ownership, lineage, retention, tenant segregation, access control, auditability, and lifecycle management. * Regulated environments. Experience operating in environments where contractual, security, privacy, regulatory, data\-residency, or jurisdiction\-specific requirements materially influence architecture. * Strategic delivery leadership.
