jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country. Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence. As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization. We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber. **Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in\-office days per week). We prefer NYC\-based candidates or those open to relocation.** **Role Overview** ================= We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer to build PermitFlow's core product AI Assistant, infrastructure, and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up\-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel. Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow. The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build. This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance. **What You'll Do** ================== * Own the agent architecture. Design the reasoning loop, planning and decomposition strategy, state and session model, and recovery behavior for long\-running tasks. * Build the context layer. Retrieval, memory, and context\-window management over project documents, jurisdictional requirements, prior submissions, and customer\-specific conventions. * Design the action surface. Define the tools the assistant can call, the permissions model around them, and the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints for actions that are expensive or irreversible. * Make evaluation the engine of progress. Stand up offline and online eval harnesses that measure task completion and failure modes. Build the iteration loop that lets the whole team improve agent quality on evidence. * Set the bar for the org. Establish the abstractions, SDKs, and review standards other engineers build agentic features on. * Stay close to the customer. Sit with permit coordinators and builders, watch the assistant fail in real conditions, and bring that back into the system design. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * You've shipped an assistant or agentic product at meaningful scale * Deep, current knowledge of the agentic stack (tool calling and tool design, context engineering, memory, retrieval, orchestration patterns, etc) * You’ve built eval harnesses that changed what a team worked on, and you can articulate what makes an eval trustworthy. * You are a genuinely strong software engineer, not an AI specialist who needs someone else to make it production\-ready. You’ve owned services in production and you write code that other people are glad to inherit. * You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with recent time spent building LLM\-powered products. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high\-growth company * 100% company\-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees \+ healthcare FSA * 401(k) savings plan * Unlimited PTO and paid family leave * Home office \& equipment stipend * Daily in\-office lunch and dinner provided * Commuter benefits (pre\-tax transit and parking) *PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.* *We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.* Compensation Range: $250K \- $300K

Reporting to the AI Engineering \& Architecture Lead within Global Data \& AI Enablement (GDAI), this engineer writes the code that converts governed data assets into tools commercial teams use every day. The first use cases are concrete: patient and HCP opportunity identification, and proactive field alerts that surface meaningful signals instead of asking the field to search dashboards. Backend ETL is delivered by an external vendor into Snowflake, so this role builds on vendor\-delivered and internally modeled data rather than owning ingestion. The patterns this engineer establishes — retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, monitoring — become the foundation the rest of the team builds on. **Key Responsibilities** **Build*** Build agentic and LLM\-based applications against our Snowflake data assets, from first working version through production operation * Implement retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and monitoring so that application behaviour is measurable and regressions are caught before users see them * Deliver early high\-value use cases, starting with opportunity identification and proactive field alerts, and iterate on them with real users * Integrate AI services with the systems the field already uses, so output arrives in workflow rather than in a separate tool **Establish Patterns*** Establish reusable engineering patterns — prompt and agent structure, evaluation harnesses, deployment, observability — that the team can build on * Write the documentation, tests, and deployment processes that let a second engineer work on the same codebase without archaeology * Apply the standards set by the AI Engineering \& Architecture Lead for security, cost, and responsible deployment, including how AI output reaching field\-facing use is reviewed and logged **Partner*** Work with Data Product Engineering to specify the data models and semantic assets applications need, and to flag where delivered data is not fit for purpose * Work with AI Product Strategy \& Value to turn prioritized business problems into shippable scope, and with AI Enablement \& Adoption on rollout and user feedback * Say plainly when a use case will not work as specified, and propose what would **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree required; technical degree (computer science, engineering, or related field) preferred * 5\+ years building production software, including recent hands\-on delivery of LLM\-based or agentic applications that real users depend on * Strong Python and SQL; comfortable working directly against a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake * Practical experience with retrieval, context management, tool and API integration, and agent orchestration frameworks * Has built evaluation and monitoring for an AI system, and can explain how quality was measured rather than asserted * Experience deploying and operating services in a cloud environment, including observability and incident response **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare commercial data, or another regulated industry * Integration experience with CRM and field\-facing systems (Veeva, Salesforce) * Enough front\-end capability to ship a usable interface without waiting for a dedicated front\-end hire * Experience as an early engineer on a small team, where scope is set by what the business needs rather than by a backlog handed down **Location and Work Arrangement** This position is based in Burlington, Massachusetts, and follows a hybrid work model requiring on\-site presence three days per week. The expected base salary range for this position is $140,000\-182,000\. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education and geographical location. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package, successful candidates are eligible for short\-term and long\-term incentives. **Benefits of working with our team:** PharmaEssentia USA strives every day to improve the lives of patients as well as our employees. As a valued member of PharmaEssentia USA, you will enjoy the following benefits:* Comprehensive medical coverage * Dental and vision coverage * Generous paid time\-off * 401(k) retirement plan with competitive company match * Medical \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account * Up to $150 monthly cell phone reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program * Free parking **EEO Statement:** *At PharmaEssentia USA, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. PharmaEssentia USA believes that diversity and inclusion among our team are critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.* *PharmaEssentia does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Staffing agencies should not send resumes to our HR team or to any PharmaEssentia employees. PharmaEssentia is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies.* At PharmaEssentia, our goal is to treat as many people with cancer as possible. That means challenging the status quo with better science that leads to better lives. By joining our team, you will not only expand your own possibilities, but you will contribute to expanding options for people with cancer. https://us.pharmaessentia.com/careers/ hNIyb1r32q

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Perception
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Pickle Robot, we're on a mission to automate global supply chains with Physical AI. Our robots work alongside warehouse teams to unload trucks and containers — one of the toughest, most understaffed jobs in logistics — making the work safer, faster, and more efficient for the people doing it. Loading trucks comes next, followed by the Dill Autonomy Engine: generalized autonomy that will eventually orchestrate robots across entire logistics processes. We're looking for a rigorous and self\-directed Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own machine learning problems end\-to\-end on the systems that decide how our robots grasp packages. This role will focus on problem formulation, building the data engines that feed our models, training and experimentation, and the evaluation rigor that tells us whether a model is genuinely better. Our platform and robotics engineers own runtime integration and edge deployment, so you can stay focused on the modeling loop. ### **What You'll Do** * Own ML Problem Formulation: You will turn ambiguous picking performance goals into well\-posed ML problems, deciding what the model predicts, how labels and rewards are defined, what loss to optimize, and what "better" actually means. This is the core of the role. * Build the Data Engine: You will own dataset strategy end\-to\-end, from large\-scale synthetic scene generation and distributed cloud dataset jobs to scene diversity filtering and self\-supervised label generation. You will identify when the data, rather than the model, is the bottleneck, and fix it. * Train and Iterate on Large Vision Models: You will fine\-tune large backbones with multiple task\-specific heads, run disciplined experiments, and know both which experiment to run next and when to stop. * Own Evaluation and Verification: You will define offline metrics that predict on\-robot outcomes and online metrics that help you improve performance on edge cases. * Drive Technical Excellence: As a senior member of the team, you will conduct rigorous code reviews, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and contribute to the perception and grasping roadmap. * Hand Off Cleanly to Production: You will produce deployable models with sane latency budgets, exportable graphs, and reproducible artifacts, partnering with the engineers who own runtime integration and inference optimization rather than owning that yourself. ### **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ Years of Experience in Machine Learning and Computer Vision, including models you personally carried from problem statement to measured outcome. * A track record of framing problems. You can translate high\-level product requirements into specific engineering tasks and explain technical trade\-offs to non\-expert stakeholders. * Hands\-on Experience Building Datasets at Scale: generation or collection, curation, automated quality assurance, coverage and bias analysis, and active learning to systematically close edge cases. * Rigorous Evaluation Habits: baselines, ablations, metric design, and a clear sense of when a result is real. * Expert\-level Python and PyTorch skills. * Comfortable with cloud training infrastructure (GCP or AWS), Docker, and experiment tracking tools. * **Professional experience with at least one of the following:** + Developing and training multi\-task models + Developing and training multi\-modal models + Developing and training multi–view models + Self\-supervised, outcome\-based, or reward\-driven learning. ### **Pay at Pickle** At Pickle Robot Company, we believe transparency builds trust. The salary range listed here is provided in accordance with Massachusetts law and reflects what we reasonably and in good faith expect to offer for this role. We often consider candidates at different levels of seniority, and final compensation will reflect the level at which a candidate is hired, along with factors like experience and location. ### **Pickle Perks** Pickle provides best\-in\-class benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited vacation; paid federal and state holidays; 401(k) contributions of 5% of your salary; company\-covered travel expenses; and other perks to make your working life more fun, comfortable, and productive. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Elite AI Agent Engineer: B2B Lead Generation & GTM Automation
jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a proven, hands\-on AI Agent builder who specializes in B2B lead generation. You must have personally architected, built, deployed, and operated AI agents that generate measurable B2B prospecting results. **We're seeking an AI engineer who can build the intelligence behind the system** AI agents that use tools, make decisions, coordinate workflows, and turn enterprise buying signals into qualified sales meetings. If you are an expert at building AI agents for B2B lead generation and can prove they work, we want to meet you. **About PlanITROI** 25 years of success. Global industry recognition. Founder\-led. No corporate red tape. An ambitious future powered by AI and Robotics! For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped enterprise organizations maximize the financial value of retired technology through IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide, is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor, and has built our business around reuse\-as\-intended\-use, prioritizing reuse over recycling. **Our mission:** Maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients, reduces unnecessary electronic waste, and gives technology a second life as affordable technology. **Why you'll love working here** **Founder\-led. Move fast. Get things done.** Work directly with entrepreneurial leadership. No layers of corporate bureaucracy or endless approval cycles. Great ideas get heard, tested, and implemented. **Built like an AI startup, backed by an established company.** Bring your engineering ideas to a business with 25 years of enterprise relationships, operating experience, and real market opportunities. **Engineer something big.** Build AI agents capable of researching 5,000\+ enterprise accounts, identifying buying signals, reaching 250,000\+ potential right contacts, and generating qualified meetings at scale. **See measurable results.** Your agents will directly influence enterprise revenue and help more technology get repaired, reused, and returned to productive use. **Work with people who value builders.** We believe in optimism, discipline, humility, ownership, continuous improvement, and recognizing teammates who help others succeed. **Your mission: Build an intelligent AI\-powered lead generation engine** Design, build, deploy, and continuously improve an interconnected system of specialized AI agents that identifies enterprise buying opportunities and converts them into qualified meetings. You will own the technical outbound engine end to end, from buying\-signal detection and account intelligence to contact discovery, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. Our target market (ICP) includes enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 1,000,000\+ employees, 80%\+ mostly knowledge workers with complex buying committees, and existing technology providers. Your challenge is to find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and create a compelling reason to engage in PlanITROI. *This role reports to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer. You'll work directly with them and the VP of Marketing, with no layers in between.* **Your goal:** Qualified enterprise meetings generated and MSA's signed! **What you will build and own** * **AI Intent Signal Detection Agents.** Identify, ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals, including technology refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, technology initiatives, and social activity. Trigger the right next action. * **AI Buying Committee Intelligence Agents.** Identify high\-value ICP accounts, research enterprise organizations, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts for each entry point, validate contact information, and continuously track changes. * **AI Personalization \& Challenger Messaging Agents.** Combine account intelligence, buying signals, persona\-specific pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context to create relevant, personalized outreach at scale. * **AI Multichannel Orchestration Agents.** Coordinate email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR/BDR follow\-up. Manage sequencing, timing, channel rules, routing, and next\-best actions. * **AI Objection Handling \& Follow\-Up Agents.** Recognize and respond intelligently to objections such as "We already have a provider." Maintain conversational context, determine appropriate follow\-up, and escalate to humans when needed. * **AI Performance \& Optimization Agents.** Measure results across signals, personas, channels, and campaigns. Identify winning and losing hypotheses, recommend experiments, and improve qualified meeting conversion. *These are functional capabilities, not a requirement to deploy six separate agents. You will desi y. Using them isn't the role; building the agents that run on top of them is. We are seeking proven hands\-on expertise in: * **AI agent engineering:** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, agent memory, state management, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * **Agent frameworks:** LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or comparable frameworks. * **Software development:** Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, custom integrations, and automation architecture. * **GTM integrations:** Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense, Bombora\-type intent sources, and AI calling/voicemail platforms. * **Enterprise prospecting:** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying\-committee identification, contact resolution, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. * **Production operations:** Agent monitoring, debugging, data quality, CRM synchronization, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, error handling, and auditability. * **Scale:** Engineering reliable systems capable of very high outbound volumes, reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail, while protecting platform limits, accuracy, compliance, and deliverability. You must understand both the technical engineering and the B2B prospecting strategy required to turn agents into a functioning revenue system. **What success looks like** * **Qualified meetings generated:** Your primary business outcome. Meetings must satisfy defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion:** How effectively your agents convert meaningful buying signals into conversations and qualified meetings. * **Contact Precision:** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Agent deployment velocity:** How quickly you turn a campaign idea into a reliable, working agent and live test. * **Multichannel conversion:** Positive responses, conversations, qualified meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability:** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, compliance, and scalability. * **Learning rate:** How quickly do you identify what isn't working, fix root causes, and scale what produces results. **Our hiring process: Show me, don't tell me** We hire proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished presentations about what agents might do. The process has three stages: * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build a project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show: * Your agent architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, data integrations, and orchestration. * How your agents identify opportunities and execute prospecting workflows. * How do your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human intervention? * Real performance data: qualified meetings, pipelines, conversions, or measurable improvements your systems produced. **Ready for the challenge?** If you love solving difficult technical problems and want to build something ambitious, PlanITROI is where you can make an impact. Bring your engineering expertise, working agents, ideas, and your drive to succeed. We'll bring 25 years of industry experience, enterprise relationships, a substantial market opportunity, and the ability to move fast. **Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow.** *PlanITROI offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and more. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at all levels of the organization.* Learn more: PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| DigitalDreamsProject.com

jobs.title: Lead iOS Engineer, Product Engineering
jobs.description: About Us: Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest\-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21\.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain. The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high\-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non\-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners. At Planet Fitness, our unique mission has always been to enhance people’s lives by providing a high\-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non\-intimidating environment. And we’re proud of the amazing Planet Fitness team that supports our clubs and team members. They are comprised of dynamic, dedicated, and talented individuals who represent our values of integrity, transparency, passion, respect, and excellence (while having fun!) in everything they do. Joining the PF family means being part of a company that cares about bettering the health and wellbeing of our communities. It means being a part of a supportive, engaging workforce with an inclusive culture that values diversity and creates an environment where everyone can feel they belong. It means encouraging professional growth and development. It means making true, lasting connections with your co\-workers with celebrations, team building activities and engaging corporate events! It means creating a positive impact in our local communities through our Judgement Free Generation® philanthropic initiative. It means being part of a brand that you can be proud of! For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started! Overview: The Lead iOS Engineer is a leading velocity contributor for a cross\-functional delivery Pod, responsible for shaping, reinforcing, and executing the technical direction of iOS applications. They drive the design, implementation, and testing of high\-quality, scalable mobile solutions, ensuring strong alignment with modern iOS best practices and user experience standards. They play a critical role in accelerating team delivery by identifying and addressing technical and process bottlenecks, applying pragmatic engineering approaches, and maintaining a high bar for code quality, performance, and reliability. As a senior member of the team, they contribute meaningfully across the full mobile development lifecycle—from architecture and development through testing, release, and ongoing optimization. The Lead iOS Engineer works closely with Product, Design, and cross\-functional engineering partners to deliver user\-centric solutions that meet both business and technical objectives. They bring a strong passion for the iOS platform, championing technologies like Swift, SwiftUI, and Liquid Glass Design, while staying current with evolving platform capabilities and industry trends. They also serve as a mentor and technical leader within the team, supporting the growth of junior engineers, promoting best practices, and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and engineering excellence. This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in\-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work\-from\-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role. Responsibilities: **Technical Contributions*** Actively contributes to the design, implementation, and testing of iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI (with limited UIKit as needed), and modern architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture). * Identifies and removes delivery and quality bottlenecks (e.g., build performance, app performance, release friction) through pragmatic, scalable solutions. * Applies modern iOS practices, including CI/CD, automated testing (unit and UI), observability, and performance monitoring. * Champions iOS platform excellence, including Human Interface Guidelines (HIG), accessibility, responsiveness, and device compatibility. * Contributes to the iOS technical vision and helps evolve mobile architecture and standards. * Leverages AI\-powered tools to improve development efficiency and shares learnings with the team. * Acts as a trusted advisor on iOS\-specific design, architecture, and platform capabilities. * Champions best practices (lifecycle management, state handling, performance optimization, modularization) through code reviews and mentorship. **Cross Functional Collaboration*** Executes delivery plans using modern iOS technologies to build performant, user\-centric mobile experiences. * Proactively identifies and m  Management Information Systems, etc.). Master's degree a plus * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on building and delivering iOS applications in cross\-functional teams * Strong proficiency in Swift and modern iOS development, including SwiftUI and core Apple frameworks (Combine, SwiftData/Core Data, Navigation), required * Deep understanding of iOS fundamentals (lifecycle, state management, concurrency (async/await, GCD), threading, performance optimization), required * Experience with modern architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture) and modularized codebases * Experience with iOS testing (XCTest, XCUITest, Appium) and mobile CI/CD pipelines * Familiarity with Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) and building accessible, responsive UIs across diverse iOS devices * Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with asynchronous patterns (async/await, Combine); GraphQL is a plus * Experience with mobile observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Firebase, Datadog) * Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and mobile\-backend integration patterns * Experience with App Store release processes, versioning, and staged rollouts * Knowledge of defining, measuring, and improving key iOS performance metrics (e.g., startup time, jank/frame drops, hangs/watchdog terminations, crash\-free sessions, memory and battery usage), with experience leveraging profiling and observability tools to drive continuous performance improvements * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools or AI\-enabled features is a plus * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced environments * Strong attention to detail, efficient, and organized with an ability to establish priorities and objectives * Excellent presentation and communication skills along with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization * Able to establish and maintain effective, collaborative work relationships with diverse individuals, internally and externally * Dedicated learner with a natural curiOSity for consistent growth * Exhibits comfort, ease, and flexibility working in an extremely fast\-paced ever\-changing, deadline\-driven environment * Cooperative team player with an upbeat, positive, "can\-do" attitude Perks: Planet Fitness cares about you and your well\-being. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees which includes the core medical, dental, vision, life and disability as well as supplemental accident, hospital and critical illness coverage options. In addition, we are proud to offer eligible employees a generous time off program (including volunteer time), childcare reimbursement, paid parental leave, pet care reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, free Black Card membership, learning and development programs and a whole host of engagement activities. We offer a 401(k) Plan with safe harbor employer matching and an employee stock purchase plan. This role is also eligible to participate in an annual corporate bonus incentive program based on company financial and personal performance. The salary for NH\-based and MA\-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below. This is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with a candidate’s professional experience, qualifications and internal equity. Annual Base Salary Range: $130,000\-$150,000 ***Note to Applicants:*** *We have been made aware of an increasing number of hiring fraud schemes across numerous platforms. Planet Fitness never requires advance payments of any kind for computer equipment or any other purpose at the start of employment. Any request for you to provide payment information during the application process is part of a fraud scheme. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.*

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description: **About Plaud Inc.** Plaud is building the real\-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 2,500,000 users worldwide since 2023\. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity. Plaud Inc. is a Delaware\-incorporated, San Francisco\-based company pushing the boundary of human–AI intelligence through a hardware–software combination. With full ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, GDPR, EN18031, and HIPAA compliances, Plaud is committed to the highest standards of data security and privacy protection. To learn more about Plaud, please visit https://www.plaud.ai and follow along on Instagram, X, Facebook, Linkedin, and YouTube **Why You Should Join Us** Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think. * Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years. * Define the next\-gen paradigm for human\-AI interaction. * Gain exposure to cutting\-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion. * Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success. * Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development. * Market\-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity\-fueled work atmosphere. **What you will do** About the Role * We're looking for a Software Engineer in Test (SDET) to build our quality engineering function from the ground up. You'll own test automation across our consumer and enterprise platforms, embed quality into every stage of the development process, and help build a culture where engineers ship with confidence. This is an engineering role first. We expect you to build, not just test. 1\. Build the Test Automation Platform Build an end\-to\-end automation framework covering Plaud's D2C consumer platform (plaud.ai, web.plaud.com) and B2B Teams product. Integrate tests into CI/CD for continuous feedback. You'll also pioneer the use of AI\-agentic tools — LLM\-driven test generation, agent\-based exploratory testing — to scale coverage in ways traditional approaches can't. 2\. Shift Testing Left Embed into the SDLC from day one — review requirements, define acceptance criteria, and flag testability gaps before code is written. Partner with PMs and engineers so quality is a design input, not an afterthought. 3\. Evangelize a Quality\-First Engineering Culture Be the voice of quality in planning, sprint reviews, and design discussions. Coach engineers on writing testable code and owning quality in their own work. Make quality visible across the team. 4\. Define and Track Quality Metrics Own key KPIs: test coverage, defect escape rate, regression pass rate. jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer, AI and DevSecOps
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- RadarFirst is seeking a Lead Platform Engineer, AI \& DevSecOps Engineer to lead the next stage of our cloud, security, reliability, and AI operations maturity. This role will own the platforms, practices, and operating model that enable our engineering teams to build, deploy, monitor, secure, and continuously improve production SaaS systems and agentic AI capabilities. Since launching RadarFirst's first agentic AI offering using AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, we are expanding the DevOps remit to include production\-grade AI infrastructure and operations. The person in this role will help mature the environment required by customers in highly regulated industries, including governance, secure agent/tool access, observability, continuous LLM and agent evaluations, traceability, incident response, cost controls, and operational readiness for future agent development. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. The right candidate is an experienced platform, DevSecOps, or SRE leader who can set direction, build shared engineering practices, mentor others, and create a more DevOps\-forward engineering culture across historically siloed teams. This position can be based out of our HQ in Portland, OR, or remote from anywhere in the U.S. **Our Technical Stack** ----------------------- Our front end is built with Angular and Material Design, using TypeScript for strong typing and maintainability. Backend services are written in Go and Nest.js. Technologies currently in use include Packer, Ansible, Docker, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, Go, Bash, Datadog, Git, TeamCity, Jira, Slack, and Google's productivity suite. We deploy on AWS using EC2, ECS, RDS\-hosted PostgreSQL, S3, OpenSearch, Lambda, SES, CloudWatch, IAM, and related AWS services. Our agentic AI environment uses AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, with a growing need for AI\-specific observability, evaluation, governance, and operational automation. **Essential Responsibilities \& Duties** ---------------------------------------- ### **Platform and Reliability** * Own and evolve the DevSecOps, platform engineering, and AI operations roadmap, with clear goals for reliability, security, deployment maturity, developer productivity, auditability, and customer readiness. * Design, implement, and operate secure, scalable, fault\-tolerant AWS infrastructure for SaaS and AI workloads. * Implement automation to reduce manual deployment, provisioning, compliance, monitoring, and support work. * Monitor platform KPIs and cost drivers, including cloud spend, token consumption, model usage, latency, error rates, deployment frequency, change failure rate, recovery time, and operational toil. ### **AI Operations** * Lead the operational maturity of RadarFirst's agentic AI platform, including the management of AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, agent/tool governance, policy controls, observability, evaluation workflows, and cost management. * Build observability across infrastructure, applications, and agentic workflows, including logs, metrics, traces, token usage, latency, error rates, tool invocation behavior, evaluation results, and customer\-impacting SLOs. * Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, and Customer\-facing teams to ensure AI systems meet expectations for regulated industries, including auditability, access control, privacy, traceability, incident response, and defensible governance. * Define and evolve CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and release\-management practices that improve speed, safety, reproducibility, and rollback confidence. ### **Security and Governance** * Lead incident response and reliability improvement efforts, including post\-incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, alert tuning, runbooks, operational readiness reviews, and long\-term remediation. * Maintain and improve security practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, secrets management, authentication, authorization, vulnerability scanning, and software supply chain controls. ### **Leadership and Culture** * Create shared engineering standards and paved paths that help product engineers ship safely without waiting on bespoke DevOps support. * Drive a DevOps\-forward engineering culture by reducing team silos, improving ownership models, clarifying operational responsibilities, and coaching teams on secure, observable, supportable software delivery. * Mentor DevOps, platform, and software engineers; help develop future technical leaders and raise the organization's operational bar. Opportunity exists for people management for a small team. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a closely related engineering role. * Proven track record designing and operating production AWS infrastructure for SaaS or enterprise software environments. * Experience leading technical cal, and troubleshooting skills. ### **Strong Plus** * Hands\-on experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, or comparable agentic AI platforms. * Experience implementing LLM or agent evaluation frameworks, including automated regression tests, golden datasets, human review workflows, prompt/version management, safety checks, and release thresholds. * Experience building governance for agent tool access, including policy enforcement, identity, permissions, audit trails, redaction, approval flows, and controlled access to internal systems. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Datadog, Langfuse, Arize/Phoenix, Promptfoo, TruLens, OpenAI Evals, or similar AI observability/evaluation tools. * Experience with regulated customers in healthcare, insurance, financial services, government, or privacy/security\-sensitive industries. * SaaS scale\-up experience. * Certifications or training such as SANS/SEC\-540, SSCP, CISSP, CAP, CSSLP, HCISPP, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security Specialty, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more likely to doubt the strength of their qualifications, so we encourage you to submit an application if you're interested in this role despite any reservations you may have about your background or skill set. **Who We Are** -------------- At RadarFirst, our mission is to make regulatory risk and data privacy simple, actionable, and sustainable. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud\-seeding science with weather\-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course\-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud\-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. We work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and flight operations teams to turn new hardware into reliable systems that can be built, deployed, and operated at scale. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed. ### **About the Role** You will own embedded firmware across Rainmaker’s vehicle and its integration with our onboard and ground control software systems. Your scope includes flight\-controller firmware, power distribution, sensor and payload controllers, and the interfaces connecting those systems to onboard Linux software. You will take work from architecture and board bring\-up through testing, manufacturing, deployment, and support in the field. We’re looking for a high\-agency engineer who identifies what needs to happen, turns incomplete requirements into a clear plan, and follows through until the hardware works reliably in real operating conditions. This is a hands\-on technical ownership role with the autonomy to shape the firmware architecture and the responsibility to deliver it.### **What You'll Do** * Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of all embedded firmware across the vehicle, including flight\-controller firmware, power distribution, sensors, and seeding payloads. * Set firmware priorities, identify reliability risks and technical gaps, and drive projects from an ambiguous problem to a validated release. * Bring up new boards with electrical engineers: read schematics, validate interfaces, write drivers, and debug failures at the boundary between hardware and software. * Develop dependable device communication and command handling over CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C, with clear contracts for telemetry, timing, and fault behavior. * Integrate firmware with our vehicle software so commands, device state, and telemetry behave consistently from the microcontroller to the operator. * Design and validate safe startup states, watchdogs, interlocks, and recovery behavior for resets, communication loss, sensor faults, and interrupted updates. * Own firmware builds, versioning, flashing, over\-the\-air updates, and recovery workflows so deployed vehicles run known, traceable software. * Build automated tests, simulation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop coverage that catch regressions and exercise failure modes before releases reach the fleet. * Partner with manufacturing and flight operations to make provisioning, calibration, diagnostics, and servicing repeatable and practical. * Investigate bench and field failures using logs, telemetry, and lab instruments; resolve root causes and turn what you learn into better software and tests. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing embedded software or firmware for microcontroller\-based systems, including board bring\-up, hardware integration, and deployment into production or field use. * Demonstrated ownership of an embedded subsystem from design through release and ongoing support, including making technical decisions independently, validating behavior on hardware, and resolving failures in real operating conditions. * Strong systems programming skills in Rust and/or C/C\+\+, with the ability and willingness to work across both Rust and C/C\+\+ codebases. * Practical experience with peripheral drivers and communication buses such as CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C. * Comfort reading schematics and using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers to isolate problems across electrical and software boundaries. * The ability to reason about system failures and implement robust state machines, fault detection, safe outputs, and recovery paths. * Experience building maintainable firmware with version control, reproducible builds, automated testing, and disciplined release practices. * Evidence of high agency: you surface problems without waiting to be assigned, make sound decisions with incomplete information, ask for help when it matters, and close the loop on results. * Clear communication and the ability to work closely with hardware engineers and operators, explain tradeoffs, and document decisions so others can build and service what you ship. ### **What Will Set You Apart** * Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, or other systems where software controls physical equipment in demanding conditions. * Familiarity with PX4, MAVLink, flight\-controller development, or flight\-critical software. ### **What Success Looks Like In the First 90 Days** You have mapped the vehicle’s firmware, hardware interfaces, build and update paths, and most consequential reliability risks, and the team has a clear plan for what to address first. You can independently build, flash, instrument, and debug the key embedded systems and trace their behavior through our vehicle software. You have delivered a meaningful firmware improvement through bench and integration testing into an operational release, working with flight operations to verify its behavior in the field. You have improved at least one recurring source of friction in testing, provisioning, updates, or diagnostics, and established a practical ownership and release cadence for the firmware stack. **Supporting the people behind the mission** Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. We want the people doing it to feel supported—in the work we share and the lives they’re building. * **A stake in what we build.** Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team. * **Support for your health.** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * **An investment in your future.** A 401(k) with employer matching to help you build long\-term savings. * **Time to recharge.** Unlimited PTO for rest, exploration, and the people and pursuits that matter to you. * **Time for a growing family.** Paid parental leave for both parents to welcome a child and spend time together. * **Lunch together.** Daily lunch provided at our El Segundo headquarters—a chance to share a meal and connect with teammates. * **Help making the move.** Relocation assistance for eligible roles to support your transition to Rainmaker.

jobs.description: **DIRECTOR, AI \& DATA SCIENCE** Data Engineering \& Analytics, AI, and Data Science \| Full\-Time, Salaried \| Player\-Coach \| Reports to the Co\-CEOs **Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media) **Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA **Team** Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps **Education** Bachelor’s degree in a technical field required. Master’s or PhD preferred. **Compensation** $175,000 to $225,000 base **Schedule** Collaboration across time zones. Regular working\-hour overlap with our Singapore Dev team and partners is required. **Travel** Required for team weeks and quarterly planning in Las Vegas **About the Role** Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a lean company of about 60 people, so every leader here builds. You will lead our combined Data Engineering \& Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co\-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous\-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself. Your first mandate is to achieve 100% AI automation of routine user\-uploaded content moderation, with accuracy proven superior to our human moderators and at a lower total cost. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results. Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them. This role is for someone who manages a hands\-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading. **What You Will Do** **1\. Set the foundation in your first 30 days** * Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it. * Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps. * Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix. **2\. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%** * Test the AI and our moderators on the same held\-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy\-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals. * Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback. **3\. Build systems that keep getting better** * Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test. * Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back. **4\. Run production AI like a business** * Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills. * Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance. Keep one executive dashboard and run a weekly review with the Co\-CEOs. **5\. Automate support, then partner across Seeking** * Own AI customer support end to end: agents that resolve tickets and execute approved actions, such as subscription changes and eligible refunds, held to the same evaluation, rollout, and monitoring standards as moderation. * Once moderation and support are delivered, partner with the leaders of Marketing, Product, and other departments on fraud, matching, onboarding, monetization, and retention. Bring the Co\-CEOs a ranked list of opportunities by impact on cost, revenue, efficiency, and member experience. * In those partnerships, department leaders own their business outcomes. Your team owns the models, infrastructure, evaluation, and learning systems, and is accountable for their performance. **6\. Lead and grow the team** * Review each person's work line by line, pair on hard problems, and give direct feedback every week. Build a growth plan for everyone, recruit strong talent, and address performance gaps early. * Set quarterly OKRs for the function and each direct report, with leading and lagging KPIs for every Key Result. Run the work in Jira, Confluence, and Monday. **What You Must Bring** * A Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field. A Master’s or Ph.D. in CS, AI, ML, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred. * Seven or more years delivering production data or ML systems, including three or more years managing teams of individual contributors. You manage a hands\-on team today, or did so recently. * Strong Python and SQL, with production code you personally wrote in the past year. You will code in the interview. * Production ML and architecture judgment. You have designed, built, and operated ML and LLM systems end to end, from data pipelines through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, on a major cloud platform. * You have done this before. You led an AI automation program in moderation, trust and safety, support, or a comparable decision system, from a measured human baseline to automated decisions at scale. * Evaluation rigor and continuous learning. You measure false negatives and false positives separately, report uncertainty, keep test data clean, and have built systems that improve through feedback and controlled updates. * Measurable business impact. You can name the cost, revenue, efficiency, or member outcomes your work moved, with the numbers. * Cross\-functional influence. You have found AI opportunities in other departments, won over their leaders, and taken the solution from concept into production. * A record of mentoring engineers and scientists into stronger, more senior contributors. * Daily use of Claude, Claude Code, Cowork, or comparable AI tools. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you. **Nice to Have** * Production work in multi\-modal or computer vision moderation, fraud detection, recommender systems, or marketing and monetization models such as propensity, pricing, and lifetime value. * Our stack: AWS (S3, Redshift, SageMaker, Bedrock), Looker, and Kubernetes. **Compensation** * $175,000 to $225,000 base, commensurate with experience. Full\-time, salaried, remote within the US. * 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision. 50% 401(k) match up to 6%. Flexible Spending Account and flexible paid time off. **How We Hire** * Recruiter screen: code you wrote in the last 90 days, the team you manage, and logistics. * Practical round: live SQL and Python, plus a production architecture discussion. * Systems round: work through a simplified moderation workflow. Find where items fall back to humans, define an honest automation rate, and design the evaluation against human moderators. * Co\-CEO round: treat it as a pitch. Study the product, ask sharp questions, and bring your 90\-day plan for moderation and customer support. * References, including a former direct report. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check. QtKLmXwX64

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team:** ------------------- Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We are building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large\-scale enterprise transformation. **About the role:** ------------------- We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production\-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real\-world data. You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re\-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low\-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions. * Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems. * Turn complex processes into multi\-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire\-to\-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs. * Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling. * Leverage full\-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high\-ownership, user\-facing agent systems. * Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts. * Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human\-in\-the\-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time. * Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused. **Experience you’ll need:** --------------------------- * Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands\-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes. * Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces. * A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here. ### **Software engineering skills and best practices:** * System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures. * Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Unlike traditional centralized engineering roles, the Forward Deployed AI Engineer will be heavily embedded with our Construction project teams; partnering side\-by\-side with Project Managers, Superintendents, Project Engineers, and Field Operations. You will act as the technical bridge between enterprise AI capabilities and day\-to\-day jobsite workflows, rapidly prototyping, integrating, and deploying custom AI solutions directly into field operations. This role requires strong hands\-on AI coding proficiency, deep cloud expertise on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), a product\-focused mindset, and a willingness to operate on active project sites to drive tangible business value in construction delivery. submittals, RFIs, change orders). * Construction Data Integration: Connect solutions, models and pipelines into existing construction ecosystems (such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, ERPs, and document repositories). * Feedback Loop and Scale: Serve as the critical feedback loop between construction site realities and the centralized AI team, turning field\-tested prototypes into scalable enterprise solutions. * Culture Building: Actively participate in fostering Ryan’s data and AI culture through promoting data\-driven decision\-making. **What we expect you to have:** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying generative AI, machine learning or advanced software solutions in enterprise or field environments. * Advanced proficiency and hands\-on workflow mastery utilizing agentic coding environments and AI harnesses (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or comparable tools) to accelerate software architecture, coding, testing, and system delivery. * impactful and valuable AI solutions. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with diverse skill sets and work styles. * Resourceful, entrepreneurial, and innovative mindset, with a drive to tackle ambiguous challenges effectively. * Commitment to staying updated on AI trends and leveraging them to deliver business value. * Understanding of ethical and responsible AI principles and practices **Preferred Experience** * Prior exposure to Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC), commercial real estate, or industrial operations. * Familiarity with construction tools and APIs (Procore, Autodesk BIM 360 / ACC, Bluebeam, DroneDeploy). * Experience designing conversational interfaces or automated field data capture workflows (voice\-to\-text, field forms) **Compensation:** The base pay range is $100,000 \- $130,000/Annually. jobs.title: Lead Mechanical Engineer 1 - Nuclear
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Sargent \& Lundy is seeking a Senior Mechanical Project Engineer to support nuclear plant modification and engineering projects at the Calvert Cliffs Clean Energy Center. The role will require approximately two to three days on\-site each week at CCCEC, with the flexibility to work remotely the other days. The successful candidate will provide senior\-level mechanical engineering direction, coordinate multidisciplinary activities, and serve as a key technical interface among Sargent \& Lundy, Constellation, CCCEC station personnel, vendors, and project stakeholders. The role will support mechanical system evaluations, plant modifications, Engineering Change packages, calculations, studies, equipment and piping design, specifications, design reviews, field walkdowns, and implementation support. The engineer will also contribute to project execution by managing assigned scope, budget, schedule, deliverables, risks, and technical interfaces. **Responsibilities:** * Lead or support mechanical engineering activities for nuclear plant modifications and related projects at CCCEC. * Develop and review mechanical design inputs, calculations, evaluations, studies, reports, drawings, specifications, and implementation documentation. * Support engineering for mechanical systems and equipment, including pumps, piping, heat exchangers, HVAC, balance\-of\-plant systems, supports, and mechanical interfaces, as assigned. * Prepare and review Engineering Change packages and related conceptual, detailed, and implementation\-phase deliverables. * Evaluate system performance, equipment impacts, operating conditions, design requirements, and mechanical interfaces associated with plant modifications and power uprate activities. * Review vendor drawings, calculations, specifications, equipment data, and other technical submittals; identify missing information and follow up on required vendor inputs. * Participate in project kickoff meetings, technical focus meetings, design reviews, milestone reviews, field walkdowns, constructability reviews, comment\-resolution meetings, and client coordination meetings. * Coordinate mechanical interfaces with electrical, I\&C, structural, civil, fire protection, licensing, procurement, construction, operations, and other disciplines. * Support installation, testing, startup, outage, and implementation activities, including development or review of implementation and testing documentation. * Serve as a technical liaison with Constellation and CCCEC personnel and communicate technical issues, assumptions, decisions, risks, and required actions clearly and promptly. * Develop mechanical input to multidisciplinary budgets, schedules, work plans, proposals, and resource plans. * Monitor assigned scope, budget, schedule, progress, and deliverable status; identify trends early and elevate risks before commitments are affected. * Support project controls and change management, including evaluation of scope growth, schedule impacts, budget impacts, and changes to technical requirements. * Ensure work is performed in accordance with applicable Sargent \& Lundy procedures, client procedures, quality requirements, codes, standards, and project instructions. * Support client presentations, proposal development, technical discussions, and identification of follow\-on engineering opportunities. **Other Opportunities Provided:** * The opportunity to work on challenging nuclear power projects with experienced engineers and project professionals. * A multidisciplinary environment that supports technical growth, collaboration, and professional development. * The opportunity to contribute to projects that support safe, reliable, and carbon\-free energy. * A hybrid work arrangement that combines remote flexibility with regular onsite collaboration at CCCEC. Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.*** **Required Qualifications:** + Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; equivalent experience may be considered. + Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible mechanical engineering and project experience. + Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating mechanical engineering work for complex industrial, utility, power\-generation, or nuclear projects. + Experience developing or reviewing mechanical calculations, evaluations, drawings, specifications, reports, and technical documentation. + Experience coordinating technical work across multiple disciplines and managing interfaces among engineering, design, procurement, vendors, construction, operations, and client organizations. + Experience with project planning, task budgeting, schedule development or monitoring, progress reporting, change management, and risk identification. + Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. + Ability  plier technical questions. + Familiarity with applicable nuclear industry codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and quality\-assurance practices. + Experience with field walkdowns, constructability reviews, installation support, testing, startup, or commissioning activities. + Proficiency with common engineering, project\-controls, document\-management, and Microsoft Office tools. Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology\-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description. About Sargent \& Lundy: At Sargent \& Lundy, we care about the health and well\-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work\-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award\-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024\. **Health \& Wellness** **Financial Benefits** **Work\-Life Balance** * Health Plans: Medical, Dental, Vision * Life \& Accident Insurance * Disability Coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Back\-Up Daycare * FSA \& HSA * 401(k) * Pre\-Tax Commuter Account * Merit Scholarship Program * Employee Discount Program * Corporate Charitable Giving Program * Tuition Assistance * First Professional Licensure Bonus * Employee Referral Bonus * Paid Annual Personal/Sick Time (PST) * Paid Vacation * Paid Holidays * Paid Parental Leave * Paid Bereavement Leave * Flexible Work Arrangements Compensation Range: $118,023 \- $180,313 Transparency Statement: Sargent \& Lundy discloses compensation ranges that comply with all local and state regulations. The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well\-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus. About This Business Unit: Join Sargent \& Lundy's Nuclear Power Group and be part of a team driving the future of clean, carbon\-free energy. Since 1954, we’ve been a trusted leader in nuclear engineering, design, and licensing, with expertise spanning small modular reactors (SMRs), advanced reactor technology (ART), and first\-of\-a\-kind commercial reactor restart projects. Our work supports life extensions and digital modernization of existing nuclear plants, coal\-to\-nuclear conversion initiatives with the Department of State, and international nuclear new\-build projects. With a commitment to safety, innovation, and sustainability, we provide cutting\-edge solutions that power communities worldwide while reducing emissions. Shape the future of global energy with us! Equal Opportunity: Sargent \& Lundy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any protected status as defined by applicable law.
