As a Process Engineer on the Inspection System team, you will help define and support the inspection technologies used across SEL’s manufacturing operations. Rather than supporting a single product or process area, you will specify, validate, and continuously improve SPI, AOI, and AXI systems deployed across multiple factories and product families. This role emphasizes data‑driven decision‑making, clear acceptance criteria, and strong supplier collaboration. You will work closely with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to ensure inspection systems are robust, measurable, and aligned with real manufacturing risk. This work helps establish inspection standards that support SEL’s long‑term reliability and quality commitments. **A typical day as a Process Engineer might include:** * Providing engineering support in multiple areas of manufacturing. * Specifying, developing, justifying, implementing, and sustaining assembly equipment and materials. * Improving quality, yield, efficiency, and capacity of processes in accordance with strategic objectives. * Applying statistical problem solving to identify root causes. * Evaluating new equipment and processes and process improvement activities. * Interpreting results and providing recommendations to management. * Keeping abreast of new developments in equipment, industry standards, best practices, and developments in assembly processes. * Modeling, teaching, and applying SEL Values, Principles of Operations, and World Class Manufacturing Principles. **This job might be for you if:** * You have a B.S. in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience. * You have two years' experience in process development in a related world class manufacturing company. * You can lead a cross functional team. * You can influence others and reach consensus. * You have project management experience. * You have knowledge of statistics as applied to process capability measurements. * You have effective writing, documentation, and speaking skills. * You can work cooperatively in a team environment. * You have background check results satisfactory to SEL. * You have negative drug test result(s). **It is a plus if you have:** * Thorough understanding of the materials used in the industry. **Physical Requirements** None **About Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories** SEL designs, manufactures, and supports products and systems that protect, monitor, control, and automate electric power systems. Our technologies help detect faults, prevent equipment damage, and reduce the impact of power outages. Our mission is to make electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical. Employees contribute to practical, high\-quality solutions used every day, where attention to detail and quality directly support the reliability of the electric grid. **Location:** **Nampa, ID** – This position is located in Nampa, ID, in the heart of the Treasure Valley. Enjoy a thriving community with a family\-friendly atmosphere, affordable living, and convenient access to the amenities of the greater Boise metropolitan area. Residents benefit from nearby outdoor recreation, including rivers, lakes, mountains, and miles of trails, as well as excellent schools, local events, and a growing economy that makes Nampa a great place to live and work. **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.** People are at the core of our company and we hire employee\-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. * We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. **Pay Range: $89,400 \- $134,100 annually** We set starting pay based on job\-related factors such as your experience, training, knowledge, and skills. We are looking to fill this position at the Process Engineer level, and we welcome applicants with a range of experience. Depending on your background, we may consider you for a different level, with compensation aligned accordingly. Associate Process Engineer: $82,000 – $122,900 annually Process Engineer: $89,400 \- $134,100 annually Lead Process Engineer: $107,600 – $161,500 annually **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com. SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company:** Marigold is a fast\-growing marketing technology company helping growing businesses build stronger customer relationships through its three core platforms: Emma, Campaign Monitor, and Vuture. We deliver powerful tools for email, SMS, and marketing automation that elevate engagement and drive real results. Marigold is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee with offices in Sydney and London. **The Role:** At Emma, we’re looking for a driven, curious software engineer to join our team. The Emma Engineering organization is made up of passionate engineers focused on building elegant, reliable tooling that helps our customers succeed in their email marketing efforts. Our teams operate with clear ownership boundaries, allowing engineers to specialize, deepen their expertise, and build sustainable software that’s easy to support and evolve over time. We take pride in crafting creative, scalable solutions for a wide range of customers—and we genuinely enjoy doing it together. This is an entry\-level, Software Engineer role. On the frontend, we work primarily with React and supporting libraries, including a proprietary UI toolkit. Our backend systems are Python\-driven, Django, and AWS\-based. Experience in any of these areas is a plus, but a strong desire to learn and grow across the full stack is essential. Within your first six months, you’ll also have opportunities to contribute to additional areas of development as you continue to build your skills and expand your technical foundation. **What You’ll Do:** * Build and ship code that solves real problems for real customers. Engineering is central to what we do, and you’ll work closely with your team to plan, experiment, and deliver impactful solutions. * Collaborate in code reviews, sharing ideas, learning from others, and helping raise the bar on quality and best practices. * Get hands\-on with how Emma builds intuitive, scalable tooling that helps marketing teams do their best work. * Have fun while doing it! We care deeply about our customers, move with intention, and genuinely enjoy building great products together. * Use AI\-assisted tools thoughtfully to research, prototype, and build, while learning how to apply them responsibly in a production codebase. **About You:** You’re an early\-career developer who’s excited to learn, grow, and contribute as part of a collaborative engineering team. While you may not be a master of React, Python, or AWS yet, you bring curiosity, strong potential, and a genuine desire to build your skills and learn best practices. You care deeply about technology, the products you help create, and the customers who rely on them. You enjoy variety in your work, are eager to take on new challenges, and are motivated by opportunities to expand your knowledge and grow alongside a supportive team. You're comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, and you know that good engineering still means understanding, questioning, and owning the code you ship. **Ideal** **Qualifications:** * Early\-career developer or recent graduate with a strong interest in software engineering * Foundational experience or exposure to modern technologies such as React, Python, AWS, or similar tools * Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, frameworks, and best practices * Passion for building quality products with the end user in mind * Comfortable working across different areas of the codebase and contributing where needed * Strong collaboration skills and openness to feedback and continuous improvement * Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to speed up your work, and able to critically review, test, and own the code they help produce **Location Eligibility** This position is eligible for hire in the following US states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. **Compensation \& Benefits** **Compensation:** The base salary range for this role is $70,000 \-$80,000 annually. The compensation range represents the pay the Company reasonably expects to offer for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and applicable law. **Benefits:** * Competitive benefits including: medical/dental/vision insurance, life/accident/disabilities insurance, supplemental health benefits, FSA, EAP and pet insurance * Generous time off (we call it Open Time Away) as well as paid holidays and a birthday benefit day off. * Paid Volunteer Time * 401k plan with a company match on your contributions. * Employee\-centric and supportive remote work environment with flexibility. * Support for life events including paid parental leave.

For more information, visit www.shift4\.com. Shift4 is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to join our Data Platform team and own the pipelines that move data from our production systems into the analytics warehouse. At present, multiple ECS services and SQS queues handle the replication of Aurora MySQL into Snowflake. Tomorrow, it will include more sources and more consumers. This is a hands\-on infrastructure role focused on the throughput, reliability, sizing, cost, and observability of the pipes themselves. Data modeling, warehouse cost management, and business transformation logic are owned by other teams. You make sure the data gets there, on time, every time, while embracing the Shift4 way. **Responsibilities** * Operate, tune, and scale the ECS/SQS\-based ingestion pipelines from Aurora MySQL into tune throughput versus cost across ECS, SQS, and Snowflake ingestion (Snowpipe/COPY, stages) * Onboard new sources and consumers to the platform in partnership with application, data, and analytics teams * Apply data\-quality and security controls appropriate for PCI\-compliant or payment\-handling environments: encryption, secrets handling, least\-privilege access, audit trails * Proactively explore and apply AI tools to improve efficiency across the pipeline lifecycle (development, testing, runbooks, and documentation) **Qualifications** * 5\+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps roles supporting data\-intensive systems in production * Deep hands\-on AWS experience: ECS/Fargate (task sizing, autoscaling, deployments), SQS (throughput, DLQs, visibility timeouts, batching), S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and Aurora/RDS from the operator side * Proven track record tuning message\-driven workloads: consumer concurrency, backpressure, retries, idempotency, throughput versus cost * Experience operating pipelines into Snowflake from the ingestion side (Snowpipe/COPY, stages, load monitoring) * Infrastructure as code with Terraform/Ansible, containerization with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines * Observability and alerting for pipeline health and lag using Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, or the Elastic Stack * Enough Python to read, debug, and instrument worker code * Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience * Strong SQL and dbt skills, including incremental models and testing * Hands\-on Snowflake experience, including semantic modeling * Commitment to data quality, with experience building tests and monitoring that catch issues before stakeholders do * Experience working with product working in a regulated environment with privacy and compliance requirements * The ownership and end\-to\-end thinking to see a problem from raw data to a metric someone trusts * Strong communication skills with technical and non\-technical partners **Nice to Have** * Snowflake Cortex, CoWork agents, or other LLM\-based tooling * Working knowledge of statistics and experimentation * Healthcare, claims, or insurance background; HIPAA familiarity * Python for pipelines or lightweight applications * Fivetran or other ELT experience, including troubleshooting sync and CDC issues * Tableau or other BI tools **What You'll Get** * Competitive salary, bonus opportunity, and equity package * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits * A 401k retirement plan * Paid vacation and company diverse team. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Components & Device Actions
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area. More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation! SmartThings is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join the Components and Device Actions (CODA) team. CODA owns the core device and location cloud services that the rest of the SmartThings platform builds on: how devices are described, organized, and managed, and how homes and their contents are represented and handed between owners. You'll join a tight\-knit team of experienced engineers running mission\-critical services at scale, with a roadmap that spans new platform capabilities, modernization of our stack, and growing demand from enterprise customers. It's a role with real influence over where these services go next. This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!). The pay range for this role is **$139,000 to $198,000,** with an annual bonus target of 20%.### **Key Responsibilities** In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:* **Technical Strategy:** Chart the long\-term direction for one or more CODA domains so our device and location services keep pace with platform growth. * **Complex Initiatives:** Own large, ambiguous, multi\-team efforts from first sketch to well\-run production launch. * **Architecture for Reliability \& Scale:** Steer design for the services behind device capabilities, device groups, locations, and ownership transfer, including event\-driven state processing and the demands of enterprise customers. Reliability, performance, and security shape the design from day one. * **Platform Modernization:** Lead the evolution of our stack while balancing security, maintainability, and cost. * **AI Practices \& Vision:** Shape how the team adopts AI\-assisted development and operational tooling, deciding where it genuinely improves speed and quality. * **Partnership Across Teams:** Work alongside global platform, product, and partner teams that build on CODA, keeping priorities aligned with product needs and business goals. * **Mentorship \& Team Growth:** Coach engineers at every level and build habits that lift the bar across the organization. * **Service Ownership:** SmartThings teams run what they build. You'll share responsibility for production support, from planning through deployment. ### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** **What You Bring On Day One (Required Qualifications)*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field * 8\+ years of production software engineering with a record of Staff\-level leadership * Fluency in JVM languages (Java, Kotlin, etc.) and frameworks (Spring Boot, Micronaut, etc). * A hands\-on record designing and operating distributed microservices and RESTful APIs on AWS at scale, with Terraform and Docker in your toolkit * Sound judgment across data and messaging layers: DynamoDB versus relational stores, and event\-driven systems built on Kafka or similar * Working knowledge of AI development tools and practices * Proven ability to lead design reviews, steer direction across teams, and turn complex problems into simple solutions, with clear written and verbal communication for technical and non\-technical audiences **Desired Skills*** Zero\-downtime migrations and large\-scale data backfills on live systems * Observability, failure testing, and disciplined release practices * Kubernetes and container orchestration in production * Agentic coding tools, and a habit of sharing what works * Multi\-tenant platforms with permissions, usage limits, and rate limiting ### **SmartThings Benefits** * We offer an attractive compensation package with comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health; an HSA with employer contribution; life \& disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more. * All of our employees enjoy unlimited PTO, 12 paid holidays, and a generous parental leave policy (8 weeks fully paid parental leave and 8 more fully paid weeks for childbirth recovery leave). * Eligible employees benefit from our education reimbursement program, and all employees enjoy access to learning resources through O’Reilly. * Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging is embedded into our culture and our work, and everyone has frequent opportunities to join forums and groups and participate in ongoing projects. * We offer a parking stipend to cover the monthly garage cost. EV chargers are also onsite. * In\-office catered lunches once a week. * Access to the onsite gym. Base compensation range for this position is $139,000 to $198,000\. Actual base within this range will depend on many factors including experience, skills, technical expertise and market alignment. In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance. At SmartThings, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all. If you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process or to perform the requirements of the job, we will work with you to meet your needs in compliance with applicable laws. Please reach out to talent@smartthings.com and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will connect with you further!### **About SmartThings** **Creating a safer, smarter world with you.** SmartThings brings your home to life by being the leading open platform for the consumer Internet of Things. Bringing together developers, device makers, and service providers to make the world a smarter place. From a door that knows when to lock itself, to a living room that can get the party started or a sink that can help to call a plumber; the opportunities are endless to make everyday objects around us more useful. So if you’re innovative, not afraid to challenge status quo, collaborative and have a passion for technology, then you’ve found your next home with SmartThings!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Agent Marketplace
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Staff Software Engineer – File Ingestion (Customer\-Facing Services)** ======================================================================== ### **Build the Future of the AI Data Cloud** Snowflake’s File Ingestion team owns the core engines behind **COPY INTO** and **Snowpipe** — the primary arteries landing customer data into the AI Data Cloud at hundreds of petabytes per quarter. We are expanding our core mission to build next\-generation, **external\-facing ingestion services** that directly expose file\-ingest capabilities to external platforms, partner ecosystems, and customer applications. As a **Staff Software Engineer**, you will lead the architectural vision and execution for these mission\-critical, customer\-facing services. You will operate at the intersection of high\-throughput distributed systems, API platform design, and direct customer feature delivery, defining how enterprise data seamlessly flows into Snowflake at global scale. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Drive Technical Vision \& Architecture:** Define the multi\-year architecture and technical strategy for high\-throughput, external\-facing ingestion services and APIs across multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). * **Deliver Customer\-Facing Innovations:** Lead the end\-to\-end execution of enterprise\-grade external features, ensuring low\-latency data landing, high availability, and seamless ecosystem integration (e.g., Snowpark Connect, partner connectors). * **Set Technical Direction:** Author foundational design documents, establish technical standards for reliability, security, and scalability, and lead high\-stakes architectural reviews across engineering orgs. * **Lead Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner closely with Principal Architects, Product Management, Security, and external developer platforms to translate customer requirements into resilient system architecture. * **Elevate Engineering Excellence:** Mentor and sponsor Senior, Mid\-level, and Junior engineers; raise the bar for system design, code quality, testing methodologies, and operational maturity. * **Direct Customer \& Strategic Impact:** Engage with enterprise customer engineering teams to solve complex integration challenges, debug production edge cases at scale, and turn direct customer feedback into core platform capabilities. ### **What We’re Looking For** * **10\+ years** of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems or cloud\-native infrastructure in production. * Proven track record of **architectural leadership**, having successfully taken complex, customer\-facing services or external APIs from initial concept to General Availability (GA) and global scale. * **Expert proficiency in Java or C\+\+** (strong preference for engineers comfortable working across both systems\-level C\+\+ and managed service Java frameworks). * Deep expertise in **external API design, cloud service orchestration**, and building resilient, multi\-tenant customer\-facing endpoints. * Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following: high\-throughput ingestion pipelines, distributed query execution engines, messaging/streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar), or database internals. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to drive technical consensus across cross\-functional leadership, product partners, and external technical stakeholders. * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience building and scaling **external developer platforms, SDKs, or public SaaS APIs** serving external consumers. * Deep expertise with **open table formats** (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and integration with ecosystems like Apache Spark or Ray. * Advanced performance engineering expertise: memory management, SIMD, vectorization, lock\-free data structures, or I/O optimization at PB\-scale. * Strong background in metadata management, transactional state machines, or consensus protocols (e.g., Raft, Paxos). * Active contributor to open\-source data infrastructure, cloud\-native compute systems, or query engines. ### **Why This Team** * **Massive Strategic Impact:** You will lead the expansion of Snowflake's most critical data\-path surface into direct, customer\-facing integrations that unlock new platform ecosystems and drive platform volume. * **Broad Architectural Scope:** Your work will bridge edge API layers, control\-plane orchestrators, file scanners/parsers, query planners, and underlying storage engines. * **High Customer Visibility:** Work directly on features that power the external integrations for Fortune 500 enterprises, seeing the immediate revenue and performance impact of your architecture. * **Culture of Technical Leadership:** Partner directly with Snowflake’s top architects and leads in an environment that values deep technical autonomy, rigorous engineering, and long\-term architectural stewardship. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $236,000 \- $339,200\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Marketing Technologies Director** The Marketing Technologies Director, leads PlayStation's global marketing technology organization across engineering, product management, UX, measurement and experimentation, audience activation, and marketing data. This leader owns the technology vision, architecture, product strategy, and roadmap for platforms used by marketers worldwide to reach hundreds of millions of players. jobs.title: Manager, IT Quality Assurance - Grade 15
jobs.description: At **Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU)**, our members are at the heart of everything we do. The Manager will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, define project scope, and ensure high\-quality software solutions are tested and delivered on time. **Why Join SCCU?** * **Member\-Focused Mission:** Be part of a not\-for\-profit organization that reinvests in its members. * **Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options:** Available for select positions. This position is Hybrid with 2 days per week required in office. * **Career Growth:** We prioritize internal promotions and offer on\-the\-job training. **Manger of IT Quality Assurance Key Responsibilities:** * Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the IT quality assurance and business analysis teams. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting professional growth and development opportunities. * Recruit, mentor, and develop team members to ensure high performance and career growth. Set clear goals and objectives for the teams and monitor performance against these targets. * Collaborate closely with Systems Development, and other departments to translate business requirements into technical specifications and solutions. * Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle. * Work closely with project managers and teams to ensure QA and BA activities are integrated into project plans and timelines. Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of IT business analysis and quality assurance processes. * Tool selection for QA and BA teams to mature their processes within the organization. Quality Assurance * Oversee the quality assurance process, including test planning, execution, and reporting. Engineers will own all aspects from design and development to build and operations. You will be expected to define and improve team processes and to contribute to scaling and maintenance efforts. This is a highly technical, hands\-on role bridging ML cluster requirements with cutting\-edge interconnect hardware — ideal for engineers who love both large\-scale AI systems and the physics/engineering of 200G\+ SerDes, PAM4, photonics, signal integrity and diagnostics. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, validate, and productize high\-speed copper and optical connectivity bring\-up \& characterization. * Investigate the opportunity for LPO and LRO in our network. * Evaluate early co\-packaged and near\-packaged engines for switches and GPUs. * Pathfinding for new interconnect modalities including VCSEL, microLED, THz radio\-based solutions to improve network economics and reliability. * Work closely with vendors (transceiver, cable, SerDes, DSP, silicon photonics foundries) to influence roadmaps and ensure timely delivery of next\-gen solutions. * Collaborate with ML training teams to translate workload communication patterns into concrete interconnect topology and optical reconfigurability requirements. * Perform system\-level simulation of end\-to\-end fabric performance. * Drive failure analysis, root cause, and corrective actions jitter, crosstalk. * Solid operational understanding of FEC, Retimers, TIAs and Drivers. * Deep knowledge of optical link budget analysis and performance metrics including TDECQ, OMA, Tcode, stressed receiver sensitivity and associated diagnostics. * Expertise in transceiver components including CW lasers, SiPh PICs, EML, DSP, passive subassemblies, their failure modes and characterization. * technologies and challenges/risk areas. * Familiarity with subcomponent supply chains and global manufacturers, ODMs and CMs. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, Ability is required to design and implement engineering activities; to organize projects; to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others; to supervise personnel; and to expressing ideas clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. **Level I:** Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required at this level consist of knowledge of engineering practices, principles and systems; of management principles; and of the principles of effective supervision. Ability is required to design and implement engineering activities; to organize projects; to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others; to supervise personnel; and to expressing ideas clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. **Special Requirements** Persons appointed to engineering manager positions must possess or obtain registration as a professional engineer with the Oklahoma State Board of Registration for Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors within six (6\) months from the date of appointment. **Equal Opportunity Employment** The State of Oklahoma is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of genetic information, race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, or disability **This position is located in the ODOT's District 6; Guymon Oklahoma. jobs.title: HIL Test Engineer – EV Charging
jobs.description: **HIL Test Engineer \- EV Charging (Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop)** **Long Beach, CA** **6 Month C2H** **Role summary** The HIL Test Engineer \- EV Charging develops and executes tests that verify electric\-vehicle charging systems and their interactions with vehicle controls. The role uses real\-time simulation and hardware test benches to identify issues early, improve product quality, and support reliable charging across vehicle programs. We’re looking for a candidate to help us develop and maintain HIL test environments and implement automated tests. This role involves collaborating with power electronic controls and developers to create and implement automated test cases, execute and analyze test results and ensure traceability of test cases to requirements. **Key responsibilities** * Develop and maintain HIL test benches for EV charging systems, vehicle control modules, and related communication networks. * Develop comprehensive automated test case sequences that cover a wide range of operating conditions, fault scenarios and functional safety requirements. * Execute automated HIL tests, collect and analyze data, identify and document issues and provide clear and concise reports to development teams. Maintain and add regression test cases for different programs along with its integration with CI/CD workflow/pipelines. * Verify charging operation across relevant conditions, including AC and DC charging, connector states, power limits, fault handling, and recovery behavior. * Test interfaces and communication between vehicle systems and charging equipment, including applicable charging protocols and network messages. * Perform eFuse and HSD functional and fault\-condition testing, under faults such as short to battery, short to ground, overcurrent, overvoltage etc. Analyze fault detection, diagnostic reporting, current limiting, shutdown, and recovery behavior for eFuse and HSD channels. * Integrate and configure hardware, models, simulation environments, and test software. * Analyze test results, reproduce failures, document defects, and work with software, systems, and hardware teams to resolve issues. * Support requirements traceability, test coverage reporting, regression testing, and release readiness. * Improve test benches, automation, and continuous\-integration workflows. * Follow applicable engineering, electrical safety, cybersecurity, and quality processes. **Basic qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field. * Knowledge of EV charging systems, vehicle control systems and power\-electronics fundamentals. * Experience developing and executing tests for embedded software or vehicle electronics. * Comfortable using oscilloscope and basic probing tools for debugging purposes. * Experience with any HIL and real\-time testing software tools such as Vector, Typhoon, NI preferred. * Familiarity with Body Controls Module testing, eFuses, HSDs, or automotive power\-distribution circuits. * Familiarity with vehicle communication networks such as CAN, CAN FD, or Ethernet. * Proficiency in a scripting or programming language used for test automation, such as Python, CAPL, or MATLAB. * Hands\-on experience in using test equipment and validation tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, vTeststudio, Tracetronic) * Comfortable with using schematics and layout files to understand design information. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with HIL platforms such as Vector, dSPACE, NI, or comparable systems. * Familiarity with charging standards and protocols such as IEC 61851, ISO 15118, or SAE J1772\. * Experience with automotive diagnostic and network\-analysis tools. * Knowledge of model\-based development, control\-system simulation, or requirements\-management tools. * Experience with automated testing, continuous integration, and software version control. * Understanding of functional safety, cybersecurity, and automotive development processes.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **How You'll Make An Impact** At Strive Health, patients come first. We're on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey. Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You'll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday. If you're looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you'll feel right at home at Strive! **Benefits \& Perks** * **Hybrid\-Remote Flexibility** –Work from home while fulfilling in\-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits. * **Comprehensive Benefits** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer\-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts. * **Financial \& Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation with a performance\-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources. * **Time Off \& Leave** – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves. * **Wellness \& Growth** – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend. To learn more about our offerings, click **here**. **What** **You'll** **Do** As a Staff Software Engineer in our Product \& Technology organization, you will help define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture of Strive's platform, ensuring engineering decisions align tightly with our clinical and business goals. This is a senior, hands\-on individual contributor role. You will take on the most complex and ambiguous technical problems, designing and building scalable, reliable, and secure software while balancing the need to maintain and scale existing systems with the need to deliver new capabilities for patients, clinicians, and partners. Your impact will extend well beyond the systems you build yourself. You will help teams make sound architectural decisions, establish reusable patterns and standards, address systemic technical risk, and mentor engineers across multiple teams, raising the bar on design, implementation quality, and cross\-functional collaboration. This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering. **The Day to Day** * Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for one or more critical domains within Strive's platform, grounded in our business objectives and long\-term product vision. * Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for complex, cross\-team initiatives, from problem framing and architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation. * Stay hands\-on in the code, writing high\-quality, well\-tested, observable software, especially where complexity, risk, or ambiguity calls for senior engineering leadership. * Make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs that balance scalability, reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, cost, and long\-term maintainability, while keeping the platform simple for other engineers to build on. * Design and evolve the APIs, services, data models, integrations, and distributed systems that support Strive's products and healthcare operations. * Partner with Product, Clinical, Data, Security, and Operations leaders to make sure we solve the right problems in the right order, with clear outcomes and measures of success. * Identify systemic technical risks, architectural limitations, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, and lead the work to address them. * Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering standards that help teams build consistently and effectively. * Drive platform\-wide improvements in developer experience, reliability, observability, security posture, and performance that measurably improve how engineering delivers value. * Provide technical leadership across teams by facilitating design and architecture reviews, guiding major engineering decisions, and unblocking teams through hands\-on help. * Participate in production support and incident response, helping teams find root causes and turn operational lessons into better architecture, tooling, and practices. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance to ensure systems protect sensitive healthcare information and meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day\-to\-day work, helping them strengthen their technical judgment and grow as owners of their domains. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering effectiveness. * Co xperience building them into application and system design. * Strong experience designing and scaling distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and data pipelines on AWS or a similar cloud platform. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical data, electronic health records, or standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with relational and non\-relational data stores and systems processing significant volumes of operational or clinical data. * Experience influencing engineering strategy beyond a single team, such as setting technical direction or establishing architecture, testing, observability, and operational standards across teams. * Experience leading modernization efforts involving legacy systems, architecture evolution, or significant technical debt. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools, and with evaluating new technologies through prototypes, reference implementations, and incremental adoption. * Exposure to kidney care, value\-based care, or other complex clinical workflows. **About You** * You are a builder who enjoys designing systems, writing code, solving hard problems, and seeing your work run successfully in production. * You are energized by ambiguous, high\-impact problems and can turn loosely defined challenges into clear technical approaches, even where process and systems don't yet exist. * You pair broad knowledge of software engineering with deep expertise in one or more areas, and you use that breadth to weigh the organizational impact of technical choices. * You have strong technical judgment and know that the best solution isn't always the most complex one, or when a long\-term platform investment is worth it versus a simpler approach. * You balance short\-term needs with long\-term architectural investments and keep a clear view of tradeoffs and sequencing over time. * You are an excellent systems thinker and communicator who explains decisions and the reasoning behind them, and proactively shares risks, tradeoffs, and progress. * You raise engineering standards through influence, collaboration, and example rather than authority, and you enjoy helping others grow their skills and autonomy. * You challenge assumptions constructively while staying open to different perspectives and new information. * You take ownership of outcomes, including the reliability and maintainability of software long after it ships. * You approach privacy, security, and risk thoughtfully because the systems you build support patients and clinicians, and you handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion. * You are collaborative, low\-ego, and motivated by the success of the broader team rather than ownership boundaries. * You are outcome\-driven and curious, using data, experimentation, and feedback loops, as well as thoughtful adoption of AI and other new capabilities, to keep improving the platform and how engineering works. **Annual Salary Range: $130,000 \- $163,000\. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15%** Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications. Strive Health is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. At this time Strive Health is unable to provide work visa sponsorship. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to talentacquisition@strivehealth.com. **We do not accept unsolicited resumes from outside recruiters/placement agencies. Strive Health will not pay fees associated with resumes presented through unsolicited means.**

jobs.title: Staff Software Design Quality Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Why join Stryker?** Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture. We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description** We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.**Staff Software Design Quality Engineer** *San Jose, CA; Orlando, FL; Portage, MI; or Fort Wayne, IN* Stryker is seeking a Staff Software Design Quality Engineer to support our Smart Care division's growing portfolio of digital, connected, cloud\-based, and software\-enabled healthcare solutions. This role sits at the intersection of software development, quality systems, risk management, and regulatory compliance, partnering closely with software engineering teams to ensure quality is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle. This is a strategic quality engineering role focused on process excellence, compliance oversight, and risk management rather than software testing or test execution. **Work Flexibility:** Hybrid work arrangement requiring on\-site presence several days per week. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of San Jose, CA; Orlando, FL; Portage, MI; or Fort Wayne, IN. **What You Will Do** * Lead software quality and compliance activities for cloud\-based, connected, Software as a Service (SaaS), and software\-enabled medical technologies. * Guide product development teams through software development lifecycle requirements, quality system processes, and design control documentation. * Conduct risk assessments, software Failure Modes and Effects Analyses (FMEA), security risk reviews, and change\-impact assessments throughout product development and sustaining activities. * Review quality deliverables, design documentation, and release readiness packages to ensure compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements. * Develop and improve quality procedures, work instructions, templates, and governance frameworks that support scalable software development practices. * Support audit and inspection readiness activities, including evidence collection, gap assessments, corrective actions, and compliance monitoring. * Integrate quality and risk management practices into Agile, DevOps, and continuous integration/continuous deployment environments. * Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, regulatory, privacy, information technology, and operations teams to drive quality\-focused decision\-making and process improvement initiatives. **What You Will Need** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Sciences, or a related technical discipline. * Minimum 4 years of experience in a regulated industry within Research \& Development, Quality, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Healthcare IT, or Systems Engineering. * Experience working within software development lifecycle methodologies, including Agile, SAFe, and/or Waterfall. * Experience with software risk management, software Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), security risk assessments, defect management, software verification, and software validation activities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Experience supporting regulated software products, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), software\-enabled medical systems, digital health, or telehealth solutions. * Experience with medical device quality and regulatory standards, including FDA regulations, IEC 62304, IEC 82304, or related frameworks. * Experience supporting cloud, mobile, artificial intelligence/machine learning, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), iOS, or Android technologies. **United States of America Pay Ranges:** * **USN**: $102,600 \- $171,000 USD Annual * **US5**: $107,700 \- $179,600 USD Annual * **US10**: $112,900 \- $188,100 USD Annual * **US15**: $118,000 \- $196,600 USD Annual * **US20**: $123,100 \- $205,200 USD Annual * **US30**: $133,400 \- $222,300 USD Annual View the U.S. work location and transparency guide to find the pay range for your location. Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Payments
jobs.description: Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. The terms of our culture should not be set by gate\-keeping legacy media or chaos\-fueling social media, but by the people who actually make and participate in that culture. Substack’s model, based on direct subscriptions, has fueled an explosion of independent publishing. It empowers creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences. **About the Payments Team** Subscription payments are the heart of Substack’s product and business model. Everything we do is based on the idea that creators can and should be paid directly by their audience, instead of relying on attention capture and advertising. And we believe that creators *themselves* should own these payment relationships, without being tied to any platform, including ours. We are a small team with outsized impact and ownership. We take on both the traditional payments engineering : integrating with payment processors, managing the flow of hundreds of millions of dollars in subscription revenue, and also the full stack feature development that drives those payments. This means a wide variety of projects, including building brand new payout systems, A/B testing the subscribe flow, and shipping features like gift subscriptions. **Responsibilities** * Develop the core payment surfaces and backend systems on Substack. * Own your work and deliver high\-quality solutions from product concept and proposal to implementation, experimentation, and measurement. * We work with TypeScript, especially Node/Express and React, and Postgres. It’s helpful if you know these technologies already; if not, we’ll be excited to help you learn. * We also work with payment processors, including Stripe. Again, experience here is beneficial but not required. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping web applications. * Independent and autonomous. Strong product sense and intuition. * Passionate about building a better business model for the internet. *Substack's compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $260,000\. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.* Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking a Technical Support Engineer to play a critical role in ensuring the successful operation of Symbotic systems at customer sites. This role supports system stand\-up, stabilization, and ongoing operations, serving as a key technical partner to internal teams and customer stakeholders. The Technical Support Engineer is responsible for executing structured troubleshooting, supporting complex escalations, and contributing to system reliability during high\-impact operational events. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, solutions\-oriented environment and brings strong technical problem\-solving skills paired with a customer\-first mindset. **What we do** The Technical Support Team is part of Symbotic’s Service Operations Organization and is responsible for the successful stand\-up, performance, and continuous operation of Symbotic systems inside customer sites. Our team supports all production\-impacting aspects of the system including controls, electrical, software, networking, and infrastructure and serves as the primary escalation point for real\-time system issues. Working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Implementation, and Customer Operations, Technical Support delivers timely troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and sustainable solutions to ensure system reliability and operational excellence. Through rapid response and strong technical ownership, we strengthen customer relationships and keep automated operations running at peak performance. **What you’ll do** * Troubleshoot and resolve production\-impacting system issues across software, networking, and infrastructure layers * Support real\-time escalations during high\-impact operational events * Connect to and diagnose systems remotely using tools such as SSH, Remote Desktop, and browser\-based interfaces * Analyze logs, system data, and performance trends to identify root causes and prevent recurring issues * Partner cross\-functionally with Engineering and Field teams to drive issue resolution * Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and knowledge base content * Support continuous improvement by identifying patterns and recommending preventative solutions **What you’ll need** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience) * Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting complex technical systems in a remote or production environment * Strong experience troubleshooting using Linux command line and system\-level tools * Experience connecting to systems via SSH, Remote Desktop, or similar tools * Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and troubleshooting * Strong experience with SQL or scripting for data analysis * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to prioritize and multitask in high\-pressure environments * Effective communication skills, especially during real\-time issue resolution Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting automated systems, robotics, or warehouse environments * Familiarity with electrical schematics and hardware\-level diagnostics * Experience with packet capture tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) * Exposure to PLCs, VFDs, or industrial controls **Our Environment** * Ability to travel up to 15% after the training period (Senior roles may require up to 15% ongoing travel). * Must possess a valid driver’s license and be able to travel to customer sites via car or air. * Employee must maintain a personal credit card and manage expenses for bi\-weekly reimbursement. **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $70,000\.00 \- $97,900\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

It involves designing and building high\-performance services and APIs: the distributed data stores, low\-latency access layers, and real\-time sync mechanisms that deliver the right data to each consumer within strict latency and reliability targets. The role requires applying seasoned engineering judgment to solve complex systems challenges and to make recommendations on architecture, technology selection, and API and service design. Success is measured by the scalability and reliability of these systems, the strength of technical leadership provided to engineers, and the ability to influence engineering decisions across the organization. The work impacts the organization by enabling the real\-time, AI\-ready capabilities that power better products and customer experiences.**Job Responsibilities**: * Design and build serving infrastructure for AI use cases including vector databases, graph databases, and agent\-facing data patterns * Design Infrastructure\-as\-Code blueprints for provisioning serving stores, sync pipelines, and APIs in a repeatable, governed way * Partner with business teams and other technical teams to drive technical decision making, mentor engineers, and contribute to reusable blueprints and reference implementations. * Design and develop high\-performance data stores, real\-time sync pipelines, and governed APIs that deliver data at the latency and scale each use case requires * Drive engineering projects to deliver software solutions that meet technical requirements and quality standards * Provide technical leadership by mentoring engineers and influencing technology and policy decisions across the organization * Evaluate and apply technology strategies that align with business goals and system requirements * Develop innovative software designs and improvements that enhance existing systems and processes * Produce clear technical documentation and architecture descriptions for internal and external stakeholders * Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed **Required Education and Work Experience**: * Bachelor's Degree plus 7 years of related work experience OR Advanced degree with 5 years of related experience (Required) * Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science or Engineering (Required) * 7\-10 years Technical engineering experience. (Required) **Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**: * AI/ML Infrastructure * Knowledge Graphs * Vector Databases * Streaming and caching architecture * API Design and Governance * MCP\-Style tooling or agent facing data access patterns * Data sync pipelines * Analytics, Collaboration and Communication skills * Analytical Thinking, Cloud computing, Customer Service and Leadership skills * Software Development and Technical Writing skills * At least 18 years of age * Legally authorized to work in the United States **Travel**: Travel Required (Yes/No): Yes **DOT Regulated**: DOT Regulated Position (Yes/No): No Safety Sensitive Position (Yes/No): No Compensation Range: Bellevue, WA: $173,500 to $234,700 Atlanta, GA: $151,200 to $204,600 Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity: $160,200 \- $288,840 National Base Pay Range: $133,500 \- $240,700 The Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity represents the expected total cash compensation for this role at target performance, combining base salary and annual incentive opportunity. The candidate’s actual pay will be based on various factors, such as work location, qualifications, and experience, so the actual starting pay will vary within this range. To find the pay range for this role based on hiring location, click here. jobs.description: **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. **About the role:** As an Application Security Engineer, you will secure how Tempus builds software, from design through release. You will partner with product and engineering teams to build security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and you will assess our applications and APIs the way an attacker would, through security assessments and penetration tests. The applications you secure handle sensitive clinical and genomic data and increasingly include AI\-powered capabilities, so securing AI and LLM\-enabled systems is a core part of the role. You will own well\-defined application security problems within your team's scope, with guidance from your lead. **What you'll do** * Embed security into the SDLC through threat modeling, design reviews, security requirements, and security\-focused code reviews with product and development teams. * Plan and conduct application security assessments and penetration tests of web applications, APIs, and cloud\-hosted services, and document findings with clear risk ratings and practical remediation guidance. * Threat model and assess AI and LLM\-enabled features (agents, RAG pipelines, tool and MCP integrations), including adversarial prompt testing and validation of guardrails, permissions, and data access controls. * Select, integrate, and tune SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines. * Build automation, secure\-by\-default patterns, and guardrails that prevent whole classes of vulnerabilities. * Use AI\-assisted tooling to scale code review, triage, and remediation, applying human judgment to validate the results. * Reproduce, triage, and prioritize application security vulnerabilities, and work with developers through to remediation. * Communicate the nature, severity, and business risk of security issues to development teams and leadership. * Design, implement, and document application security controls, standards, and secure coding guidance. * Run and support the vulnerability disclosure program. * Coach developers on secure design and coding through consulting, training, and everyday collaboration. **What you'll bring** * 3\-5 years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or software engineering with a security focus. * Hands\-on experience testing web applications, APIs, and cloud\-hosted services, using proxying and penetration testing tools (e.g. Burp Suite), and strong command of common security flaws and mitigations (e.g. OWASP Top 10\). * Experience performing security design reviews at the architecture level * Working experience securing AI and LLM\-enabled applications: how they are designed and how they fail, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure output handling (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications). * Practical experience with at least one threat modeling method (e.g. STRIDE, PASTA, attack trees). * Experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines. * Proficiency in Python, Go, or JavaScript for security tooling and automation, and the ability to read and review code. * Solid understanding of network and web protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/S), authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth/OIDC), and cryptography fundamentals. * Able to work well with software development teams and Product Managers. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely. **Bonus points for:** * Hands\-on AI red teaming or security testing of agentic or RAG systems; familiarity with MITRE ATLAS or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GCP or AWS, and infrastructure\-as\-code scanning * Bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program experience * Experience with HIPAA and healthcare data protection * An interest in working in biotech, genomics, and precision medicine * Certifications such as GWAPT, OSCP, CSSLP, CISSP, or ISC2 CC (Certified in Cybersecurity) CHI: $85,000\-$130,000 The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **About Us** Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics. We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives. ### **Why Work Here?** We’re looking for people who can change the world. Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: ***Who we are:*** Since 1956, Lewer has served as an advocate for independent business owners who seek to protect what they’ve built and prepare for the future. In 1991, our student division was formed to protect people around the world. Lewer offers a concierge approach to employee and student insurance by providing tailored benefit strategies designed to create healthier businesses, families, and individuals. ***What you'll do at Lewer:*** **Roles and Responsibilities** As the Data Engineer, you design, maintain, and document the Lewer Companies data architecture, ETL processes, and data flow. You ensure business data is reliably collected, integrated, stored, backed up, scheduled, and monitored to support accurate reporting, analytics, and operational needs while maintaining data integrity, availability, and security. You also combine business intelligence with AI innovation to shape the future of data strategy*.* **Your Key Areas of Impact** **Organizational Intelligence:** You play a central role in cultivating a culture of evidence\-based decision\-making. Through data pipeline development and ELT/ETL management, you build scalable systems that extract data from a variety of sources (APIs, CRM tools, applications, web traffic) and execute ETL/ELT processes (extract, transform, load) to clean, reform, aggregate, and structure raw data into readable formats. Finally, you automate data workflows using orchestration tools to ensure continuous data delivery without manual intervention. **Infrastructure \& Data Architecture:** You design and maintain storage solutions like enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, and lake houses. You optimize database performance by fine\-tuning queries, managing data partitioning, and scaling the big data infrastructure to minimize lag and bottlenecks. **Data Governance \& Security:** You implement security protocols and access controls to safeguard data systems against unauthorized access, leaks, or breaches. You enforce data quality standards by building monitoring systems that flag anomalies, corrupt data, or broken streams before they disrupt downstream workflows. You protect the Lewer Companies through compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** You support Technology and Analytics teams by structuring complex data sets required to train machine learning models and populate business dashboards. You translate business requirements from stakeholders and executive leadership into robust, technical data models, to improve company decision making. **The Work Environment, Physical Demands \& Travel** Your work is conducted at the Lewer Administrative Offices, with eligibility to work from home in accordance with company policy. You must be able to remain in a stationary position 75% of the time, and be able to occasionally move about inside the office to access filing cabinets, office machinery, etc. You will operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a phone, calculator, copy machine and computer printer 75% of the time. You will need to be able to lift 25 lbs. Travel is not required for this seat. ***Your qualifications:*** **Requirements** You may hold a degree in data science, information technology, data engineering, or a highly quantitative field. Equivalent practical experience of specialized bootcamps is also heavily weighted, with 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, software engineering, or data pipeline. You are proficient in SQL, Power BI, data platforms (Azure/Microsoft Fabric) and scripting languages (Python), with experience in data modeling and visualization best practices, and AI/ML concepts and tools. You demonstrate strong analytical thinking, clear communication, and the ability to collaborate across departments while maintaining integrity in data handling. This Impact Description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the Associate for this seat. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Associate must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable Associates with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. ***More about us:*** **Our Core Values** You live the following “***Lewer Core Values****”* in your daily work: ***I've Got This*** \- Always takes care of business; assumes responsibility, supports accountability, leads by example. ***Kaizen*** \- Embodies constant improvement; always asks why and continuously improves our processes. ***Results With Integrity*** \- Commits to strong moral and ethical principles in the pursuit of excellence. ***Good Vibes*** \- Takes care of one another; works enthusiastically, treats others professionally and respectfully. **The Team** Lewer runs on the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS). That means as a member of this team, your manager is committed to: * Giving clear directions. * Providing the necessary tools. * Acting with the greater good in mind. * Delegating. * Understanding your role and how you can help the company. * Providing clear expectations. * Communicating effectively. * Running effective meetings. * Meeting one\-on\-one with you quarterly or more, if needed. * Rewarding and recognizing your performance. It also means you are committed to the EOS life by doing what you love, with people you love. You make a huge difference, are compensated appropriately, and take time to pursue personal passions. Your coworkers are a diverse group of professionals across all the business units of Lewer. They are highly skilled professionals who are passionate about their work and committed to achieving Lewer’s goals. They are collaborative and eager to work together to identify opportunities for improvement and find solutions to complex business challenges. **Benefits** Some benefits Lewer offers its Associates include: * Employer\-paid medical, dental \& vision insurance * Employer\-paid short\-term disability, long\-term disability and life insurance * $1,500 Employer HSA annual contribution * 5% 401(k) match with 100% immediate vesting

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **How to Apply** ---------------- A cover letter and resume are important submissions for the hiring team to get a sense of your experience. In the cover letter, in two pages or less, please let us know how this role aligns with your career aspirations and skill set. Submit both a cover letter and resume as one file (because of system limitations). **Who We Are** -------------- **About the Center for Academic Innovation** Through curricular innovation, tools for student success, and educational research and analytics, the University of Michigan Center for Academic Innovation is building the future of education. Our vision is a future in which education connects and empowers learners everywhere to reach their full potential throughout their lives. To realize our vision, we make it our mission to collaborate across campus and around the world to create equitable, lifelong educational opportunities for learners everywhere. **About the Technology Infrastructure and Support Team** The TIS team builds and maintains the technology behind CAI's learning, media, and IT work. Working closely with Creative Studios, Operations, and product engineering teams, we keep CAI's systems dependable and secure so learners, faculty, and staff can focus on their work. You will report to the Director of Technology, Infrastructure and Support. **What makes this fellowship distinctive** You will help operate CAI's dedicated multi\-GPU local AI server and the open\-source software stack that supports it, gaining experience deploying, evaluating, and monitoring models.
