The fellowship combines hands\-on delivery, platform operations, and knowledge transfer, with documented project outcomes and a handoff to the next cohort to help build a fellowship alumni community over time. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------------------- * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information, human\-computer interaction, data science, engineering, learning sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and applied experience, completed by the start date * Hands\-on programming experience in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language, including experience working with APIs * Experience building applications with large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, agents, or related AI techniques * Experience using Git and working with cloud, container, or modern application\-development environments * Experience designing tests or evaluations and interpreting both quantitative results and user feedback * Working knowledge of software security, privacy, access control, and responsible AI practices * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation and agent frameworks, experience with evaluation or observability tooling * Ability to learn and appropriately use new technologies to improve processes, communication, and outcomes, including AI\-enabled tools where relevant to the role, consistent with university policy and job responsibilities **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Additional Information** -------------------------- This is a one\-year term\-limited fellowship with the possibility of annual renewal depending on funding and performance. Candidates must have legal authorization to work in the United States. The mode of work for this position is **Hybrid** with a minimum of 4 days in the office per week, Monday through Thursday, with an option of remote work on Fridays. On occasion, you may be required and must be available to work onsite on Fridays if necessitated by our center's policy and domain leadership or by your job requirements. The salary for this position will be based upon the selected candidate's education and experience. We support the creative, responsible, and ethical use of AI tools to enhance our work, in alignment with institutional policies and best practices. Excellent benefits are available, for details, see http://benefits.umich.edu/. **Salary Information** The general salary range for this position is $85,000 \- $92,000\. Candidates can expect to be paid a competitive and equitable salary. Factors used to determine salary include education level, experience, knowledge and skills for the position and salaries that are currently established within the unit. All candidates are encouraged to discuss salary questions to honor alignment and transparency throughout the recruiting process. **Organizational Statement on Harassment** We believe all individuals deserve to be treated with respect and dignity and have the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes mutual respect and a safe space for collaboration. Any concerns shared with any staff members and student employees in the Center for Academic Innovation will be reported to the Equity, Civil Rights, \& Title IX Office to be reviewed and addressed, and the Center for Academic Innovation encourages reporting of any forms of harassment including sexual and gender\-based harassment. **Background Screening** ------------------------ The University of Michigan conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background checks. Background checks will be performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended. **Decision Making Process** --------------------------- Applications will be reviewed as received throughout the posting period and continue until the position is filled. **U\-M EEO Statement** ---------------------- The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Job Opening ID** 284255 ### **Working Title** Applied AI Engineer ### **Job Title** AI Appl Developer Assoc ### **Work Location** Ann Arbor Campus Ann Arbor, MI ### **Modes of Work** Hybrid ### **Full/Part Time** Full\-Time ### **Regular/Temporary** Regular ### **FLSA Status** Exempt ### **Organizational Group** Vp Acad Innovation ### **Department** Center for Academic Innovation ### **Posting Begin/End Date** 10/13/2026 \- 11/03/2026 ### **Salary** $85,000\.00 \- $92,000\.00 ### **Career Interest** Information Technology

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- As a **Legal AI Engineer** focused on helping law firms adopt generative AI, you will partner directly with customers to uncover their highest\-value legal workflows and show how Thomson Reuters Legal AI can address them. You’ll lead in\-person discovery sessions, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings, and you’ll turn what you learn into reusable use cases, prompts, and playbooks that scale across practice areas. This is a high\-impact role that sits at the intersection of customer strategy, hands\-on AI experimentation, and thought leadership. As the go\-to voice for legal AI in customer conversations, you’ll bring clarity and practical solutions to every engagement, helping firms decide when a Thomson Reuters product, a partner tool, or a custom approach is the right fit. **Key Responsibilities:** In the role of **Legal AI Engineer** , you will collaborate closely with Customer Success, Sales, and Product teams to: * Lead in\-person discovery sessions, solution demonstrations, workflow workshops, and executive briefings with law firm customers to identify priority legal workflows and show how Thomson Reuters Legal AI can address them. * Support customers throughout the lifecycle by scoping Legal AI use cases, advising on workflow and solution design, and demonstrating legal AI capabilities. * Partner with Customer Success Managers to develop Legal AI adoption strategies, support successful solution deployment, and move high\-value use cases into sustained use across practice areas. * Discover, test, and document best practices for applying Thomson Reuters Legal AI across customer workflows, creating reusable use cases, prompts, playbooks, and workflow patterns that can scale. * Apply a strong understanding of the legal technology ecosystem to determine when customer needs are best addressed through Thomson Reuters products, a partner solution, an integration, or custom development, and help orchestrate the right approach. * Support customer advocacy by communicating customer needs to Customer Success and our cross\-functional partners in Product, Engineering, and Marketing, and highlighting opportunities to improve and innovate our legal AI products. * Contribute to Thomson Reuters’ thought leadership by sharing expertise with customers and the broader market through events, advisory boards, or customer\-facing content. * Be an effective advocate for Thomson Reuters products. Understand their strengths, areas for improvement, and roadmaps, and be able to explain, on multiple levels, how they can be specifically applied to take customers’ client advocacy to new heights. * **Travel:** This role requires regular travel (approximately 25\-30%, varying by quarter) to customer and firm sites to support client engagements, demonstrations, and team initiatives. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as a condition of employment. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- You are a fit for the role of **Legal AI Engineer** if you have the following required qualifications: * J.D. from an accredited US law school required. * Prior experience practicing law required (e.g., in a law firm, in\-house legal department, government, clerkship, or comparable legal practice setting). * Proven experience in customer\- or client\-facing roles, ideally engaging with Enterprise or complex accounts. * Familiarity with legal workflows and processes such as due diligence, eDiscovery, large document review, compliance, or related domains — gained through direct practice, adjacent roles, or working with legal professionals. * Demonstrable experience with generative artificial intelligence applications. * Substantial experience using a variety of online legal research and practice tools (e.g., Westlaw, Practical Law, HighQ, Relativity, Everlaw, etc.). * Tech\-savvy with a strong aptitude for learning new AI tools and platforms; no formal technical or programming background is required. Experience with basic programming (Python) and/or exploratory coding for problem\-solving is a plus but not required. * **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Bring experience in customer\-facing roles, ideally working with Enterprise accounts. * Understand the architecture and operation of large language models (LLMs) and are comfortable working hands\-on with AI tools, even without a formal technical or engineering background. * Approach challenges constructively, framing Thomson Reuters solutions positively and accurately. * Are knowledgeable in due diligence, eDiscovery, managing large document sets, data rooms, and related workflows where AI can accelerate results. * Excel at communicating technical concepts and creating clear, high\-quality documentation and learning materials, and can craft persuasive presentations that resonate with non\-technical and often skeptical customers by focusing on their needs and outcomes rather than just product features. * T catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD\&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa; This job posting will close 12/31/2026\. **About Us** Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace. We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) matching * Competitive salary * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Profit sharing * Vision insurance **About the Role:** Join THREE PHASE as a Process Controls Engineer in the San Antonio, TX or Austin, TX area, where innovation meets excellence! In this exciting role, you will be at the forefront of optimizing control systems and enhancing operational efficiency in a dynamic environment. The Controls Engineer is a mid\-to\-senior level position at Three Phase. Our projects typically involve the development of solutions using a variety of automation technologies and platforms. These technologies are deployed for the control of automated industrial process in data centers, water/wastewater, central plants, power plants, pharmaceutical, oil \& gas, and chemical processing. You will be developing custom PLC/HMI assignments that include HMI design/development and PLC controls system design and development for projects of varying size and complexity. Our ideal Engineer will have strong experience with a mix of PLCs, databases and/or other machine vision platforms. **Responsibilities:** * Design and implement client/server software for standalone client systems based on project requirements and specifications. * Work with clients to define user, network and data interfaces and create specifications. * Monitor and analyze system performance to identify areas for improvement. * Commission new solutions on client sites; finding opportunities for improvements. * Conduct troubleshooting and root cause analysis on control system issues. * Prepare technical documentation and reports for system modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry standards and safety regulations. * Provide training and support to operational staff on control systems. * Work with sales team members to provide input during quote preparation. * Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, computer science, or related field. * 5\+ years of experience in process controls or automation engineering. * Proficient in PLC programming and HMI development experience on multiple different platforms. Must have experience with Siemens and Allen\-Bradley systems. * Experienced in control systems integration project lifecycle and the application of the following: electrical design, PLC ladder logic \& HMI development, and commissioning. * Understanding of networking including: ethernet, Modbus, BACnet and other industrial protocols. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Knowledge of industry standards such as ISA and IEC. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. **Travel Requirements:** * Typical travel for this position is \~30\-40% within the United States. We are committed to providing a positive and healthy corporate culture, one that empowers employees and promotes the sharing of knowledge. At Three Phase you will have the opportunity to work with leading industrial companies, grow your engineering talents and work as a project lead. For more information visit http://3phaseEng.com/. Our commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction has earned us a reputation for reliability, making us a preferred employer. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Business Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About** **Tia** ----------------- Tia is building a new model for women's healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, dermatology, and wellness across both in\-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike. **About the Role** ------------------ At Tia, our business teams support the people, processes, and systems that make women's healthcare possible. From credentialing providers to supporting clinic operations, too much of their time goes toward repetitive tasks, moving information between systems, tracking paperwork, and rebuilding reports. As our Business Automation Engineer, you'll help teams spend more time on the work that needs their expertise. You'll partner with People Operations, Credentialing, Clinical Operations, Data, Product, Business Analytics, and other teams to understand their workflows and build practical solutions using automation, AI, and code. You'll work with your manager to define problems and priorities, then own projects from discovery through launch and ongoing maintenance. Product partners will support architecture and data decisions. As your portfolio grows, you'll keep workflows reliable and adapt them as Tia's needs change. This role offers the opportunity to apply emerging technology to real business problems and make a measurable difference in how Tia operates. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Understand and improve business processes** * Work directly with teams to understand how work gets done, including exceptions, workarounds, and handoffs. * Map workflows and identify where human judgment is essential and where automation can reduce repetitive work. * Partner with your manager to define project scope, priorities, and measures of success. **Build practical, reliable solutions** * Design and build workflows using n8n or similar automation platforms, AI tools, and Python or JavaScript/Node.js. * Connect systems through APIs, webhooks, and other integrations. * Choose the simplest effective solution, whether that is a spreadsheet improvement, standard automation, or an AI\-assisted workflow. * Test normal operations and edge cases, and build in error handling, logging, alerts, and appropriate human review. **Own workflows after launch** * Monitor performance, troubleshoot failures, and update workflows as systems, policies, and business needs change. * Follow Tia's security, access, and AI governance controls when working with sensitive employee, business, or patient\-related information. * Maintain clear documentation so others can understand, review, and support your work. **Help teams adopt and sustain improvements** * Involve teams throughout discovery, design, and rollout. * Explain technical decisions in plain language and train teams to use their workflows. * Enable teams to make appropriate adjustments independently, with clear guidance on when technical support is needed. **Measure impact and share learning** * Establish baselines and measure time saved, accuracy, reliability, and adoption after launch. * Report results honestly, including limitations and approaches that did not work. * Partner with Product to transition solutions that could become part of Tia's products. * Evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and recommend where they can improve business operations. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- **Required Qualifications** We value the quality of what you've built and how you approach problems. Candidates who demonstrate these capabilities through research or independent projects are encouraged to apply, even without traditional professional experience. * 1\+ year of relevant experience in workflow automation, software development, systems integration, or technical operations, or equivalent hands\-on experience through internships, research, or substantial independent projects. * Experience leading a substantial project from an unclear starting point to a working solution. * Hands\-on experience building and troubleshooting workflows in n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato, or a comparable platform, with the ability to learn n8n quickly. * Ability to write Python or JavaScript/Node.js scripts, call APIs, and handle logic beyond the capabilities of low\-code tools. * Working knowledge of REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, and data movement between systems. * Comfort using SQL to query and validate data, and working with complex Google Sheets. * Experience applying LLM tools or APIs to practical problems, with an understanding of their limitations, how to evaluate outputs, and when human review is needed. * Ability to break complex processes into manageable steps and anticipate exceptions and downstream effects. * A disciplined approach to testing, documentation, monitoring, and handling sensitive data. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to earn trust with nontechnical teams. * Initiative, persistence, and accountability: you make progress through ambiguity, raise blockers early, and learn from mistakes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Google Workspace automation, including Apps Script. * Experience building AI workflows that use tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agents. * Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals and how to assess whether a model is appropriate for a task. * Experience handling sensitive data in healthcare, finance, or another regulated environment. * Experience measuring operational improvements through time studies or before\-and\-after comparisons. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- Success in this role means: * Delivering agreed\-upon projects and communicating progress and blockers clearly. * Building workflows that teams adopt and that remain reliable after launch. * Demonstrating measurable improvements in time spent, accuracy, or process quality. * Providing documentation and training that help teams use and sustain improvements. * Identifying opportunities to simplify work while protecting the human judgment and expertise essential to Tia's operations. **Work Location** ----------------- This is a remote role, based in the United States. \#LI\-Remote **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job\-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions. The expected annual compensation for this role is: **$90,000 \- $100,000**. You are also eligible for: * Medical, dental, and vision benefits * 401k * Parental leave * Performance\-based bonus * Equity * Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays #### **About Tia** Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our "Whole Woman, Whole Life" model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in\-person care and a national virtual platform. We are a Series D, venture\-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology\-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women. #### **About Tia's Culture** Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women. This position may require attendance at company and team off\-sites. #### **Scam Notice** Tia will never ask for payment, gift cards, or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. All communication from our team will come from an official company email address ending in @asktia.com. If something feels off, please contact peopleservices@asktia.com. #### **Equal Opportunity** Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ\+ community to apply. If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high\-quality work, and making waves in women's healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Titan** Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7\. In under a year we've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market\-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K\+ tickets across 400\+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. ### **About the team** Titan's Forward Deployed Engineering team works with our partners and customers to put AI agents into production across their operations. We sit at the intersection of partner delivery and core platform engineering. ### **About the role** Forward Deployed Engineers lead Titan deployments end to end with our MSP and enterprise partners. You own discovery, scoping, the build, and the production rollout, working directly with partner IT teams. You'll architect integrations, write production code, and deploy agents at scale, then sit with customer and partner leadership to shape business outcomes and strategy. This position plays a key role in advancing the company's use of artificial intelligence to support customer service, account servicing, payment reminders, and other business operations. The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with a strong background in conversational AI, real\-time technologies, and developing secure, scalable solutions.**Duties/Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain real\-time AI voice applications using large language models, speech\-to\-speech technologies, and conversational AI platforms. * Develop automated conversational workflows for customer service, payment reminders, promise\-to\-pay interactions, account servicing, and other business needs. * Configure AI prompts, conversation policies, security controls, escalation procedures, and automated tool\-calling capabilities. * Implement conversation management features, including interruption handling, contextual awareness, fallback logic, and transfers to live representatives. * Develop and integrate applications using OpenAI Live/Realtime APIs and other real\-time AI technologies. * Manage streaming audio, transcription, session processing, and system integrations to ensure reliable, responsive AI interactions. * Integrate AI voice applications with SIP, VoIP, PBX systems, and enterprise telecommunications infrastructure to support inbound and outbound calling. * Develop and maintain applications, APIs, and microservices using C\#, .NET, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or other appropriate technologies. * Integrate AI applications with company databases, customer systems, payment platforms, messaging systems, and other business applications. * Develop secure AI\-enabled functions for account lookup, customer verification, conversation evaluations, and quality assurance processes to improve AI accuracy, reliability, and performance. * Monitor system performance, including call outcomes, response times, errors, developing and supporting production applications. * Advanced knowledge of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and real\-time application architectures. * Strong understanding of large language models, generative AI, conversational AI, and prompt engineering. * Advanced troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and systems analysis skills. * Ability to design secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. * Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain \- the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day. We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America. Since then, we've expanded our suite of AI agents to help logistics providers, manufacturers, 3PLs, and other industrial businesses fully automate their manual workflows, derive insights from their data streams, and transform their decision intelligence. Our mission is to build a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **You'll build the AI agents themselves—the harnesses, evals, orchestration, and model strategy the rest of Traba's product runs on.** We're seeking an entrepreneurial Senior AI Agent Engineer to join as a founding member of the Agents team and build the next layer of Traba's product—an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. (Our Applied AI team puts these agents to work across the product; you own the agents and infrastructure they depend on.) You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agent harnesses on top of frontier models, and turn what you learn in the field into durable product. You will partner closely with our CTO, product, and our operators to take 0\-to\-1 ideas to scaled deployments. **About You** ------------- * **Builder with an AI operator's instinct.** You've shipped real product on top of LLMs—not just chat wrappers. You've designed agent harnesses, structured tools, written evals, and tuned prompts against production traces. You think in capability, reliability, and unit economics—not just whether the model says the right thing. * **Domain\-immersed.** You enjoy time with the people who do the work—learning an industry's vocabulary, edge cases, and operational tempo—and let that shape what you build. * **High\-agency in ambiguity.** Dropped into a fuzzy customer problem with a half\-formed hypothesis and a deadline, you scope, build, evaluate, and ship without waiting for a spec. * **Sweat both ends of the stack.** You move between prompt iteration, eval design, backend services, and customer\-facing UI in the same week, and you care about evals that catch regressions and traces that are easy to debug. **You Will** ------------ * Embed with customers and operators to understand how supply chains run today—then design and ship agents that take meaningful work off their plate. * Build production agent systems on frontier LLMs: tool use, sub\-agents, retrieval, structured outputs, MCP servers, and the orchestration that ties them together. * Own evaluation as a first\-class discipline—datasets from real traces, rubrics and graders, experiments, and improvements you can prove move the needle. * Architect the data, services, and APIs the agent layer depends on—integrating our internal systems with customers' WMS, TMS, and ERP environments. * Codify repeatable deployment patterns so each new customer rollout is faster than the last. **You Have** ------------ * 5\+ years of software engineering, with 1\+ year shipping LLM\- or agent\-based features into production. * Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, and comfortable designing APIs, distributed systems, and data models in PostgreSQL. * Hands\-on with the modern agent stack: production\-scale prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, orchestration patterns, and frontier model APIs. * A track record of building in fast, ambiguous environments—ideally at a vertical AI, AI\-agent, forward\-deployed, or data\-product company. * Excellent written and verbal communication—you can run a customer workshop in the morning and write a clean design doc in the afternoon. **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Gympass Benefit * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $200,000 and $240,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Job Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

jobs.description: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. **Where is the work:** On\-Site (5 days) **What's in it for you:** The Strategic Business Unit (SBU) Field Quality Engineer will influence business bottom line results by leading, facilitating, and reporting Customer and Field related quality activities for each of our SBU’s platforms. This role will bring improved connection between the customer/field and our manufacturing/engineering teams. In this role, your responsibilities will includes oversight of all quality related aspects for each equipment platform including the quality failure analysis based on customer provided feedback through the prioritization of programs and activities to improve the performance of our products within the field. Development of a clearly defined project pipeline including analysis of factors that are utilized to define each project. The role will coordinate information from Technical Support teams, Field Teams, Customer Interactions and Field Technicians to define the specific elements to be fixed or changed to improve the overall customer experience. This team will be the first point of contact for the SBU Distribution teams for customer impacting issues and challenges for their assigned product platforms. This position will report to the SBU Field Quality Leader, and is required to sit in Columbia, SC. **What you will do:** • **Quality Management and Improvement:** * Oversee and manage quality initiatives across multiple product platforms. * Focus on reducing quality\-related costs and improving overall product quality. * Develop and implement quality\-driven test systems and procedures to ensure products meet customer expectations. • **Customer Interaction and Support:** * Conduct site visits and gather information to address and resolve customer issues. * Perform customer research and investigations to identify root causes and calculate benefits of quality improvements. * Act as a liaison for key selling situations requiring information about the quality management system and processes. • **Data Analysis and Prioritization:** * Provide data and prioritize improvement opportunities for Product Growth Teams (PGTs). * Develop and present business cases for improvements, and track improvement timelines. * Utilize various tools to evaluate the effectiveness of the Field Quality function, including Gemba, management reviews, internal audits, and customer feedback. • **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** * Facilitate and complete Root Cause Analysis across multiple functions to ensure corrections improve component reliability and product performance. * Develop communication strategies with field service technicians to identify and resolve real issues through manufacturing and engineering changes. * Collaborate with suppliers to facilitate reliability improvements and integrate them into new product and project introduction phases. • **Project and Metrics Management:** * Create and manage a prioritized project pipeline to maximize customer and business benefits. * Track and ensure teams deliver agreed quality improvements. * Forecast and manage key metrics to align with plant financials and PGT Glide paths. • **Training and Communication:** * Identify gaps in field training and customer application that affect customer experience. * Develop and communicate core messages about quality improvement efforts and the evolving quality culture within the business. **What you will bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, operations management or related discipline * 5\+ years of experience in quality or quality engineering in a design, engineering or manufacturing environment that has embraced best practices in terms of Advanced Quality Planning, DFMEA deployment and Production Part Approval Processes. * Demonstrated strong leadership and applied knowledge in: APQP, DFMEA, PPAP * Experience in quality management, operations, lean manufacturing processes including visual management * Excellent interpersonal skills, mentor, team player including professional customer and supplier interaction capability * Ability to travel up to 10% with some peaks at higher levels. * Solid interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and motivate associates and to interact with various departments throughout the organization * Team oriented proactive change agent with a hands\-on, collaborative approach in implementing and maintaining operating disciplines while leveraging lean methodologies * Problem solving techniques, process improvement tools, statistical and sampling techniques, SPC, process capability, traceability, control points * Project management and planning tools, measuring and monitoring of project activities and project documentation. Proficiency in information technology systems utilized in Quality Management Systems and process **Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range:** $89,585\.00 \- $143,700\.00 **Compensation Type:** Salary **Incentive Eligible:** No **Sales Commission Eligible:** No **Disclaimer:** We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status. **Thrive at work and at home:** * Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE! * Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance. * Paid time off includes up to 15 vacation days, paid holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave. * 401K match up, educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support. **Disclaimer:** Benefit offerings may vary by site as well as Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations **Safety Sensitive Role:** YesThe company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. jobs.title: Sr AI Architect/Engineer
jobs.description: An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence! **Overview** ------------ Researches, designs, plans, develops and/or evaluates new, advanced network technologies by translating customer requirements or strategic business objectives into final product design. Work typically includes in\-depth assessment of the customer’s networked application needs, providing network modeling and simulation testing, consulting to further clarify needs, and engineering high\-speed technology network transports to deliver application functionality.**Responsibilities** -------------------- **Why this role exists** ======================== TNS is moving from AI governance and foundations into execution. The platform building blocks are in place or underway — Microsoft 365, Copilot, Entra ID, SharePoint, and Anthropic's Claude models via AWS Bedrock. What we don't yet have is a dedicated person who can both **build and operate the secure, production\-grade AI platform that lets AI work safely against our data** *and* **embed with our lines of business to turn that capability into measurable value.** This role does both. You'll be the technical engine and the on\-the\-ground partner who makes AI a productive, trusted tool across the enterprise — and who multiplies that impact by enabling others to build, not just building yourself. **What you'll do** ================== Your time will span two connected halves. **Build and operate the AI platform** ------------------------------------- **Model platform and private hosting.** Own our Claude deployment on AWS Bedrock end to end — model access and versioning, region and data\-residency decisions, provisioned throughput vs. on\-demand, and the private, VPC\-isolated hosting posture that keeps our data inside our boundary and out of third\-party training. Evaluate and manage additional models where they fit, and maintain a routing layer so applications aren't hard\-wired to a single model or provider. **Harness and orchestration management.** Build and maintain the application harness that sits between our users and the models: prompt and context management, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, guardrails and content filtering, caching, and fallback behavior. Own the evaluation harness too — regression suites, quality benchmarks, and the release process that lets us upgrade models without breaking what's in production. **Data connectivity.** Design and build secure, governed connections between AI systems and TNS data — Microsoft 365 and Graph, SharePoint, databases, data warehouses, APIs, and line\-of\-business systems. Own the retrieval architecture, indexing and freshness strategy, and the permission\-trimming that ensures every user sees only what they're entitled to see, with no leakage across boundaries. **Security and access control.** Architect least\-privilege access across identity, network, and data layers — IAM and Entra ID, private networking, encryption and key management, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. Defend against AI\-specific threats: prompt injection, data exfiltration through model outputs, insecure tool use, and over\-permissioned agents. Partner with security and governance so every deployment is auditable and compliant by design, with a full audit trail of prompts, outputs, and data access. **Monitoring and observability.** Instrument the platform for production operations — latency, error rates, throughput and quota headroom, output quality and drift, guardrail trips, and anomalous usage. Build the dashboards and alerting that let us find problems before users do, and the usage telemetry that tells us which solutions are actually delivering value. **Cost management.** Own AI spend as a first\-class engineering concern: token\-level cost attribution by application and line of business, budgets and alerting, model right\-sizing (using the cheapest model that meets the quality bar), prompt caching and context optimization, batch processing where latency allows, and provisioned\-throughput decisions. Produce the chargeback and unit\-economics reporting leadership needs to fund the portfolio with confidence. **Reusable foundations.** Turn all of the above into patterns, templates, and guardrails so each new use case is faster, cheaper, and safer to build than the last. **Ship value with the business (forward\-deployed engineering)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Embed directly with teams across our lines of business (Communications, Waypoint, Payments, Corporate/Shared) to identify high\-value AI and automation opportunities. * Prototype quickly, validate with real users, and take the strongest ideas to production. * Drive adoption — measure whether solutions are actually used and delivering value, and iterate until they are. * Enable others: seed and support a networ urable value — reduced cost to serve, shorter cycle times, and volume absorbed without added headcount. * Establish a use\-case intake and prioritization process so demand is triaged by value rather than by who asks loudest. * Deliver AI cost transparency and attribution by application and line of business. * Enable at least one capable AI champion in each line of business. **What you bring (required)** ============================= * Strong software / solutions engineering background with hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI/LLM applications — RAG, agents, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation. * Direct experience with a managed model platform in production; **AWS Bedrock strongly preferred**, along with the surrounding AWS estate (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudWatch, PrivateLink). * Demonstrated ability to build and operate data connectivity to enterprise systems with permission\-aware retrieval. * Working command of enterprise security and data governance: identity and access, data protection, encryption and key management, and AI\-specific threat models. * Production operations instincts — you instrument what you build, and you've owned the monitoring and on\-call reality of a live system. * Cost discipline: you treat inference spend as an engineering constraint and can show where the money goes. * Genuine business fluency and communication skills — you're comfortable sitting with finance, operations, or sales, understanding their problems, and translating them into solutions. * A demonstrated bias toward shipping and adoption, not just building demos. **Nice to have** ================ * Depth in the Microsoft / Azure ecosystem alongside AWS (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Entra ID, SharePoint / Graph) — our environment spans both. * Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive industry — payments, telecom, or financial data. * Self\-hosted or fine\-tuned model experience, and a clear view of when it beats a managed API. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD for AI systems (Terraform, pipelines, automated evals in the release path). * Change\-management or internal\-consulting experience. * Prior forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineering experience. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Who you are** =============== The rare blend of builder and partner. You carry the technical depth of a staff engineer and the people instincts of an internal consultant. You're energized by variety — a private\-networking and key\-management problem in the morning, a finance\-team workflow in the afternoon. You measure yourself by value delivered and adopted, not lines of code. You teach and multiply rather than hoard knowledge. And you operate with ownership: when a deployment is struggling or a cost\-line spikes, you own the fix. **How your success is measured** ================================ In short: reduced cost to serve on named processes, use cases shipped and *sustained* in production, adoption across lines of business, champions enabled, platform reliability and cost\-per\-unit\-of\-value, and a clean security and governance record. For this role, we anticipate paying $150,000 \- $250,000 annually. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package including medical and dental coverage, life insurance, paid holidays and vacations, and a 401K plan with company match. If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about! TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server hosted in Azure, and other approved cloud database technologies. * Support Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, and resiliency, and cost\-optimization controls for cloud data environments. * Evaluate cloud data architectures for scalability, performance, availability, recoverability, supportability, and cost efficiency. **Data Architecture and Integration** * Review application, database, reporting, analytics, and integration designs for alignment with enter ity controls, privileged access, and access\-review processes. * Experience supporting regulated or compliance\-driven environments and sensitive data. * Experience developing technical documentation, operating procedures, recovery plans, and support standards. **Preferred:*** Student loan industry experience. * Hands\-on IBM Db2 administration experience. * Hands\-on Microsoft SQL Server administration experience. * Experience solutions. * Experience supporting audits, security assessments, vulnerability remediation, access reviews, and disaster recovery exercises. **Licenses or Certifications** **Required:** None required **Preferred:** * Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate. * Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate or successor data\-engineering certification. * Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate. * Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals or Azure Data Fundamentals. * IBM Db2 Database Administrator certification or comparable IBM certification. * Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP). **Work Environment** * Work is performed in an office and/or approved remote\-work environment. * The office work environment is climate controlled with no substantial exposure to adverse environmental conditions. * The position may require scheduled after\-hours maintenance, participation in an on\-call rotation, and support during incidents or disaster jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **SENIOR MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER IV** At Trilliant Health, we help hospitals and healthcare systems make smarter, data\-driven decisions in an increasingly complex healthcare environment. Our teams combine healthcare data, analytics, machine learning and AI to create products that help healthcare leaders understand what is happening in their markets and act with confidence. **About the Role** We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer IV to join our Machine Learning (ML) team and help build the models, systems, and software that power Trilliant Health’s machine learning and AI capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role combining hands\-on machine learning, software engineering, and technical leadership. We prefer simple solutions over complex ones, and we document what we build and how it works. **Our Stack** Our stack is built around Python, which we manage with uv in a monorepo. Most of our heavy computation runs as jobs on Kubernetes, where we increasingly favor DuckDB and Parquet, though some of our pipelines still run on Spark and Databricks. We build our models with libraries including scikit\-learn, XGBoost, and PyTorch, and our newer LLM\-based systems with LangChain. Our services and internal web applications use FastAPI and NiceGUI, several of them backed by SQLite, and we deploy everything to Azure. Every change runs through pre\-commit hooks, static type checking, and automated tests before it merges. We also publish several of our core libraries as open source on PyPI and GitHub. **What We’re Looking For** **Education \& Experience** * 8\+ years of professional experience in machine learning, software engineering, data science, or a closely related technical discipline, with significant hands\-on experience building production ML systems * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field or equivalent professional experience * Demonstrated experience taking ownership of significant ML initiatives and influencing technical decisions across teams * Demonstrated willingness to speak up, challenge assumptions, and advocate for sound technical or modeling decisions. * Experience working collaboratively across engineering and cross\-functional teams **Machine Learning \& Data Science** * Strong understanding of predictive modeling and machine learning techniques * Experience selecting, developing, evaluating, and improving ML models * Understanding of statistics, experimentation, and model evaluation * Experience working with large, complex datasets * Experience developing ML workflows from experimentation through production **Software Engineering** * Strong, hands\-on Python development experience, including writing production\-quality, maintainable, and well\-tested code * Experience developing and maintaining distributed data pipelines * Experience with SQL and relational databases * Experience with CI/CD, Python packaging, and software deployment * Proficiency with Git and modern version\-control practices * Strong familiarity with Linux and command\-line tools * Ability to write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-tested code * Experience using AI coding agents and reviewing, testing, and improving agent\-generated code **Nice to Have** * Experience building, evaluating, or deploying LLM\-based or other AI systems * Experience with Healthcare claims data * Experience with entity resolution/record linkage * Experience with Spark or similar compute frameworks * Open\-source contributions If you don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. **Why Join Trilliant Health?** You’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, data, software engineering, and machine learning, building technology that helps healthcare organizations make better decisions. You’ll also have a meaningful opportunity to influence technical direction, work on challenging data problems, and collaborate with a highly talented team that values curiosity, ownership, deep listening, and effective communication. **Benefits** * Comprehensive health benefits package * 401(k) plan * Flexible PTO * Equity **Please Note** Trilliant Health is **unable** to provide visa sponsorship for this position. **How to Apply:** If this opportunity sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you! **Please submit your application directly through Indeed to be considered for this position.** Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Director, Data Center & Network Engineering
jobs.description: Truliant’s mission is to improve lives by putting our members first, providing great service and straightforward financial solutions. Our core values of Member Focus, Service, Guidance, Relationships, and Community define how we interact with members to fulfill our mission of improving lives and providing a foundation on which we conduct ourselves. Our Promise to Our Teammates: Truliant strives to provide all teammates with an enjoyable place to work where they feel valued, empowered and rewarded for all that they do. **Why this role matters** At Truliant Federal Credit Union, reliable and secure technology helps our teams serve members with confidence. As Director of IT Data Center and Network Engineering, you’ll shape the strategy behind our data center, cloud, network, and telecom environments while ensuring they can scale with the business. This is an opportunity for a technology leader who enjoys building strong teams, modernizing complex infrastructure, and turning long\-term strategy into dependable day\-to\-day performance. **What you’ll do** In this role, you’ll lead the teams and strategy responsible for Truliant’s core infrastructure. You’ll balance operational stability, security, scalability, and cost while advancing cloud\-first capabilities and keeping technology aligned with business priorities. Day to day, you’ll: * Guide the design, deployment, and ongoing performance of data center, cloud, network, telecom, storage, compute, backup, LAN, SD\-WAN, and related infrastructure. * Build and develop high\-performing engineering teams while overseeing staffing, coaching, priorities, delivery methods, and operational results. * Partner with executives, business leaders, Risk, Legal, Vendor Management, and strategic sourcing to guide roadmaps, budgets, vendor relationships, contracts, governance, and disaster recovery readiness. Beyond that, you’ll identify opportunities to automate and simplify work, review operational and risk metrics, influence enterprise technology decisions, and serve as an escalation point when teams need a practical path forward. **What you bring** We’re looking for a strategic, hands\-on technology leader who can connect infrastructure decisions to business outcomes, communicate clearly with technical and executive audiences, and create an environment where teams can do their best work. This role is a great fit if you have: **Required Experience:** * 8\+ years of equivalent IT work experience. * 5\+ years of demonstrated leadership experience in a related IT role within a medium\-to\-large enterprise, including on\-premises infrastructure and outsourced or cloud services. * 5\+ years of experience in technology procurement and asset tracking. * At least 1 year of experience in each of the following: application support for internally developed and third\-party solutions; modern on\-premises and cloud infrastructure planning and implementation; and hands\-on software, hardware, and data management troubleshooting. **Required Skills:** * Lead infrastructure strategy, technical project implementation, and engineering delivery using waterfall, agile, or hybrid approaches. * Apply operational knowledge of SD\-WAN, VPN, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPSec, firewalls, routing, and switching. * Apply operational knowledge of telephony technologies, including SIP, VoIP, SBC, unified communications, call processing, automated attendants, ACD queues, and skill assignments. * Administer and manage licensing for VMware vCenter, vSphere ESXi, VMware Horizon VDI, and supporting products. * Work with cloud computing protocols and standards across Azure, AWS, or GCP, and support infrastructure decisions spanning on\-premises and cloud environments. * Interpret technical documentation, research technology issues, analyze complex problems, and implement practical efficiency improvements. * Manage budgets, capacity, vendors, contracts, risk considerations, and executive\-level operational reporting. * Communicate clearly in English, verbally and in writing, and translate technical priorities for executives, department leaders, engineers, and business partners. **Education/Certifications:** * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or a related field, or a Bachelor of Arts degree. You should also be comfortable making independent decisions, adjusting resources and priorities as needs change, working with minimal supervision, and maintaining a strong commitment to excellent member service. **What sets you apart** You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role: * Experience shaping disaster recovery strategy across network, telecom, on\-premises, and cloud environments. * Exposure to infrastructure that supports robotic process automation, advanced data analytics, or artificial intelligence capabilities. * Experience contributing to enterprise technology governance, long\-range cloud planning, or cross\-functional roadmap decisions. **What you’ll get** We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. In this role, you can expect: * A visible leadership opportunity to shape infrastructure strategy that supports Truliant’s member\-focused mission. * The chance to modernize a broad technology environment spanning data center, cloud, network, telecom, disaster recovery, and emerging capabilities. * Meaningful partnership with executive leaders and teams across the credit union, with the ability to influence priorities and long\-term decisions. * Opportunities to grow leaders, strengthen engineering practices, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * A comprehensive benefits package and a workplace focused on professional development, reliable service, and the success of both members and team members. **Ready to apply?** If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant! As a member of the Truliant family, you will enjoy the following full time benefits: * No\-cost employee Medical, dental, vision coverage * Prescription benefits (including mail order) * Paid holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) plan with contribution matching * Paid community involvement volunteers hours * Paid group life Insurance * Teammate loan discounts * Tuition reimbursement * Short and long\-term disability * Health \& Wellness program * Teledoc (physician video conferencing) * Onsite fitness facilities or health club reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Medical flexible spending account * Dependent care flexible spending account

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Data Engineer will be responsible for a wide variety of tasks which include all aspects of the development and delivery of data solutions and maintaining the enterprise data warehouse. You will work closely with business analysts, product managers, quality assurance and business stakeholders to effectively implement data solutions. This role will be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, optimizing performance of database environments and automating data processes. Responsibilities * Develop and deliver data solutions that comply with development standards. * Maintaining a relational database schema. This includes defining tables, relationships and constraints to ensure data integrity. * Build automated processes to Extract, Transform and Load data from various sources into a centralized data warehouse. * Optimizing complex SQL queries, indexing strategies and execution plans to handle large datasets efficiently. * Effectively assist in day\-to\-day tasks / activities in coordination with a team of developers to effectively meet the deliverables and schedule of a data solution component within a larger application project. * Lend support to various business and technology teams as necessary during design, development and delivery to ensure solid, scalable, robust data solutions. * Support and maintain data and database systems to meet business delivery specifications and needs. * Exceptional oral and written communication skills, facilitating effective cross\-functional collaboration. Qualifications **Required:** * 5\+ years proven experience in * A data\-centric role within a collaborative data and technology team * Writing and optimizing complex SQL queries to extract large datasets * Using data transformation tools like SSIS * Advanced SQL knowledge and proficiency in working with relational databases * Hands\-on experience with data warehouse solutions * Proficiency with the SQL query language, preferably Microsoft T\-SQL. * Strong understanding of data modeling and best practices in data governance. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively to resolve data\-related issues. * In lieu of education the following equivalent experience will be accepted: development life cycle of projects lasting longer than two years, requirements gathering, business and technical designs, development, quality assurance, deployment, support and documentation. * Must be flexible, action and results oriented, self\-starting, have strong analytical skills, and be comfortable with a Microsoft SQL business intelligence environment * Familiarity with financial and/or mortgage servicing data but not mandatory **Preferred:** * Experience in Azure Data Factory * Experience in Active Batch scheduling software * Experience in Snowflake All fulltime employees of Two Harbors and its subsidiary companies are eligible for our benefits which include: * Medical / Dental / Vision Insurance * Life / Disability Insurance * 401(k) with company matching * Generous Vacation / Paid Time Off (accrual based) * Targeted Compensation: $95,000\-$120,000 Physical Demands \& Working Conditions The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job: * The employee is regularly required to talk or hear. * The employee is required to sit for extended periods of time and is occasionally required to stand and walk. * The employee must regularly use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects and is regularly required to reach with hands and arms; the employee may occasionally climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. * The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. * The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate, and no extreme conditions are present. About RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing LLC RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing LLC is a fully integrated, non\-bank mortgage company, with a subservicing portfolio of approximately 900,000 loans. In 2023, RoundPoint was acquired by Two Harbors Investment Corp. (NYSE: TWO), reaffirming its commitment to MSR as core and essential to our business strategy and our future. A combined Two Harbors and RoundPoint capitalizes on the strengths of both companies, adding significant value for stakeholders through operational and cost efficiencies, as well as the ability to participate more fully in the mortgage finance space as opportunities arise. Founded in 2009, Two Harbors has grown into a leading publicly traded residential mortgage real estate investment trust (mortgage REIT). We leverage our core competencies of understanding and managing interest rate and prepayment risk to invest in our Agency residential mortgage\-backed securities (RMBS) and mortgage servicing rights (MSR) portfolio, with the objective of delivering attractive risk\-adjusted returns to our stockholders. Location * St. Louis Park ,MN Employee Status * Regular Travel * No

You will need to move the needle for the business by building systems that are not only highly available and reliable but also developer\-friendly, enabling rapid innovation across ML and Product teams.  ion (PSA) tool * Design and deploy company LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including servers, routers, firewalls, load balancers hubs, switches, UPSs, and other hardware * Configures, tests, and jobs.title: Senior Director, Finance AI SME, FP&A and Forecasting Transformation - Eden Prairie, MN preferred, Remote considered
jobs.description: UnitedHealth Group is a health care and well\-being company that's dedicated to improving the health outcomes of millions around the world. We are comprised of two distinct and complementary businesses, UnitedHealthcare and Optum, working to build a better health system for all. Here, your contributions matter as they will help transform health care for years to come. Make an impact with a team that shares your passion for helping others. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people\-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** The Senior Director, Finance AI SME, FP\&A and Forecasting Transformation will serve as a senior finance subject matter expert embedded within Finance AI transformation pods. This leader will partner closely with Finance, Data, Technology, Risk and Controls, and business stakeholders to blueprint current\-state and future\-state finance processes, translate business requirements into agent\-ready workflows, and help develop proof\-of\-concept AI systems that can be validated, governed, and scaled. This role is designed for a senior finance leader with deep FP\&A and forecasting experience who can bridge the gap between business finance and technical delivery teams. The individual will bring practical expertise in enterprise forecasting, variance analysis, financial planning, driver\-based modeling, performance reporting, and executive decision support. The role requires the ability to understand how finance work is performed today, identify where AI and automation can materially improve speed, quality, controls, and insight, and help convert future\-state designs into tangible AI\-enabled solutions. The Senior Director will operate in a cross\-functional pod model, working side by side with data engineers, solution architects, forward deployed engineers, AI/ML resources, risk and controls partners, and business finance leaders. The person will not simply advise from the sidelines. They will be expected to lead hands\-on blueprinting sessions, define use\-case requirements, pressure\-test data and control assumptions, validate prototype outputs, and ensure that AI systems are solving real finance problems in a way that is accurate, explainable, auditable, and adoptable. The purpose of this role is to provide senior\-level FP\&A and forecasting expertise to Finance AI pods that are redesigning core finance processes and developing proof\-of\-concept AI systems. The Senior Director will help move Finance from periodic, manual, and fragmented forecasting and analysis processes toward more continuous, driver\-based, data\-enabled, and AI\-supported decision intelligence. The role will focus on three integrated mandates: * Blueprint the current state. Understand and document existing FP\&A and forecasting activities, including process flows, data inputs, handoffs, manual workarounds, estimation methods, controls, outputs, and decision points * Design the future state. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define how forecasting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, performance reporting, and decision support should operate when AI, data, controls, and human judgment are designed together from the beginning * Develop and validate AI proof\-of\-concept systems. Translate finance requirements into clear prototype designs, partner with data and technology teams during development, validate outputs against business expectations, and help determine whether POCs should be killed, refined, scaled, or transitioned to the AI Factory for productization You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week. **Primary Responsibilities:** Finance SME Leadership in Pod Delivery * Serve as a senior Finance SME within cross\-functional Finance AI pods focused on FP\&A, forecasting, performance reporting, and decision intelligence * Partner with pod leads, business finance leaders, data teams, solution architects, and engineering resources to define the business problem, target outcomes, scope, requirements, and success criteria for each POC * Bring practical FP\&A judgment to AI design decisions, ensuring prototypes reflect how finance leaders actually forecast, analyze, explain, and make decisions * Act as the translator between finance users and technical teams, converting business needs into clear, testable requirements for AI\-enabled workflows * Help ensure pod work remains focused on high\-value finance problems rather than disconnected technology experimentation Current\-State Blueprinting * Lead structured blueprinting sessions with Finance, business, data, and technology stakeholders to map current\-state forecasting and FP\&A processes * Document key process steps, business owners, data sources, systems, handoffs, manual workarounds, spreads river\-based forecasting, P\&L analysis, business metrics, executive reporting, and financial planning processes * Experience working across business, finance, technology, and data teams to deliver process improvement, automation, analytics, or transformation initiatives * Ability to map complex current\-state processes and translate them into simplified future\-state operating models * Proven solid analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate data quality, process gaps, business logic, and control implications * Proven solid executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex issues, frame trade\-offs, and make clear recommendations * Ability to operate in ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and move work forward across a matrixed organization * Proven high degree of ownership, urgency, judgment, and attention to detail **Preferred Qualifications:** * MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced finance, accounting, or analytics credential * Experience with AI, machine learning, automation, analytics products, data products, or digital finance transformation * Experience with Oracle EPM, enterprise planning tools, data visualization platforms, financial data marts, Snowflake, Azure, or related enterprise data environments * Experience designing or implementing driver\-based forecasting, rolling forecasts, scenario modeling, or advanced business performance analytics * Experience supporting finance transformation in a regulated environment with SOX, SEC reporting, audit, model governance, or other control considerations * Familiarity with agentic AI concepts, LLM\-enabled workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt evaluation, and AI output validation * Experience working in a product\-oriented or agile delivery model, including POCs, pilots, MVPs, product roadmaps, and adoption measurement * All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $159,300 \- $273,200 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.
